jobs.title: Head of Product, Solution & Segment Marketing

titleByLocale.en: Head of Product, Solution & Segment Marketing

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Join Sulzer’s global Marketing team and shape how a CHF 3.5 billion industrial leader positions its solutions across the world’s most critical markets.
We are seeking a senior and strategic Head of Product & Solution Marketing to lead how Sulzer’s portfolio of pumps, separation technologies, services and sustainability solutions is positioned and activated globally. This role will drive commercial growth by developing compelling value propositions, leading go-to-market strategy and enabling Sales across Flow, Services and Chemtech.

You will own the product marketing agenda — spanning portfolio positioning, solution launches, sales enablement and market intelligence — while building a high-performing team and embedding a customer-centric, insight-driven culture across the marketing function.
In this role you will be accountable for:

Product & Solution Marketing Strategy and Plan

• Define and own the global product and solution marketing strategy, aligned with Sulzer’s corporate strategy and divisional and BU priorities across Flow, Services and Chemtech

• Develop clear value propositions and positioning frameworks for core product lines including pumps, separation technologies, rotating equipment services, bioplastics (PLA) and digital monitoring

• Lead One Sulzer targeting for priority verticals: water/wastewater, oil & gas, chemical processing, energy, food & beverage, and green hydrogen

• Translate Sulzer’s sustainability narrative — decarbonisation, green hydrogen, CCUS, circular economy — into credible, differentiated market positioning

Marketing Execution

• Lead the marketing of solution launch plans for new products, technologies and market entries, coordinating across divisions, regions and functions

• Ensure consistent and compelling positioning across all customer-facing channels: digital, events, sales tools, technical literature and campaigns

• Partner with Sales and Commercial Excellence to develop sales enablement materials, competitive battlecards, customer case studies, ROI tools and technical value-selling content

• Drive differentiated messaging for Sulzer’s aftermarket and service offerings, leveraging the expanding global service network and long-term customer partnerships

• Define yearly marketing plans and lead execution of marketing campaigns in alignment w regional and digital marketing

Marketing Insights

• Work closely with Product Management to influence roadmap priorities based on market trends, customer needs and competitive dynamics

• Monitor developments in decarbonisation, industrial digitalisation and sustainable process technologies to identify positioning opportunities

Team Leadership & Capability Development

• Lead, inspire and develop a team of product and solution marketers across geographies, fostering a culture of commercial creativity, analytical rigour and customer centricity

• Set clear goals, KPIs and development plans for direct reports; build capability in product storytelling, digital marketing and data-driven decision-making

• Establish best-practice processes for product launch, content development and campaign execution across divisions

Stakeholder Engagement & Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Act as the key marketing interface with Division Presidents, BU & Region Heads, VP Sales and Product Management leaders across Flow, Services and Chemtech

• Work closely with Corporate Communications to integrate product and solution narratives into employer brand, investor messaging and corporate reputation activities

• Collaborate with Digital Marketing and Regional marketing to ensure solution content is optimised for digital channels, SEO and lead generation; manage external agencies and specialist content partners

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile.

Informazioni sul ruolo

Unisciti al team di Marketing globale di Sulzer e plasma come un leader industriale di CHF 3,5 miliardi posiziona le sue soluzioni nei mercati più critici del mondo.
Siamo alla ricerca di un Head of Product & Solution Marketing senior e strategico per guidare come il portafoglio di pompe, tecnologie di separazione, servizi e soluzioni di sostenibilità sia posizionato e attivato a livello globale. Questo ruolo spingerà la crescita commerciale sviluppando proposizioni di valore convincenti, leader strategia di go-to-market e consentendo vendite attraverso Flow, Services e Chemtech.

Possiederai l'agenda di marketing del prodotto: posizionamento del portafoglio, lancio di soluzioni, abilitazione delle vendite e intelligenza di mercato, mentre costruirai un team altamente performante e incorporerai una cultura orientata al cliente attraverso la funzionalità di marketing.
In questo ruolo sarete responsabili per:

Strategia di marketing e piano di prodotto e soluzioni

• Definire e possedere la strategia globale di marketing di prodotti e soluzioni, allineato con la strategia aziendale di Sulzer e le priorità divisionali e BU su Flow, Services e Chemtech

• Sviluppare proposizioni di valore chiare e quadri di posizionamento per linee di prodotti principali tra cui pompe, tecnologie di separazione, servizi di apparecchiature rotanti, bioplastiche (PLA) e monitoraggio digitale

• Piombo Uno Sulzer mirante per i verticali prioritari: acqua/acqua, petrolio e gas, lavorazione chimica, energia, cibo e bevande, e idrogeno verde

• Tradurre la narrativa di sostenibilità di Sulzer — decarbonizzazione, idrogeno verde, CCUS, economia circolare — in posizione di mercato credibile e differenziato

Esecuzione del marketing

• Guidare la commercializzazione dei piani di lancio di soluzioni per nuovi prodotti, tecnologie e voci di mercato, coordinando tra divisioni, regioni e funzioni

• Assicurare un posizionamento coerente e convincente in tutti i canali di customer-facing: digitale, eventi, strumenti di vendita, letteratura tecnica e campagne

• Partner con Vendite ed Eccellenza Commerciale per sviluppare materiali di abilitazione delle vendite, cartoline da battaglia competitive, studi sui casi dei clienti, strumenti ROI e contenuti tecnici di vendita del valore

• Guida messaggi differenziati per le offerte di post-vendita e servizi di Sulzer, sfruttando l'espansione della rete di servizi globale e partnership con clienti a lungo termine

• Definire piani di marketing annuali e condurre l'esecuzione di campagne di marketing in allineamento con il marketing regionale e digitale

Insights di marketing

• Lavorare a stretto contatto con la Product Management per influenzare le priorità della roadmap in base alle tendenze del mercato, alle esigenze dei clienti e alle dinamiche competitive

• Monitorare gli sviluppi della decarbonizzazione, della digitalizzazione industriale e delle tecnologie di processo sostenibili per individuare le opportunità di posizionamento

Leadership del team & Capability Development

• Leader, ispirare e sviluppare un team di marketing di prodotti e soluzioni attraverso geografie, promuovendo una cultura della creatività commerciale, rigore analitico e centricità dei clienti

• Impostare obiettivi chiari, KPI e piani di sviluppo per rapporti diretti; costruire capacità nella narrazione dei prodotti, nel marketing digitale e nel processo decisionale basato sui dati

• Stabilire processi best practice per il lancio del prodotto, lo sviluppo dei contenuti e l'esecuzione delle campagne attraverso le divisioni

Stakeholder Engagement & Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Atto come l'interfaccia di marketing chiave con i presidenti di Divisione, i capi BU & Region, i leader VP Sales e Product Management di Flow, Services e Chemtech

• Lavorare a stretto contatto con Corporate Communications per integrare le narrazioni di prodotto e di soluzione nel marchio datore di lavoro, messaggistica degli investitori e attività di reputazione aziendale

• Collaborare con Digital Marketing e Regional Marketing per garantire che i contenuti delle soluzioni siano ottimizzati per i canali digitali, SEO e lead generation; gestire agenzie esterne e partner specializzati

Per avere successo in questo ruolo, y

descriptionByLocale.de:
Sulzer ist ein führendes Ingenieurunternehmen mit einem stolzen Erbe an Innovationen. Schließen Sie sich unserem globalen Team an, um Ihr Fachwissen zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine wohlhabende und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen.

Über die Rolle

Schließen Sie sich dem globalen Marketing-Team von Sulzer an und gestalten Sie, wie ein Branchenführer von CHF 3,5 Milliarden seine Lösungen in den wichtigsten Märkten der Welt positioniert.
Wir suchen einen leitenden und strategischen Leiter des Produkt- und Lösungsmarketings, der die Positionierung und Aktivierung des Sulzer-Portfolios von Pumpen, Trenntechnologien, Dienstleistungen und Nachhaltigkeitslösungen weltweit übernimmt. Diese Rolle wird das kommerzielle Wachstum vorantreiben, indem sie überzeugende Wertversprechen entwickelt, die Go-to-Market-Strategie anführt und den Vertrieb in Flow, Services und Chemtech ermöglicht.

Sie werden die Produktmarketing-Agenda besitzen - Portfoliopositionierung, Lösungsstarts, Sales Enablement und Market Intelligence - während Sie ein leistungsstarkes Team aufbauen und eine kundenzentrierte, aufschlussreiche Kultur in der gesamten Marketingfunktion einbetten.
In dieser Rolle sind Sie verantwortlich für:

Product & Solution Marketing Strategie und Plan

• Definieren und besitzen Sie die globale Produkt- und Lösungsmarketingstrategie, die auf die Unternehmensstrategie von Sulzer und die Prioritäten von Divisionen und BU in Flow, Services und Chemtech ausgerichtet ist

• Entwicklung klarer Wertversprechen und Positionierungsrahmen für Kernproduktlinien wie Pumpen, Trenntechnologien, Dienstleistungen für rotierende Geräte, Biokunststoffe (PLA) und digitale Überwachung

• Lead One Sulzer Targeting für prioritäre Vertikalen: Wasser / Abwasser, Öl & Gas, chemische Verarbeitung, Energie, Lebensmittel & Getränke und grüner Wasserstoff

• Übersetzen Sie Sulzers Nachhaltigkeitsnarrativ – Dekarbonisierung, grüner Wasserstoff, CCUS, Kreislaufwirtschaft – in eine glaubwürdige, differenzierte Marktpositionierung

Marketingausführung

• Führen Sie die Vermarktung von Lösungs-Launch-Plänen für neue Produkte, Technologien und Markteintritte und koordinieren Sie sie über Abteilungen, Regionen und Funktionen hinweg

• Gewährleistung einer konsistenten und überzeugenden Positionierung über alle kundenorientierten Kanäle hinweg: Digital, Events, Verkaufstools, technische Literatur und Kampagnen

• Partnerschaft mit Sales and Commercial Excellence zur Entwicklung von Sales Enablement-Materialien, Wettbewerbsschlachtkarten, Kundenfallstudien, ROI-Tools und technischen Value-Selling-Inhalten

• Fördern Sie differenziertes Messaging für Sulzers Aftermarket- und Serviceangebote, indem Sie das expandierende globale Servicenetzwerk und langfristige Kundenpartnerschaften nutzen

• Definieren Sie jährliche Marketingpläne und führen Sie die Durchführung von Marketingkampagnen in Abstimmung mit regionalen und digitalen Marketing

Marketing Insights

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Produktmanagement, um die Roadmap-Prioritäten basierend auf Markttrends, Kundenbedürfnissen und Wettbewerbsdynamik zu beeinflussen

• Beobachtung der Entwicklungen in den Bereichen Dekarbonisierung, industrielle Digitalisierung und nachhaltige Prozesstechnologien zur Identifizierung von Positionierungsmöglichkeiten

Team Leadership & Capability Development

• Führen, inspirieren und entwickeln Sie ein Team von Produkt- und Lösungsvermarktern in allen Regionen und fördern Sie eine Kultur der kommerziellen Kreativität, analytischer Strenge und Kundenorientierung

• Setzen Sie klare Ziele, KPIs und Entwicklungspläne für direkte Berichte; Aufbau von Fähigkeiten im Bereich Produkt-Storytelling, digitales Marketing und datengesteuerte Entscheidungsfindung

• Etablierung von Best-Practice-Prozessen für Produkt-Launch, Content-Entwicklung und Kampagnenausführung über Abteilungen hinweg

Stakeholder-Engagement und funktionsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit

• Handeln Sie als zentrale Marketingschnittstelle mit Division Presidents, BU & Region Heads, VP Sales und Product Management Leaders in Flow, Services und Chemtech

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Corporate Communications, um Produkt- und Lösungsnarrative in Employer Brand, Investor Messaging und Corporate Reputation Aktivitäten zu integrieren

• Zusammenarbeit mit Digitalem Marketing und Regionalem Marketing, um sicherzustellen, dass Lösungsinhalte für digitale Kanäle, SEO und Leadgenerierung optimiert werden; Verwaltung externer Agenturen und spezialisierter Content-Partner

Um in dieser Rolle erfolgreich zu sein, y
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable.

Sur le rôle

Rejoignez l'équipe mondiale de marketing de Sulzer et façonnez comment un leader industriel de 3,5 milliards de CHF positionne ses solutions à travers le monde les marchés les plus critiques.
Nous recherchons un responsable principal et stratégique du marketing de produits et de solutions pour montrer comment le portefeuille de pompes, de technologies de séparation, de services et de solutions durables est positionné et activé à l'échelle mondiale. Ce rôle stimulera la croissance commerciale en élaborant des propositions de valeur convaincantes, en menant une stratégie d'accès au marché et en permettant la vente à travers Flow, Services et Chemtech.

Vous serez propriétaire de l'agenda de marketing de produits - en couvrant le positionnement de portefeuille, le lancement de solutions, l'activation des ventes et l'intelligence du marché - tout en construisant une équipe hautement performante et en intégrant une culture axée sur le client, axée sur la perspicacité dans toute la fonction marketing.
Dans ce rôle, vous serez responsable :

Stratégie et plan de commercialisation des produits et des solutions

• Définir et posséder la stratégie de marketing globale des produits et des solutions, alignée sur la stratégie d'entreprise de Sulzer et les priorités de division et de BU dans Flow, Services et Chemtech

• Élaborer des propositions de valeur claires et des cadres de positionnement pour les lignes de produits de base, y compris les pompes, les technologies de séparation, les services d'équipement rotatif, les bioplastiques (PLA) et la surveillance numérique

• Lead One Sulzer cible les verticales prioritaires: eau/eaux usées, pétrole et gaz, traitement chimique, énergie, aliments et boissons, et hydrogène vert

• Traduire le récit de la durabilité de Sulzer, décarbonisation, hydrogène vert, CCUS, économie circulaire, en positionnement crédible et différencié du marché

Mise en marché

• Diriger la commercialisation des plans de lancement de solutions pour les nouveaux produits, technologies et entrées sur le marché, en coordonnant les divisions, les régions et les fonctions

• Assurer un positionnement cohérent et convaincant sur tous les canaux orientés vers le client : numérique, événements, outils de vente, littérature technique et campagnes

• Partenaire avec Sales and Commercial Excellence pour développer des matériaux d'habilitation de vente, des cartes de combat compétitives, des études de cas clients, des outils ROI et des contenus de vente à valeur technique

• Lancer des messages différenciés pour les offres de services et de services après-vente de Sulzer, en tirant parti de l'expansion du réseau mondial de services et des partenariats avec les clients à long terme

• Définir des plans de commercialisation annuels et mener des campagnes de commercialisation en alignement w marketing régional et numérique

Perspectives commerciales

• Collaborer étroitement avec la gestion des produits pour influencer les priorités de la feuille de route en fonction des tendances du marché, des besoins des clients et de la dynamique concurrentielle

• Surveiller l'évolution des technologies de décarbonisation, de numérisation industrielle et de procédés durables pour identifier les possibilités de positionnement

Leadership d'équipe et développement des capacités

• Diriger, inspirer et développer une équipe de marketing de produits et de solutions à travers les géographies, favorisant une culture de créativité commerciale, de rigueur analytique et de centricité client

• Établir des objectifs clairs, des ICR et des plans de développement pour les rapports directs; renforcer les capacités en matière de contes de produits, de marketing numérique et de prise de décisions axées sur les données

• Mettre en place des processus de pratiques exemplaires pour le lancement de produits, l'élaboration de contenus et l'exécution de campagnes entre les divisions

Engagement des intervenants et collaboration intersectorielle

• Agir comme interface marketing clé avec les Présidents de Division, les Chefs de Région, les Chefs de Ventes et de Gestion de Produits VP à travers Flow, Services et Chemtech

• Collaborer étroitement avec Communications corporatives pour intégrer les narrations de produits et de solutions dans les activités de marque de l'employeur, de messagerie des investisseurs et de réputation de l'entreprise

• Collaborer avec le marketing numérique et le marketing régional pour optimiser le contenu de la solution pour les canaux numériques, le référencement et la production de pointe; gérer les agences externes et les partenaires de contenu spécialisés

Pour réussir dans ce rôle, y

jobs.title: HR Administration & Payroll Manager
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The HR Administration & Payroll Manager is responsible for leading and overseeing all HR administrative processes and end-to-end payroll operations for Switzerland. This role ensures full compliance with Swiss labor law, social security regulations, tax obligations, and internal policies. The position acts as the primary point of contact for HR operations, employee lifecycle administration, payroll accuracy, and HR system integrity. The role needs hands-on execution, ensuring efficient HR processes and high-quality service delivery to employees and managers.
Your main tasks and responsibilities

Payroll Management (Swiss Payroll)

• Oversee and execute monthly payroll for all Swiss employees, including variable pay, allowances, deductions, and absences.

• Manage payroll controls, reconciliations, audits, and reporting activities.

• Ensure correct calculation of taxes, social security contributions, pension fund deductions, and insurance premiums.

• Act as key contact for employees on payroll, benefits, and time management topics.

• Collaborate with Finance on payroll accounting, salary provision, and audit requirements.

• Manage year‑end activities (salary certificates, Withholding Tax year closing, social security reporting)

HR Administration & Employee Lifecycle Management

• Act as a trusted HR advisor to managers and senior leaders based in Switzerland

• Manage and oversee all administrative HR processes for the entire employee lifecycle (hire to retire).

• Prepare employment contracts, amendments, reference letters, and other legal documents in accordance with Swiss law.

• Ensure accurate maintenance of employee records and digital personnel files.

• Manage onboarding and offboarding processes, including work permits (L, B, C) and liaison with authorities.

• Ensure timely registration and reporting to social security institutions (AHV/ALV/IV/EO), pension funds (BVG/LPP), accident insurance (UVG), KTG and family allowance offices.

• Support annual performance and compensation cycles from an administrative standpoint.

• Ensure compliance with internal policies, GDPR, and Swiss data protection regulations.

HR Systems & Process Optimization

• Maintain and optimize HRIS and time‑tracking systems (e.g., SAP, Workday, Abacus, or similar).

• Ensure data accuracy and reliability for reporting and analytics.

• Drive process improvements and standardization across HR administration and payroll.

• Support implementation of new tools and digital HR solutions.

• Compliance, Policies & Governance.

• Ensure full compliance with Swiss labour law, collective labour agreements (if applicable), and company policies.

• Maintain HR governance frameworks and support HR audits.

• Keep up to date with regulatory changes and translate them into operational processes.

To succeed in this role, you will need

• Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.

• Several years of experience in HR administration and Swiss payroll (mandatory).

• Strong understanding of Swiss labour law, social security system, taxes, and employment compliance.

• Experience in multinational environments is an asset.

• Strong MS Office and HRIS proficiency; payroll system expertise required.

• Fluent in German and English.

• Working time: 80 - 100 %.

No visa or work permit support can be provided for this role.

Do you have a question about the role?

Reach out to Alexi Donadoni at alexi.donadoni@sulzer.com.

What we offer you

• 25 days holidays (exclusive of bank holidays) + service days

• Defined contribution pension scheme

• Employee Assistance Program/health care

• On-site car parking/public transport allowance

• Access to a wide range of discounts

Sulzer is an equal opportunity em

Informazioni sul ruolo

L'Amministrazione delle risorse umane & Payroll Manager è responsabile di guidare e supervisionare tutti i processi amministrativi delle risorse umane e le operazioni di payroll end-to-end per la Svizzera. Questo ruolo garantisce il pieno rispetto del diritto del lavoro svizzero, delle norme di sicurezza sociale, degli obblighi fiscali e delle politiche interne. La posizione funge da punto di contatto primario per le operazioni HR, l'amministrazione del ciclo di vita dei dipendenti, l'accuratezza del libro paga e l'integrità del sistema HR. Il ruolo ha bisogno di esecuzione pratica, garantendo processi HR efficienti e consegna di servizi di alta qualità a dipendenti e manager.
I vostri compiti principali e responsabilità

Gestione dei pagamenti (Swiss Payroll)

• Controllare ed eseguire il libro paga mensile per tutti i dipendenti svizzeri, tra cui retribuzione variabile, indennità, detrazioni e assenze.

• Gestisci controlli payroll, conciliazioni, audit e attività di reporting.

• Assicurare il corretto calcolo delle imposte, dei contributi sociali, delle deduzioni dei fondi pensione e dei premi assicurativi.

• Agire come contatto chiave per i dipendenti sui temi payroll, benefici e gestione del tempo.

• Collaborare con la finanza sulla contabilità del libro paga, la fornitura di stipendio e i requisiti di audit.

• Gestire attività di fine anno (certificati di sala, Mantenere la chiusura dell'anno fiscale, reporting di sicurezza sociale)

Amministrazione HR e gestione del ciclo di vita dei dipendenti

• Agire come consulente HR affidabile per manager e leader senior con sede in Svizzera

• Gestire e supervisionare tutti i processi amministrativi delle risorse umane per l'intero ciclo di vita dei dipendenti (andare in pensione).

• Preparare contratti di lavoro, modifiche, lettere di riferimento e altri documenti legali in conformità con la legge svizzera.

• Assicurare la manutenzione accurata dei registri dei dipendenti e dei file del personale digitale.

• Gestisci i processi di bordo e di fuoribordo, inclusi i permessi di lavoro (L, B, C) e il collegamento con le autorità.

• Assicurare la registrazione tempestiva e la segnalazione alle istituzioni di sicurezza sociale (AHV/ALV/IV/EO), fondi pensione (BVG/LPP), assicurazione contro gli infortuni (UVG), KTG e uffici di assegni familiari.

• Supporta cicli di rendimento e compensazione annuali da un punto di vista amministrativo.

• Assicurare il rispetto delle politiche interne, del GDPR e delle normative sulla protezione dei dati svizzere.

Sistemi HR e ottimizzazione dei processi

• Mantenere e ottimizzare i sistemi HRIS e time-tracking (ad esempio, SAP, Workday, Abacus, o simili).

• Assicurare l'accuratezza e l'affidabilità dei dati per la segnalazione e l'analisi.

• Miglioramento del processo di guida e standardizzazione attraverso l'amministrazione HR e payroll.

• Supporta l'implementazione di nuovi strumenti e soluzioni HR digitali.

• Compliance, Politiche e Governance.

• Assicurare il pieno rispetto del diritto del lavoro svizzero, degli accordi collettivi di lavoro (se applicabili) e delle politiche aziendali.

• Mantenere i quadri di governance delle risorse umane e sostenere gli audit delle risorse umane.

• Tenere aggiornato con i cambiamenti normativi e tradurli in processi operativi.

Per avere successo in questo ruolo, avrete bisogno

• Laurea in Risorse umane, Business Administration, o un campo relativo.

• Diversi anni di esperienza nell'amministrazione delle risorse umane e nel libro paga svizzero (obbligatorio).

• Forte comprensione del diritto del lavoro svizzero, del sistema di sicurezza sociale, delle imposte e del rispetto dell'occupazione.

• L'esperienza in ambienti multinazionali è una risorsa.

• Forte competenza MS Office e HRIS; competenze del sistema payroll richiesto.

• Fluente in tedesco e inglese.

• Tempo di lavoro: 80 - 100 %.

Nessun visto o permesso di lavoro può essere fornito per questo ruolo.

Hai una domanda sul ruolo?

Raggiungi Alexi Donadoni all'indirizzo alexi.donadoni@sulzer.com.

• 25 giorni festivi (esclusi i giorni festivi) + giorni di servizio

• regime pensionistico contributivo

• Programma di assistenza dei dipendenti/assistenza sanitaria

• Parcheggio in loco/indennità di trasporto pubblico

• Accesso a una vasta gamma di sconti

The position acts as the primary point of contact for HR operations, employee lifecycle administration, payroll accuracy, and HR system integrity. The role needs hands-on execution, ensuring efficient HR processes and high-quality service delivery to employees and managers.
Your main tasks and responsibilities

Payroll Management (Swiss Payroll)

• Oversee and execute monthly payroll for all Swiss employees, including variable pay, allowances, deductions, and absences.

• Manage payroll controls, reconciliations, audits, and reporting activities.

• Ensure correct calculation of taxes, social security contributions, pension fund deductions, and insurance premiums.

• Act as key contact for employees on payroll, benefits, and time management topics.

• Collaborate with Finance on payroll accounting, salary provision, and audit requirements.

• Manage year‑end activities (salary certificates, Withholding Tax year closing, social security reporting)

HR Administration & Employee Lifecycle Management

• Act as a trusted HR advisor to managers and senior leaders based in Switzerland

• Manage and oversee all administrative HR processes for the entire employee lifecycle (hire to retire).

• Prepare employment contracts, amendments, reference letters, and other legal documents in accordance with Swiss law.

• Ensure accurate maintenance of employee records and digital personnel files.

• Manage onboarding and offboarding processes, including work permits (L, B, C) and liaison with authorities.

• Ensure timely registration and reporting to social security institutions (AHV/ALV/IV/EO), pension funds (BVG/LPP), accident insurance (UVG), KTG and family allowance offices.

• Support annual performance and compensation cycles from an administrative standpoint.

• Ensure compliance with internal policies, GDPR, and Swiss data protection regulations.

HR Systems & Process Optimization

• Maintain and optimize HRIS and time‑tracking systems (e.g., SAP, Workday, Abacus, or similar).

• Ensure data accuracy and reliability for reporting and analytics.

• Drive process improvements and standardization across HR administration and payroll.

• Support implementation of new tools and digital HR solutions.

• Compliance, Policies & Governance.

• Ensure full compliance with Swiss labour law, collective labour agreements (if applicable), and company policies.

• Maintain HR governance frameworks and support HR audits.

• Keep up to date with regulatory changes and translate them into operational processes.

To succeed in this role, you will need

• Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.

• Several years of experience in HR administration and Swiss payroll (mandatory).

• Strong understanding of Swiss labour law, social security system, taxes, and employment compliance.

• Experience in multinational environments is an asset.

• Strong MS Office and HRIS proficiency; payroll system expertise required.

• Fluent in German and English.

• Working time: 80 - 100 %.

No visa or work permit support can be provided for this role.

Reach out to Alexi Donadoni at alexi.donadoni@sulzer.com.

What we offer you

Sur le rôle

Le gestionnaire de l'administration des RH et de la paie est chargé de diriger et de superviser tous les processus administratifs des RH et les opérations de paye de bout en bout pour la Suisse. Ce rôle assure le plein respect du droit du travail suisse, des règlements de sécurité sociale, des obligations fiscales et des politiques internes. Le poste est le principal point de contact pour les opérations des RH, l'administration du cycle de vie des employés, l'exactitude de la paye et l'intégrité du système des RH. Le rôle doit être exécuté de façon pratique, en assurant des processus de RH efficaces et une prestation de services de haute qualité aux employés et aux gestionnaires.
Vos principales tâches et responsabilités

Gestion de la paie (Swiss Payroll)

• Surveiller et exécuter la paie mensuelle de tous les employés suisses, y compris la rémunération variable, les indemnités, les retenues et les absences.

• Gérer les contrôles des états de paie, les rapprochements, les vérifications et les activités de rapport.

• Assurer le calcul correct des impôts, des cotisations de sécurité sociale, des déductions des fonds de pension et des primes d'assurance.

• Agir en tant que contact clé pour les employés sur la paye, les avantages sociaux et la gestion du temps.

• Collaborer avec les Finances sur la comptabilité de la paie, la provision salariale et les exigences de vérification.

• Gérer les activités de fin d'année (certificats de salaire, clôture de l'année fiscale de retenue, déclaration de sécurité sociale)

Administration des RH et gestion du cycle de vie des employés

• Gérer et superviser tous les processus administratifs des RH pour l'ensemble du cycle de vie des employés (embauche à la retraite).

• Préparer des contrats de travail, des amendements, des lettres de référence et d'autres documents juridiques conformément au droit suisse.

• Assurer la maintenance exacte des dossiers des employés et des dossiers personnels numériques.

• Gérer les processus d'embarquement et de débarquement, y compris les permis de travail (L, B, C) et la liaison avec les autorités.

• Veiller à ce que les institutions de sécurité sociale (AHV/ALV/IV/EO), les caisses de retraite (BVG/LPP), l'assurance accidents (UVG), le KTG et les bureaux d'allocations familiales soient enregistrés en temps voulu et informés.

• Soutenir les cycles annuels de rendement et de rémunération du point de vue administratif.

• Assurer le respect des politiques internes, du RGPD et de la réglementation suisse en matière de protection des données.

Systèmes RH et optimisation des processus

• Maintenir et optimiser les systèmes HRIS et de suivi du temps (p. ex. SAP, Workday, Abacus, ou similaire).

• Assurer l'exactitude et la fiabilité des données pour les rapports et les analyses.

• Favoriser l'amélioration des processus et la normalisation de l'administration des RH et de la paye.

• Soutenir la mise en œuvre de nouveaux outils et de solutions numériques de RH.

• Conformité, politiques et gouvernance.

• Maintenir les cadres de gouvernance des RH et appuyer les vérifications des RH.

• Tenez-vous au courant des modifications réglementaires et les traduire en processus opérationnels.

Pour réussir dans ce rôle, vous aurez besoin

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society

About the role

Join our IT Team in Madrid as SAP Inhouse Consultant Finance & Controlling to work on SAP projects and to support our SAP ERP platforms in your area of expertise.

Your main tasks and responsibilities:

• Facilitating, coordinating and contributing to feasibility studies

• Understanding business processes and business requirements and creating functional specifications for implementation

• Responsible for system build, thus hands on configuration skills are required

• Responsible for solution design and contributing to harmonization initiatives

• Incident and request resolution

• Contributing actively to problem management and challenging incidents or change requests on the strategic SAP platforms

• Providing or assisting with training of (key) users

• Preparing test cases and test scripts and carrying out the integration testing as a part of the project delivery

• Maintaining user and system documentation and incorporating changes as needed / appropriate

• Keeping up to date with industrywide trends and best practices (both process and technology)

• Ensure proper rollout / implementation of ERP roll-out projects for your area of responsibility

• Identify and manage actions related to communication, training, master data management, etc. arising from and in connection with projects, both within and outside the IT community

• Project management of the finance related projects

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• Degree in technical or business studies, further training in SAP or equivalent experience

• A strong portfolio of experience with SAP Finance and Controlling as a consultant, especially in Product Costing and Profitability Analysis

• Experience in SAP Finance components: Fixed Assets, Banking, Accounts Receivables, Credit Control Management, Accounts Payables, Statutory, Indirect Tax and IFRS Reporting

• Experience in Month and Year End closing and reporting. Knowledge of Schedule Manager or Closing Cockpit is a plus.

• Knowhow from the manufacturing industry is a plus

• Experience from two or more successful SAP rollouts where you handled finance projects as your specialist area

• Knowhow in customizing finance modules, and understanding integration with other modules like SD and MM

• Good process understanding and ability to be able to support SAP best practice approaches within different templates

• Experience with Basware is considered an advantage

• Strong communication skills in English.

• Excellent collaboration, internal consulting and facilitation skills

• Ability to learn new technologies and processes quickly and to adapt to changes in timelines and sequences

• Readiness to travel (25 %)

What we offer you

• A competitive salary as well as participation in the variable remuneration system based on personal and financial objectives.

• Restaurant Tickets

• Permanent contract

• Accident insurance

• Central workplace in Nuevos Ministerios

•

No visa or work permit support can be provided for this role.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

• Il know-how dell'industria manifatturiera è un vantaggio

• Esperienza derivante da due o più implementazioni SAP di successo in cui hai gestito progetti finanziari come area specialistica

• Know-how nella personalizzazione dei moduli finanziari e comprensione dell'integrazione con altri moduli come SD e MM

• Buona comprensione del processo e capacità di supportare approcci basati sulle best practice SAP all'interno di diversi modelli

• L'esperienza con Basware è considerata un vantaggio

• Forti capacità di comunicazione in inglese.

• Ottime capacità di collaborazione, consulenza interna e facilitazione

• Capacità di apprendere rapidamente nuove tecnologie e processi e di adattarsi ai cambiamenti nelle tempistiche e nelle sequenze

• Biglietti per ristoranti

• Assicurazione contro gli infortuni

• Posto di lavoro centrale a Nuevos Ministerios

jobs.title: OTC Billing Accountant
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society

About the role

We are looking for an OTC Billing Accountant to join our Accounting team in Spain to help us take our Order to Cash processes to the next level. As a Billing Analyst, you will collaborate with multiple Sulzer Legal Entities and engage with diverse stakeholders, including Project Managers, Finance Heads, the CoE Accounting Manager, the Reporting and Analytics team, and external customers.

Your main tasks and responsibilities:

• Prepare and issue invoices to customers based on service agreements and purchase orders, ensuring accuracy in billing details and compliance with contractual terms

• Closely collaborate with the local Project Manager

• Review and reconcile billing data for completeness and accuracy, making necessary adjustments or corrections

• Ensure timely invoice dispatch to third-party customers in line with customer requirements, complying with local regulations (e.g., B2B e-invoicing).

• Collaborate with sales, customer service, the cash collections team, and project management teams to gather necessary information for billing, and to resolve any billing-related issues and queries.

• Maintain and update customer billing information and records in the billing system

• Perform AR, Revenue & Aging analysis

• Support the month-end and year-end close processes, including preparing journal entries and account reconciliations related to billing

• Generate and analyze billing reports, providing insights and recommendations to improve the billing process and reduce errors. Closely collaborate with the Reporting & Analytics team on this

• Ensure compliance with OTC internal controls, accounting policies, and regulatory requirements related to billing operations

• Participate in the implementation and improvement of billing systems and procedures to enhance efficiency and accuracy, in cooperation with the OTC GPO.

• Provide support during internal and external audits by preparing required documentation and addressing auditor inquiries related to billing

• Support the intercompany billing process.

• Support definition and preparation of KPIs in the billing area.

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• University degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration or related field.

• Minimum of 2 of experience in billing in a similar role.

• Experience within the manufacturing or industrial sectors is preferred.

• Strong understanding of the Order to Cash cycle.

• Strong understanding of accounting principles, revenue recognition and billing process

• Proficiency in interpreting billing reports

• Excellent analytical, problem-solving and decision-making skills

• Strong communication skills for delivering key insights to i.e. Senior Billing Accountants, CoE Accounting Manager, Reporting & Analytics team and Country Finance Heads

• Experience in Global Business Services or Finance Shared Services organizations will be highly valued.

• Experience with ERP systems (SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365, iScala) highly valued.

• Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint).

• Fluency in English; additional European languages are a plus.

• Great communication skills. Continuous interaction with project teams and other stakeholders is critical to succeed in this role.

• Proactive mindset, ready to contribute to create the new teams we are building up in our Center of Excellence.

What we offer you

• A permanent contract.

• A competitive salary as well as participation in the variable remuneration system based on personal and financial objectives.

• Restaurant tickets

• Be part of

Sul ruolo

Stiamo cercando un contabile di fatturazione OTC che si unisca al nostro team di contabilità in Spagna per aiutarci a portare i nostri processi dall'ordine al contante al livello successivo. In qualità di analista di fatturazione, collaborerai con più entità legali Sulzer e interagirai con diverse parti interessate, tra cui project manager, responsabili finanziari, responsabile contabilità CoE, team di reporting e analisi e clienti esterni.

I tuoi principali compiti e responsabilità:

• Preparare ed emettere fatture ai clienti sulla base di contratti di servizio e ordini di acquisto, garantendo l'accuratezza dei dettagli di fatturazione e il rispetto dei termini contrattuali

• Collaborare strettamente con il Project Manager locale

• Rivedere e riconciliare i dati di fatturazione per completezza e accuratezza, apportando le modifiche o le correzioni necessarie

• Garantire l'invio tempestivo delle fatture a clienti terzi in linea con i requisiti del cliente, rispettando le normative locali (ad esempio, fatturazione elettronica B2B).

• Collaborare con le vendite, il servizio clienti, il team di riscossione dei contanti e i team di gestione del progetto per raccogliere le informazioni necessarie per la fatturazione e per risolvere eventuali problemi e domande relativi alla fatturazione.

• Mantenere e aggiornare le informazioni e i record di fatturazione del cliente nel sistema di fatturazione

• Eseguire analisi AR, ricavi e invecchiamento

• Supportare i processi di chiusura di fine mese e di fine anno, inclusa la preparazione delle voci di giornale e le riconciliazioni dei conti relative alla fatturazione

• Generare e analizzare report di fatturazione, fornendo approfondimenti e consigli per migliorare il processo di fatturazione e ridurre gli errori. Collaborare strettamente con il team Reporting & Analytics a questo proposito

• Garantire la conformità ai controlli interni OTC, alle politiche contabili e ai requisiti normativi relativi alle operazioni di fatturazione

• Partecipare all'implementazione e al miglioramento dei sistemi e delle procedure di fatturazione per migliorare l'efficienza e l'accuratezza, in collaborazione con il GPO OTC.

• Fornire supporto durante gli audit interni ed esterni preparando la documentazione richiesta e rispondendo alle domande dei revisori relative alla fatturazione

• Supportare il processo di fatturazione interaziendale.

• Supporto nella definizione e predisposizione dei KPI in ambito fatturazione.

Per avere successo in questo ruolo, avrai bisogno di:

• Laurea in Finanza, Contabilità, Amministrazione aziendale o settore correlato.

• Minimo 2 di esperienza nella fatturazione in un ruolo simile.

• Costituisce titolo preferenziale esperienza nel settore manifatturiero o industriale.

• Ottima comprensione del ciclo Order to Cash.

• Ottima conoscenza dei principi contabili, del riconoscimento dei ricavi e del processo di fatturazione

• Competenza nell'interpretazione dei report di fatturazione

• Eccellenti capacità analitiche, di problem solving e decisionali

• Forti capacità di comunicazione per fornire approfondimenti chiave, ad esempio ai contabili senior della fatturazione, al responsabile contabilità del CoE, al team di reporting e analisi e ai responsabili finanziari nazionali

• L'esperienza in organizzazioni di servizi aziendali globali o di servizi finanziari condivisi sarà molto apprezzata.

• Esperienza con sistemi ERP (SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365, iScala) molto apprezzata.

• Conoscenza di MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint).

• Ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese; ulteriori lingue europee sono un vantaggio.

• Grandi capacità di comunicazione. L'interazione continua con i team di progetto e le altre parti interessate è fondamentale per avere successo in questo ruolo.

• Mentalità proattiva, pronta a contribuire alla creazione dei nuovi team che stiamo costruendo nel nostro Centro di Eccellenza.

Cosa ti offriamo

• Un contratto a tempo indeterminato.

• Una retribuzione competitiva e la partecipazione al sistema di remunerazione variabile basato su obiettivi personali e finanziari.

• Biglietti ristorante

• Partecipare

descriptionByLocale.de:
Sulzer ist ein führendes Ingenieurunternehmen mit einer stolzen Tradition der Innovation. Werden Sie Teil unseres globalen Teams, um Ihr Fachwissen zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine wohlhabende und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen

Über die Rolle

Wir sind auf der Suche nach einem OTC Billing Accountant zur Verstärkung unseres Buchhaltungsteams in Spanien, der uns dabei hilft, unsere Order-to-Cash-Prozesse auf die nächste Stufe zu heben. Als Billing Analyst arbeiten Sie mit mehreren Sulzer-Rechtseinheiten zusammen und interagieren mit verschiedenen Stakeholdern, darunter Projektmanagern, Finanzleitern, dem CoE Accounting Manager, dem Reporting- und Analytics-Team und externen Kunden.

Ihre Hauptaufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten:

• Erstellen und stellen Sie Kunden Rechnungen auf der Grundlage von Servicevereinbarungen und Bestellungen aus und stellen Sie dabei die Genauigkeit der Rechnungsdetails und die Einhaltung der Vertragsbedingungen sicher

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem lokalen Projektmanager

• Rechnungsdaten auf Vollständigkeit und Richtigkeit überprüfen und abgleichen und notwendige Anpassungen oder Korrekturen vornehmen

• Stellen Sie sicher, dass Rechnungen an Drittkunden rechtzeitig versendet werden, entsprechend den Kundenanforderungen und unter Einhaltung lokaler Vorschriften (z. B. B2B-E-Invoicing).

• Arbeiten Sie mit dem Vertrieb, dem Kundendienst, dem Inkassoteam und den Projektmanagementteams zusammen, um die für die Abrechnung erforderlichen Informationen zu sammeln und alle abrechnungsbezogenen Probleme und Fragen zu lösen.

• Kundenabrechnungsinformationen und -datensätze im Abrechnungssystem pflegen und aktualisieren

• Führen Sie AR-, Umsatz- und Alterungsanalysen durch

• Unterstützen Sie die Prozesse zum Monats- und Jahresabschluss, einschließlich der Vorbereitung von Journaleinträgen und Kontoabstimmungen im Zusammenhang mit der Abrechnung

• Erstellen und analysieren Sie Abrechnungsberichte und liefern Sie Erkenntnisse und Empfehlungen zur Verbesserung des Abrechnungsprozesses und zur Reduzierung von Fehlern. Arbeiten Sie dabei eng mit dem Reporting & Analytics-Team zusammen

• Stellen Sie die Einhaltung interner OTC-Kontrollen, Rechnungslegungsrichtlinien und behördlicher Anforderungen im Zusammenhang mit Abrechnungsvorgängen sicher

• Beteiligen Sie sich an der Implementierung und Verbesserung von Abrechnungssystemen und -verfahren zur Steigerung der Effizienz und Genauigkeit in Zusammenarbeit mit dem OTC GPO.

• Bieten Sie Unterstützung bei internen und externen Audits, indem Sie die erforderliche Dokumentation vorbereiten und Auditorenanfragen im Zusammenhang mit der Abrechnung bearbeiten

• Unterstützen Sie den konzerninternen Abrechnungsprozess.

• Unterstützen Sie die Definition und Erstellung von KPIs im Abrechnungsbereich.

Um in dieser Rolle erfolgreich zu sein, benötigen Sie:

• Universitätsabschluss in Finanzen, Rechnungswesen, Betriebswirtschaft oder einem verwandten Bereich.

• Mindestens 2 Personen mit Erfahrung in der Abrechnung in einer ähnlichen Rolle.

• Erfahrung in der Fertigungs- oder Industriebranche wird bevorzugt.

• Ausgeprägtes Verständnis des Order-to-Cash-Zyklus.

• Ausgeprägtes Verständnis der Rechnungslegungsgrundsätze, der Umsatzrealisierung und des Abrechnungsprozesses

• Kenntnisse in der Interpretation von Abrechnungsberichten

• Hervorragende Analyse-, Problemlösungs- und Entscheidungsfähigkeiten

• Starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, um wichtige Erkenntnisse z. B. an leitende Abrechnungsbuchhalter, CoE Accounting Manager, Reporting & Analytics-Team und Country Finance Heads zu liefern

• Erfahrung in Global Business Services- oder Finance Shared Services-Organisationen wird sehr geschätzt.

• Erfahrung mit ERP-Systemen (SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365, iScala) wird sehr geschätzt.

• Kenntnisse in MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint).

• Fließende Englischkenntnisse; Weitere europäische Sprachen sind ein Plus.

• Große Kommunikationsfähigkeiten. Für den Erfolg in dieser Rolle ist die kontinuierliche Interaktion mit Projektteams und anderen Stakeholdern von entscheidender Bedeutung.

• Proaktive Denkweise, bereit, einen Beitrag zur Bildung der neuen Teams zu leisten, die wir in unserem Kompetenzzentrum aufbauen.

Was wir Ihnen bieten

• Ein unbefristeter Vertrag.

• Ein wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt sowie Teilnahme am variablen Vergütungssystem basierend auf persönlichen und finanziellen Zielen.

À propos du rôle

Nous recherchons un comptable de facturation OTC pour rejoindre notre équipe comptable en Espagne afin de nous aider à faire passer nos processus Order to Cash au niveau supérieur. En tant qu'analyste de facturation, vous collaborerez avec plusieurs entités juridiques de Sulzer et dialoguerez avec diverses parties prenantes, notamment les chefs de projet, les responsables financiers, le responsable comptable du CoE, l'équipe de reporting et d'analyse et les clients externes.

Vos principales tâches et responsabilités :

• Préparer et émettre des factures aux clients sur la base des accords de service et des bons de commande, en garantissant l'exactitude des détails de facturation et le respect des conditions contractuelles.

• Collaborer étroitement avec le chef de projet local

• Examiner et rapprocher les données de facturation pour en vérifier l'exhaustivité et l'exactitude, en apportant les ajustements ou corrections nécessaires.

• Garantir l'envoi en temps opportun des factures aux clients tiers, conformément aux exigences des clients et dans le respect des réglementations locales (par exemple, facturation électronique B2B).

• Collaborer avec les ventes, le service client, l'équipe de recouvrement des espèces et les équipes de gestion de projet pour recueillir les informations nécessaires à la facturation et pour résoudre tout problème et requête lié à la facturation.

• Maintenir et mettre à jour les informations de facturation des clients et les enregistrements dans le système de facturation.

• Effectuer une analyse AR, revenus et vieillissement

• Soutenir les processus de clôture de fin de mois et de fin d'année, y compris la préparation des écritures de journal et des rapprochements de comptes liés à la facturation.

• Générez et analysez des rapports de facturation, en fournissant des informations et des recommandations pour améliorer le processus de facturation et réduire les erreurs. Collaborer étroitement avec l'équipe Reporting & Analytics à ce sujet

• Assurer la conformité aux contrôles internes d'OTC, aux politiques comptables et aux exigences réglementaires liées aux opérations de facturation.

• Participer à la mise en œuvre et à l'amélioration des systèmes et procédures de facturation pour améliorer l'efficacité et l'exactitude, en coopération avec l'OTC GPO.

• Fournir un soutien lors des audits internes et externes en préparant la documentation requise et en répondant aux demandes des auditeurs liées à la facturation.

• Soutenir le processus de facturation intersociétés.

• Supporter la définition et la préparation des KPI dans le domaine de la facturation.

Pour réussir dans ce rôle, vous aurez besoin de :

• Diplôme universitaire en finance, comptabilité, administration des affaires ou dans un domaine connexe.

• Minimum de 2 d'expérience en facturation dans un rôle similaire.

• Une expérience dans les secteurs manufacturier ou industriel est préférable.

• Bonne compréhension du cycle Order to Cash.

• Solide compréhension des principes comptables, de la reconnaissance des revenus et du processus de facturation

• Maîtrise de l'interprétation des rapports de facturation

• Excellentes compétences analytiques, de résolution de problèmes et de prise de décision

• Solides compétences en communication pour fournir des informations clés, par exemple aux comptables de facturation principaux, au responsable comptable du CoE, à l'équipe de reporting et d'analyse et aux responsables financiers des pays.

• Une expérience dans des organisations de services commerciaux mondiaux ou de services financiers partagés sera très appréciée.

• Expérience avec les systèmes ERP (SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365, iScala) très appréciée.

• Maîtrise de MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint).

The Accounting Officer is responsible for supporting accounting operations including data entry, reconciliations, and assisting with financial reporting. This role ensures accuracy in financial records and supports compliance with accounting standards. This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyse problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

At Sulzer, you are empowered to deliver superior results. As a pioneer in industry, we have a proud heritage of innovation and continue to evolve for the future. Join our story and create your own impact by developing your expertise and building solutions that help make our lives safer, smarter and more sustainable.

We are looking for a/an Accounts Receivable Collections Specialist (French / German Speaker) to join our GF_Finance & Controlling, Accounting team in Spain to help us take our Accounts Receivable area to the next level.

Your main tasks and responsibilities:

• Taking action to achieve AR overdue reduction in the legal entities (LEs) under your responsibility.
• Proactively following-up the collections process for assigned customer accounts, including communications with customers by phone and email to ensure payments are made complying with agreed contract conditions.
• Identifying and resolving disputes impacting customer payments, coordinating with relevant stakeholders for a quick issue resolution.
• Defining together with CoE Team Leader efficient collection strategies, ensuring compliance with Sulzer Collection Guideline and an efficient prioritization of customer contacts to optimize overdue results.
• Following-up on LE overdue results, supporting with KPI calculation and maintaining accurate accounts receivable files and records.
• Actively participating in meetings with LE stakeholders, proposing actions to correct deviations and escalating AR-related issues when required.
• Cooperating in the migration of new customers and LE’s to the scope of the CoE in Madrid.

• Identifying improvement opportunities related to collections activities, working closely with Legal Entity stakeholders and CoE Team Leader looking for efficiencies and best practices in the area.
• Credit risk analysis and credit rating assessment of customers based on external credit risk management tools and reports.
• Defining and recommending credit limits in line with Sulzer internal policies and standards.
• Ongoing monitoring, reporting and escalation of credit exposure.
• Dealing with customers and work closely with Sales Team and local Finance stakeholders as part of the credit management process.

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• Financial background with good understanding of OTC processes.
• Fluency in English is a must. German, French, Italian or any other European language will be an advantage.
• Some experience working in Cash Collections, or Accounts receivable in Financial Shared Services organization is a plus.
• SAP & FSCM (Collection and Disputes) experience is also a plus.
• Results oriented.
• Effective time management and ability to meet deadlines.
• Ability to identify when issues need to be escalated.
• Excel

• Supporto nella standardizzazione dei processi relativi alla raccolta AR in tutto il gruppo.

• Identificare opportunità di miglioramento relative alle attività di recupero crediti, lavorando a stretto contatto con le parti interessate della persona giuridica e il team leader del CoE alla ricerca di efficienze e migliori pratiche nell'area.
• Analisi del rischio di credito e valutazione del rating creditizio dei clienti sulla base di strumenti e report esterni di gestione del rischio di credito.
• Definire e consigliare limiti di credito in linea con le politiche e gli standard interni di Sulzer.

• Monitoraggio, reporting ed escalation continui dell'esposizione creditizia.
• Trattare con i clienti e lavorare a stretto contatto con il team di vendita e gli stakeholder finanziari locali come parte del processo di gestione del credito.

Per avere successo in questo ruolo, avrai bisogno di:

• Background finanziario con buona conoscenza dei processi OTC.
• La conoscenza fluente dell'inglese è un must. Il tedesco, il francese, l'italiano o qualsiasi altra lingua europea costituiranno un vantaggio.
• Una certa esperienza di lavoro nella riscossione di contanti o nella contabilità clienti nell'organizzazione di servizi finanziari condivisi costituisce un vantaggio.
• Anche l'esperienza in SAP & FSCM (Riscossione e Controversie) costituisce un plus.
• Orientamento ai risultati.
• Gestione efficace del tempo e capacità di rispettare le scadenze.
• Capacità di identificare quando è necessario intensificare i problemi.
• Eccellere

About the role

Job Summary
The Accounting Officer is responsible for supporting accounting operations including data entry, reconciliations, and assisting with financial reporting. This role ensures accuracy in financial records and supports compliance with accounting standards. This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyse problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

At Sulzer, you are empowered to deliver superior results. As a pioneer in industry, we have a proud heritage of innovation and continue to evolve for the future. Join our story and create your own impact by developing your expertise and building solutions that help make our lives safer, smarter and more sustainable.

We are looking for a/an Accounts Receivable Collections Specialist (French / German Speaker) to join our GF_Finance & Controlling, Accounting team in Spain to help us take our Accounts Receivable area to the next level.

Your main tasks and responsibilities:

• Taking action to achieve AR overdue reduction in the legal entities (LEs) under your responsibility.
• Proactively following-up the collections process for assigned customer accounts, including communications with customers by phone and email to ensure payments are made complying with agreed contract conditions.
• Identifying and resolving disputes impacting customer payments, coordinating with relevant stakeholders for a quick issue resolution.
• Defining together with CoE Team Leader efficient collection strategies, ensuring compliance with Sulzer Collection Guideline and an efficient prioritization of customer contacts to optimize overdue results.
• Following-up on LE overdue results, supporting with KPI calculation and maintaining accurate accounts receivable files and records.
• Actively participating in meetings with LE stakeholders, proposing actions to correct deviations and escalating AR-related issues when required.
• Cooperating in the migration of new customers and LE’s to the scope of the CoE in Madrid.
• Supporting in standardization of AR collection-related processes across the group.
• Acting as a subject-matter expert (SME) for Sulzer in AR Collections area, identifying and sharing best practices across the Group and providing guidance to stakeholders to improve Group collection results.
• Identifying improvement opportunities related to collections activities, working closely with Legal Entity stakeholders and CoE Team Leader looking for efficiencies and best practices in the area.
• Credit risk analysis and credit rating assessment of customers based on external credit risk management tools and reports.
• Defining and recommending credit limits in line with Sulzer internal policies and standards.
• Ongoing monitoring, reporting and escalation of credit exposure.
• Dealing with customers and work closely with Sales Team and local Finance stakeholders as part of the credit management process.

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• Financial background with good understanding of OTC processes.
• Fluency in English is a must. German, French, Italian or any other European language will be an advantage.
• Some experience working in Cash Collections, or Accounts receivable in Financial Shared Services organization is a plus.
• SAP & FSCM (Collection and Disputes) experience is also a plus.
• Results oriented.
• Effective time management and ability to meet deadlines.
• Ability to identify when issues need to be escalated.
• Excel

• Effektives Zeitmanagement und Fähigkeit, Fristen einzuhalten.
• Fähigkeit zu erkennen, wann Probleme eskaliert werden müssen.
• Excel

Le comptable est chargé de soutenir les opérations comptables, y compris la saisie des données, les rapprochements et de contribuer à l'élaboration des rapports financiers. Nous recherchons un spécialiste du recouvrement des comptes clients (francophone / germanophone) pour rejoindre notre équipe GF_Finance & Controlling, Comptabilité en Espagne afin de nous aider à faire passer notre secteur des comptes clients au niveau supérieur.

• Prendre des mesures pour réduire les retards de paiement dans les entités juridiques (LE) sous votre responsabilité.

• Identifier et résoudre les litiges ayant un impact sur les paiements des clients, en coordination avec les parties prenantes concernées pour une résolution rapide des problèmes.

• Suivi des résultats LE en retard, en soutenant le calcul des KPI et en maintenant des fichiers et des enregistrements précis des comptes clients.
• Participer activement aux réunions avec les parties prenantes LE, proposer des actions pour corriger les écarts et faire remonter les problèmes liés à l'AR si nécessaire.
• Coopérer à la migration de nouveaux clients et LE vers le périmètre du CoE de Madrid.
• Soutenir la standardisation des processus liés à la collecte des AR au sein du groupe.
• Agir en tant qu'expert en la matière (SME) pour Sulzer dans le domaine des recouvrements AR, identifier et partager les meilleures pratiques au sein du groupe et fournir des conseils aux parties prenantes pour améliorer les résultats de recouvrement du groupe.
• Identifier les opportunités d'amélioration liées aux activités de recouvrement, en travaillant en étroite collaboration avec les parties prenantes des entités juridiques et le chef d'équipe du CoE à la recherche d'efficacités et de meilleures pratiques dans le domaine.
• Analyse du risque de crédit et évaluation de la notation de crédit des clients sur la base d'outils et de rapports externes de gestion du risque de crédit.
• Définir et recommander des limites de crédit conformément aux politiques et normes internes de Sulzer.

• Surveillance continue, reporting et remontée du risque de crédit.
• Traiter avec les clients et travailler en étroite collaboration avec l'équipe commerciale et les parties prenantes financières locales dans le cadre du processus de gestion du crédit.

Pour réussir dans ce rôle, vous aurez besoin de :

• Expérience financière avec une bonne compréhension des processus OTC.
• La maîtrise de l'anglais est indispensable. L'allemand, le français, l'italien ou toute autre langue européenne sera un avantage.
• Une certaine expérience de travail dans le recouvrement d'espèces ou dans les comptes clients dans une organisation de services financiers partagés est un plus.

• Orienté vers les résultats.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

We are looking for a dynamic Accounts Payable Coordinator to join our Finance & Accounting team in Madrid, Spain.
This is an exciting opportunity to collaborate with international and external stakeholders, leverage your expertise in accounts payable, whilst contributing to the success of a newly established office in central Madrid.
If you enjoy creating impact and eager to advance your career within a global and mission-led organisation, we want to hear from you! In this position you will be a member of our Accounts Payable Controls team based in our Madrid office, supporting our European companies. You will work together with an external shared service center who is responsible for master data, invoice processing and payments. Furthermore, you will closely work other country Finance functions, Procurement, and external vendors.

Your main tasks and responsibilities:

• Independently manage the daily business in accounts payable, in collaboration with the country’s Finance team and the external Shared Service Center

• Manage escalations in incoming accounts payable related queries from suppliers

• Review payment proposals and ensure a complete alignment with the country’s compliance requirements.

• Monitor and control accounts payable aging.

• Assist in the preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements according to IFR.

• Drive process standardization and reduce inefficiencies, acting as a guide for the shared services teams.

• Actively support various projects, such as system implementations and process optimizations

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• Degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or related fields

• 3 years of experience in Accounts Payable

• Very good written and verbal communication skills

• Knowledge of ERP systems (preferable SAP or D365)

• Fluent English skills

• Any other European language is a plus

• Analytical and problem solving skills

What we offer you

What we offer you:
• A permanent contract.
• A competitive salary as well as participation in the variable remuneration system based on personal and financial objectives.
• Restaurant tickets
• Be part of an experienced, international team.
• A good vibe working environment.
• Enjoy great office facilities and a perfect location in Madrid Nuevos Ministerios, making your work experience both comfortable and convenient.
• Other fringe benefits

No visa or work permit support can be provided for this role.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Wir suchen einen dynamischen Koordinator für die Kreditorenbuchhaltung zur Verstärkung unseres Finanz- und Buchhaltungsteams in Madrid, Spanien.

jobs.title: Zerspanungsmechaniker (m/w/d) / Dreher (m/w/d)

titleByLocale.fr: Mécanicien de coupe (m/w/d) / machine à tourner (m/w/d)

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Sie suchen als Zerspanungsmechaniker die technische Herausforderung und möchten Ihre Fachkunde in einer abwechslungsreichen Tätigkeit einbringen? Sie möchten Teil eines gut aufgestellten Teams werden, in dem Sie auch zukunftsorientierte Perspektiven haben? Dann sind Sie richtig in unserem Service Center am Standort Schwarze Pumpe: unser erfahrenes Team mit ca. 30 Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeitern sind Teil unseres Service Center Netzwerks in Deutschland. Wir bieten unseren Kunden technisch maßgeschneiderte Lösungen für ihre Einsatzbereiche. Darüber hinaus gehört die präventive Wartung, Instandhaltung und Reparatur von Pumpen, Armaturen und Turbinen sowie anderen rotierenden Maschinen sowohl für Sulzer als auch für Produkte anderer Hersteller zu unserem Leistungsspektrum.

In dieser Stelle sind Sie verantwortlich für:

Als Zerspanungsmechaniker sind Sie zuständig für die eigenständige Bearbeitung verschiedenster Bauteile an CNC-gesteuerten und konventionellen Zerspanungsmaschinen. Im Bereich CNC-Drehtechnik arbeiten Sie an Dreh- und Fräsmaschinen mit Siemens-Steuerung. An konventionellen Maschinen werden Arbeiten an Bohrwerken und Drehmaschinen mit Spitzenweite von bis zu 4500 mm durchgeführt. Dabei können Sie auch auf einen breit gefächerten Maschinenpark und tatkräftige Unterstützung durch das bestehende Team zurückgreifen. Zu Ihren Aufgaben gehört unter anderem:

• Einzelbearbeitung von Bauteilen nach Zeichnung

• Eigenständiges Ermitteln von Bearbeitungswerten unter Berücksichtigung von Werkstoffdaten

• Beim Schwerpunkt CNC-Drehtechnik: komplett eigenständiges Erstellen von CNC-Programmen (Zyklensteuerung)

• Selbständiges Rüsten und Aufspannen der Maschine bzw. der Bauteile

• Bedienung der Zerspanungsmaschinen

• Prüfung der gefertigten Bauteile im Rahmen der Werker-Selbstkontrolle

• Mitwirkung bei der Optimierung von Bearbeitungsprozessen

Um in dieser Stelle erfolgreich zu sein, sollten Sie Folgendes mitbringen:
Sie passen gut bei uns ins Team, wenn Sie neben dem notwendigen technischen Geschick auch die richtige Einstellung mitbringen: aufgrund der hohen Anforderungen unseres Service-Geschäfts sind uns hierbei ein ausgeprägtes Verantwortungsbewusstsein, eine genaue und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise, sowie Flexibilität hinsichtlich Aufgaben besonders wichtig. Darüber hinaus bringen Sie noch folgende Qualifikationen mit:

• Erfolgreich abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Zerspanungsmechaniker oder gleichwertige Ausbildung / Erfahrung

• Idealerweise mehrjährige einschlägige Berufserfahrung

• Kranführer-Schein von Vorteil (ansonsten: Bereitschaft / Eignung zur Ausbildung nach Eintritt)

What we offer you

Mit unserem an den Metall- und Elektro-Tarifvertrag angelehnten Haustarifvertrag bieten wir eine adäquate Vergütung auf Basis einer 37,5-Stunden Woche, sowie zahlreiche Sozialleistungen.
Es erwarten Sie zum Beispiel:

• Betriebliche Sonderzahlungen wie Urlaubs- und Weihnachtsgeld

• Zukunftssicherer Arbeitsplatz in modernem Neubau ab 2023

• Familiäres Arbeitsumfeld vor Ort bei gleichzeitig internationaler Anbindung im Konzernverbund

• Unterstützung der individuellen Entwicklung durch gezielte in- und externe Weiterbildungsmaßnahmen

• Lebensarbeitszeitkonten mit attraktiver Förderung durch das Unternehmen

• Betriebsrente sowie zusätzliche Möglichkeit zur Nutzung der individuellen Bruttoentgeltumwandlung der MetallRente

In qualità di operatore di macchine da taglio, stai cercando una sfida tecnica e vorresti utilizzare la tua esperienza in un lavoro vario? Ti piacerebbe entrare a far parte di un team ben posizionato in cui hai anche prospettive orientate al futuro? Allora siete nel posto giusto nel nostro centro assistenza presso la sede di Schwarze Pumpe: il nostro team esperto con circa 30 dipendenti fa parte della nostra rete di centri assistenza in Germania. Offriamo ai nostri clienti soluzioni tecnicamente personalizzate per i loro campi di applicazione. In questa posizione sei responsabile di:

In qualità di operatore di macchine da taglio, sei responsabile della lavorazione indipendente di un'ampia varietà di componenti su macchine da taglio convenzionali e controllate da CNC. Nell'ambito della tecnologia di tornitura CNC lavorerai su torni e fresatrici con controlli Siemens. Sulle macchine convenzionali si lavora su alesatrici e torni con larghezze punte fino a 4500 mm. Puoi anche contare su un'ampia gamma di macchine e sul supporto attivo del team esistente. I tuoi compiti includono, tra gli altri:

• Lavorazione individuale dei componenti secondo i disegni

• Determinazione indipendente dei valori di lavorazione tenendo conto dei dati del materiale

• Quando ci si concentra sulla tecnologia di tornitura CNC: creazione completamente indipendente di programmi CNC (controllo del ciclo)

• Impostazione e bloccaggio indipendenti della macchina o dei componenti

• Funzionamento delle macchine da taglio

• Ispezione dei componenti prodotti nell'ambito dell'autoispezione del lavoratore

• Partecipazione all'ottimizzazione dei processi di lavorazione

Per avere successo in questa posizione dovresti avere quanto segue:
Ti inserirai bene nel nostro team se, oltre alle competenze tecniche necessarie, avrai anche l'atteggiamento giusto: a causa delle elevate esigenze della nostra attività di servizi, un forte senso di responsabilità, un modo di lavorare preciso e affidabile e la flessibilità in termini di compiti sono per noi particolarmente importanti. • Formazione completata con successo come operatore di macchine da taglio o formazione/esperienza equivalente

• Idealmente diversi anni di esperienza professionale rilevante

• Costituisce titolo preferenziale il possesso della licenza di gruista (altrimenti: disponibilità/idoneità alla formazione all'ingresso)

Con il nostro contratto collettivo aziendale, che si basa sul contratto collettivo metallurgico ed elettrico, offriamo una remunerazione adeguata basata su una settimana di 37,5 ore, oltre a numerosi vantaggi sociali.

• Pagamenti aziendali speciali come ferie e bonus natalizi

• Postazione di lavoro a prova di futuro in un nuovo edificio moderno a partire dal 2023

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

As a cutting machine operator, are you looking for a technical challenge and would you like to use your expertise in a varied job? Would you like to become part of a well-positioned team in which you also have future-oriented perspectives? Then you have come to the right place in our service center at the Schwarze Pumpe location: our experienced team with around 30 employees are part of our service center network in Germany. We offer our customers technically tailored solutions for their areas of application. Our range of services also includes preventive maintenance, servicing and repair of pumps, valves and turbines as well as other rotating machines for both Sulzer and products from other manufacturers.

In this position you are responsible for:

As a cutting machine operator, you are responsible for independently machining a wide variety of components on CNC-controlled and conventional cutting machines. In the area of ​​CNC turning technology, you will work on turning and milling machines with Siemens controls. On conventional machines, work is carried out on boring mills and lathes with center widths of up to 4500mm. You can also rely on a wide range of machines and active support from the existing team. Your tasks include, among others:

• Individual processing of components according to drawings

• Independent determination of machining values taking material data into account

• When focusing on CNC turning technology: completely independent creation of CNC programs (cycle control)

• Independent setup and clamping of the machine or components

• Operation of the cutting machines

• Inspection of the manufactured components as part of worker self-inspection

• Participation in the optimization of machining processes

To be successful in this position you should have the following:
You will fit well into our team if, in addition to the necessary technical skills, you also have the right attitude: due to the high demands of our service business, a strong sense of responsibility, a precise and reliable way of working, and flexibility in terms of tasks are particularly important to us. You also have the following qualifications:

• Successfully completed training as a cutting machine operator or equivalent training/experience

• Ideally several years of relevant professional experience

• Crane operator's license is an advantage (otherwise: willingness/suitability for training upon entry)

What we offer you

With our company collective agreement, which is based on the metal and electrical collective agreement, we offer adequate remuneration based on a 37.5-hour week, as well as numerous social benefits.
For example, you can expect:

• Special company payments such as vacation and Christmas bonuses

• Future-proof workplace in a modern new building from 2023

• Familiar working environment on site with simultaneous international connections within the group

• Supporting individual development through targeted internal and external further training measures

• Lifetime working accounts with attractive support from the company

• Company pension and additional option to use the individual gross salary conversion of the MetallRente

• Supplementary health insurance with subsidy from the company

• Selbständiges Rüsten und Aufspannen der Maschine bzw. der Bauteile

• Bedienung der Zerspanungsmaschinen

• Prüfung der gefertigten Bauteile im Rahmen der Werker-Selbstkontrolle

• Mitwirkung bei der Optimierung von Bearbeitungsprozessen

Sie passen gut bei uns ins Team, wenn Sie neben dem notwendigen technischen Geschick auch die richtige Einstellung mitbringen: aufgrund der hohen Anforderungen unseres Service-Geschäfts sind uns hierbei ein ausgeprägtes Verantwortungsbewusstsein, eine genaue und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise, sowie Flexibilität hinsichtlich Aufgaben besonders wichtig. Darüber hinaus bringen Sie noch folgende Qualifikationen mit:

• Erfolgreich abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Zerspanungsmechaniker oder gleichwertige Ausbildung / Erfahrung

• Idealerweise mehrjährige einschlägige Berufserfahrung

• Kranführer-Schein von Vorteil (ansonsten: Bereitschaft / Eignung zur Ausbildung nach Eintritt)

Mit unserem an den Metall- und Elektro-Tarifvertrag angelehnten Haustarifvertrag bieten wir eine adäquate Vergütung auf Basis einer 37,5-Stunden Woche, sowie zahlreiche Sozialleistungen.

• Betriebliche Sonderzahlungen wie Urlaubs- und Weihnachtsgeld
