Sulzer est une société d'ingénierie leader avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable.

À propos du rôle

Résumé du poste
Le principal opérateur de machine est chargé de superviser le fonctionnement des machines et des équipements sur le site de production, en garantissant des performances optimales et le respect des normes de sécurité et de qualité. Ce rôle fournit des conseils aux autres opérateurs de machines et prend en charge les activités de dépannage et de maintenance.
Ce profil d'emploi s'adresse au personnel professionnel qui travaille de manière autonome et peut coordonner les activités d'autres personnels professionnels, notamment dans des situations non routinières. Machiniste

Entreprise : Sulzer Pump Services (US) Inc.

Résumé du poste

Sulzer Pump Services (US) Inc. est à la recherche d'un machiniste qualifié pour exploiter et entretenir diverses machines-outils, produisant des composants et des pièces de précision pour nos systèmes de pompes industrielles. Ce rôle est crucial pour garantir la qualité et la livraison dans les délais de nos produits.

Responsabilités du poste

* Installer, utiliser et entretenir une variété de machines-outils telles que des tours, des fraiseuses, des meuleuses et des perceuses à colonne pour fabriquer ou réparer des pièces métalliques et non métalliques.
* Lire et interpréter des plans, des dessins techniques et des spécifications techniques pour déterminer les opérations, les séquences et les dimensions d'usinage.
* Sélectionnez les outils, les vitesses de coupe et les vitesses d'avance appropriés en fonction du type de matériau et des spécifications de la pièce.
* Inspecter les produits finis pour vérifier leur conformité aux spécifications à l'aide d'instruments de mesure de précision tels que des micromètres, des pieds à coulisse et des jauges.
* Effectuer l'entretien de routine des machines et des équipements pour assurer des performances et une longévité optimales.
* Identifier et résoudre les problèmes liés aux machines ou aux pièces, en effectuant les ajustements ou les réparations nécessaires.
* Maintenir une zone de travail propre et organisée, en respectant toutes les règles de sécurité et politiques de l'entreprise.
* Collaborer avec les ingénieurs et les autres membres de l'équipe pour optimiser les processus d'usinage et améliorer la qualité des produits.
* Documenter le travail effectué, y compris les mesures, les matériaux utilisés et tout problème rencontré.

Qualifications du poste

* Diplôme d'études secondaires ou équivalent; l'achèvement d'un programme professionnel ou d'un apprentissage en usinage est hautement préférable.
* Expérience avérée en tant que machiniste, avec une solide compréhension de diverses machines-outils et principes d'usinage.
* Maîtrise de la lecture et de l'interprétation de plans, de dessins techniques et de schémas.
* Solide connaissance de divers matériaux (ex. : acier, aluminium, laiton, plastiques) et de leurs propriétés d'usinage.
* Expertise dans l'utilisation d'instruments de mesure de précision (micromètres, pieds à coulisse, jauges de profondeur, etc.) et dans le maintien de tolérances serrées.
* Capacité à effectuer des calculs mathématiques pertinents aux opérations d'usinage.
* Excellentes compétences en résolution de problèmes et souci du détail.

jobs.title: Siemens V84 Specialist Superintendent EG
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The SGTS Superintendent oversees the daily operations of the SGTS GT Division with a focus on safety, quality, and efficiency. They cultivate a positive work environment, drive technical advancement, and ensure effective collaboration with customers and stakeholders. This role also involves optimizing processes, managing budgets, and leading Health and Safety initiatives to promote a culture of excellence and continuous improvement. Responsibilities

• Manage day-to-day operations, prioritizing safety, environmental compliance, and adherence to quality standards.

• Manage the Profit and Loss (P&L) of the division, ensuring financial targets are met or exceeded by effectively managing costs, maximizing revenue streams, and implementing strategies to enhance profitability.

• Cultivate a positive work environment by actively engaging with employees, setting clear expectations, and promoting teamwork.

• Drive technical advancement within the division by staying abreast of industry trends and continuously improving coating solutions.

• Optimize work processes to enhance efficiency and profitability, ensuring alignment with monthly budgets.

• Collaborate with customers, Sales Department, and vendors to meet project requirements and maintain strong relationships.

• Coordinate scheduling and project timelines, regularly updating task status and completion dates for effective project management.

• Conduct performance evaluations for Direct Reports and manage salary adjustments in line with company policies.
Qualifications:
The ideal candidate will possess the following:

• 15-20 plus years of Siemens V84 gas turbine field technical execution experience in project management and/or technical direction

• BS in Mechanical Engineering a plus

• Ability to manage a team of Siemens Technical specialists to execute all levels of scheduled and non-scheduled outage activities

• Travel required to quote pending or executing projects

• Sulzer in person office interface required on a balanced basis

• Additional Siemens gas turbine experience a plus

• Strong communication and leadership skills imperative

• Fluent in business and project relative software’s

What we offer you

• 12 Paid Holidays

• 15 Paid Time Off (PTO) Days

• Medical, dental, vision, life & disability

• 401K with 6% company match

About the role

Job Summary
The Machine Operator is responsible for operating and monitoring machinery used in the manufacturing process. This role ensures that machines run efficiently, products meet quality standards, and safety protocols are followed.

• Expérience sur machines conventionnelles et/ou à commande numérique

• Bonne capacité de lecture de plans mécaniques

• Connaissances en programmation et réglage machines

• Rigueur, précision et sens de la qualité

• Autonomie, esprit d’analyse et respect des consignes de sécurité

Résumé du poste

L'administrateur est responsable de fournir un soutien administratif de base en suivant les procédures établies. Ce rôle travaille sous une supervision étroite et gère les tâches de routine pour soutenir les opérations du bureau.

Répondra au téléphone, accueillera et enregistrera tous les visiteurs.

Ce profil d'emploi s'adresse au personnel de soutien qui suit les procédures établies et travaille sous étroite supervision. Les décisions plus petites/plus faciles sont prises de manière autonome. Caroline du Sud : Phoenix, Arizona

FONCTIONS PRINCIPALES :

• À votre arrivée, assurez-vous que les lumières nécessaires sont allumées et que le téléviseur avec le message de sécurité est allumé.

• Répondre/filtrer/transférer les appels téléphoniques entrants à l'aide d'un système téléphonique multiligne.

• Accueillir et accueillir personnellement les clients/visiteurs sans rendez-vous ; assurez-vous qu'ils sont connectés en conséquence, puis dirigez-les vers le membre du personnel approprié

• Diriger les visiteurs vers la personne et le bureau appropriés

• S'assurer que la réception est ouverte et que la ligne téléphonique principale est couverte à tout moment pendant les heures de bureau.

• Effectuer une brève orientation sur la sécurité en conséquence avec les clients/visiteurs entrant dans les locaux, le cas échéant.

• Gérer l'inventaire et acheter des fournitures de bureau

• Créer et maintenir une feuille de calcul d'inventaire pour les fournitures d'administration et de vente.

• Gérer et mettre à jour le calendrier de la salle de conférence selon les besoins

• Organiser, mettre en place, démonter et entretenir la salle de conférence pour toutes les opérations et réunions de direction

• Organiser et commander le déjeuner selon les besoins

• Superviser le tri et la distribution du courrier vers l'administration et les magasins.

• Préparer le courrier sortant / UPS / FedEx (enveloppes, colis, etc.)

• Effectuer d'autres tâches de réceptionniste telles que le classement, la photocopie, la saisie de données, etc.

• Gardez les espaces communs propres et organisés

• Fournir une assistance aux autres départements selon les besoins et selon l'approbation du superviseur.

EXPÉRIENCE/COMPÉTENCES :

• Connaissance et utilisation compétente de Microsoft Word, Excel et Power Point

• Maintenir une attitude et une apparence professionnelles

• Excellentes compétences en communication et en organisation

• Qualité du service client

• Effectuer de manière indépendante des travaux de bureau et de bureau substantiels

• La capacité d'utiliser efficacement un système téléphonique multiligne, un ordinateur, un photocopieur et d'autres équipements de bureau.

• Être une personne motivée, dotée d'initiative et capable d'effectuer plusieurs tâches à la fois.

• Orienté vers l'équipe et capable d'interagir avec plusieurs départements

• Bilingue requis (anglais et espagnol)

ENVIRONNEMENT DE TRAVAIL ET EXIGENCES PHYSIQUES :

• Environnement de bureau

• Dans le cadre de l'exécution des tâches liées à ce travail, il serait occasionnellement nécessaire de se tenir debout, de marcher, de s'asseoir, de tendre la main avec les mains et les bras, de grimper ou de se tenir en équilibre, de se pencher ou de s'agenouiller, de parler et d'entendre, et d'utiliser les doigts et les mains pour sentir des objets.

• Peut occasionnellement soulever et/ou déplacer jusqu'à 25 livres

jobs.title: Field Service Supervisor
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The (Field) Service Machinist Supervisor is responsible for managing on-site machining operations in demanding industrial environments. This role is responsible for supervising field personnel, ensuring precision machining work meets strict tolerances, and delivering projects safely, on time, and within budget. The ideal candidate combines strong technical machining expertise with proven leadership and customer-facing skills. Key Responsibilities
Set up and operate portable machining equipment lathes, line boring, flange facing, milling, drilling, and tapping.
Interpret blueprints, technical drawings, and specifications.
Measure and inspect components using, calipers, dial indicators, etc.
Ensure proper alignment and tolerances are achieved.
Maintain field equipment and tooling.
Communicate with clients and supervisors regarding job progress and issues.

Skills & Qualifications
High school diploma or equivalent technical training.
Proven experience as a machinist, preferably in field or industrial environment.
Ability to read and interpret blueprints and schematics.
Mechanical aptitude and problem-solving skills.
Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
Willingness to travel frequently and work in varying conditions outdoors, confined spaces, and heights.
Physical ability to lift heavy equipment and stand for long periods.

What we offer you

• 12 Paid Holidays

• 15 Paid Time Off (PTO) Days

• Medical, dental, vision, life & disability

• 401K with 6% company match

• Employee Assistance Program

• Employee Wellness Program

• New onsite cafeteria, all meals subsidized (La Porte Service Center)

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Production Planner is responsible for scheduling and coordinating production activities to ensure timely delivery of products. This role works closely with procurement, manufacturing, and logistics to align production plans with demand forecasts and resource availability.
This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. Key Responsivities:

• Develop and maintain master production schedules based on sales targets, customer orders, and forecast demand.

• Analyze manufacturing capacity, workload, and resource utilization(labor, equipment) to identify constraints and bottlenecks.

• Collaborate with production, engineering and procurement teams to resolve scheduling conflicts and implement corrective actions.

• Monitor master schedule progress and adjust plans proactively to achieve sales target.

• Maintain accurate planning data, documentation, and generate regular performance reports(e.g., schedule adherence, capacity utilization).

• Continuously improve scheduling processes to increase efficiency, reduce lead times, and support lean manufacturing initiatives.

Skills & Qualifications:
Typically a University degree (or equivalent work experience) and at least of 3-4 years of relevant experience (or equivalent skills) are minimally required to carry out the role.
Strong analytical and organizational skills. Experience with ERP/MRP systems. Knowledge of master planning and scheduling. Effective communication and collaboration abilities. Ability to manage multiple priorities.

What we offer you

• Analyser la capacité de fabrication, la charge de travail et l'utilisation des ressources (main-d'œuvre, équipement) pour identifier les contraintes et les goulots d'étranglement.

Solides compétences analytiques et organisationnelles. Expérience avec les systèmes ERP/MRP. Connaissance de la planification générale et de l'ordonnancement. Capacités efficaces de communication et de collaboration. Capacité à gérer plusieurs priorités.

jobs.title: Lead Piping Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The (Mechanical) Engineering Supervisor is responsible for supervising a team of mechanical engineers and support staff engaged in the design, development, and testing of mechanical systems and components. This role ensures that engineering projects are executed efficiently, meet technical and quality standards, and align with organizational goals. The supervisor also plays a key role in mentoring junior engineers, managing project timelines, and fostering innovation in mechanical design and manufacturing processes.

As a Principal Piping Engineer, you will participate in Sulzer projects at all execution stages (Conceptual design, Skid and Modular design, DD, Procurement / Construction / Commissioning support etc.).
Principal Piping Engineer reports to the Chief Piping Engineer and/or Engineering Manager.
主要任务与职责:
Main tasks and responsibilities:

• Take lead in overall piping design of skid

• Act as overall mechanical engineering IC in skid projects

• Train and guide piping engineers

• Design, 3D modeling and review of main metal structures of skids and modules

• Interface management

• Checking and approval documentation from subcontractors.

• Participation in the development of design philosophy and internal standards within the discipline

• Participation in the project meetings, 3D models review etc.

• Contribute to development of the overall project schedule.

• Tracking and managing changes within discipline

• Participation in the project progress report development.

职位要求：
Qualifications:
Education and Experience

• Bachelor in Mechanical Engineering

• 10 years’ experience in the oil and gas industries.

• Good knowledge of applicable industrial standards and best practices. (China & International)

• Good knowledge of designing methods and economic analysis.

• Extensive experience in skid and modular design

• General knowledge of oil and gas plant construction.

Language

• Fluent in Mandarin and English

Others

• Ability to work under tight deadlines with multiple tasks.

• Ability to work in multiple projects.

• Ability to travel on business trips including lengthy business trips to site during construction and commissioning.

What we offer you

target bonus：18.33% of annual income

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer è una società leader nel settore dell'ingegneria con un orgoglioso patrimonio di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile.

Sul ruolo

Riepilogo del lavoro
Il supervisore dell'ingegneria (meccanica) è responsabile della supervisione di un team di ingegneri meccanici e del personale di supporto impegnato nella progettazione, sviluppo e test di sistemi e componenti meccanici. Questo ruolo garantisce che i progetti di ingegneria vengano eseguiti in modo efficiente, soddisfino gli standard tecnici e di qualità e siano in linea con gli obiettivi organizzativi. Il supervisore svolge anche un ruolo chiave nel tutoraggio degli ingegneri junior, nella gestione delle tempistiche dei progetti e nella promozione dell'innovazione nella progettazione meccanica e nei processi di produzione.
Questo profilo professionale è destinato a People Manager di 4+ anni, da junior a ruoli esperti di livello esperto. Descrizione del prodotto:
Scopo del lavoro:

In qualità di Principal Piping Engineer, parteciperai ai progetti Sulzer in tutte le fasi di esecuzione (progettazione concettuale, progettazione skid e modulare, DD, supporto per approvvigionamento / costruzione / messa in servizio ecc.).
L'ingegnere principale delle tubazioni riporta all'ingegnere capo delle tubazioni e/o al responsabile dell'ingegneria.
Cosa ne pensi:
Principali compiti e responsabilità:

• Assumere un ruolo guida nella progettazione complessiva delle tubazioni dello skid

• Agire come IC generale dell'ingegneria meccanica nei progetti skid

• Formare e guidare gli ingegneri delle tubazioni

• Progettazione, modellazione 3D e revisione delle principali strutture metalliche di skid e moduli

• Analisi delle sollecitazioni delle tubazioni

• Sviluppo dei disegni e degli altri documenti di progettazione nell'ambito della disciplina

• Selezione dei materiali all'interno della disciplina

• Ingegneria del valore all'interno della disciplina

• Gestione dell'interfaccia

• Partecipare allo sviluppo delle specifiche tecniche per la progettazione, dei requisiti tecnici per la fornitura, ecc.

• Supervisione e supporto delle attività dei subappaltatori

• Controllo e approvazione della documentazione dei subappaltatori.

• Partecipazione allo sviluppo della filosofia progettuale e degli standard interni alla disciplina

• Partecipazione alle riunioni di progetto, revisione dei modelli 3D ecc.

• Contribuire allo sviluppo del programma complessivo del progetto.

• Monitoraggio e gestione dei cambiamenti all'interno della disciplina

• Partecipazione allo sviluppo del report sullo stato di avanzamento del progetto.

职位要求:
Qualifiche:
Formazione ed esperienza

• Laurea in Ingegneria Meccanica

• 10 anni di esperienza nel settore del petrolio e del gas.

• Buona conoscenza degli standard industriali applicabili e delle migliori pratiche. (Cina e internazionale)

• Buona conoscenza dei metodi di progettazione e di analisi economica.

• Vasta esperienza nella progettazione di skid e modulari

• Conoscenza generale della costruzione di impianti di petrolio e gas.

Lingua

• Ottima conoscenza del mandarino e dell'inglese

Altri

• Capacità di lavorare con scadenze ravvicinate con più attività.

• Capacità di lavorare su più progetti.

• Possibilità di viaggiare per viaggi d'affari, compresi lunghi viaggi d'affari al cantiere durante la costruzione e la messa in servizio.

Cosa ti offriamo

bonus target: 18,33% del reddito annuo

Sulzer è un datore di lavoro che garantisce pari opportunità. Crediamo nella forza di una forza lavoro diversificata e ci impegniamo a offrire un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo.

Siamo orgogliosi di essere riconosciuti come Top Employer 2026 in Brasile, Canada, Cina, Finlandia, Germania, Irlanda, Messico, Svizzera, Sud Africa, Regno Unito e Stati Uniti.

• Eseguire l'ingegneria di dettaglio della progettazione degli strumenti per gli skid modulari degli impianti di processo, compresi gli schemi delle linee elettriche, gli strumenti, le specifiche di controllo del pannello e del PLC.

• Preparare le specifiche tecniche per l'indagine, emettere richieste per strumenti, articoli correlati e lavori di subappalto.

• Preparazione e progettazione del diagramma di tubazioni e strumentazione, in collaborazione con gli ingegneri di processo

• Preparazione della filosofia di controllo operativo dell'impianto di processo, inclusa la matrice degli allarmi e degli interventi di interblocco in collaborazione con gli ingegneri di processo

• Sviluppare SIS, SIF e SIL

• Partecipare a HAZOP per impianti di processo

• Esaminare e approvare i documenti tecnici del subappaltatore, inclusi il calcolo dello strumento, la selezione e la programmazione del PLC del subappaltatore.

• Supervisione e supporto delle attività dei subappaltatori

• Supporto tecnico per la determinazione dei costi dei progetti skid.

• Supportare la ricezione dell'ispezione degli elementi E&I del progetto.

• Supporto tecnico per montaggio skid officina.

• Selezione dei materiali all'interno della disciplina

• Ingegneria del valore all'interno della disciplina

• Gestione dell'interfaccia tra le discipline

• Partecipazione allo sviluppo della filosofia progettuale e degli standard interni alla disciplina

• Partecipazione alle riunioni di progetto, revisione dei modelli 3D ecc.

• Contribuire allo sviluppo del programma complessivo del progetto.

• Monitoraggio e gestione dei cambiamenti all'interno della disciplina

• Partecipazione allo sviluppo del report sullo stato di avanzamento del progetto.

职位要求:
Qualifiche:
Formazione ed esperienza

• Laurea in Ingegneria Elettrica/Strumentale

• 10 anni di esperienza nel settore del petrolio e del gas.

• Buona conoscenza degli standard industriali applicabili e delle migliori pratiche. (Cina e internazionale)

• Buona conoscenza dei metodi di progettazione e di analisi economica.

• Buona conoscenza della progettazione skid e modulare

• Conoscenza generale della costruzione di impianti di petrolio e gas.

Lingua

• Ottima conoscenza del mandarino e dell'inglese

Altri

• Capacità di lavorare con scadenze ravvicinate con più attività.

• Capacità di lavorare su più progetti.

• Possibilità di viaggiare per viaggi d'affari, compresi lunghi viaggi d'affari al cantiere durante la costruzione e la messa in servizio.

Cosa ti offriamo

bonus target: 18,33% del reddito annuo

Sulzer è un datore di lavoro che garantisce pari opportunità. Crediamo nella forza di una forza lavoro diversificata e ci impegniamo a offrire un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo.

About the role

Job Summary
The (Mechanical) Engineering Specialist is responsible for researching, designing, and developing mechanical systems and components. This role applies advanced engineering knowledge to support the development and testing of mechanical and electromechanical systems.

• Prepare technical specifications for inquiry, issuing requisition for instruments, related items and subcontracting work.

• Preparation and design of Piping and Instrumentation Diagram, in conjunction with Process Engineers

• Preparation of process plant operating control philosophy, including alarm and interlocking trip matrix in conjunction with Process Engineers

• Develop SIS, SIF and SIL

• Participate in HAZOP for process plant

• Review and approve subcontractor engineering documents, including instrument calculation, selection and PLC programming subcontractor.

• Supervision and support of subcontractors' activities

• Technical support for costing of skid projects.

• Support receiving inspection of project E&I items.

• Technical support for workshop skid assembly.

• Material selection within discipline

• Value engineering within discipline

• Interface management between disciplines

• Participation in the project meetings, 3D models review etc.

• Tracking and managing changes within discipline

• Participation in the project progress report development.

Der (Maschinen-)Ingenieurspezialist ist für die Erforschung, Konstruktion und Entwicklung mechanischer Systeme und Komponenten verantwortlich. • Überwachung und Unterstützung der Aktivitäten von Subunternehmern

• Technische Unterstützung bei der Kostenkalkulation von Skid-Projekten.

• Unterstützung bei der Inspektion von Projekt-E&I-Elementen.

• Technische Unterstützung bei der Werkstatt-Skid-Montage.

• Materialauswahl innerhalb der Disziplin

• Value Engineering innerhalb der Disziplin

• Schnittstellenmanagement zwischen den Disziplinen

• Mitwirkung an der Entwicklung der Designphilosophie und internen Standards innerhalb der Disziplin

• Teilnahme an Projektbesprechungen, Überprüfung von 3D-Modellen usw.

• Mitwirken bei der Entwicklung des gesamten Projektzeitplans.

• Verfolgen und Verwalten von Änderungen innerhalb der Disziplin

• Mitwirkung bei der Entwicklung des Projektfortschrittsberichts.

Ausbildung und Erfahrung

• Bachelor in Elektrotechnik/Instrumententechnik

• 10 Jahre Erfahrung in der Öl- und Gasindustrie.

• Gute Kenntnisse der geltenden Industriestandards und Best Practices. (China und International)

• Gute Kenntnisse in Entwurfsmethoden und wirtschaftlicher Analyse.

• Gute Kenntnisse im Skid- und Moduldesign

• Allgemeine Kenntnisse im Öl- und Gasanlagenbau.

• Fähigkeit, in mehreren Projekten zu arbeiten.

• Fähigkeit zu Geschäftsreisen, einschließlich längerer Geschäftsreisen zur Baustelle während der Bau- und Inbetriebnahmephase.

Zielbonus: 18,33 % des Jahreseinkommens

Le spécialiste en génie (mécanique) est responsable de la recherche, de la conception et du développement de systèmes et de composants mécaniques. Ce rôle applique des connaissances avancées en ingénierie pour soutenir le développement et les tests de systèmes mécaniques et électromécaniques.

En tant qu'ingénieur E&I senior, vous participerez à l'exécution des projets Sulzer à toutes les étapes d'exécution (conception conceptuelle, conception skid et modulaire, DD, support approvisionnement/construction/mise en service et et.) dans le cadre de la discipline et du responsable.
L'ingénieur E&I senior relève de l'ingénieur en chef E&I et/ou du responsable de l'ingénierie.

主要任务与职责 :
Principales tâches et responsabilités :

• Préparer les spécifications techniques pour l'enquête, émettre une demande d'instruments, d'articles connexes et de travaux de sous-traitance.

• Préparation et conception du schéma de tuyauterie et d'instrumentation, en collaboration avec les ingénieurs procédés

• Préparation de la philosophie de contrôle de fonctionnement de l'usine de traitement, y compris la matrice de déclenchement des alarmes et des verrouillages en collaboration avec les ingénieurs de procédés.

• Participer à HAZOP pour l'usine de transformation

• Examiner et approuver les documents d'ingénierie des sous-traitants, y compris le calcul des instruments, la sélection et la programmation des automates du sous-traitant.

• Supervision et accompagnement des activités des sous-traitants

• Support technique pour le chiffrage des projets de skid.

• Soutenir la réception de l'inspection des éléments E&I du projet.

• Support technique pour l'assemblage des skids en atelier.

• Sélection des matériaux au sein de la discipline

• Ingénierie de la valeur au sein de la discipline

• Gestion des interfaces entre disciplines

• Participation au développement de la philosophie de conception et des normes internes au sein de la discipline

• Participation aux réunions de projet, revue des modèles 3D etc.

• Contribuer à l'élaboration du calendrier global du projet.

• Suivre et gérer les changements au sein de la discipline

• Participation à l'élaboration du rapport d'avancement du projet.

职位要求:
Qualités :
Éducation et expérience

• Baccalauréat en génie électrique/instrumentation

• 10 ans d'expérience dans les industries pétrolières et gazières.

• Bonne connaissance des normes industrielles applicables et des meilleures pratiques. (Chine et international)

• Bonne connaissance des méthodes de conception et d'analyse économique.

• Bonne connaissance de la conception skid et modulaire

• Connaissance générale de la construction d'usines pétrolières et gazières.

Langue

• Maîtrise du mandarin et de l'anglais

D'autres

• Capacité à travailler dans des délais serrés avec plusieurs tâches.

• Capacité à travailler sur plusieurs projets.

• Capacité à voyager lors de voyages d'affaires, y compris de longs voyages d'affaires sur le site pendant la construction et la mise en service.

Ce que nous vous proposons

bonus cible：18,33% du revenu annuel

jobs.title: ESH Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The ESH Engineer is responsible for supporting basic environmental, safety, and health activities, including inspections, data collection, and compliance monitoring. This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyse problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. Main tasks and responsibilities:
- Implement applicable national workplace safety laws and regulations, standards and specifications, and the company’s safety management system; implement the safety production responsibility system.
- Conduct daily on-site safety inspections and hazard identification and rectification. Focus on high-risk activities such as machinery operations, welding, chemical use, dust-related work, working at height, hot work, temporary electrical work, and heavy lifting/handling.
- Supervise workers correct wearing and use of personal protective equipment (PPE) and promptly stop the “three violations” (unauthorized command, unsafe/unauthorized operation, and violation of work discipline).
- Organize three-level safety induction training for new employees, pre-job/toolbox safety briefings, special safety training, and emergency drills to enhance safety awareness and emergency response capability.
- Participate in permit-to-work approvals and on-site monitoring for hazardous operations; verify work conditions, control measures, and personnel qualifications to ensure compliant execution.
- Conduct periodic inspection, maintenance, and management of fire-fighting facilities, emergency equipment, and protective supplies to ensure they are in good condition and effective.
- Improve safety signs, warning boards, and safety communication materials, and promote on-site safety culture.
- Participate in the investigation and handling of safety incidents/accidents; perform root-cause analysis, record and report findings, and track implementation of corrective actions.
- Establish and maintain safety records, inspection logs, training files, and hazard rectification closure records to ensure they are standardized and complete.
- Complete other workplace safety management tasks assigned by supervisors.

What we offer you

target bonus：15% of annual income

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Senior QC Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary

Ensures quality and technical compliance in servicing rotating equipment, including pumps, turbines, and compressors. Ensures adherence to Sulzer OEM, customer, and international standards, while supporting inspections, repair solutions, and quality procedures. Provides technical feedback, prepares inspection reports, and develops and implements required standards.

Key Responsibilities

• Conduct incoming, in-process, and final inspections of rotating equipment and components.

• Prepare and review overhaul reports with technical recommendations.

• Develop work instructions, drawings, and repair methods based on findings.

• Maintain job packs, checklists, inspection records, and SOPs.

• Prepare and execute Inspection & Test Plans (ITPs) with stakeholders.

• Provide technical quality support, including WPS/PQR review and material selection.

• Perform dimensional, geometric, and disassembly inspections.

• Manage NCRs, including RCA, CAPA, and lessons learned.

• Coordinate and oversee NDT and specialized testing with third parties.

• Ensure calibration, control, and traceability of inspection equipment.

• Support operations/projects, including progress updates and resolving technical issues.

• Train staff on quality standards and support LEAN and continuous improvement.

• Ensure compliance with EHS, quality procedures, and 5S practices.

• Promote a safe, clean, and positive work environment.

Qualifications / Requirements

• Bachelor’s degree in engineering

• Minimum of 7 years of experience in a similar or related role

• Strong centrifugal pump background required; compressor/turbine experience is an advantage.

• Ability to interpret engineering drawings, manuals, and technical specifications

• Experience in procedure development and NCR handling

• Proficient in precision measurement and workshop inspection

• Solid understanding of pump hydraulics, mechanical seals, and rotating equipment

• NDT certification (LPT/MPI/UT Level 2); LEAA lifting/rigging certification is a plus

• Knowledge of OEM standards and practices preferred

What we offer you

• Excellent opportunities for development, along with a competitive salary and company bonus scheme.

• A great working environment.

• Work Location: Riyadh- Industrial Area 2

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer è una società leader nel settore dell'ingegneria con un orgoglioso patrimonio di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile.

Sul ruolo

Riepilogo del lavoro

Garantisce la qualità e la conformità tecnica nella manutenzione delle apparecchiature rotanti, comprese pompe, turbine e compressori. Garantisce il rispetto degli standard OEM, dei clienti e internazionali di Sulzer, supportando al contempo ispezioni, soluzioni di riparazione e procedure di qualità. Fornisce feedback tecnico, prepara rapporti di ispezione e sviluppa e implementa gli standard richiesti.

Responsabilità chiave

• Condurre ispezioni in entrata, in corso e finali delle apparecchiature e dei componenti rotanti.

• Preparare ed esaminare i rapporti di revisione con raccomandazioni tecniche.

• Sviluppare istruzioni di lavoro, disegni e metodi di riparazione basati sui risultati.

• Conservare pacchetti di lavoro, liste di controllo, registri di ispezione e SOP.

• Preparare ed eseguire piani di ispezione e test (ITP) con le parti interessate.

• Fornire supporto tecnico di qualità, inclusa la revisione WPS/PQR e la selezione dei materiali.

• Eseguire ispezioni dimensionali, geometriche e di smontaggio.

• Gestire gli NCR, inclusi RCA, CAPA e le lezioni apprese.

• Coordinare e supervisionare NDT e test specializzati con terze parti.

About the role

Safely and efficiently disassemble, thoroughly inspect, and precisely build rotating equipment such as steam turbines, gas turbines, compressors, hot gas expanders, gear boxes and other machinery according to Sulzer’s established guidelines and safety protocols. Assembly Mechanic

Sulzer offers you a wealth of opportunities to drive your career into the direction that you want, depending on your skills and interests. We've been awarded a top employer nationwide for the past 3 years. We invite you to apply if you are ready to take the next step!

We are looking for Assembly Mechanics to join our Core team in La Porte.

Your main tasks and responsibilities:

• Utilize precision measuring instruments, such as micrometers, dial indicators, and bore gauges, to take accurate measurements and assess dimensional integrity of parts.

• Operate overhead cranes, torches, grinders, and forklifts when required.

• Prepare detailed inspection reports documenting findings and measurements.

• Execute unit assembly of repaired or replaced components, following technical specifications and quality standards.

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• 3 years of hands-on, shop oriented experience turbomachinery repair preferred.

• High mechanical aptitude and experience in detailed mechanic industries (turbines, compressors, rotating equipment)

• Willingness to work overtime when necessary.

• Must be able to use precision measuring instruments.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The Order to Cash (OTC) Credit & Collections Coordinator is responsible for assessing the creditworthiness of current and potential customers and advice on the setup of new customers, managing credit risk, and supporting the overall OTC process in close collaboration with the country Project Managers and Credit Control Managers. Moreover, the professional is responsible for managing and executing the collections process to ensure timely payments from customers, maintaining healthy cash flow and minimizing risk of bad debts. The Credit & Collections Accountant will play a crucial role in maintaining financial stability of the organization by ensuring that receivables are collected in a timely manner.

Key Responsibilities:

• Evaluate customer credit applications using credit scoring models and financial analysis to determine the degree of risk involved in extending the credit

• Analyze new customer and advise on the acceptance/rejection for the setup in the Master Data

• Conduct thorough financial analysis, including reviewing financial statements, credit reports and payment history to set and adjust credit limits

• Monitor and analyze customers’ credit exposures and make recommendations to minimize risk and optimize accounts receivables

• Collaborate closely with the Senior Credit & Collection Accountants, local Project Managers, sales and customer service teams to resolve credit issues and support business growth while managing credit risk as well as to address any disputes or issues that delay payments

• Execute collections strategies to reduce Days of Sales Outstanding (DSO) and improve cash flow

• Engage with customers via phone, email or other communication channels to negotiate timely payments and resolve outstanding receivables

• Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of all credit & collections-related activities, including credit review, limits and terms

• Communicate credit policies and procedures to relevant stakeholders within the organization

• Support the collections process, ensuring timely payments from customers

• Prepare credit & collections reports and risk assessments for management, highlighting trends, potential risks and opportunities for improvement

• Support the OTC and Reporting & Analytics team with the month-end closing activities, ensuring accurate and timely financial reporting related to credit and accounts receivable

• Participate in continuous improvement initiatives to enhance credit processes and systems

• Ensure OTC internal controls are in place in the CoE and followed for the processes performed by this role

Minimum Job Requirements/Skillset:

• University degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration or related field

• Minimum of 1-2 years of experience in OTC, credit analysis, risk assessment or a similar role

• Experience within the manufacturing or industrial sectors is preferred

• Strong understanding of financial analysis, credit scoring, and risk management principles as well as the collection processes

• Proficiency in financial statement analysis and interpreting credit reports

• Excellent analytical, problem-solving and decision-making skills

• Proficient in ERP systems (relevant to your business unit; SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365 or iScala )

• Strong MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint) skills

• Experience with Tagetik and Qlik Sense is a plus

What we offer you

• 30 days Christmas Bonus ( Aguinaldo )

• Savings Fund: 8% monthly matching

• Pension Plan & Seniority Recognition

• Major Medical Insurance (Individual)

• Life, Dental, and Vision Insurance

• 12 days of vacation to start with a 50% vacation premium

Sulzer è una società leader nel settore dell'ingegneria con un orgoglioso patrimonio di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile.

Sul ruolo

Il coordinatore crediti e riscossioni Order to Cash (OTC) è responsabile della valutazione dell'affidabilità creditizia dei clienti attuali e potenziali e della consulenza sulla creazione di nuovi clienti, sulla gestione del rischio di credito e sul supporto dell'intero processo OTC in stretta collaborazione con i project manager nazionali e i responsabili del controllo del credito. Inoltre, il professionista è responsabile della gestione e dell'esecuzione del processo di riscossione per garantire pagamenti tempestivi da parte dei clienti, mantenendo un flusso di cassa sano e minimizzando il rischio di crediti inesigibili. Il contabile crediti e riscossioni svolgerà un ruolo cruciale nel mantenimento della stabilità finanziaria dell'organizzazione garantendo che i crediti vengano riscossi in modo tempestivo.

Responsabilità chiave:

• Valutare le richieste di credito dei clienti utilizzando modelli di credit scoring e analisi finanziarie per determinare il grado di rischio coinvolto nell'estensione del credito

• Analizzare il nuovo cliente e consigliare l'accettazione/rifiuto per l'impostazione nei dati anagrafici

• Condurre un'analisi finanziaria approfondita, inclusa la revisione dei rendiconti finanziari, dei rapporti di credito e della cronologia dei pagamenti per impostare e adeguare i limiti di credito

• Monitorare e analizzare le esposizioni creditizie dei clienti e formulare raccomandazioni per ridurre al minimo il rischio e ottimizzare i crediti

• Collaborare a stretto contatto con i Senior Credit & Collection Accountants, i Project Manager locali, i team di vendita e di assistenza clienti per risolvere problemi di credito e supportare la crescita aziendale gestendo al contempo il rischio di credito, nonché per affrontare eventuali controversie o problemi che ritardano i pagamenti

• Eseguire strategie di riscossione per ridurre i giorni di vendite in sospeso (DSO) e migliorare il flusso di cassa

• Interagire con i clienti tramite telefono, e-mail o altri canali di comunicazione per negoziare pagamenti tempestivi e risolvere i crediti in sospeso

• Mantenere registrazioni accurate e aggiornate di tutte le attività relative al credito e alla riscossione, inclusa la revisione del credito, i limiti e i termini

• Comunicare le politiche e le procedure di credito alle parti interessate rilevanti all'interno dell'organizzazione

• Supportare il processo di riscossione, garantendo pagamenti puntuali da parte dei clienti

• Preparare rapporti su crediti e riscossioni e valutazioni del rischio per il management, evidenziando tendenze, rischi potenziali e opportunità di miglioramento

• Supportare il team OTC e Reporting & Analytics con le attività di chiusura di fine mese, garantendo un reporting finanziario accurato e tempestivo relativo al credito e ai crediti

• Partecipare a iniziative di miglioramento continuo per migliorare i processi e i sistemi creditizi

• Garantire che i controlli interni OTC siano in atto nel CoE e seguiti per i processi svolti da questo ruolo

Requisiti lavorativi/competenze minime:

• Laurea in Finanza, Contabilità, Amministrazione aziendale o settore correlato

• Minimo 1-2 anni di esperienza in OTC, analisi del credito, valutazione del rischio o ruolo simile

• Costituisce titolo preferenziale esperienza nel settore manifatturiero o industriale

• Ottima conoscenza dell'analisi finanziaria, del credit scoring e dei principi di gestione del rischio, nonché dei processi di riscossione

• Competenza nell'analisi del bilancio e nell'interpretazione dei rapporti di credito

• Eccellenti capacità analitiche, di problem solving e decisionali

• Competente nei sistemi ERP (pertinente alla tua business unit; SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365 o iScala)

• Ottime competenze in MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint).

• L'esperienza con Tagetik e Qlik Sense costituisce un vantaggio

Cosa ti offriamo

• Bonus di Natale di 30 giorni (Aguinaldo)

• Fondo di risparmio: 8% di integrazione mensile

• Piano pensionistico e riconoscimento dell'anzianità

• Assicurazione medica principale (individuale)

• Assicurazione sulla vita, dentistica e sulla vista

• 12 giorni di ferie per iniziare con un premio di vacanza del 50%.

Über die Rolle

Der Order-to-Cash (OTC)-Kredit- und Inkassokoordinator ist für die Beurteilung der Kreditwürdigkeit aktueller und potenzieller Kunden sowie für die Beratung bei der Einrichtung neuer Kunden, das Management des Kreditrisikos und die Unterstützung des gesamten OTC-Prozesses in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Projektmanagern und Kreditkontrollmanagern des Landes verantwortlich. Darüber hinaus ist der Fachmann für die Verwaltung und Durchführung des Inkassoprozesses verantwortlich, um pünktliche Zahlungen von Kunden sicherzustellen, einen gesunden Cashflow aufrechtzuerhalten und das Risiko von Forderungsausfällen zu minimieren. Der Kredit- und Inkassobuchhalter spielt eine entscheidende Rolle bei der Aufrechterhaltung der finanziellen Stabilität der Organisation, indem er dafür sorgt, dass Forderungen rechtzeitig eingezogen werden.

Hauptaufgaben:

• Bewerten Sie Kreditanträge von Kunden mithilfe von Kreditbewertungsmodellen und Finanzanalysen, um den Grad des Risikos zu ermitteln, das mit der Kreditvergabe verbunden ist

• Analysieren Sie neue Kunden und beraten Sie über die Annahme/Ablehnung für die Einrichtung in den Stammdaten

• Führen Sie eine gründliche Finanzanalyse durch, einschließlich der Überprüfung von Finanzberichten, Kreditberichten und Zahlungshistorien, um Kreditlimits festzulegen und anzupassen

• Überwachen und analysieren Sie die Kreditrisiken Ihrer Kunden und geben Sie Empfehlungen zur Risikominimierung und Optimierung der Forderungen

• Arbeiten Sie eng mit den leitenden Kredit- und Inkassobuchhaltern, lokalen Projektmanagern, Vertriebs- und Kundendienstteams zusammen, um Kreditprobleme zu lösen und das Geschäftswachstum zu unterstützen und gleichzeitig das Kreditrisiko zu verwalten sowie etwaige Streitigkeiten oder Probleme zu lösen, die Zahlungen verzögern

• Führen Sie Inkassostrategien aus, um die ausstehenden Tage (Days of Sales Outstanding, DSO) zu reduzieren und den Cashflow zu verbessern

• Treten Sie per Telefon, E-Mail oder über andere Kommunikationskanäle mit Kunden in Kontakt, um pünktliche Zahlungen auszuhandeln und ausstehende Forderungen zu begleichen

• Unterstützen Sie den Inkassoprozess und stellen Sie pünktliche Zahlungen der Kunden sicher

• Beteiligen Sie sich an Initiativen zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung, um Kreditprozesse und -systeme zu verbessern

• Stellen Sie sicher, dass im CoE interne OTC-Kontrollen vorhanden sind und für die von dieser Rolle durchgeführten Prozesse befolgt werden

• Hervorragende Analyse-, Problemlösungs- und Entscheidungsfähigkeiten

• Gute MS-Office-Kenntnisse (Excel, PowerPoint).

Was wir Ihnen bieten

• 30 Tage Weihnachtsbonus (Aguinaldo)

• Sparfonds: 8 % monatliche Anpassung

• Pensionsplan und Dienstaltersanerkennung

• Lebens-, Zahn- und Sehversicherung

Sulzer est une société d'ingénierie leader avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable.

À propos du rôle

Le coordonnateur du crédit et des recouvrements Order to Cash (OTC) est chargé d'évaluer la solvabilité des clients actuels et potentiels et de conseiller sur l'installation de nouveaux clients, de gérer le risque de crédit et de soutenir le processus OTC global en étroite collaboration avec les chefs de projet nationaux et les responsables du contrôle de crédit. De plus, le professionnel est responsable de la gestion et de l’exécution du processus de recouvrement afin d’assurer les paiements des clients en temps opportun, de maintenir une trésorerie saine et de minimiser le risque de créances irrécouvrables. Le comptable du crédit et des recouvrements jouera un rôle crucial dans le maintien de la stabilité financière de l'organisation en veillant à ce que les créances soient recouvrées en temps opportun.

Responsabilités clés :

• Évaluer les demandes de crédit des clients à l'aide de modèles de notation de crédit et d'analyses financières pour déterminer le degré de risque impliqué dans l'octroi du crédit.

• Analyser le nouveau client et conseiller sur l'acceptation/rejet de la configuration dans les données de base

• Effectuer une analyse financière approfondie, y compris l'examen des états financiers, des rapports de crédit et de l'historique des paiements pour définir et ajuster les limites de crédit.

• Surveiller et analyser les expositions de crédit des clients et formuler des recommandations pour minimiser les risques et optimiser les comptes clients.

• Collaborer étroitement avec les comptables principaux de crédit et de recouvrement, les chefs de projet locaux, les équipes de vente et de service client pour résoudre les problèmes de crédit et soutenir la croissance de l'entreprise tout en gérant le risque de crédit ainsi que pour résoudre tout litige ou problème retardant les paiements.

• Exécuter des stratégies de recouvrement pour réduire les jours de ventes impayés (DSO) et améliorer les flux de trésorerie.

• S'engager avec les clients par téléphone, e-mail ou autres canaux de communication pour négocier les paiements dans les délais et résoudre les créances impayées.

• Tenir des registres précis et à jour de toutes les activités liées au crédit et au recouvrement, y compris l'examen du crédit, les limites et les conditions.

• Communiquer les politiques et procédures de crédit aux parties prenantes concernées au sein de l'organisation.

• Soutenir le processus de recouvrement, en garantissant les paiements en temps opportun des clients

• Préparer des rapports de crédit et de recouvrement et des évaluations des risques pour la direction, en mettant en évidence les tendances, les risques potentiels et les opportunités d'amélioration.

• Soutenir l'équipe OTC et Reporting & Analytics avec les activités de clôture de fin de mois, en garantissant des rapports financiers précis et opportuns liés au crédit et aux comptes clients.

• Participer aux initiatives d'amélioration continue pour améliorer les processus et les systèmes de crédit.

• S'assurer que les contrôles internes de l'OTC sont en place au sein du CoE et suivis pour les processus exécutés par ce rôle.

Exigences minimales du poste/compétences :

• Diplôme universitaire en finance, comptabilité, administration des affaires ou dans un domaine connexe

• Minimum de 1 à 2 ans d'expérience en gré à gré, en analyse de crédit, en évaluation des risques ou dans un rôle similaire

• Une expérience dans les secteurs manufacturier ou industriel est préférable

• Solide compréhension des principes d'analyse financière, de notation de crédit et de gestion des risques ainsi que des processus de recouvrement.

• Maîtrise de l'analyse des états financiers et de l'interprétation des rapports de crédit

• Excellentes compétences analytiques, de résolution de problèmes et de prise de décision

• Maîtrise des systèmes ERP (pertinents pour votre unité commerciale ; SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365 ou iScala)

• Solides compétences en MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint)

• Une expérience avec Tagetik et Qlik Sense est un plus

Ce que nous vous proposons

• 30 jours de bonus de Noël (Aguinaldo)

• Fonds d'épargne : abondement mensuel de 8 %

• Régime de retraite et reconnaissance de l'ancienneté

• Assurance médicale majeure (individuelle)

• Assurance vie, dentaire et visuelle

• 12 jours de vacances pour commencer avec une prime de vacances de 50 %

• Preparare rapporti di credito e collezioni e valutazioni dei rischi per la gestione, evidenziando tendenze, potenziali rischi e opportunità di miglioramento

• Sostenere il team OTC e Reporting & Analytics con le attività di chiusura di fine mese, assicurando una reportistica finanziaria accurata e tempestiva relativa al credito e ai conti crediti

• Partecipa a iniziative di miglioramento continuo per migliorare i processi e i sistemi di credito

De plus, le professionnel est responsable de la gestion et de l'exécution du processus de recouvrement afin d'assurer le paiement en temps opportun des clients, de maintenir des flux de trésorerie sains et de réduire le risque de créances douteuses. Le comptable des créances et recouvrements jouera un rôle crucial dans le maintien de la stabilité financière de l'organisation en veillant à ce que les créances soient perçues en temps opportun.

Principales responsabilités :

• Évaluer les demandes de crédit à la clientèle à l'aide de modèles de notation et d'analyse financière pour déterminer le degré de risque associé à l'extension du crédit

• Analyser le nouveau client et conseiller sur l'acceptation/rejection de l'installation dans le Master Data

• Effectuer une analyse financière approfondie, notamment en examinant les états financiers, les rapports de crédit et les antécédents de paiement afin de fixer et d'ajuster les limites de crédit

• Surveiller et analyser les expositions de crédit des clients et faire des recommandations pour minimiser les risques et optimiser les comptes débiteurs

• Collaborer étroitement avec les comptables principaux du crédit et de la perception, les gestionnaires de projet locaux, les équipes de vente et de service à la clientèle pour résoudre les problèmes de crédit et soutenir la croissance des entreprises tout en gérant le risque de crédit ainsi que pour régler les différends ou les problèmes qui retardent les paiements

• Exécuter des stratégies de recouvrement pour réduire les jours de vente en circulation et améliorer les flux de trésorerie

• Faire appel aux clients par téléphone, par courriel ou par d'autres moyens de communication pour négocier les paiements en temps opportun et régler les créances impayées

• Tenir des registres précis et à jour de toutes les activités liées au crédit et aux recouvrements, y compris l'examen du crédit, les limites et les modalités

• Communiquer les politiques et les procédures de crédit aux intervenants pertinents de l'organisation

• Soutenir le processus de collecte, en assurant le paiement en temps opportun des clients

• Préparer des rapports de crédit et de recouvrement et des évaluations des risques pour la gestion, en mettant en évidence les tendances, les risques potentiels et les possibilités d'amélioration

• Appuyer l'équipe du CTO et de l'analyse et des rapports dans les activités de clôture de fin de mois, en veillant à ce que les rapports financiers relatifs au crédit et aux comptes débiteurs soient exacts et opportuns

• Participer à des initiatives d'amélioration continue pour améliorer les processus et les systèmes de crédit

• S'assurer que les contrôles internes de l'OTC sont en place dans le Conseil de l'Europe et suivis pour les processus exécutés par ce rôle

Exigences et compétences minimales en matière d'emploi :

• Diplôme universitaire en finance, comptabilité, administration des affaires ou domaine connexe

• Minimum de 1 à 2 ans d'expérience en CTO, en analyse de crédit, en évaluation des risques ou dans un rôle similaire

• L'expérience dans les secteurs manufacturier ou industriel est privilégiée

• Connaissance approfondie des principes d'analyse financière, de notation et de gestion du risque ainsi que des processus de collecte

• Compétence en analyse des états financiers et en interprétation des rapports de crédit

• Excellente capacité d'analyse, de résolution de problèmes et de prise de décisions

• Compétence en systèmes ERP (pertinents pour votre unité commerciale; SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365 ou iScala)

• Fortes compétences de MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint)

• Expérience avec Tagetik et Qlik Sense est un plus

Ce que nous vous offrons

• 30 jours Bonus de Noël ( Aguinaldo )

• Caisse d'épargne : 8 % par mois

• Reconnaissance du régime de retraite et de l'ancienneté

• Assurance maladie majeure (individuelle)

• Assurance vie, soins dentaires et assurance vision

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

We are looking for a dynamic Accounts Payable Coordinator to join our Finance & Accounting team in Polanco, Mexico. This is an exciting opportunity to collaborate with international and external stakeholders, leverage your expertise in accounts payable. If you enjoy creating impact and eager to advance your career within a global and mission-led organization, we want to hear from you! In this position you will be a member of our Accounts Payable Controls team based in our Mexico office. You will work together with an external shared service center who is responsible for master data, invoice processing and payments. Furthermore, you will closely work other country Finance functions, Procurement, and external vendors.

Key Responsibilities

• Manage escalations in incoming accounts payable related queries from suppliers SULZER CONFIDENTIAL

• Review payment proposals and ensure a complete alignment with the country’s compliance requirements.

• Monitor and control accounts payable aging.

• Assist in the preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements according to IFRS.

• Drive process standardization and reduce inefficiencies, acting as a guide for the shared services teams.

• Actively support various projects, such as system implementations and process optimizations.

Skills & Qualifications

• Degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or related fields

• 4 years of experience in Accounts Payable

• Very good written and verbal communication skills

• Knowledge of ERP systems (preferable SAP or D365)

• Fluent English skills

• Analytical and problem-solving skills

What we offer you

• 30 days Christmas Bonus ( Aguinaldo )

• Savings Fund: 8% monthly matching

• Pension Plan & Seniority Recognition

• Major Medical Insurance (Individual)

• Life, Dental, and Vision Insurance

• 12 days of vacation to start with a 50% vacation premium

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The Controller is responsible for supporting the financial integrity of the organization through accurate reporting, compliance, and internal controls. This role involves preparing financial statements, assisting with audits, and ensuring adherence to accounting standards and policies.
This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. The Business Controller will serve as the primary financial liaison between local manufacturing operations and the Center of Excellence (CoE), ensuring seamless coordination and effective execution of key
financial and project management activities. Also ensure seamless coordination and effective execution of key financial processes.

Key responsibilities:

• Ensure accurate tracking and management of sales and backlogs

• Monitor customer order contract profitability and utilization metrics

• Link strategic plans to operational and financial drivers, aligning sales and operations planning, resource management, capital projects, other expenses, and working capital planning.

• Generate, model, and execute action plans to address performance gaps and improve overall site performance

• Provide business planning, forecasting, and budgeting know how and support to the relevant stakeholders

• Supervision and coordination of tasks with the Coe & BPO team.

• Variance analysis

• Responsible for managing internal reports.

• Support to the Head Office on financial matters.

What you need you to succeed:

• University degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration or related field

• Minimum of 2 years of experience in Controlling

• Proven track record in inventory management, cost control, and project management

• Experience within the manufacturing sectors is preferred

• Strong Knowledge of cost controlling, budgeting, and financial planning

• Excellent communication skills to liaise between local operations, BPO and CoE

• Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams

• Capacity to remain flexible and effective when facing challenges

• Continuous improvement mindset

• Experience with Tagetik and Qlik Sense is a plus

• Understanding of integrated ERP systems is a plus

• Strong MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint) skills

• Used to work with databases and reporting tools

• Proficiency in English (C1)

What we offer you

• A permanent contract.

• A competitive salary as well as participation in the variable remuneration system based on personal and financial objectives.

• Meal vouchers.

• Access to a voluntary flexible compensation scheme allowing employees to optimize their salary package (e.g. health insurance, transport, childcare)

• Be part of an experienced and international team.

• A Good vibe working environment.

• The opportunity to grow your career within a solid and well-established international company.

• Be part of a dynamic organization undergoing continuous transformation and improvement.

• Offices location: Rivas (Madrid)

Sulzer è una società leader nel settore dell'ingegneria con un orgoglioso patrimonio di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile.

Sul ruolo

Il Controller è responsabile di supportare l'integrità finanziaria dell'organizzazione attraverso reporting, conformità e controlli interni accurati. Questo ruolo prevede la preparazione del rendiconto finanziario, l'assistenza negli audit e la garanzia del rispetto dei principi e delle politiche contabili.
Questo profilo professionale è destinato a professionisti esperti che applicano la conoscenza pratica di un'area lavorativa e lavorano in modo indipendente con supervisione generale. Il Business Controller fungerà da collegamento finanziario primario tra le operazioni di produzione locali e il Centro di Eccellenza (CoE), garantendo un coordinamento senza soluzione di continuità e l'esecuzione efficace dei compiti chiave
attività finanziarie e di gestione dei progetti. Garantire inoltre un coordinamento senza soluzione di continuità e un'esecuzione efficace dei processi finanziari chiave.

Responsabilità principali:

• Garantire un monitoraggio e una gestione accurati delle vendite e degli arretrati

• Monitorare la redditività dei contratti relativi agli ordini dei clienti e le metriche di utilizzo

• Collegare i piani strategici ai fattori operativi e finanziari, allineando la pianificazione delle vendite e delle operazioni, la gestione delle risorse, i progetti di capitale, le altre spese e la pianificazione del capitale circolante.

• Generare, modellare ed eseguire piani d'azione per colmare le lacune prestazionali e migliorare le prestazioni complessive del sito

• Fornire know-how e supporto in materia di pianificazione aziendale, previsione e budget alle parti interessate pertinenti

• Supervisione e coordinamento delle attività con il team Coe & BPO.

• Analisi della varianza

• Responsabile della gestione dei report interni.

• Supporto alla Direzione Centrale su questioni finanziarie.

Cosa ti serve per avere successo:

• Laurea in Finanza, Contabilità, Amministrazione aziendale o settore correlato

• Minimo 2 anni di esperienza nel controllo

• Comprovata esperienza nella gestione dell'inventario, nel controllo dei costi e nella gestione dei progetti

• Costituisce titolo preferenziale esperienza nei settori manifatturieri

• Conoscenza approfondita del controllo dei costi, del budget e della pianificazione finanziaria

• Eccellenti capacità di comunicazione per mantenere i contatti tra le operazioni locali, BPO e CoE

• Capacità di lavorare efficacemente con team interfunzionali

• Capacità di rimanere flessibili ed efficaci nell'affrontare le sfide

• Mentalità di miglioramento continuo

• L'esperienza con Tagetik e Qlik Sense costituisce un vantaggio

• La conoscenza dei sistemi ERP integrati costituisce un vantaggio

• Ottime competenze in MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint).

• Utilizzato per lavorare con database e strumenti di reporting

• Conoscenza della lingua inglese (C1)

Cosa ti offriamo

• Un contratto a tempo indeterminato.

• Una retribuzione competitiva e la partecipazione al sistema di remunerazione variabile basato su obiettivi personali e finanziari.

• Buoni pasto.

• Accesso a un sistema di compensazione flessibile volontario che consenta ai dipendenti di ottimizzare il proprio pacchetto salariale (ad esempio assicurazione sanitaria, trasporti, assistenza all'infanzia)

• Far parte di un team esperto e internazionale.

• Un ambiente di lavoro con una buona atmosfera.

• L'opportunità di far crescere la tua carriera all'interno di un'azienda internazionale solida e consolidata.

• Essere parte di un'organizzazione dinamica in continua trasformazione e miglioramento.

• Ubicazione degli uffici: Rivas (Madrid)

Siamo orgogliosi di essere riconosciuti come Top Employer 2026 in Brasile, Canada, Cina, Finlandia, Germania, Irlanda, Messico, Svizzera, Sud Africa, Regno Unito e Stati Uniti.

Der Controller ist dafür verantwortlich, die finanzielle Integrität der Organisation durch genaue Berichterstattung, Compliance und interne Kontrollen zu unterstützen. Diese Rolle umfasst die Erstellung von Jahresabschlüssen, die Unterstützung bei Prüfungen und die Sicherstellung der Einhaltung von Rechnungslegungsstandards und -richtlinien.
Dieses Berufsbild richtet sich an erfahrene Fachkräfte, die praktische Kenntnisse in einem Berufsfeld anwenden und unter allgemeiner Aufsicht selbstständig arbeiten. Der Business Controller fungiert als primäre finanzielle Verbindung zwischen den lokalen Produktionsbetrieben und dem Center of Excellence (CoE) und sorgt für eine nahtlose Koordination und effektive Ausführung wichtiger Aufgaben
Finanz- und Projektmanagementaktivitäten. Sorgen Sie außerdem für eine reibungslose Koordination und effektive Ausführung wichtiger Finanzprozesse.

Hauptaufgaben:

• Gewährleisten Sie eine genaue Verfolgung und Verwaltung von Verkäufen und Rückständen

• Überwachen Sie die Rentabilität und Auslastungskennzahlen von Kundenauftragsverträgen

• Verknüpfen Sie strategische Pläne mit operativen und finanziellen Faktoren und stimmen Sie Vertriebs- und Betriebsplanung, Ressourcenmanagement, Kapitalprojekte, andere Ausgaben und Betriebskapitalplanung aufeinander ab.

• Aktionspläne erstellen, modellieren und ausführen, um Leistungslücken zu schließen und die Gesamtleistung der Website zu verbessern

• Bereitstellung von Fachwissen und Unterstützung für Geschäftsplanung, Prognosen und Budgetierung für die relevanten Stakeholder

• Überwachung und Koordination der Aufgaben mit dem Coe & BPO-Team.

• Varianzanalyse

• Verantwortlich für die Verwaltung interner Berichte.

• Unterstützung der Zentrale in finanziellen Angelegenheiten.

Was Sie brauchen, um erfolgreich zu sein:

• Universitätsabschluss in Finanzen, Rechnungswesen, Betriebswirtschaft oder einem verwandten Bereich

• Mindestens 2 Jahre Erfahrung im Controlling

• Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz in der Bestandsverwaltung, Kostenkontrolle und im Projektmanagement

• Erfahrung in der Fertigungsbranche wird bevorzugt

• Fundierte Kenntnisse in Kostenkontrolle, Budgetierung und Finanzplanung

• Hervorragende Kommunikationsfähigkeiten zur Kommunikation zwischen lokalen Betrieben, BPO und CoE

• Fähigkeit, effektiv mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams zusammenzuarbeiten

• Fähigkeit, bei Herausforderungen flexibel und effektiv zu bleiben

• Einstellung zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung

• Erfahrung mit Tagetik und Qlik Sense ist von Vorteil

• Kenntnisse über integrierte ERP-Systeme sind von Vorteil

• Gute MS-Office-Kenntnisse (Excel, PowerPoint).

• Wird für die Arbeit mit Datenbanken und Berichtstools verwendet

• Englischkenntnisse (C1)

Was wir Ihnen bieten

• Ein unbefristeter Vertrag.

• Ein wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt sowie Teilnahme am variablen Vergütungssystem basierend auf persönlichen und finanziellen Zielen.

• Essensgutscheine.

• Zugang zu einem freiwilligen flexiblen Vergütungssystem, das es den Mitarbeitern ermöglicht, ihr Gehaltspaket zu optimieren (z. B. Krankenversicherung, Transport, Kinderbetreuung)

• Werden Sie Teil eines erfahrenen und internationalen Teams.

• Ein angenehmes Arbeitsumfeld.

• Die Möglichkeit, Ihre Karriere in einem soliden und gut etablierten internationalen Unternehmen voranzutreiben.

• Seien Sie Teil einer dynamischen Organisation, die sich kontinuierlich verändert und verbessert.

jobs.title: Record to Report accountant
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Accounting Officer is responsible for supporting accounting operations including data entry, reconciliations, and assisting with financial reporting. This role ensures accuracy in financial records and supports compliance with accounting standards. This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyse problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. The RTR Senior Accountant in the Center of Excellence (CoE) works in a RTR team assigned to multiple countries, supporting the Record to Report (RTR) teams for example with various ad hoc tasks, complex bookings, or the maintenance of the chart of accounts.

Key responsibilities

• Serve as a member of the RTR team in the CoE, providing support on ad hoc topics and accounting issues

• Support with financial booking activities, ensuring accuracy and compliance with International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) and Sulzer regulations

• Manage clearing, including reconciliations and adjustments, to maintain accurate financial records

• Utilize advanced knowledge of ERP systems to streamline accounting processes

• Support the Global Process Owner (GPO) with system implementations

• Maintain and update the chart of accounts and hierarchies, ensuring it reflects the current business structure and reporting requirements

• Collaborate closely with local Finance Teams in countries and Finance Shared Services teams / Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) provider

• Coordinate with other departments and the Finance Shared Services teams to ensure all financial transactions are properly accounted for and reflected in the general ledger

• Supports the period end close, including closing the accounts receivable/payable subledger and reconcile with the general ledger; close general ledger, open new financial period, close Asset Accounting (AA)

• Support with the preparation of journal entries, balance sheet reconciliations and variance analysis

• Contribute to the continuous improvement of the RTR process, leveraging technology and best practices; maintain policies, procedures and templates

• Ensure financial internal controls are in place and followed for the processes performed by this role

• Do all technical Year End Closing activities such as balance carry forward, number range creations, close of AA

• Support Intercompany reconciliation process in Coprocess and Tagetik (fix variances)

Education and experience

• University degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration or related field

• Minimum of 2-3 years of experience in Accounting with a strong focus on general ledger and financial reporting

• CPA, ACCA, CMA or equivalent certification preferred

Critical success factors

• Strong analytical, problem-solving and management skills

• Excellent attention to detail and commitment to accuracy and integrity in financial reporting

• Proven ability to manage multiple priorities in a deadline-driven environment

• Strong communication skills for delivering key insights to senior leadership

Technical & language skills

• Proficient in ERP systems (relevant to your business unit; SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365 or iScala) and accounting software

• Strong MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint) skills

• Experience with Tagetik, Coprocess and Qlik Sense is a plus

• Proficiency in English

Interfaces with

• Accounting teams

• Reporting & Analytics team

• Local Accounting Managers

• Country Finance Heads

• RTR GPO

• External stakeholders (i.e. auditors, tax authorities etc.)

What we offer you

Medical insurance for self and family
Company sponsored transportation facility during week days
