Sul ruolo

Riepilogo del lavoro
Il contabile è responsabile del supporto delle operazioni contabili, tra cui l'immissione dei dati, le riconciliazioni e l'assistenza nella rendicontazione finanziaria. Questo ruolo garantisce l'accuratezza dei registri finanziari e supporta la conformità agli standard contabili. Questo profilo professionale è destinato a professionisti all'inizio della carriera che applicano ampie conoscenze teoriche e richiedono la capacità di indagare e analizzare i problemi. Le soluzioni vengono generalmente discusse/verificate con un membro più esperto. Il Senior Accountant RTR presso il Centro di Eccellenza (CoE) lavora in un team RTR assegnato a più paesi, supportando i team Record to Report (RTR), ad esempio con vari compiti ad hoc, registrazioni complesse o la manutenzione del piano dei conti.

Responsabilità chiave

• Servire come membro del team RTR nel CoE, fornendo supporto su argomenti ad hoc e questioni contabili

• Supporto nelle attività di contabilizzazione finanziaria, garantendo l'accuratezza e la conformità agli International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) e alle normative Sulzer

• Gestire la compensazione, comprese riconciliazioni e aggiustamenti, per mantenere registri finanziari accurati

• Utilizzare la conoscenza avanzata dei sistemi ERP per semplificare i processi contabili

• Supportare il Global Process Owner (GPO) con le implementazioni del sistema

• Mantenere e aggiornare il piano dei conti e le gerarchie, assicurandosi che rifletta l'attuale struttura aziendale e i requisiti di reporting

• Collaborare a stretto contatto con i team finanziari locali nei paesi e con i team di servizi finanziari condivisi/fornitore di Business Process Outsourcing (BPO).

• Coordinarsi con gli altri dipartimenti e i team dei servizi finanziari condivisi per garantire che tutte le transazioni finanziarie siano adeguatamente contabilizzate e riflesse nella contabilità generale

• Supporta la chiusura di fine periodo, inclusa la chiusura del registro secondario dei conti clienti/debiti e la riconciliazione con la contabilità generale; chiudere la contabilità generale, aprire un nuovo periodo finanziario, chiudere la contabilità patrimoniale (AA)

• Supporto nella preparazione delle scritture contabili, riconciliazioni di bilancio e analisi degli scostamenti

• Contribuire al miglioramento continuo del processo RTR, sfruttando la tecnologia e le migliori pratiche; mantenere politiche, procedure e modelli

• Garantire che i controlli finanziari interni siano in atto e seguiti per i processi svolti da questo ruolo

• Eseguire tutte le attività tecniche di chiusura di fine anno, come il riporto del saldo, la creazione di intervalli di numeri, la chiusura di AA

• Supportare il processo di riconciliazione interaziendale in Coprocess e Tagetik (correzione delle varianze)

Formazione ed esperienza

• Laurea in Finanza, Contabilità, Amministrazione aziendale o settore correlato

• Minimo 2-3 anni di esperienza in contabilità con una forte attenzione alla contabilità generale e al reporting finanziario

• Preferibile certificazione CPA, ACCA, CMA o equivalente

Fattori critici di successo

• Forti capacità analitiche, di problem solving e di gestione

• Eccellente attenzione ai dettagli e impegno per l'accuratezza e l'integrità nel reporting finanziario

• Comprovata capacità di gestire più priorità in un ambiente basato sulle scadenze

• Forti capacità di comunicazione per fornire informazioni chiave alla leadership senior

Competenze tecniche e linguistiche

• Competente nei sistemi ERP (pertinenti alla vostra business unit; SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365 o iScala) e nei software di contabilità

• Ottime competenze in MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint).

• L'esperienza con Tagetik, Coprocess e Qlik Sense costituisce un vantaggio

• Conoscenza della lingua inglese

Si interfaccia con

• Squadre contabili

• Team di reporting e analisi

• Responsabili Contabilità Locali

• Responsabili finanziari nazionali

• Oggetto Criteri di gruppo RTR

• Stakeholder esterni (ad esempio revisori, autorità fiscali, ecc.)

Cosa ti offriamo

Assicurazione medica per sé e per la famiglia
Struttura di trasporto sponsorizzata dall'azienda durante i giorni feriali

Sulzer ist ein führendes Ingenieurunternehmen mit einer stolzen Tradition der Innovation. Werden Sie Teil unseres globalen Teams, um Ihr Fachwissen zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine wohlhabende und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen.

Über die Rolle

Jobzusammenfassung
Der Rechnungsführer ist für die Unterstützung der Buchhaltungsvorgänge verantwortlich, einschließlich Dateneingabe, Abstimmungen und Unterstützung bei der Finanzberichterstattung. Diese Rolle stellt die Genauigkeit der Finanzunterlagen sicher und unterstützt die Einhaltung von Buchhaltungsstandards. Dieses Berufsbild richtet sich an Berufseinsteiger, die über ein breites theoretisches Wissen verfügen und über die Fähigkeit verfügen, Probleme zu untersuchen und zu analysieren. Lösungen werden in der Regel mit einem erfahreneren Mitglied besprochen/überprüft. Der RTR Senior Accountant im Center of Excellence (CoE) arbeitet in einem länderübergreifenden RTR-Team und unterstützt die Record to Report (RTR)-Teams beispielsweise bei verschiedenen Ad-hoc-Aufgaben, komplexen Buchungen oder der Pflege des Kontenplans.

Hauptverantwortlichkeiten

• Als Mitglied des RTR-Teams im CoE fungieren und Unterstützung bei Ad-hoc-Themen und Rechnungslegungsfragen leisten

• Unterstützung bei Finanzbuchungsaktivitäten, Sicherstellung der Genauigkeit und Einhaltung der International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) und der Sulzer-Vorschriften

• Verwalten Sie das Clearing, einschließlich Abstimmungen und Anpassungen, um genaue Finanzunterlagen zu führen

• Nutzen Sie fortgeschrittene Kenntnisse über ERP-Systeme, um Buchhaltungsprozesse zu optimieren

• Unterstützen Sie den Global Process Owner (GPO) bei Systemimplementierungen

• Pflegen und aktualisieren Sie den Kontenplan und die Hierarchien und stellen Sie sicher, dass er die aktuelle Geschäftsstruktur und die Berichtsanforderungen widerspiegelt

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit lokalen Finanzteams in den Ländern und Finance Shared Services-Teams/Business Process Outsourcing (BPO)-Anbietern

• Koordinieren Sie sich mit anderen Abteilungen und den Finance Shared Services-Teams, um sicherzustellen, dass alle Finanztransaktionen ordnungsgemäß verbucht und im Hauptbuch widergespiegelt werden

• Unterstützt den Periodenabschluss, einschließlich der Schließung des Debitoren-/Verbindlichkeitsnebenbuchs und der Abstimmung mit dem Hauptbuch; Hauptbuch schließen, neue Finanzperiode eröffnen, Anlagenbuchhaltung (AA) schließen

• Unterstützung bei der Erstellung von Journalbuchungen, Bilanzabstimmungen und Abweichungsanalysen

• Beitrag zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung des RTR-Prozesses durch Nutzung von Technologie und Best Practices; Pflegen Sie Richtlinien, Verfahren und Vorlagen

• Stellen Sie sicher, dass interne Finanzkontrollen für die von dieser Rolle durchgeführten Prozesse vorhanden sind und befolgt werden

• Führen Sie alle technischen Aktivitäten zum Jahresabschluss durch, z. B. Saldoübertrag, Erstellung von Nummernkreisen und AA-Abschluss

• Unterstützung des Intercompany-Abstimmungsprozesses in Coprocess und Tagetik (Behebung von Abweichungen)

Ausbildung und Erfahrung

• Universitätsabschluss in Finanzen, Rechnungswesen, Betriebswirtschaft oder einem verwandten Bereich

• Mindestens 2-3 Jahre Erfahrung im Rechnungswesen mit starkem Fokus auf Hauptbuchhaltung und Finanzberichterstattung

• CPA, ACCA, CMA oder gleichwertige Zertifizierung bevorzugt

Kritische Erfolgsfaktoren

• Starke Analyse-, Problemlösungs- und Managementfähigkeiten

• Ausgezeichnete Liebe zum Detail und Engagement für Genauigkeit und Integrität in der Finanzberichterstattung

• Nachgewiesene Fähigkeit, mehrere Prioritäten in einer termingesteuerten Umgebung zu verwalten

• Starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten zur Vermittlung wichtiger Erkenntnisse an die Geschäftsleitung

Technische und sprachliche Fähigkeiten

• Kenntnisse in ERP-Systemen (relevant für Ihre Geschäftseinheit; SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365 oder iScala) und Buchhaltungssoftware

• Gute MS-Office-Kenntnisse (Excel, PowerPoint).

Sulzer est une société d'ingénierie leader avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable.

À propos du rôle

Résumé du poste
Le comptable est chargé de soutenir les opérations comptables, y compris la saisie des données, les rapprochements et de contribuer à l'élaboration des rapports financiers. Ce rôle garantit l'exactitude des dossiers financiers et soutient la conformité aux normes comptables. Ce profil d'emploi est destiné aux professionnels en début de carrière qui appliquent de vastes connaissances théoriques et nécessitent la capacité d'enquêter et d'analyser des problèmes. Les solutions sont généralement discutées/vérifiées avec un membre plus expérimenté. Le Comptable Senior RTR du Centre d'Excellence (CoE) travaille au sein d'une équipe RTR affectée à plusieurs pays, en supportant les équipes Record to Report (RTR) par exemple avec diverses tâches ponctuelles, des réservations complexes, ou la maintenance du plan comptable.

Principales responsabilités

• Servir en tant que membre de l'équipe RTR au sein du CoE, en fournissant un soutien sur des sujets ad hoc et des questions comptables.

• Soutenir les activités de comptabilité financière, en garantissant l'exactitude et la conformité aux normes internationales d'information financière (IFRS) et aux réglementations Sulzer.

• Gérer la compensation, y compris les rapprochements et les ajustements, pour maintenir des dossiers financiers précis.

• Utiliser une connaissance avancée des systèmes ERP pour rationaliser les processus comptables

• Soutenir le propriétaire du processus global (GPO) avec la mise en œuvre du système.

• Maintenir et mettre à jour le plan comptable et les hiérarchies, en s'assurant qu'il reflète la structure actuelle de l'entreprise et les exigences en matière de reporting.

• Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes financières locales dans les pays et les équipes de services financiers partagés / fournisseur d'externalisation des processus métiers (BPO).

• Coordonner avec les autres départements et les équipes des services financiers partagés pour garantir que toutes les transactions financières sont correctement comptabilisées et reflétées dans le grand livre général.

• Prend en charge la clôture de fin de période, y compris la clôture du grand livre auxiliaire des comptes clients/payeurs et le rapprochement avec le grand livre général ; clôturer le grand livre, ouvrir une nouvelle période financière, clôturer la comptabilité des immobilisations (AA)

• Support à la préparation des écritures de journal, des rapprochements de bilan et des analyses d'écarts

• Contribuer à l'amélioration continue du processus RTR, en tirant parti de la technologie et des meilleures pratiques ; maintenir les politiques, les procédures et les modèles

• S'assurer que les contrôles financiers internes sont en place et suivis pour les processus exécutés par ce rôle.

• Effectuer toutes les activités techniques de clôture de fin d'année telles que le report de solde, la création de tranches de numéros, la clôture de l'AA.

• Supporter le processus de rapprochement inter-entreprises dans Coprocess et Tagetik (corriger les écarts)

Formation et expérience

• Diplôme universitaire en finance, comptabilité, administration des affaires ou dans un domaine connexe

• Minimum de 2 à 3 ans d'expérience en comptabilité avec une forte concentration sur le grand livre général et les rapports financiers

• Certification CPA, ACCA, CMA ou équivalente préférée.

Facteurs critiques de succès

• Solides compétences en analyse, en résolution de problèmes et en gestion

• Excellente attention aux détails et engagement envers l'exactitude et l'intégrité des rapports financiers.

• Capacité avérée à gérer plusieurs priorités dans un environnement axé sur les délais

• Solides compétences en communication pour fournir des informations clés à la haute direction

Compétences techniques et linguistiques

• Maîtrise des systèmes ERP (pertinents pour votre unité commerciale ; SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365 ou iScala) et des logiciels de comptabilité.

• Solides compétences en MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint)

• Une expérience avec Tagetik, Coprocess et Qlik Sense est un plus

• Maîtrise de l'anglais

Interfaces avec

• Équipes comptables

• Équipe de reporting et d'analyse

• Responsables comptables locaux

• Responsables financiers pays

• Objet de stratégie de groupe RTR

• Parties prenantes externes (c'est-à-dire auditeurs, autorités fiscales, etc.)

Installation de transport sponsorisée par l'entreprise en semaine

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

As a Field Service Technician, you will be responsible for the installation, commissioning, maintenance and repair of pump systems both at customer sites and in the workshop. Working in a hands-on environment, you will ensure reliable operation of equipment, support troubleshooting activities and contribute to high service quality and customer satisfaction. This role requires a practical mindset, technical expertise and a strong commitment to safety, as well as the flexibility to work across different locations and applications.
Key Responsibilities

• Installation, commissioning, maintenance and repair of pumps and associated equipment at customer sites as well as in the workshop

• Disassembly, inspection and reassembly of machinery based on defined work scopes or independently in case of unplanned repairs or troubleshooting

• Execution of work in line with specified tolerances and manufacturer guidelines or established engineering standards

• Performing safety assessments at the worksite (e.g. when changing activities)

• On-site activities including coordination and supervision of customer-provided personnel when required

• Preparation of service and repair reports as well as required documentation after completion of work

• Ensuring compliance with health, safety and environmental standards – both internally and at customer sites

Your Profile

• Experience in installation, commissioning and maintenance of pumps and associated equipment

• Hands-on experience in assembly, repair and testing of machinery – ideally also in a workshop environment

• Good command of English and confident use of common IT tools

• Independent, structured and solution-oriented way of working

• Strong customer and service orientation

• Flexible and adaptable with willingness to travel

• Team player with good communication skills and a confident presence on site

• Ideally VCA certification and initial experience in supervising or guiding others

What we offer you

• 8% holiday allowance and up to 40 days of annual leave

• A solid pension scheme with attractive employer contribution

• Travel allowance for commuting (EUR 0.23/km, tax-free)

• Free coffee, tea and water , plus access to an on-site canteen with fresh and affordable meals

• Free parking on-site

• Employee benefit programs such as Bike leasing with tax advantages and Gym contribution

• A staff association offering social activities and seasonal gifts

• Training and development opportunities aligned with your role and personal development plan

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Senior Project Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Driven by growth in the FRC business, this role provides focused project delivery, improves cross-functional coordination, and protects margins across advanced turnkey projects ($1M–$5M) . Operating from our Cumming, GA facility, the Senior Project Engineer serves as the technical execution hub—collaborating with Mechanical Design, Electrical, and Project Engineering departments to combine resources and deliver complete industrial process systems on time and within budget .

Key Responsibilities:

• Synchronize workflows across mechanical design, electrical, and project engineering teams to efficiently output complex systems.

• Travel 30%–40% nationwide to supervise on-site installation work and assist with system commissioning and startup efforts.

• Review, interpret, and resolve discrepancies across technical specifications, customer layout drawings, orders, and P&IDs.

• Prepare engineering submittal documentation and directly address or rectify consulting engineer comments.

• Size, select, and generate purchase requisitions for system components including pumps, piping, tanks, and dosing equipment.

• Maintain sharp cost control, prepare project change orders, review vendor quotes, and negotiate with suppliers.

• Inspect fabricated equipment at manufacturing subcontractor facilities and record strict quality control documentation.

• Maintain close client communication regarding order status and support the sales process by answering technical engineering questions.

Skills & Qualifications
Minimum Requirements:

• Bachelor’s degree in Process, Chemical, or Mechanical Engineering (or 15 years of equivalent hands-on engineering experience).

• 6 to 10+ years of progressive project engineering and management experience, specifically within the industrial water and wastewater fields.

• High proficiency in reading P&IDs, checking layout drawings, and working within AutoCAD and standard office suites (Excel/Word).

• Legally authorized to work in the US with the flexibility to travel nationwide 30%–40% of the time

• Proven ability to manage multiple simultaneous projects, make quick decisions under pressure, and manage costs against budgets.

Preferred Assets:

• Active PMP certification or Professional Engineer (PE) license.

• Prior experience with wastewater OEM technologies, industrial fluid handling, or onshore/offshore oil and gas process equipment.

• Familiarity with components like Dissolved Air Flotation (DAF) systems, mixers, biological systems, and valves.

• Existing OSHA 30 or OSHA 40 safety certifications (training provided as needed).

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym reimbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer è una società leader nel settore dell'ingegneria con un orgoglioso patrimonio di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile.

Sul ruolo

Spinto dalla crescita del business FRC, questo ruolo fornisce una fornitura mirata di progetti, migliora il coordinamento interfunzionale e protegge i margini nei progetti chiavi in mano avanzati ($ 1 milione – $ 5 milioni). Operando dalla nostra struttura di Cumming, Georgia, il Senior Project Engineer funge da hub di esecuzione tecnica, collaborando con i dipartimenti di progettazione meccanica, elettrica e ingegneria di progetto per combinare le risorse e fornire sistemi di processo industriale completi nei tempi e nel budget previsti.

Responsabilità chiave:

• Sincronizzare i flussi di lavoro tra i team di progettazione meccanica, elettrica e di ingegneria di progetto per produrre in modo efficiente sistemi complessi.

• Viaggiare dal 30% al 40% a livello nazionale per supervisionare il lavoro di installazione in loco e assistere nella messa in servizio del sistema e nelle attività di avvio.

• Esaminare, interpretare e risolvere le discrepanze tra specifiche tecniche, disegni di layout del cliente, ordini e P&ID.

• Preparare la documentazione di presentazione tecnica e affrontare o rettificare direttamente i commenti del tecnico consulente.

• Dimensionare, selezionare e generare richieste di acquisto per componenti del sistema tra cui pompe, tubazioni, serbatoi e apparecchiature di dosaggio.

• Mantenere un controllo accurato dei costi, preparare ordini di modifica del progetto, esaminare i preventivi dei fornitori e negoziare con i fornitori.

• Ispezionare le apparecchiature fabbricate presso le strutture dei subappaltatori di produzione e registrare una rigorosa documentazione di controllo qualità.

• Mantenere una stretta comunicazione con il cliente riguardo allo stato dell'ordine e supportare il processo di vendita rispondendo a domande di ingegneria tecnica.

Competenze e qualifiche
Requisiti minimi:

• Laurea in ingegneria di processo, chimica o meccanica (o 15 anni di esperienza pratica equivalente in ingegneria).

• Da 6 a 10+ anni di progressiva esperienza nella progettazione e gestione di progetti, in particolare nei settori delle acque industriali e delle acque reflue.

• Elevata competenza nella lettura di P&ID, nel controllo dei disegni di layout e nel lavoro con AutoCAD e suite per ufficio standard (Excel/Word).

• Legalmente autorizzato a lavorare negli Stati Uniti con la flessibilità di viaggiare a livello nazionale per il 30%–40% del tempo

• Comprovata capacità di gestire più progetti simultanei, prendere decisioni rapide sotto pressione e gestire i costi rispetto ai budget.

Risorse preferite:

• Certificazione PMP attiva o licenza di Professional Engineer (PE).

• Esperienza precedente con tecnologie OEM per le acque reflue, movimentazione di fluidi industriali o apparecchiature per il processo di petrolio e gas onshore/offshore.

• Familiarità con componenti come sistemi di flottazione ad aria disciolta (DAF), miscelatori, sistemi biologici e valvole.

• Certificazioni di sicurezza OSHA 30 o OSHA 40 esistenti (formazione fornita secondo necessità).

Cosa ti offriamo

• 15 giorni di ferie retribuite e 12 ferie aziendali retribuite

• Piano 401k con un match del 6%.

• Piano sanitario completo che comprende cure mediche, dentistiche, oculistiche, sulla vita, invalidità a breve e lungo termine

• Adeguamento dei conti di risparmio sanitario

• Programma benessere motivante

• Programma di assistenza ai dipendenti

• Congedo paterno retribuito

• Rimborso palestra

Sulzer è un datore di lavoro che garantisce pari opportunità. Crediamo nella forza di una forza lavoro diversificata e ci impegniamo a offrire un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo.

Siamo orgogliosi di essere riconosciuti come Top Employer 2026 in Brasile, Canada, Cina, Finlandia, Germania, Irlanda, Messico, Svizzera, Sud Africa, Regno Unito e Stati Uniti.

Opérant depuis nos installations de Cumming, en Géorgie, l'ingénieur de projet principal sert de centre d'exécution technique en collaborant avec les départements de conception mécanique, électrique et d'ingénierie de projet pour combiner les ressources et fournir des systèmes de processus industriels complets dans les délais et dans les limites du budget.

jobs.title: Mechanical Designer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Mechanical Designer - Full Time - Whitby, Canada

At Sulzer, you are empowered to deliver superior results. As a pioneer in industry, we have a proud heritage of innovation and continue to evolve for the future. Join our story and create your own impact by developing your expertise and building solutions that help make our lives safer, smarter and more sustainable.

Join our FRC team within the Sulzer Pumps division of Sulzer Canada as a Mechanical Designer to help us take FRC to the next level.

Job Description

In this role you will be accountable for:

• Modeling 3D layouts and creating drawing sets for installation and construction of our equipment and products using SolidWorks as well as AutoCAD

• Preparing design concepts, sketches, or models of our equipment for approval

• Consulting with engineers and production staff during manufacturing stage

• Assisting the Applications Team to generate sales equipment and layout drawings

• Preparing and interpreting engineering designs, drawings and specifications as they pertain to our equipment or layouts

• Other duties and special projects as assigned
​
To succeed in this role, you will need:

• Experience with SolidWorks, SolidWorks PDM or a related software package

• Knowledge of SolidWorks modeling, sheet metal design and pipe routing

• Familiarity with data management and revision control

• Proficiency in MS Office (formulas, formatting, Outlook)

• Experience in sheet metal design would be an asset

• Experience with welding would be an asset

• Experience using Autodesk Revit for draft and pre-construction drawings would be an asset

• Knowledge of waste management, or water treatment equipment/industry would be an asset

• Willingness to take occasional criminal record/drug tests for US clients

​If you possess a post-secondary degree or diploma in mechanical engineering, mechanical engineering technology/technician, drafting, mechanical design or similar discipline, take the next step and make the most of your design skills.

Location: We are based in Whitby, ON, with easy access to Highway 401.
Required: Valid Canadian passport and ability to travel to the US.

What we offer you

• Health and dental benefits

• Employee Assistance Program

• Defined contribution pension plan

• Vacation: 15 days upon completion of 1 year of service, increasing per vacation accrual schedule

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

We are looking for a/an Senior accountant (RTR) to join our Accounting team in Spain to help us take our Record to Report (RTR) area to the next level. As a Senior accountant, you will collaborate with multiple countries and engage with a diverse array of areas stakeholders, including Accounting, Reporting, Analytics, Country Finance Heads, Global Process Owners (GPOs), and external parties such as auditors and tax authorities. Key Responsabilities:

• Serve as a key member of the RTR team in the CoE, providing expert support on ad hoc topics and complex accounting issues

• Support with complicated financial booking activities, ensuring accuracy and compliance with International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) and Sulzer regulations

• Manage complex clearing, including reconciliations and adjustments, to maintain accurate financial records

• Utilize advanced knowledge of ERP systems to streamline accounting processes and improve efficiency

• Support the Global Process Owner (GPO) with the definition of RTR processes and system implementation

• Oversees and governs the chart of accounts and hierarchies, ensuring it reflects the current business structure and reporting requirements

• Collaborate closely with local Finance Teams in countries and Finance Shared Services teams / Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) provider

• Coordinate with other departments and the Finance Shared Services teams to ensure all financial transactions are properly accounted for and reflected in the general ledger

• Support where required with the period end close, including closing the accounts receivable/payable subledger and reconcile with the general ledger; close general ledger, open new financial period, close Asset Accounting (AA)

• Support with the preparation of complex journal entries, balance sheet reconciliations and variance analysis to solve discrepancies

• Contribute to the continuous improvement of the RTR process, leveraging technology and best practices; maintain policies, procedures and templates

• Ensure financial internal controls are in place and followed for the processes performed by this role

• Provide documentation and explanations for internal and external audits

• Do all technical Year End Closing activities such as balance carry forward, number range creations, close of AA

• Support Intercompany reconciliation process in Coprocess and Tagetik (fix variances)

Education and experience

• University degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration or related field

• Minimum of 4-5 years of experience in Accounting with a strong focus on general ledger and financial reporting

• CPA, ACCA, CMA or equivalent certification preferred

• Strong analytical, problem-solving and management skills

• Excellent attention to detail and commitment to accuracy and integrity in financial reporting

• Proven ability to manage multiple priorities in a deadline-driven environment

• Strong communication skills for delivering key insights to senior leadership

• Proficient in ERP systems (relevant to your business unit; SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365 or iScala) and accounting software

• Strong MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint) skills

• Experience with Tagetik, Coprocess and Qlik Sense is a plus

• Proficiency in English. French is a big plus

What we offer you

• A permanent contract.

• A competitive salary as well as participation in the variable remuneration system based on personal and financial objectives.

• Restaurant tickets.

• Be part of an experienced, international team.

• A good vib

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer è una società leader nel settore dell'ingegneria con un orgoglioso patrimonio di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile.

Sul ruolo

Stiamo cercando un/un contabile senior (RTR) che si unisca al nostro team di contabilità in Spagna per aiutarci a portare la nostra area Record to Report (RTR) al livello successivo. In qualità di contabile senior, collaborerai con più paesi e interagirai con una vasta gamma di stakeholder di aree, tra cui contabilità, reporting, analisi, responsabili finanziari nazionali, proprietari di processi globali (GPO) e parti esterne come revisori e autorità fiscali. Responsabilità chiave:

• Ricoprire il ruolo di membro chiave del team RTR nel CoE, fornendo supporto di esperti su argomenti ad hoc e questioni contabili complesse

• Supporto in complesse attività di contabilizzazione finanziaria, garantendo l'accuratezza e la conformità agli International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) e alle normative Sulzer

• Gestire compensazioni complesse, comprese riconciliazioni e aggiustamenti, per mantenere registri finanziari accurati

• Utilizzare la conoscenza avanzata dei sistemi ERP per semplificare i processi contabili e migliorare l'efficienza

• Supportare il Global Process Owner (GPO) nella definizione dei processi RTR e nell'implementazione del sistema

• Supervisiona e governa il piano dei conti e le gerarchie, assicurando che rifletta l'attuale struttura aziendale e i requisiti di reporting

• Collaborare a stretto contatto con i team finanziari locali nei paesi e con i team di servizi finanziari condivisi/fornitore di Business Process Outsourcing (BPO).

• Coordinarsi con gli altri dipartimenti e i team dei servizi finanziari condivisi per garantire che tutte le transazioni finanziarie siano adeguatamente contabilizzate e riflesse nella contabilità generale

• Supporto, ove richiesto, con la chiusura di fine periodo, inclusa la chiusura del registro secondario dei conti clienti/debiti e la riconciliazione con la contabilità generale; chiudere la contabilità generale, aprire un nuovo periodo finanziario, chiudere la contabilità patrimoniale (AA)

• Supporto nella preparazione di registrazioni contabili complesse, riconciliazioni di bilancio e analisi degli scostamenti per risolvere discrepanze

• Contribuire al miglioramento continuo del processo RTR, sfruttando la tecnologia e le migliori pratiche; mantenere politiche, procedure e modelli

• Garantire che i controlli finanziari interni siano in atto e seguiti per i processi svolti da questo ruolo

• Fornire documentazione e spiegazioni per gli audit interni ed esterni

• Eseguire tutte le attività tecniche di chiusura di fine anno, come il riporto del saldo, la creazione di intervalli di numeri, la chiusura di AA

• Supportare il processo di riconciliazione interaziendale in Coprocess e Tagetik (correzione delle varianze)

Formazione ed esperienza

• Laurea in Finanza, Contabilità, Amministrazione aziendale o settore correlato

• Minimo 4-5 anni di esperienza in contabilità con una forte attenzione alla contabilità generale e al reporting finanziario

• Preferibile certificazione CPA, ACCA, CMA o equivalente

• Forti capacità analitiche, di problem solving e di gestione

• Eccellente attenzione ai dettagli e impegno per l'accuratezza e l'integrità nel reporting finanziario

• Comprovata capacità di gestire più priorità in un ambiente basato sulle scadenze

• Forti capacità di comunicazione per fornire informazioni chiave alla leadership senior

• Competente nei sistemi ERP (pertinenti alla vostra business unit; SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365 o iScala) e nei software di contabilità

• Ottime competenze in MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint).

• L'esperienza con Tagetik, Coprocess e Qlik Sense costituisce un vantaggio

• Conoscenza della lingua inglese. Il francese è un grande vantaggio

Cosa ti offriamo

• Un contratto a tempo indeterminato.

• Una retribuzione competitiva e la partecipazione al sistema di remunerazione variabile basato su obiettivi personali e finanziari.

• Biglietti ristorante.

• Far parte di un team internazionale esperto.

• Una buona atmosfera

Hauptaufgaben:

• Als wichtiges Mitglied des RTR-Teams im CoE fungieren und fachkundige Unterstützung bei Ad-hoc-Themen und komplexen Rechnungslegungsfragen leisten

• Unterstützung bei komplizierten Finanzbuchungsaktivitäten, Gewährleistung der Genauigkeit und Einhaltung der International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) und der Sulzer-Vorschriften

• Verwalten Sie komplexe Abrechnungen, einschließlich Abstimmungen und Anpassungen, um genaue Finanzunterlagen zu führen

• Nutzen Sie fortgeschrittene Kenntnisse über ERP-Systeme, um Buchhaltungsprozesse zu rationalisieren und die Effizienz zu verbessern

• Unterstützen Sie den Global Process Owner (GPO) bei der Definition von RTR-Prozessen und der Systemimplementierung

• Überwacht und regelt den Kontenplan und die Hierarchien und stellt sicher, dass er die aktuelle Geschäftsstruktur und die Berichtsanforderungen widerspiegelt

Was wir Ihnen bieten

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Sulzer est une société d'ingénierie leader avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable.

À propos du rôle

Nous recherchons un/un comptable principal (RTR) pour rejoindre notre équipe comptable en Espagne afin de nous aider à faire passer notre domaine Record to Report (RTR) au niveau supérieur. En tant que comptable principal, vous collaborerez avec plusieurs pays et dialoguerez avec un large éventail de parties prenantes de domaines, notamment la comptabilité, le reporting, l'analyse, les responsables financiers nationaux, les propriétaires de processus mondiaux (GPO) et des parties externes telles que les auditeurs et les autorités fiscales. Responsabilités clés :

• Servir de membre clé de l'équipe RTR au sein du CoE, en fournissant un soutien expert sur des sujets ponctuels et des questions comptables complexes.

• Prise en charge des activités de comptabilité financière complexes, garantissant l'exactitude et la conformité aux normes internationales d'information financière (IFRS) et aux réglementations Sulzer.

• Gérer les compensations complexes, y compris les rapprochements et les ajustements, pour maintenir des dossiers financiers précis.

• Utiliser une connaissance avancée des systèmes ERP pour rationaliser les processus comptables et améliorer l'efficacité.

• Soutenir le Global Process Owner (GPO) dans la définition des processus RTR et la mise en œuvre du système.

• Supervise et régit le plan comptable et les hiérarchies, en s'assurant qu'il reflète la structure actuelle de l'entreprise et les exigences en matière de reporting.

• Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes financières locales dans les pays et les équipes de services financiers partagés / fournisseur d'externalisation des processus métiers (BPO).

• Coordonner avec les autres départements et les équipes des services financiers partagés pour garantir que toutes les transactions financières sont correctement comptabilisées et reflétées dans le grand livre général.

• Soutenir, si nécessaire, la clôture de fin de période, y compris la clôture du grand livre auxiliaire des comptes clients/payeurs et le rapprochement avec le grand livre général ; clôturer le grand livre, ouvrir une nouvelle période financière, clôturer la comptabilité des immobilisations (AA)

• Assistance à la préparation d'écritures de journal complexes, aux rapprochements de bilan et à l'analyse des écarts pour résoudre les écarts

• Contribuer à l'amélioration continue du processus RTR, en tirant parti de la technologie et des meilleures pratiques ; maintenir les politiques, les procédures et les modèles

• S'assurer que les contrôles financiers internes sont en place et suivis pour les processus exécutés par ce rôle.

• Fournir de la documentation et des explications pour les audits internes et externes

• Effectuer toutes les activités techniques de clôture de fin d'année telles que le report de solde, la création de tranches de numéros, la clôture de l'AA.

• Supporter le processus de rapprochement inter-entreprises dans Coprocess et Tagetik (corriger les écarts)

Formation et expérience

• Diplôme universitaire en finance, comptabilité, administration des affaires ou dans un domaine connexe

• Minimum de 4 à 5 ans d'expérience en comptabilité avec une forte concentration sur le grand livre général et les rapports financiers

• Certification CPA, ACCA, CMA ou équivalente préférée.

• Solides compétences en analyse, en résolution de problèmes et en gestion

• Excellente attention aux détails et engagement envers l'exactitude et l'intégrité des rapports financiers.

• Capacité avérée à gérer plusieurs priorités dans un environnement axé sur les délais

• Solides compétences en communication pour fournir des informations clés à la haute direction

• Maîtrise des systèmes ERP (pertinents pour votre unité commerciale ; SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365 ou iScala) et des logiciels de comptabilité.

• Solides compétences en MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint)

• Une expérience avec Tagetik, Coprocess et Qlik Sense est un plus

• Maîtrise de l'anglais. Le français est un gros plus

Ce que nous vous proposons

• Un contrat à durée indéterminée.

• Un salaire compétitif ainsi qu'une participation au système de rémunération variable basé sur des objectifs personnels et financiers.

• Billets restaurant.

• Faites partie d'une équipe internationale expérimentée.

• Une bonne ambiance

jobs.title: Tendering Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Tendering Engineer is responsible for providing technical support to sales teams and conducting technical analysis of product configurations to determine customer-specific pricing.
This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyze problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. This job and its associated grade are specifically aligned with roles that have the following scope of responsibility:

• Overall responsibility to ensure that initiated projects meet company requirements in terms of selection, pricing, terms and conditions and lead time. Ensure application of Sulzer tools and policies, procedures, codes of conduct and best practice guidelines

• Review inquiry documents/specifications and prepares quality quotations on time for Sulzer Pumps' products using current tendering tools & procedures independently or with guidance

• Analyzing customer requirements, particularly of complex applications and products for relevant market / application

• Independent development of suitable technical solutions with the involvement of specialist departments

• Consulting customers and the sales team on possible pump applications and in preparation of specifications, Configuration of pumps and accessories

• Enquiry and evaluation of subcontractor offers as well as corresponding expediting

• Co-operation with the plants in the Energy & Infrastructure Business Unit factory network

• Analysis and evaluation of commercial as well as technical risks of projects at the bidding stage, corresponding negotiations together with specialist departments as well as development of approaches to minimize risks in the event of an order

• Preparation and realization of presentations of technical offers

• Indirect management & co-ordination with multidisciplinary functions as part of the bid preparation

• Preparation of high-quality technical/commercial offers in line with market requirements

• Review quote received and challenge as necessary internal as well as external stakeholders to ensure a competitive proposal is submitted meeting Sales / market expectation

• Familiar with the risks and hazards within the activities and processes of the role and procedures, practices, and measures in place to mitigate the risks.

• Participation in sales negotiations, corresponding preparation, and follow-up in co-operation with sales department

• Attend clarification meetings with clients as required and provide all necessary support to Sales to ensure the offered solution meets specification/customer requirement while highlighting our competitive advantage

• Leading technical negotiations with subcontractors

• Ensuring a complete and successful order handover to project team

• Regular maintenance of our sales systems and the data contained therein

Work experience : >5 years
Expertise (e.g. professional, technical):

• Successfully completed technical studies (ideally mechanical engineering, industrial engineering or process engineering or equal)

• Structured way of working, ability to break down complex issues together with the bid team

• Experience in at least one of the following disciplines: pump design, international tender or sales, project management or equivalent

• Ideally intercultural competences

• Sound knowledge of pumps or rotating equipment and accessories

What we offer you

Medical insurance for self and family
Company sponsored transportation facility during week days

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Empl

Analisi delle esigenze dei clienti, in particolare delle applicazioni complesse e dei prodotti per il mercato/applicazione rilevanti - Sviluppo indipendente di soluzioni tecniche adeguate con il coinvolgimento di reparti specializzati - Familiar con i rischi e i rischi all'interno delle attività e dei processi del ruolo e delle procedure, delle pratiche e delle misure in atto per mitigare i rischi. - Partecipazione a trattative commerciali, preparazione corrispondente e follow-up in collaborazione con il reparto vendite - incontri di chiarimento del campo di competenza con i clienti, se necessario, e fornire tutto il supporto necessario alle vendite per garantire che la soluzione offerta soddisfi le specifiche/il requisito del cliente, evidenziando il nostro vantaggio competitivo - Leading trattative tecniche con subappaltatori - Garantire un trasferimento di ordine completo e riuscito al team di progetto - Manutenzione regolare dei nostri sistemi di vendita e dei dati ivi contenuti. - Studi tecnici completati con successo (ingegneria meccanica, ingegneria industriale o di processo o di livello equivalente) - Modalità di lavoro strutturata, capacità di risolvere problemi complessi insieme al team di offerta - Esperienza in almeno una delle seguenti discipline: progettazione di pompe, gara internazionale o vendita, gestione di progetti o equivalente - Idealmente competenze interculturali - Conoscenza sana di pompe o attrezzature rotanti e accessori Co-Babeamo - Assicurazione medica per auto e famiglia - Struttura di trasporto sponsorizzata dall'azienda durante la settimana Days Sulzer è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità. Crediamo nella forza di una forza lavoro diversificata e ci impegniamo ad offrire un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo. Siamo orgogliosi di essere riconosciuti come Top Empl

Sulzer ist ein führendes Ingenieurunternehmen mit einem stolzen Erbe an Innovationen. Schließen Sie sich unserem globalen Team an, um Ihr Fachwissen zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine prosperierende und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen. jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Join our Water & Industry Business Unit and be part of a global team delivering high-impact pumping and rotating equipment solutions. Purpose of the Role
We are seeking an experienced Sales Manager, Water and Wastewater to lead sales activities across Greece, Cyprus, and Israel for our Water and Industrial Business Uni . The role focuses on developing long-term customer relationships, identifying and converting commercial opportunities, and delivering tailored pumping and rotating equipment solutions within the water industry.
You will represent Sulzer in front of key customers, manage complex technical and commercial engagements, and consistently achieve agreed sales targets.

Key Responsibilities

• Build and maintain strong relationships with new and existing customers across the assigned territories

• Develop and manage a robust sales pipeline and key account strategy

• Visit customers regularly, lead project discussions, and deliver technical presentations on the Sulzer Water portfolio

• Prepare technical and commercial quotations with support from tendering teams

• Negotiate contracts and support project order wins

• Work closely with engineering, procurement, manufacturing, project management, and global Sulzer WIBU offices

• Coordinate with local agents in Greece, Cyprus, and Israel

• Prepare structured handover documentation to Project Management and support delivery through to contractual completion

Requirements:

jobs.title: Serviceleder
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Service i Sulzer er et spennende og interessant fagfelt, og har ofte et høyt tempo. Det å bidra til at folk har rent vann og fungerende infrastruktur for vann- og avløp er et av de viktigste samfunnsoppdragene som finnes! Vi trives best med flere baller i luften, i et arbeidsmiljø hvor kreativitet og rasjonalitet går hånd i hånd. Vi liker kort avstand mellom verksted og ledelse, hvor ideer blir hørt og hvor muligheter for både faglig og personlig utvikling blir gitt.
Sulzer søker nå etter en fagsterk og kundeorientert serviceleder. Du kommer til å være lokalisert ved vårt verksted på hovedkontoret i Asker, og også ha personalansvar for teknikerne på flere lokasjoner. Har du dokumenterte erfaringer med å skape, lede, og utvikle effektive team, håper vi at nettopp du ønsker å være med på denne reisen med oss!

Stillingen inneholder blant annet:

• Du vil være en del av et team med 2 serviceledere, som tilsammen har personalansvar for alle teknikerne.

• Du vil være ansvarlig for salg av servicetjenester, driften av og effektiv bruk av ressursene, både menneskelige og materielle. Sulzer har stort fokus på kontinuerlig forbedring, utvikling, og vekst.

• Vi ønsker at du er en rollemodell, at du viser engasjement og felles retning.

• Sørge for at de ansatte får et tett og effektivt samarbeid, slik at de blir inspirert til å oppnå felles suksess.

• Sikre at teknikerne har riktig kompetanse for å utføre avdelingens arbeid, gjennom kompetanseutvikling og ansettelser, i samråd med serviceleder i Norge.

• I og med at våre serviceteknikere jobber med tungt maskineri og med arbeid som kan være risikopreget, er det svært viktig at leder har stort fokus på å drifte på en sikker og helsefremmende måte, og sikrer HMS og kvalitet i alle ledd.

• Dette er en operativ rolle, som består av både ledelse og salg, samt administrative oppgaver som bidrar til å holde hjulene i gang.

Hovedoppgaver
Arbeidsoppgavene inkluderer, men er ikke begrenset til:

• HMS ansvar for teknikerne og verkstedene.

• Personalansvar for teknikerne

• Kundekontakt og befaringer

• Salgsrelaterte oppgaver på serviceområdet

• Ansvar for servicebiler/flåtestyring lokalt

• Det er behov for en del reising i stillingen, for å vise tilstedeværelse på flere lokasjoner.

Rapporterer til: Serviceleder Norge

Ønsket erfaring og formell utdanning

• Gjerne utdanning på BSc- nivå, eller teknisk utdannelse

• Operativ ledelseserfaring, gjerne fra bransje med serviceteknikere i felt eller lignende

• Erfaring innen vedlikehold av prosessutstyr eller annet mekanisk utstyr

• Det er en fordel å kjenne til vann- og avløpsbransjen.

• Kompetanse innen HMS for arbeid i felt

• Kompetanse eller interesse for tilstøtende fagdisipliner; mekaniske, elektro, automasjon og bygg & anlegg

• Gode kommunikasjonsevner på både norsk og engelsk

• Førerkort klasse B, fordel med BE (henger)

• Gode kunnskaper innen IT

Personlige styrker

• Gode kommunikasjons- og samarbeidsevner

• Komfortabel med elektroniske verktøy og systemer

• Gode mellommenneskelige egenskaper, og evne til å skape og lede et team

• Kundeorientert

• Teknisk nysgjerrighet

What we offer you

Hvem er vi tenker du? Og hva kan vi tilby akkurat deg?
Sulzer er en stor og stabil arbeidsgiver, og samtidig har vi et lokalt miljø som er liten og dynamisk.
Sulzer er kjent for produkter med høy kvalitet, har en solid ordrereserve, egne fabrikker, og er en ledende aktør i en bærekraftig og livsnødvendig industri.

Ansatte hos oss har stor påvirkningskraft på egen hverdag og bedriftens retning. Sulzer tilbyr et hyggelig miljø med høy yrkesstolthet og faglig tyngde. Vi har gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger, og fleksible arbeidstidsordninger, og ikke minst gode muligheter for videreutvikling internt og eksternt

jobs.title: Project Scheduler
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Our newly refurbished Leeds facility our Advanced Pump Design and Manufacturing Centre of Excellence, where highly engineered, bespoke pumping solutions are designed, built and delivered for some of the world’s most demanding applications. Our pumps operate in environments where failure isn’t an option — from energy, oil & gas, chemicals, water, nuclear and heavy industry, serving global customers who expect absolute precision, reliability and performance.

We’re looking for an experienced Project Scheduler to take ownership of planning and scheduling across large, complex engineering projects — the kind with long lead times, multiple workstreams and a lot of moving parts. You’ll be at the heart of the project lifecycle, building and maintaining detailed schedules that align engineering, procurement, manufacturing, testing and delivery. This is a role for someone who enjoys turning complexity into clarity.

What you’ll be doing

• Developing, maintaining and controlling end‑to‑end project schedules using MS Project

• Working closely with Project Managers, Engineering, Supply Chain and Manufacturing to ensure plans are realistic, integrated and achievable

• Managing schedule risk, critical paths and dependencies across complex, multi‑discipline projects

• Using SAP to track progress, materials, production milestones and performance

• Providing clear schedule reporting, forecasts and insights to support decision‑making

• Driving continuous improvement in planning standards, tools and processes

What we’re looking for

• Proven experience as a Project Scheduler / Planner within large, complex engineering or manufacturing projects

• Strong, hands‑on experience with MS Project

• Working knowledge of SAP within a project or manufacturing environment

• Comfortable managing projects with many interdependencies, long lead items and competing priorities

• Confident communicator who can challenge constructively and influence stakeholders

• A structured, detail‑driven mindset with the ability to see the bigger picture

What we offer you

Core Benefits

• A competitive salary

• A company-wide bonus scheme

• Medicash Health Cash Plan (covering everyday healthcare expenses such as dental, optical and GP services)

• 33 days’ holiday

• Defined pension contribution

• Employee Assistance Programmes

• Discounts on shopping, entertainment & lifestyle

• Costco membership option

• Discounted personal car leasing for you, family & friends

• Long Service Awards

• Ongoing learning through Sulzer Learning Pathways

• Armed Forces Support – As a Silver Award holder of the MoD Defence Employer Recognition Scheme, we actively support veterans, reservists and Cadet Adult Volunteers. This includes policies that enable time for training, camps and deployment, alongside access to a growing internal military network.

Onsite Perks

• Free, secure parking with EV charging

• Multi-faith prayer room

• Newly modernised work areas

• Lively Sports & Social Club with events & prize draws

• 24/7 onsite gym

• Subsidised vending machines

• Subsidised Canteen offering hot and cold food

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

In the role (Probation, 6 months), you will be a member of the Group Treasury Team Pune and in charge of various treasury topics. You will work in a global team of treasury professionals with specific responsibilities, and you will assume regular as well as ad-hoc tasks. Main tasks and responsibilities:

• Invoice Management: Operationally support the financing programs with invoice collection, accounts payable oversight, reports to service providers and banks and constant communication to Group Treasury

• Regular balance sanity & checks: Regularly perform sanities on reported Balances and loans from subsidiaries, report findings to Group Treasury

• Bank Account Management: Execute regular bank A/Cs & signatory rights check and perform the bank A/C reconciliation.

• Regular Sanity Checks: Aligning and analyzing the reported figures between different treasury tools.

• FX/Loan Management: Collect, sanitize, correct, and upload transactions from subsidiaries into the treasury management system.

• Knowledge of Intercompany reconciliation & Intercompany netting.

• Ad-hoc tasks, initiatives & database management.

Key Interfaces:

• Group Treasury Team (Switzerland/Spain/USA/Mexico)

• Regional Treasury Managers

• GTR Pune

• Service Providers
Education requirements:

• Bachelor’s or master’s degree in finance/accounting or equivalent experience

• Certification in treasury, corporate finance or AR/AP management would be a plus.

Job experience:

• Minimum experience of 2-7 yrs. in corporate treasury, banking or industrial company. Experience in global work environment is a must.

Knowledge requirements (professional, technical, language):

• Fluency in written and spoken English is a must.

• Excellent command of MS Office especially with MS Excel

• Knowledge of treasury reporting

• Knowledge of BI took Qlik is plus

jobs.title: Senior FP&A Controller
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Controller Specialist is responsible for executing core financial control activities, including the preparation of financial reports, account reconciliations, and compliance with internal controls. This role supports the accuracy and integrity of financial data and contributes to the organization’s financial planning and reporting processes.
This job profile is intended for specialist professionals that apply advanced knowledge of a job area. Required to manage projects / processes independently with limited supervision. Typically coaches and reviews the work of lower level professionals.
• Key Responsibilities

• Prepare and consolidate the annual budget

• Refresh predictive financial forecasts periodically

• Conduct profitability and performance reporting

• Perform plan analytics and risk management, managing and continuously improving the financial planning and analysis processes

• Provide recommendation to the business based on in depth financial analysis

• Manage collections reporting and analytics, ensuring accurate and timely information to support decision-making

• Provide comprehensive reporting and analytics on procurement activities, contributing to informed purchasing decisions

• Oversee the period end close processes, generating accurate and insightful period end financial reports and analytics to ensure financial integrity

• Handle period end closing, and related analytics, ensuring thorough and precise financial tracking and reporting for projects

• Oversee CAPEX planning, forecasting, investment strategy, period-end close activities and reporting

• Ensure all financial reporting and processes comply with International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS)

• Ensure internal controls are in place for the processes performed by this role

• Comply with relevant QESH regulations
Education and experience

• University degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration or related field

• Minimum of 5 -7 years of experience in financial planning and analysis or related finance roles

• Experience within the manufacturing or industrial sectors is preferred
Critical success factors

• Proficiency in financial modelling and forecasting, advanced skills in data analytics and financial software

• Strong understanding of global financial processes and standards

• Strong financial acumen

• Excellent communication skills for delivering key insights to leadership

• Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to work collaboratively with other stakeholders
Technical & language skills

• Experience with Tagetik and Qlik Sense is a plus

• Understanding of integrated ERP systems is a plus

• Strong MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint) skills

• Proficiency in English

What we offer you

Medical insurance for self and family
Company sponsored transportation facility during week days

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Senior Application Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The Sr. Application Engineer develops technical proposals for projects including proposing modifications to the standard design and configures the using design and costing tools. Works independently and develops technical responses to the customer.

Essential Functions:

• Applies in-depth knowledge of job area typically obtained through advanced education and work experience.

• Screens customer's inquiries to ensure they contain all information required to submit a quotation.

• Liaises with sales /customers to obtain any missing information.

• Collects, understands, and interprets customer’s requirements for new and/or operating data from customer’s existing systems.

• Development of the technical proposal/quotation, including equipment description and specifications, and reviews and negotiates necessary technical revisions with the customer.

• Responds to questions and inquiries from the customer regarding technical problems and issues that arise and provides related technical support or assistance, in a timely manner.

• Upon customer order, reviews/approves the scope of supply and creates job file per Sulzer specifications.

• Understands and provides solutions to large and/or complex problems

• Requires independent judgement, initiative and sound decision making

Secondary Functions:

• Meets with customers on-site, as required, to review specifications and requirements, present and discuss the company’s proposal, and participate in project initiation as needed.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering

• 3+ years' experience in design of biological wastewater treatment systems

• 2+ years’ experience in technical sales work with an understanding of how to interpret customer’s technical requirements

• Basic understanding of unit operations and wastewater analysis

• Conceptual system aptitude

• Excellent communication skills

• Self-motivated and takes initiatives

• Strong planning and organizational skills

• Open to learning

Travel: This position will not require regular business travel but may be required to visit customers onsite as needed for pilot studies.

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym re-imbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Application Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The Application Engineer develops technical proposals for projects including proposing modifications to the standard design and configures the using design and costing tools. Works independently and develops technical responses to the customer.

Essential Functions:

• Applies in-depth knowledge of job area typically obtained through advanced education and work experience.

• Screens customer's inquiries to ensure they contain all information required to submit a quotation.

• Liaises with sales /customers to obtain any missing information.

• Collects, understands, and interprets customer’s requirements for new and/or operating data from customer’s existing systems

• Development of the technical proposal/quotation, including equipment description and specifications, and reviews and negotiates necessary technical revisions with the customer.

• Responds to questions and inquiries from the customer regarding technical problems and issues that arise and provides related technical support or assistance, in a timely manner.

• Upon customer order, reviews/approves the scope of supply and creates job file per Sulzer specifications.

• Understands and provides solutions to large and/or complex problems

• Requires independent judgement, initiative and sound decision making

Secondary Functions:

• Meets with customers on-site, as required, to review specifications and requirements, present and discuss the company’s proposal, and participate in project initiation as needed.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering

• 0-2 years’ experience in technical sales work with an understanding of how to interpret customer’s technical requirements

• Basic understanding of unit operations and wastewater analysis

• Conceptual system aptitude

• Excellent communication skills

• Self-motivated and takes initiatives

• Strong planning and organizational skills

• Open to learning

Travel: This position will not require regular business travel but may be required to visit customers onsite as needed.

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym reimbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile. Informazioni sul ruolo L'Ingegnere di Applicazione sviluppa proposte tecniche per progetti tra cui la proposta di modifiche al design standard e configura gli strumenti di progettazione e costo. Funziona in modo indipendente e sviluppa risposte tecniche al cliente. Funzioni essenziali:
• Si basa sulla conoscenza approfondita dell'area di lavoro tipicamente ottenuta attraverso l'istruzione avanzata e l'esperienza lavorativa.
• Sceneggia le richieste del cliente per garantire che contengono tutte le informazioni necessarie per presentare una quotazione.
• Liaises con vendite / clienti per ottenere qualsiasi informazione mancante.
• Raccoglie, comprende e interpreta i requisiti del cliente per i dati nuovi e/o operativi dei sistemi esistenti del cliente
• Sviluppo della proposta tecnica/quotazione, compresa la descrizione delle attrezzature e le specifiche, e recensioni e negozia le necessarie revisioni tecniche con il cliente.
• Responde alle domande e alle richieste del cliente relative a problemi tecnici e questioni che sorgono e fornisce assistenza tecnica o correlata, in modo tempestivo.
• Dopo l'ordine del cliente, recensioni / approva la portata di fornitura e crea file di lavoro per specifiche Sulzer.
• Comprende e fornisce soluzioni a problemi grandi e/o complessi
• Richiede giudizio indipendente, iniziativa e decisione solida Funzioni secondarie:
• Soddisfa i clienti in loco, come richiesto, per rivedere le specifiche e i requisiti, presentare e discutere la proposta dell'azienda, e partecipare all'iniziazione del progetto secondo le necessità. Qualifiche:
• Laurea in ingegneria chimica
• 0-2 anni di esperienza nel lavoro di vendita tecnica con la comprensione di come interpretare i requisiti tecnici del cliente
• Comprensione di base delle operazioni di unità e dell'analisi delle acque reflue
• Abilità del sistema concettuale
• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione
• Automotivata e prende iniziative
• Forte pianificazione e capacità organizzative
• Aprire l'apprendimento Viaggi: Questa posizione non richiederà viaggi d'affari regolari, ma potrebbe essere richiesto di visitare i clienti in loco, se necessario. Cosa ti offriamo
• 15 giorni di tempo libero e 12 giorni festivi

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sr. (Field) Service Technician is responsible for installing, configuring, calibrating, and repairing technical products and systems at customer field locations. This role performs a variety of maintenance and technical support tasks and may provide onsite training to customer support personnel.
This job profile is intended for support staff that follows established procedures and works under close supervision. Smaller/easier decisions are made autonomously. Servicetekniker til bærekraftig industri

Dette er til deg som ønsker en jobb med mening
Kunne du tenkt deg å jobbe med bransjeledende produkter og kompetanserike kollegaer? Med fokus på bærekraft og en fremtidsrettet visjon, søker vi kollegaer som med sin kompetanse og sitt fokus på en trygg og inkluderende arbeidshverdag, kan være med og forme veien videre sammen med oss. Våre produkter er av høyeste kvalitet, og er lett å være stolte over.
Vi søker deg som er en dyktig tekniker med erfaring/kompetanse innen pumpeteknikk, industrimekanikk, industrirørlegging, VVS eller lignende.
Relevant erfaring og allsidighet kan gjøre opp for manglende formell utdannelse.

Hvem er vi tenker du? Og hva kan vi tilby akkurat deg?
Vi er et sterkt, men ungt og uformelt fagmiljø, med gode karrieremuligheter. Vi har en solid ordrereserve, egen produksjon, og er en aktør i en livsnødvendig industri.
Alle ansatte har stor påvirkningskraft på egen hverdag og bedriftens retning. Vi har gode pensjonsordninger, helseforsikring, og fleksible arbeidstidsordninger.
Som servicetekniker hos oss, foregår det meste av arbeidet ute hos kunde. Kundegruppen vår strekker seg fra industri til privatpersoner, og kommuner over hele landet. Denne stillingen er tilknyttet servicesenteret vårt i Kristiansand, og ditt nedslagsfelt vil primært være Agder, men en del reising utenfor fylket vil også være aktuelt.
Vi har ca 18 serviceteknikere i divisjonen vår i Sulzer Norge, og disse er fordelt på lokasjonene i Kristiansand, Trondheim, Bergen, Fredrikstad og Asker. Vi vektlegger samarbeid på tvers av lokasjoner.

Stillingen har søknadsfrist mandag 10. august 2026 , men vi vurdererer alle søkere fortløpende!

Vi ser etter deg som:

• Ønsker å arbeide selvstendig og er løsningsorientert

• Er nøyaktig og verdsetter kvalitet i arbeidet

• Anser digitale verktøy som hjelpemidler og ikke en belastning

• Er positiv, lærevillig, og liker å dele kunnskapen din

• Har generelt god fysisk form, og fokus på HMS

Kvalifikasjoner :

• Fortrinnsvis fagbrev innen tekniske fag, men har du relevant erfaring blir du vurdert

• Førerkort klasse B (om du har kl. BE, og/eller traverskran er det en fordel)

• Gode norskkunnskaper, samt lese og forstå Engelsk

What we offer you

Vi tilbyr:

• Sulzer tilbyr et hyggelig miljø med høy yrkesstolthet og faglig tyngde

• En sikker og trygg arbeidsplass i vekst, som opererer i flere stabile markeder

• Gode arbeidsforhold med vekt på sikkerhet, opplæring og kvalitet

• Servicebilordning

• Vår helseforsikring sørger for at alle ansatte får rask hjelp til å løse sine plager

• En av markedets beste pensjonsbetingelser

• Ferie og fritidsforsikring for hele familien

• Ulykkesforsikring for hele familien

• God opplæring, og mulighet for videreutvikling internt og eksternt i Sulzer systemet

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sr. (Field) Service Technician is responsible for installing, configuring, calibrating, and repairing technical products and systems at customer field locations. This role performs a variety of maintenance and technical support tasks and may provide onsite training to customer support personnel.
This job profile is intended for support staff that follows established procedures and works under close supervision. Smaller/easier decisions are made autonomously. Servicetekniker til bærekraftig industri

• Ønsker å arbeide selvstendig og er løsningsorientert

• Er nøyaktig og verdsetter kvalitet i arbeidet

• Anser digitale verktøy som hjelpemidler og ikke en belastning

• Er positiv, lærevillig, og liker å dele kunnskapen din

Kvalifikasjoner :

• Sulzer tilbyr et hyggelig miljø med høy yrkesstolthet og faglig tyngde

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

El/La Sales Engineer (Industrial) da soporte al proceso comercial aportando conocimiento técnico, participando en la preparación de propuestas y colaborando en la definición de soluciones adaptadas a las necesidades del cliente.

Esta posición está orientada a profesionales en etapas iniciales de su carrera, que combinan interés por la ingeniería y las ventas, analizan requisitos técnicos y contribuyen al desarrollo de oportunidades comerciales, trabajando en coordinación con equipos senior y otras áreas.

Ámbito de actuación: España y Portugal. Responsabilidades principales

• Apoyar en la preparación y presentación de propuestas técnico-comerciales

• Colaborar en el diseño de soluciones adaptadas a las necesidades del cliente

• Dar soporte en reuniones y visitas comerciales con clientes

• Responder a consultas técnicas y comerciales, actuando como interlocutor de soporte

• Coordinarse con equipos de ingeniería y operaciones para asegurar la viabilidad de las propuestas

• Realizar seguimiento de ofertas y oportunidades comerciales

• Mantener actualizada la información de clientes y actividad comercial en el CRM

• Analizar el mercado y la competencia para identificar oportunidades de negocio

• Contribuir a la implementación de la estrategia comercial en el área asignada

Requisitos

• Grado universitario en Ingeniería (Industrial o similar) o formación equivalente

• Hasta 2 años de experiencia en entornos técnicos o comerciales

• Interés por el ámbito técnico-comercial en sector industrial

• Manejo de herramientas Microsoft Office y CRM (valorable Salesforce)

• Disponibilidad para viajar dentro de España y Portugal

Competencias

• Orientación al cliente y buenas habilidades de comunicación

• Capacidad analítica y de comprensión técnica

• Proactividad, iniciativa y actitud de aprendizaje

• Habilidades de organización y seguimiento

• Capacidad de trabajo en equipo y colaboración transversal

• Flexibilidad y adaptación a entornos dinámicos

Idiomas

• Inglés: nivel B2 (intermedio-alto)

What we offer you

• Contrato indefinido.

• Salario competitivo y participación en el sistema de remuneración variable basado en objetivos personales y corporativos.

• Ticket restaurantes.

• Acceso a un plan de retribución flexible voluntario que permite optimizar el paquete salarial (por ejemplo, seguro médico, transporte, guardería).

• Formar parte de un equipo experimentado e internacional.

• Buen ambiente de trabajo.

• Oportunidades de desarrollo profesional dentro de una empresa internacional sólida y con fuerte presencia global.

• Formar parte de una organización dinámica en constante transformación y mejora.

• Ubicación de la oficina: RIVAS (MADRID)

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Unsere Auszubildenden im Ausbildungsberuf Zerspanungsmechaniker werden gezielt auf spannende Tätigkeiten im Unternehmen vorbereitet. Zu den Ausbildungsinhalten zählen unter anderem:

Von unseren zukünftigen Auszubildenden erwarten wir einen guten Hauptschul- oder Realschulabschluss, besonders in naturwissenschaftlichen bzw. technischen Fächern. About the role

Job Summary
The Lead (Field) Service Technician is responsible for installing, configuring, calibrating, and repairing technical products and systems at customer field locations. This role performs a variety of maintenance and technical support tasks and may provide onsite training to customer support personnel.
This job profile is intended for experienced support-level staff that generally works autonomously and only requires closer supervision in non-routine situations. Position Objective: to ensure high-quality service in the maintenance and repair of equipment, both in the workshop and at customer sites, as well as to resolve technical issues in coordination with the Workshop Manager and the service center team.

Your main tasks and responsibilities:

• Carry out the tasks assigned by the Team Leader, delivering high-quality service to company clients in both mechanical and electrical areas (commissioning, maintenance, repairs, and troubleshooting of electrical systems and automation). • Ability to interpret manuals, exploded views, and technical drawings.
