jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Machinery Mechanic is responsible for performing routine maintenance and minor repairs on industrial machinery to ensure smooth and safe operations. This role supports the maintenance team by identifying mechanical issues and assisting in equipment upkeep.
This job profile is intended for support staff that follows established procedures and works under close supervision. DUTIES

• Read job cards to determine; job status, work authorization/limitations, estimate, description of problems and/or expected serviceability.

• Test electro-mechanical equipment to troubleshoot known or suspected problems using various methods (ac or de).

• Disassemble electro-mechanical equipment noting parts identifications, configuration and condition.

• Clean electro-mechanical equipment assemblies as needed using various methods and steps, including but not limited to: parts washer/steamers, caustic tanks, glass beaders, etc.

• Measure for or note proper replacement parts. Correctly requisition needed items from storekeeper, as approved by supervisor.

• Replace or repair worn or defective mechanical or electro-mechanical assemblies, including but not limited to: bearings, brushes, brush holders, motors leads gears seals, impellers, mechanical switches, brakes clutches, clutch rotors, tachs, fans, end shield,, etc.

• Retest reassembled electro-mechanical equipment for proper output and operation.

• Complete required paperwork for each job accurately and on a timely basis.

• Operate specialized repair and testing equipment and other equipment as needed

• Observe all safety procedures and use proper protective gear (especially eye and car protection).

• Lift, tighten, adjust and/or secure heavy objects in order to perform work duties.

• Keep work area neat and clean as directed by supervisor.

• Assisted other mechanics or other shop personnel in skilled or –non-skilled duties as directed by supervisor or shop manager.

• Perform other skilled or not-skilled duties as directed by supervisor

QUALIFICATIONS

• High school diploma or equivalent

• Basic mechanical aptitude

• Ability to understand, perform and retain various skill related training and operational and safety procedures demonstrated by supervisor.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

• While performing duties of this job, would occasionally be required to stand, walk, sit, reach with hands and arms, climb or balance, stoop or kneel, talk and hear, and use fingers and hands to feel objects.

• Ability to lift and/or move up to 50 pounds

• Paid time off

• Vision insurance

• Health savings account

• Dental insurance

• Gym membership

• Employee assistance program

• Disability insurance

• Paid holidays

• Wellness program

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary

The Machinery Mechanic is responsible for performing routine maintenance and minor repairs on industrial machinery to ensure smooth and safe operations. This role supports the maintenance team by identifying mechanical issues and assisting in equipment upkeep.
This job profile is intended for support staff that follows established procedures and works under close supervision. o Test electro-mechanical equipment to troubleshoot known or suspected problems using various methods (ac or de).
• o Disassemble electro-mechanical equipment noting parts identifications, configuration and condition.
• o Clean electro-mechanical equipment assemblies as needed using various methods and steps, including but not limited to: parts washer/steamers, caustic tanks, glass beaders, etc.
• o Measure for or note proper replacement parts. Correctly requisition needed items from storekeeper, as approved by supervisor.
o Replace or repair worn or defective mechanical or electro-mechanical assemblies, including but not limited to: bearings, brushes, brush holders, motors leads gears seals, impellers, mechanical switches, brakes clutches, clutch rotors, tachs, fans, end shield,, etc.
• o Retest reassembled electro-mechanical equipment for proper output and operation.
• o Complete required paperwork for each job accurately and on a timely basis.
• o Operate specialized repair and testing equipment and other equipment as needed
• o Observe all safety procedures and use proper protective gear (especially eye and car protection).
• o Lift, tighten, adjust and/or secure heavy objects in order to perform work duties.
• o Keep work area neat and clean as directed by supervisor.
• o Assisted other mechanics or other shop personnel in skilled or –non-skilled duties as directed by supervisor or shop manager.
• o Perform other skilled or not-skilled duties as directed by supervisor

QUALIFICATIONS
• o High school diploma or equivalent
• o Basic mechanical aptitude
• o Ability to understand, perform and retain various skill related training and operational and safety procedures demonstrated by supervisor.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS
o While performing duties of this job, would occasionally be required to stand, walk, sit, reach with hands and arms, climb or balance, stoop or kneel, talk and hear, and use fingers and hands to feel objects.
o Ability to lift and/or move up to 50 pounds

• Wellness program

jobs.title: Final Inspection Lead
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

At Sulzer, we don't just manufacture pumps—we engineer and build critical equipment that keeps vital industries moving across the globe. From power generation and water infrastructure to energy, chemicals and industrial processing, our pumps are trusted in some of the world's most demanding applications. Our Leeds facility is one of Sulzer's flagship pump manufacturing centres, combining decades of engineering expertise with modern manufacturing technology following significant investment and refurbishment.

We're looking for an experienced Final Inspection Lead to join our recently refurbished, state-of-the-art manufacturing facility in Leeds, where you'll play a pivotal role in ensuring every pump package leaves our site meeting the highest standards of quality, safety and customer satisfaction. This is not a typical inspection role. You'll be working alongside teams who design, manufacture, assemble and test some of the largest and most technically advanced pumps in the industry. Some of our products weigh up to 150 tonnes, requiring exceptional coordination, precision and engineering excellence to take them from concept to customer delivery. What You'll Be Doing

• Leading final inspection activities for complete pump packages and rotating equipment.

• Coordinating the final assembly verification process before customer dispatch.

• Reviewing and approving final manufacturing records and quality documentation.

• Ensuring products comply with ISO 9001 standards and internal quality requirements.

• Verifying that all customer specifications, technical requirements and contractual obligations have been fulfilled.

• Overseeing and signing off complete pump packages and bareshaft assemblies.

• Working closely with Manufacturing, Engineering, Project Management and Quality teams to resolve issues and ensure on-time delivery.

• Supporting customer inspections and witness activities where required.

• Driving a culture of quality, accountability and continuous improvement across the operation.

What We're Looking For

• Experience within heavy engineering, rotating equipment, pumps, turbines, motors or similar manufacturing environments.

• Strong understanding of final inspection, quality assurance and documentation control processes.

• Knowledge of ISO 9001 quality management systems.

• Ability to interpret engineering drawings, specifications and manufacturing documentation.

• Experience coordinating inspections involving large, complex engineered products.

• Excellent communication and organisational skills.

• A proactive approach with the confidence to make critical quality decisions.

What we offer you

Core Benefits

• A competitive salary

• A company wide bonus scheme

• 33 days’ holiday

• You will be eligible to join the Company’s Medicash health cash plan, which allows you to claim back the cost of everyday healthcare expenses such as dental, optical and GP services.

• Defined pension contribution

• Employee Assistance Programmes

• Discounts on shopping, entertainment & lifestyle

• Costco membership option

• Discounted personal car leasing for you, family & friends

• Long Service Awards

• Ongoing learning through Sulzer Learning Pathways

• Armed Forces Support – As a Silver Award holder of the MoD Defence Employer Recognition Scheme, we actively support veterans, reservists and Cadet Adult Volunteers. This includes policies that enable time for training, camps and deployment, alongside access to a growing internal military network.

Onsite Perks

• Free, secure parking with EV charging

• Multi-faith prayer room

• Newly modernised work areas

• Community & Wellbeing

• Lively Sports & Social Club with events & prize draws

• 24/7 onsite gym

• Subsidised vending machines

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile. Informazioni sul ruolo A Sulzer, non produciamo solo pompe: progettiamo e costruiamo attrezzature critiche che mantengono industrie vitali in movimento in tutto il mondo. Dalla produzione di energia e dalle infrastrutture idriche all'energia, ai prodotti chimici e alla lavorazione industriale, le nostre pompe sono affidabili in alcune delle applicazioni più esigenti del mondo. La nostra struttura Leeds è uno dei centri di produzione di pompe di punta di Sulzer, che combina decenni di esperienza ingegneristica con la moderna tecnologia di produzione a seguito di significativi investimenti e ristrutturazione. Siamo alla ricerca di un'esperta struttura di produzione di Leeds, dove potrai svolgere un ruolo fondamentale nel garantire che ogni pacchetto di pompe lasci il nostro sito rispettando i più elevati standard di qualità, sicurezza e soddisfazione del cliente. Questo non è un tipico ruolo di ispezione. Potrai lavorare insieme a team che progettano, producono, assemblano e testano alcune delle più grandi e più tecnicamente avanzate pompe del settore. Alcuni dei nostri prodotti pesano fino a 150 tonnellate, richiedendo un coordinamento eccezionale, precisione e eccellenza ingegneristica per portarli dal concetto alla consegna del cliente. Cosa farai
• Le principali attività di ispezione finale per pacchetti di pompaggio completi e attrezzature rotanti.
• Coordinamento del processo di verifica del montaggio finale prima dell'invio del cliente.
• Revisione e approvazione dei record di produzione finali e documentazione di qualità.
• Garantire i prodotti conformi agli standard ISO 9001 e ai requisiti di qualità interna.
• Verificare che siano state soddisfatte tutte le specifiche del cliente, i requisiti tecnici e gli obblighi contrattuali.
• Sorvegliare e firmare pacchetti di pompa completa e assemblaggi a albero nudo.
• Lavorare a stretto contatto con i team Manufacturing, Engineering, Project Management e Quality per risolvere i problemi e garantire la consegna in tempo reale.
• Sostenere le ispezioni dei clienti e le attività di testimone ove necessario.
• Guidare una cultura di qualità, responsabilità e miglioramento continuo attraverso l'operazione. Cosa stiamo cercando
• Esperienza all'interno di ingegneria pesante, attrezzature rotanti, pompe, turbine, motori o ambienti di produzione simili.
• Forte comprensione dei processi di controllo finale, garanzia della qualità e controllo della documentazione.
• Conoscenza dei sistemi di gestione della qualità ISO 9001.
• Capacità di interpretare disegni di ingegneria, specifiche e documentazione di fabbricazione.
• Esperienza di coordinamento ispezioni che coinvolgono prodotti di grandi dimensioni e complessi ingegnerizzati.
• Ottima comunicazione e capacità organizzative.
• Un approccio proattivo con la fiducia di prendere decisioni di qualità critiche. Cosa ti offriamo Vantaggi del nucleo
• Uno stipendio competitivo
• Un ampio programma di bonus aziendale
• 33 giorni di vacanza
• Sarete idonei ad aderire al piano di cassa Medicash della Società, che vi permette di rivendicare il costo delle spese sanitarie quotidiane come i servizi dentali, ottici e GP.
• Contributo pensionistico
• Programmi di assistenza ai dipendenti
• Sconti su shopping, intrattenimento e stile di vita
• Opzione di abbonamento Costco
• Noleggio auto personali scontati per te, famiglia e amici
• Premi di servizio lungo
• Apprendimento in corso attraverso Sulzer Learning Pathways
• Supporto delle Forze Armate – Come titolare del Premio d'Argento del programma di riconoscimento dei datori di lavoro MoD Defence, sosteniamo attivamente veterani, reservisti e Volontari per adulti Cadet. Questo include politiche che consentono il tempo di formazione, campi e distribuzione, oltre all'accesso a una crescente rete militare interna. In loco Perks
• Parcheggio gratuito e sicuro con ricarica EV
• Sala di preghiera multi-fedele
• Aree di lavoro di nuova modernizzazione

• Lively Sports & Social Club con eventi e premi

Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable. Sur le rôle Chez Sulzer, nous ne fabriquons pas seulement des pompes, nous réalisons et construisons des équipements essentiels qui permettent aux industries vitales de se déplacer à travers le monde. De la production d'électricité et de l'infrastructure de l'eau à l'énergie, aux produits chimiques et à la transformation industrielle, nos pompes font confiance à certaines des applications les plus exigeantes au monde. Notre installation Leeds est l'un des centres phares de fabrication de pompes de Sulzer, combinant des décennies d'expertise en ingénierie avec des technologies de fabrication modernes après d'importants investissements et rénovations. Nous sommes à la recherche d'un guide d'inspection final expérimenté pour rejoindre notre usine de fabrication récemment rénovée et ultramoderne à Leeds, où vous jouerez un rôle essentiel pour assurer que chaque pompe laisse notre site répondre aux plus hautes normes de qualité, de sécurité et de satisfaction des clients. Ce n'est pas un rôle d'inspection typique. Vous travaillerez aux côtés d'équipes qui conçoivent, fabriquent, assemblent et testent certaines des pompes les plus grandes et les plus avancées de l'industrie. Certains de nos produits pèsent jusqu'à 150 tonnes, ce qui nécessite une coordination exceptionnelle, une précision et une ingénierie exceptionnelles pour les amener du concept à la livraison des clients. • Diriger les activités d'inspection finale pour les paquets complets de pompe et l'équipement rotatif.

jobs.title: Regional Sales Manager
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sr. Strategic Account Manager is responsible for managing and growing relationships with key clients across multiple lines of business. This role involves developing long-term account strategies, identifying growth opportunities, and ensuring high levels of client satisfaction.
This job profile is intended for specialist professionals that apply advanced knowledge of a job area. Required to manage projects / processes independently with limited supervision. Typically coaches and reviews the work of lower level professionals. Regional Sales Manager – Metals & Mining

Position Summary
The Regional Sales Manager is accountable for shaping and executing Sulzer Pumps’ channel strategy for the Metals & Mining market across North America. This role provides commercial leadership to drive profitable growth, deepen engagement with end users, EPCs, and channel partners, expand Sulzer’s installed base, and accelerate aftermarket revenue across the region.

Key Responsibilities
Strategic Growth Leadership: Lead regional growth initiatives by developing and executing a Metals & Mining strategy aligned with Sulzer Pumps’ commercial priorities and long-term objectives.
Channel Strategy & Performance: Establish, develop, and oversee channel partners to ensure market coverage, commercial effectiveness, and alignment with Sulzer’s go-to-market strategy.
Installed Base & Aftermarket Expansion: Advance new equipment sales to strengthen the installed base while driving sustainable aftermarket growth in parts, service, repairs, and upgrades.
Executive Customer Engagement: Build and strengthen strategic relationships with mining operators, processing facilities, and engineering firms to identify project opportunities and long-term account potential.
Technical & Commercial Value Selling: Provide consultative support that positions Sulzer solutions around reliability, lifecycle performance, and total cost of ownership.
Market Presence & Pipeline Development: Maintain a strong field presence through customer visits
and joint engagement with channel partners to expand pipeline and convert priority opportunities.
Capability Building: Strengthen partner and customer effectiveness through targeted product, application, and market training that reinforces Sulzer’s competitive position.
Cross-Functional Leadership: Collaborate closely with engineering, service, and operations teams to ensure disciplined execution, high customer satisfaction, and successful commercial outcomes.

Critical Success Factors
Deep understanding of pump applications within mining, mineral processing, and metals operations.
Demonstrated ability to deliver growth through both direct and channel-led commercial models.
Strong capability in strategic account development, executive relationship management, and opportunity capture.
Excellent communication, leadership, and execution skills, with the ability to influence across internal and external stakeholders.

Qualifications & Experience
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related discipline preferred.
5–10 years of progressive experience in pump or rotating equipment sales within the Metals & Mining sector.
Demonstrated record of delivering profitable growth, leading channel partner performance, and applying the technical and commercial judgment required to support engineered pump

Travel Requirement
Travel up to 75% across the assigned territory is expected to support customer engagement, channel development, and business growth objectives

What we offer you

• Competitive Paid Time Off

• 12 Company Paid Holidays per year

• Annual Bonus Program

• Full Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits

• Company Paid Short Term and Long Term Disability, Company Paid Life Insurance

• 6% 401K

This role provides commercial leadership to drive profitable growth, deepen engagement with end users, EPCs, and channel partners, expand Sulzer’s installed base, and accelerate aftermarket revenue across the region.

Key Responsibilities
Strategic Growth Leadership: Lead regional growth initiatives by developing and executing a Metals & Mining strategy aligned with Sulzer Pumps’ commercial priorities and long-term objectives.

Installed Base & Aftermarket Expansion: Advance new equipment sales to strengthen the installed base while driving sustainable aftermarket growth in parts, service, repairs, and upgrades.
Executive Customer Engagement: Build and strengthen strategic relationships with mining operators, processing facilities, and engineering firms to identify project opportunities and long-term account potential.
Technical & Commercial Value Selling: Provide consultative support that positions Sulzer solutions around reliability, lifecycle performance, and total cost of ownership.
Market Presence & Pipeline Development: Maintain a strong field presence through customer visits
and joint engagement with channel partners to expand pipeline and convert priority opportunities.

Critical Success Factors

jobs.title: Workplace AI Architect
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Define and govern the adoption of AI across Workplace and platform-based solutions, with a strong focus on out-of-the-box capabilities, integrations, and security. Act as the orchestration point across Software Development, Data & Analytics, business users, and platform owners, ensuring consistent routing of AI initiatives. Drive the transition from ad-hoc usage to controlled, scalable adoption through clear governance, measurement, and chargeback, positioning AI as an extension of existing platforms rather than a parallel capability. The role focuses on Workplace AI platforms and embedded capabilities such as Microsoft 365 Copilot, AI assistants, and collaboration tools.

Main accountabilities and tasks

• AI Roadmap & Out-of-the-Box Ownership: Own the AI roadmap for Workplace and platform-based AI capabilities and the adoption of out-of-the-box solutions; contribute to the cross-functional definition of AI architecture; establish AI as a coherent enterprise capability.

• Platform-First, Preview & Early-Access Ownership: Prioritise out-of-the-box capabilities over new builds; own the evaluation, piloting, and rollout of preview features and vendor early-access programmes; track and govern AI features increasingly embedded in existing enterprise services.

• Governance of Services, Integrations & Agents: Establish a single enterprise entry point and a risk-based approval process, supported by self-service guardrails and clear approval timelines so the front door enables rather than blocks; govern AI services, integrations, APIs, and the lifecycle of AI agents; ensure every AI asset is inventoried, owned, and operated within agreed controls.

• Routing of AI Initiatives Across Delivery Tracks: Define and govern how AI initiatives are routed across delivery tracks - out-of-the-box, preview, and early-access (this role); citizen development (business users, against standards set by this role); custom development and advanced integrations (Software Development); and analytics-driven solutions (Data & Analytics).

• Security, Risk & Compliance (with Infosec): Together with Infosec, define and enforce AI-specific controls under a clear split of accountability for who defines, approves, and enforces; ensure compliance with GDPR and the EU AI Act; govern third-party AI usage and minimise shadow-AI risk.

• AI Lifecycle Management: Govern the full lifecycle covering build, publish, operate, and retire; ensure ownership, inventory, and transparency for every AI solution; enforce environment-based controls across experiment, managed, and production.

• Business Value, Chargeback & Adoption: Define how AI business value is measured; build and operate a chargeback model so consumption is transparent and costs sit with the consuming business; drive adoption and track it against value realisation.

• User Support, Enablement & Training: Act as the primary point of contact for AI adoption; provide patterns, guardrails, and reusable templates so users can build safely; deliver training, documentation, and onboarding paths that build AI literacy across the organisation.

Desired experience and qualifications

• Work experience: 8-10+ years in enterprise IT, architecture, or transformation roles, with experience in governance, platform strategy, or large-scale adoption.

• Expertise: Senior expert / enterprise architect level. Strong understanding of enterprise AI platforms (e.g. Microsoft 365 Copilot) and assistant and agent-based tooling, and of GenAI / agent-based architectures; deep knowledge of platform vs. custom-development trade-offs and licensing models; experience defining operating models and governance standards.

• Governance & regulation: Proven experience defining and rolling out enterprise AI governance

Definieren und regeln Sie die Einführung von KI in Workplace- und plattformbasierten Lösungen mit einem starken Fokus auf Out-of-the-Box-Funktionen, Integrationen und Sicherheit. Handeln Sie als Orchestrierungspunkt für Softwareentwicklung, Daten & Analytics, Geschäftsanwender und Plattformbesitzer und gewährleisten Sie ein konsistentes Routing von KI-Initiativen. • Governance von Services, Integrationen und Agenten: Etablieren Sie einen einzigen Enterprise-Einstiegspunkt und einen risikobasierten Genehmigungsprozess, der durch Self-Service-Leitlinien und klare Genehmigungszeitpläne unterstützt wird, damit die Haustür ermöglicht und nicht blockiert wird; regeln Sie KI-Services, Integrationen, APIs und den Lebenszyklus von KI-Agenten; stellen Sie sicher, dass jedes AI-Asset inventarisiert, im Besitz ist und innerhalb der vereinbarten Kontrollen betrieben wird.

jobs.title: Gas Compressor Technician
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

At Sulzer, we specialise in delivering top-tier service to our customers across the oil & gas, power generation, and renewable sectors. With our recent £1 million investment, our Ellon facility is now a Centre of Excellence, providing cutting-edge support for electric motors, pumps, gearboxes, and turbo-compressors. We are looking for a skilled Gas Compressor Technician to join our team.

As a Gas Compressor Technician, you will be working directly on the repair, overhaul, and maintenance of gas compressors. You will play a key role in ensuring that our customers' equipment is serviced to the highest standards, meeting industry specifications and maintaining operational efficiency Your Main Tasks and Responsibilities:

• Disassembling, inspecting, and rebuilding gas compressors and their components

• Diagnosing and repairing mechanical faults in a variety of compressor types

• Precision fitting, machining, and assembly work as required

• Performing dynamic and functional testing on overhauled equipment

• Collaborating with engineering and quality teams to ensure compliance with technical specifications

• Maintaining a clean and safe working environment in line with HSE requirements

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• Experience in the overhaul and maintenance of gas compressors or similar rotating equipment

• Proficiency in mechanical fitting, assembly, and fault diagnosis

• Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality

• Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and technical manuals

• Good communication skills and a proactive attitude to teamwork

• Awareness of Health, Safety, and Environmental regulations

What we offer you

• Competitive basic salary.

• 33 days of annual leave.

• Defined pension contribution.

• Confidential support and guidance through our Employee Assistance Programmes.

• Access to a wide range of discounts on everyday shopping, entertainment, and lifestyle.

• Discounted Personal Car Leasing - available for you, your family, and friends.

• Long Service Awards to celebrate your dedication.

• Ongoing learning and development through Sulzer Learning Pathways.

• Free and secure onsite parking, with electric charging facilities.

• We're proud to support those who've served. Sulzer is a Bronze Award holder under the MoDs Defence Employer Recognition Scheme meaning we actively welcome and support ex-military personnel and reservists in building successful careers with us.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

At Sulzer, innovation and excellence are at the heart of everything we do. Our Ellon Service Centre is one of Sulzer's flagship rotating equipment service facilities, providing world-class repair, maintenance and engineering solutions for critical turbomachinery and gas compression equipment across a wide range of industries.

As the Technical Focal Point for Gas Compression, you will serve as the first point of contact for technical guidance relating to gas compression equipment and workshop procedures. You will work closely with customers, workshop personnel, field service teams and engineering colleagues to deliver technically sound recommendations and exceptional customer support.

This is a highly visible role requiring strong technical knowledge, excellent communication skills and a customer-focused approach. Your Responsibilities

• Act as the primary technical focal point for gas compression activities within the service centre.

• Provide technical guidance to workshop teams regarding repair methods, procedures and best practices.

• Support the wider engineering team in determining the optimum approach to work execution.

• Provide troubleshooting expertise for complex repair and operational issues.

• Liaise closely with engineering colleagues and other technical specialists when required.

• Attend customer meetings as the technical representative for gas compression projects.

• Accompany customers during witness testing activities, providing technical advice and support.

• Present technical findings, recommendations and repair solutions to customers.

• Build strong customer relationships through professional technical support and expertise.

• Review workshop findings and provide recommendations for repair solutions.

• Participate in failure investigations within Sulzer service centres and at customer sites.

• Deliver technical advice, coaching and training to internal teams where required.

What You Bring

Qualifications

• HNC, HND or Degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline.

Experience & Technical Knowledge

• Significant experience with gas compression equipment.

• Previous engineering experience within rotating equipment, turbomachinery or related industries.

• Understanding of vibration analysis and machinery diagnostics.

• Experience preparing technical reports and presenting engineering recommendations.

• Knowledge of repair methodologies and failure investigation practices.

Skills & Behaviours

• Strong influencing and persuasion skills.

• Comfortable engaging with customers and presenting technical information.

• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to interact at all levels.

• Strong organisational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities.

• Effective time management skills with flexibility to adapt to changing business demands.

• High attention to detail and commitment to quality.

• Ability to work collaboratively across multidisciplinary teams.

• Competent user of Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel and Outlook.

• Committed to adhering to company standards, procedures and safety requirements.

Travel Requirements
The successful candidate must be willing to travel to customer sites and Sulzer locations as required, both within the UK and occasionally internationally.

What we offer you

• A competitive basic salary

• Annual bonus scheme

• Car/Car Allowance

• 33 days annual leave.

• Defined pension contributions.

• Access to Medicash helping you cover everyday health costs like dental optical and physiotherapy plus a range of wellbeing perks.

• Confidential support via Employee Assistance Programmes.

• Access to discounts on shopping entertainment lifestyle plus opportunity to apply for Costco member

Sulzer is a non-OEM rotating equipment repair facility located in the Houston area. Sulzer is comprised of several divisions that include the Component Repair Division. Departments within the Component Repair division include Combustion, Stationary, Mechanical, Rotating, Fuel/Flow and Inspection departments. Each department is dedicated to refurbishment of gas turbine components and sub-assembly parts. The Gas Turbine Component Repair Project Engineer is responsible for developing inspection and repair workscopes for stationary and rotating gas turbine components and managing multiple repair projects from receipt through delivery. The engineer works closely with operations, sales and external vendors to define repair methods, generate purchase orders, control cost, and resolve technical issues throughout the repair cycle. Responsibilities

• Develop estimates for overhauls of gas turbine components.
· Generate repair quotations and work scopes using Dynamics 365(hours & material).
· Inspection and repair work scope development, review, evaluation, and periodic adjustment.
· Collaborate with the component engineering team and department supervisor to develop, refine, and optimize fixturing and tooling designs.
· Reverse engineering and part design improvement.
· Develop customer specific and driven scopes.
· Evaluate inspection results for rotating and stationary gas turbine components (e.g., buckets, nozzles, shrouds, casings)
· Creation of incoming and outgoing disposition reports ensuring technical accuracy.
· Creation and development of inspection and repair forms, repair specifications, written process specification, and component drawings (2D/3D prints and models).

• Project Management: Manage multiple projects using Microsoft Project to meet departments monthly deliverables and budget targets.
· Order materials for jobs – Specify material from vendors – Write Purchase Orders.
· Develop industry knowledge about competition, vendors, and gas turbine advancements applicable to Sulzer’s business.
· Work with inside and outside sales representatives to provide technical support during customer meetings.
· Work with the component engineering group to develop and maintain drawings, inspection forms and prints.
· Work on and manage special projects per manager’s instructions.
· Develop tooling, processes, documentation, and specifications for flow testing IGT components.
· Help maintain and improve flow test equipment.
· Attend bid meetings / Interact with Customers.
· In-shop (and at times off-site) evaluation and reporting on components.
Qualifications:
The ideal candidate will possess the following:

Sulzer is a non-OEM rotating equipment repair facility located in the Houston area. Sulzer is comprised of several divisions that include the Component Repair Division. Departments within the Component Repair division include Combustion, Stationary, Mechanical, Rotating, Fuel/Flow and Inspection departments. Each department is dedicated to refurbishment of gas turbine components and sub-assembly parts. The Gas Turbine Component Repair Project Engineer is responsible for developing inspection and repair workscopes for stationary and rotating gas turbine components and managing multiple repair projects from receipt through delivery. The engineer works closely with operations, sales and external vendors to define repair methods, generate purchase orders, control cost, and resolve technical issues throughout the repair cycle. Responsibilities

• Develop estimates for overhauls of gas turbine components.
· Generate repair quotations and work scopes using Dynamics 365(hours & material).
· Inspection and repair work scope development, review, evaluation, and periodic adjustment.
· Collaborate with the component engineering team and department supervisor to develop, refine, and optimize fixturing and tooling designs.
· Reverse engineering and part design improvement.
· Develop customer specific and driven scopes.
· Evaluate inspection results for rotating and stationary gas turbine components (e.g., buckets, nozzles, shrouds, casings)
· Creation of incoming and outgoing disposition reports ensuring technical accuracy.
· Creation and development of inspection and repair forms, repair specifications, written process specification, and component drawings (2D/3D prints and models).
· Work with department supervisor and shop technicians to ensure process, repair, and tooling viability. As well as to optimize, refine and streamline production workflow.

• Project Management: Manage multiple projects using Microsoft Project to meet departments monthly deliverables and budget targets.
· Order materials for jobs – Specify material from vendors – Write Purchase Orders.
· Develop industry knowledge about competition, vendors, and gas turbine advancements applicable to Sulzer’s business.
· Work with inside and outside sales representatives to provide technical support during customer meetings.
· Work with the component engineering group to develop and maintain drawings, inspection forms and prints.
· Work on and manage special projects per manager’s instructions.
· Develop tooling, processes, documentation, and specifications for flow testing IGT components.
· Help maintain and improve flow test equipment.
· Attend bid meetings / Interact with Customers.
· In-shop (and at times off-site) evaluation and reporting on components.
Qualifications:
The ideal candidate will possess the following:
· Bachelor's degree in engineering, Sciences, or related field / equivalent experience and training.
· Knowledge in rotating/stationary equipment repairs or similar machinery.

• Proficiency in all MS office software; particularly with Excel and Project.

• Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced shop environment.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.
· Be knowledgeable of and enforce safety in all aspects and areas of the position, and with fellow co-workers throughout Sulzer’s various environments, includes those of our customers and vendors.

What we offer you

• 12 Paid Holidays

• Medical, dental, vision, life & disability

• 401K with 6% company match

• Employee Assistance Program

• Employee Wellness Program

• New onsite cafeteria, all meals subsidized (La Porte Service Center)

jobs.title: Senior Business Controller
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Senior Business Controller services as the primary financial liasion between local manufacturing operations and the Center of Excellence (CoE), ensuring seamless coordination and effective execution of key financial and project management activities. This position has responsibility for all of Latin America. Key Responsibilities:

• Overseeing the accuracy and productivity of day-to-day activities for inventory management, backlog tracking, customer order profitability, and utilization metrics.

• Leading strategic planning to align sales and operations, large captial projects, and working capital planning.

• Managing and tracking capital and operating projects, including billing and revenue recognition to ensure financial objectives are met.

• Develop the annual budget and manage detailed financial planning for country-specific operations

• Refresh rolling forecasts to reflect changing business and economic conditions

• Perform plan analytics to identify risks and opportunitites, develop risk management strategies, and provide actionable insights to mitigate financial risks.

• Define costing outcomes, develop cost frameworks, and ensure accurate cost control with a focus on optimizing local operations.

What you bring:

• University degree in Finance or Accoutning

• Proven track record in inventory management, cost control, and project management

• At least 7 years of experience with Controlling in a manufacturing or industrial enviroment.

• Strong understanding of cost controlling, budgeting, and financial planning.

• Experience with SAP

• Experience with Tagetik and Qlik Sense is a plus

What we offer you

We offer:

• Benefits Over Law

• Savings Fund

• Training

• Christmas bonus over low

• Development plan

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile.

Informazioni sul ruolo

Sintesi del lavoro
I servizi di Senior Business Controller come principale legame finanziario tra le operazioni di produzione locale e il Centro di Eccellenza (CoE), garantendo un coordinamento senza soluzione di continuità e un'efficace esecuzione delle principali attività di gestione finanziaria e di progetto. Questa posizione ha responsabilità per tutta l'America Latina. Responsabilità chiave:

• Superare l'accuratezza e la produttività delle attività quotidiane per la gestione dell'inventario, il monitoraggio del backlog, la redditività dell'ordine del cliente e le metriche di utilizzo.

• Promuovere la pianificazione strategica per allineare le vendite e le operazioni, grandi progetti di prigionia e pianificazione dei capitali di lavoro.

• Gestione e monitoraggio dei capitali e dei progetti operativi, tra cui fatturazione e riconoscimento dei ricavi per garantire obiettivi finanziari.

• Sviluppare il bilancio annuale e gestire la pianificazione finanziaria dettagliata per le operazioni specifiche del paese

• Aggiornare le previsioni per riflettere le mutevoli condizioni economiche e commerciali

• Eseguire l'analisi del piano per identificare i rischi e le opportunitÃ, sviluppare strategie di gestione del rischio e fornire informazioni attuabili per mitigare i rischi finanziari.

• Definire i risultati dei costi, sviluppare i framework dei costi e garantire un controllo accurato dei costi con l'obiettivo di ottimizzare le operazioni locali.

Cosa porti:

• Laurea in Finanza o Accoutning

• Provato record di traccia nella gestione dell'inventario, il controllo dei costi e la gestione del progetto

• Almeno 7 anni di esperienza con Controlling in un ambiente produttivo o industriale.

• Forte comprensione del controllo dei costi, del budget e della pianificazione finanziaria.

• Esperienza con SAP

• Esperienza con Tagetik e Qlik Sense è un plus

Cosa ti offriamo

Offriamo:

• Vantaggi sulla legge

• Fondo di risparmio

• Formazione

• bonus di Natale su basso

• Piano di sviluppo

Sulzer è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità. Crediamo nella forza di una forza lavoro diversificata e ci impegniamo ad offrire un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo.

Siamo orgogliosi di essere riconosciuti come Top Employer 2026 in Brasile, Canada, Cina, Finlandia, Germania, Irlanda, Messico, Svizzera, Sud Africa, Regno Unito e Stati Uniti.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Sulzer ist ein führendes Ingenieurunternehmen mit einem stolzen Erbe an Innovationen. Schließen Sie sich unserem globalen Team an, um Ihr Fachwissen zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine prosperierende und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen.

Über die Rolle

Stellenbeschreibung
Der Senior Business Controller ist die primäre finanzielle Verbindung zwischen lokalen Fertigungsbetrieben und dem Center of Excellence (CoE), die eine nahtlose Koordination und effektive Durchführung wichtiger Finanz- und Projektmanagementaktivitäten gewährleistet. Diese Position trägt Verantwortung für ganz Lateinamerika. Hauptzuständigkeiten:

• Überwachung der Genauigkeit und Produktivität der täglichen Aktivitäten für Bestandsmanagement, Backlog-Tracking, Kundenauftrag Rentabilität und Auslastung Metriken.

• Führende strategische Planung zur Abstimmung von Vertrieb und Betrieb, Großprojekten und Betriebskapitalplanung.

• Verwaltung und Nachverfolgung von Kapital- und Betriebsprojekten, einschließlich Abrechnung und Umsatzerfassung, um sicherzustellen, dass die finanziellen Ziele erreicht werden.

• Entwicklung des Jahresbudgets und Verwaltung der detaillierten Finanzplanung für länderspezifische Operationen

• Auffrischung der rollierenden Prognosen zur Berücksichtigung der sich ändernden Geschäfts- und Wirtschaftsbedingungen

• Planen Sie Analysen, um Risiken und Chancen zu identifizieren, Risikomanagementstrategien zu entwickeln und umsetzbare Erkenntnisse zur Minderung finanzieller Risiken zu liefern.

• Definieren Sie Kalkulationsergebnisse, entwickeln Sie Kostenrahmen und gewährleisten Sie eine genaue Kostenkontrolle mit Schwerpunkt auf der Optimierung lokaler Abläufe.

Was Sie mitbringen:

• Universitätsabschluss in Finanzen oder Accouting

• Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz in den Bereichen Bestandsmanagement, Kostenkontrolle und Projektmanagement

• Mindestens 7 Jahre Erfahrung mit Controlling in einer Fertigungs- oder Industrieumgebung.

• Starkes Verständnis von Kostenkontrolle, Budgetierung und Finanzplanung.

• Erfahrung mit SAP

• Erfahrung mit Tagetik und Qlik Sense ist ein Plus

Was wir Ihnen bieten

Wir bieten:

• Vorteile gegenüber dem Gesetz

• Sparkasse

• Ausbildung

• Weihnachtsbonus über niedrig

• Entwicklungsplan

Sulzer ist ein Arbeitgeber für Chancengleichheit. Wir glauben an die Stärke einer vielfältigen Belegschaft und engagieren uns für ein integratives Arbeitsumfeld.

Wir sind stolz darauf, als Top Employer 2026 in Brasilien, Kanada, China, Finnland, Deutschland, Irland, Mexiko, der Schweiz, Südafrika, Großbritannien und den USA anerkannt zu werden.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable.

Sur le rôle

Résumé de l'emploi
Le contrôleur d'entreprise principal assure la liaison financière principale entre les activités manufacturières locales et le Centre d'excellence (CdE), assurant une coordination transparente et l'exécution efficace des principales activités de gestion financière et de projet. Cette position a la responsabilité de toute l'Amérique latine. Principales responsabilités :

• Superviser l'exactitude et la productivité des activités quotidiennes pour la gestion des stocks, le suivi de l'arriéré, la rentabilité des commandes et les mesures d'utilisation.

• Diriger la planification stratégique pour harmoniser les ventes et les opérations, les grands projets captifs et la planification du fonds de roulement.

• Gestion et suivi des projets d'immobilisations et d'exploitation, y compris la facturation et la comptabilisation des revenus, afin de s'assurer que les objectifs financiers sont atteints.

• Élaborer le budget annuel et gérer la planification financière détaillée des opérations par pays

• Actualiser les prévisions de roulement pour tenir compte de l'évolution des conditions économiques et commerciales

• Effectuer des analyses du plan afin de déterminer les risques et les possibilités, d'élaborer des stratégies de gestion des risques et de fournir des renseignements concrets pour atténuer les risques financiers.

• Définir les résultats en matière de coûts, élaborer des cadres de coûts et assurer un contrôle précis des coûts en mettant l'accent sur l'optimisation des opérations locales.

Ce que vous apportez:

• Diplôme universitaire en Finance ou Accoutning

• Expérience éprouvée en gestion des stocks, en contrôle des coûts et en gestion de projet

• Au moins 7 ans d'expérience avec Controlling dans une fabrication ou un environnement industriel.

• Connaissance approfondie du contrôle des coûts, de la budgétisation et de la planification financière.

• Expérience avec SAP

• Expérience avec Tagetik et Qlik Sense est un plus

Ce que nous vous offrons

Nous offrons:

• Avantages juridiques

• Fonds d ' épargne

• Formation

• Bonus de Noël plus bas

• Plan de développement

Sulzer est un employeur à chances égales. Nous croyons en la force d'un effectif diversifié et sommes déterminés à offrir un milieu de travail inclusif.

Nous sommes fiers d'être reconnus comme l'un des meilleurs employeurs 2026 au Brésil, au Canada, en Chine, en Finlande, en Allemagne, en Irlande, au Mexique, en Suisse, en Afrique du Sud, au Royaume-Uni et aux États-Unis.

jobs.title: Senior Accountant
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Accounting Sr. Officer is responsible for supporting accounting operations including journal entries, reconciliations, and financial reporting. This role ensures compliance with accounting standards and supports audits and month-end close activities. This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. Le comptable senior apporte son soutien à l'équipe financière dans le cadre de diverses tâches et responsabilités. Il est chargé de gérer la comptabilité de l'ensemble du processus « Record to Report » (RTR) au sein des sociétés du groupe en France, en veillant à l'exactitude des données et au respect des normes comptables ainsi que des règles internes de Sulzer. En outre, il apporte son soutien aux processus comptables généraux dans les domaines « Purchase to Pay » (PTP) et « Order to Cash » (OTC), lorsque cela est nécessaire.

Participer à la clôture de période, notamment en clôturant le grand livre auxiliaire des comptes clients et fournisseurs et en effectuant le rapprochement avec le grand livre général
Superviser les processus de clôture de fin de mois et de fin d’exercice ; participer à la préparation des écritures comptables, aux rapprochements du bilan et à l’analyse des écarts
Établir des états financiers précis et dans les délais, notamment les comptes de résultat, les bilans et les tableaux de flux de trésorerie
Participer à la saisie comptable des factures sans bon de commande
Assister l’équipe des services financiers partagés dans les activités liées à la gestion des immobilisations
Collaborer étroitement avec l’équipe Reporting & Analytics pour analyser les données financières et fournir des informations sur la performance financière, identifier les tendances et les écarts afin d’étayer les décisions opérationnelles
Assurer la coordination avec les autres services et les équipes des services financiers partagés afin de garantir que toutes les transactions financières sont correctement comptabilisées et reflétées dans le grand livre
Participer aux processus de budgétisation et de prévision, en apportant son expertise sur les aspects financiers et les projections ; collaborer étroitement avec le responsable financier national
Assurer la liaison avec les experts fiscaux afin de garantir l’exactitude et la ponctualité des déclarations fiscales et de la conformité
Suivre les indicateurs clés de performance (KPI) afin d’évaluer l’efficacité des processus comptables et de mettre en œuvre des initiatives d’amélioration continue
Contribuer à l’amélioration continue des processus financiers, en tirant parti des technologies et des meilleures pratiques ; veiller au respect des politiques, procédures et modèles
Fournir des rapports financiers précis et en temps opportun à la direction générale et aux parties prenantes
Veiller à ce que tous les rapports et processus financiers soient conformes aux normes internationales d’information financière (IFRS) et à la réglementation de Sulzer
Assurer la liaison avec les auditeurs et veiller à ce que les audits soient menés à bien avec un minimum d’ajustements
Veiller à ce que des contrôles internes financiers soient en place et respectés pour les processus relevant de cette fonction
Assister le responsable national de la comptabilité dans la gestion des demandes des auditeurs internes et externes et s’assurer que l’équipe comptable fournit les informations requises

• Formation et expérience
Diplôme universitaire en finance, comptabilité, gestion d’entreprise ou dans un domaine connexe
Au moins 5 à 7 ans d’expérience en comptabilité, avec une spécialisation marquée dans la comptabilité générale et le reporting financier dans un environnement industrie

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e soluzioni di sviluppo innovative che consentono una società di successo e più sostenibile.

Informazioni sul ruolo

Sintesi del lavoro
L'Accounting Sr. Officer è responsabile del supporto alle operazioni di contabilità, comprese le voci di giornale, le conciliazioni e la rendicontazione finanziaria. Questo ruolo garantisce il rispetto degli standard contabili e supporta audit e attività di fine mese. Questo profilo di lavoro è destinato a professionisti esperti che applicano la conoscenza pratica di un'area di lavoro e lavorano indipendentemente con la supervisione generale. Il Senior Accountant fornisce supporto al team finanziario in vari compiti e responsabilità. È responsabile della gestione della contabilità dell'intero processo Record to Report (RTR) all'interno delle società del Gruppo in Francia, garantendo l'accuratezza dei dati e la conformità agli standard contabili e alle regole interne di Sulzer. Inoltre, supporta i processi contabili generali nelle aree di "Procurement to Pay" (PTP) e "Order to Cash" (OTC), se necessario.

Partecipazione alla chiusura del periodo, compresa la chiusura del registro generale ausiliario dei conti crediti e dei fornitori e la riconciliazione con il registro generale
Superare i processi della fine del mese e della fine dell'anno; partecipare alla preparazione delle entrate contabili, alla riconciliazione dei bilanci e all'analisi delle differenze
Preparare dichiarazioni finanziarie accurate e tempestive, inclusi conti di profitto e perdita, bilanci e tabelle di flusso di cassa
Partecipa all'iscrizione contabile delle fatture senza ordine di acquisto
Assistere il team dei servizi finanziari condivisi nelle attività di gestione dei capitali
Lavorare a stretto contatto con il team di Reporting & Analytics per analizzare i dati finanziari e fornire informazioni sulle prestazioni finanziarie, identificare le tendenze e le variazioni per supportare le decisioni operative
Assicurare il coordinamento con altri servizi e gruppi finanziari condivisi per garantire che tutte le transazioni finanziarie siano debitamente contabilizzate e riflesse nel registro generale
Partecipa ai processi di bilancio e di previsione, fornendo competenze sugli aspetti finanziari e sulle proiezioni; lavorando a stretto contatto con l'ufficiale finanziario nazionale
Liaise con gli esperti fiscali per garantire l'accuratezza e la tempestività dei rendimenti fiscali e della conformità
Monitorare gli indicatori chiave di performance (KPI) per valutare l'efficacia dei processi contabili e implementare iniziative di miglioramento continuo
Contribuire al miglioramento continuo dei processi finanziari, utilizzando tecnologie e best practice; garantire il rispetto di politiche, procedure e modelli
Fornire report finanziari tempestivi e accurati a senior management e stakeholders
Assicurarsi che tutte le relazioni finanziarie e i processi conformi agli standard internazionali di reporting finanziario (IFRS) e ai regolamenti Sulzer
Liaise con i revisori e garantire che gli audit siano effettuati con modifiche minime
Assicurarsi che i controlli finanziari interni siano in vigore e rispettati per i processi in questa funzione
Assistere il contabile nazionale nella gestione delle richieste da parte di revisori interni ed esterni e garantire che il team contabile fornisce le informazioni necessarie

• Formazione ed esperienza
Laurea in finanza, contabilità, gestione aziendale o settori correlati
Almeno 5-7 anni di esperienza contabile, con una marcata specializzazione in contabilità generale e rendicontazione finanziaria in un ambiente industriale
descriptionByLocale.en:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and innovative development solutions that enable a successful and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Accounting Sr. Officer is responsible for supporting accounting operations including journal entries, reconciliations, and financial reporting. This role ensures compliance with accounting standards and supports audits and month-end close activities. This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. The Senior Accountant provides support to the financial team in various tasks and responsibilities. He is responsible for managing the accounting of the entire Record to Report (RTR) process within the Group's companies in France, ensuring the accuracy of the data and compliance with Sulzer's accounting standards and internal rules. In addition, it supports general accounting processes in the areas of "Procurement to Pay" (PTP) and "Order to Cash" (OTC), where necessary.

Participate in the closing of the period, including by closing the auxiliary general ledger of accounts receivable and suppliers and making the reconciliation with the general ledger
Oversee the end-of-month and end-of-year processes; participating in the preparation of accounting entries, balance sheet reconciliations and analysis of differences
Prepare accurate and timely financial statements, including profit and loss accounts, balance sheets and cash flow tables
Participate in accounting entry of invoices without purchase order
Assist the Shared Financial Services Team in Capital Management Activities
Work closely with the Reporting & Analytics team to analyze financial data and provide financial performance information, identify trends and variances to support operational decisions
Ensure coordination with other services and shared financial services teams to ensure that all financial transactions are properly accounted for and reflected in the general ledger
Participate in budgeting and forecasting processes, providing expertise on financial aspects and projections; working closely with the national financial officer
Liaise with tax experts to ensure accuracy and timeliness of tax returns and compliance
Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to assess the effectiveness of accounting processes and implement continuous improvement initiatives
Contribute to the continuous improvement of financial processes, using technologies and best practices; ensure compliance with policies, procedures and models
Provide timely and accurate financial reporting to senior management and stakeholders
Ensure that all financial reports and processes comply with International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) and Sulzer regulations
Liaise with auditors and ensure that audits are carried out with minimal adjustments
Ensure that internal financial controls are in place and respected for processes under this function
Assist the national accounting officer in the management of requests from internal and external auditors and ensure that the accounting team provides the required information

• Training and experience
University degree in finance, accounting, business management or related fields
At least 5-7 years of accounting experience, with a marked specialization in general accounting and financial reporting in an industrial environment
descriptionByLocale.de:
Sulzer ist ein führendes Ingenieurunternehmen mit einem stolzen Erbe an Innovationen. Schließen Sie sich unserem globalen Team an, um Ihre Expertise und innovativen Entwicklungslösungen zu erweitern, die eine erfolgreiche und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen.

Über die Rolle

Stellenbeschreibung
Der Accounting Sr. Officer ist verantwortlich für die Unterstützung von Buchhaltungsvorgängen, einschließlich Zeitschrifteneinträgen, Abstimmungen und Finanzberichterstattung. Diese Rolle stellt die Einhaltung der Rechnungslegungsstandards sicher und unterstützt Audits und Aktivitäten zum Monatsende. Dieses Jobprofil richtet sich an erfahrene Fachkräfte, die praktische Kenntnisse eines Jobbereichs anwenden und unabhängig mit allgemeiner Aufsicht arbeiten. Der Senior Accountant unterstützt das Finanzteam bei verschiedenen Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten. Er ist verantwortlich für die Verwaltung der Buchhaltung des gesamten Record-to-Report-Prozesses (RTR) innerhalb der Unternehmen der Gruppe in Frankreich, um die Genauigkeit der Daten und die Einhaltung der Rechnungslegungsstandards und internen Vorschriften von Sulzer zu gewährleisten. Darüber hinaus unterstützt sie bei Bedarf allgemeine Buchhaltungsprozesse in den Bereichen „Procurement to Pay“ (PTP) und „Order to Cash“ (OTC).

Beteiligen Sie sich am Abschluss der Periode, einschließlich durch Schließen des zusätzlichen Hauptbuchs der Forderungen und Lieferanten und Abgleich mit dem Hauptbuch
Überwachung der Prozesse zum Ende des Monats und zum Ende des Jahres; Teilnahme an der Erstellung von Buchungseinträgen, Bilanzabstimmungen und Analyse von Differenzen
Erstellen Sie genaue und zeitnahe Abschlüsse, einschließlich Gewinn- und Verlustrechnungen, Bilanzen und Cashflow-Tabellen
Beteiligen Sie sich an der buchmäßigen Erfassung von Rechnungen ohne Bestellung
Unterstützen Sie das Shared Financial Services Team bei Capital Management-Aktivitäten
Arbeiten Sie eng mit dem Reporting & Analytics-Team zusammen, um Finanzdaten zu analysieren und finanzielle Performance-Informationen bereitzustellen, Trends und Abweichungen zu identifizieren, um operative Entscheidungen zu unterstützen
Gewährleistung der Koordination mit anderen Diensten und geteilten Finanzdienstleistungsteams, um sicherzustellen, dass alle Finanztransaktionen ordnungsgemäß verbucht und im Hauptbuch ausgewiesen werden
Teilnahme an Budgetierungs- und Prognoseprozessen, Bereitstellung von Fachwissen zu finanziellen Aspekten und Projektionen; enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem nationalen Finanzbeamten
Kontakt mit Steuerexperten, um die Genauigkeit und Aktualität der Steuererklärungen und die Compliance sicherzustellen
Überwachung von Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), um die Effektivität von Buchhaltungsprozessen zu bewerten und Initiativen zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung umzusetzen
Beitrag zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung der Finanzprozesse unter Einsatz von Technologien und bewährten Verfahren; Gewährleistung der Einhaltung von Richtlinien, Verfahren und Modellen
Bereitstellung einer zeitnahen und genauen Finanzberichterstattung für die Geschäftsleitung und die Stakeholder
Stellen Sie sicher, dass alle Finanzberichte und -prozesse den International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) und den Sulzer-Vorschriften entsprechen
Kontaktaufnahme mit Auditoren und Gewährleistung, dass Audits mit minimalen Anpassungen durchgeführt werden
Gewährleistung, dass interne Finanzkontrollen für Prozesse im Rahmen dieser Funktion vorhanden sind und eingehalten werden
Unterstützung des nationalen Rechnungsführers bei der Bearbeitung von Anträgen interner und externer Rechnungsprüfer und Gewährleistung, dass das Rechnungsführungsteam die erforderlichen Informationen bereitstellt

• Ausbildung und Erfahrung
Universitätsabschluss in Finanzen, Rechnungswesen, Betriebswirtschaft oder verwandten Bereichen
Mindestens 5-7 Jahre Buchhaltungserfahrung, mit einer ausgeprägten Spezialisierung auf allgemeine Buchhaltung und Finanzberichterstattung in einem industriellen Umfeld

Le principali responsabilità:

• Servire come membro del team RTR nel CoE, fornendo supporto su argomenti ad hoc e questioni contabili

• Sostegno alle attività di prenotazione finanziaria, garanzia di accuratezza e conformità alle normative internazionali di reporting finanziario (IFRS) e Sulzer

• Gestire la compensazione, comprese le conciliazioni e le regolazioni, per mantenere registri finanziari accurati

• Utilizzare la conoscenza avanzata dei sistemi ERP per semplificare i processi contabili

• Supporta il Global Process Owner (GPO) con implementazioni di sistema

• Mantenere e aggiornare il grafico dei conti e delle gerarchie, assicurando che riflette la struttura aziendale attuale e i requisiti di reporting

• Collabora a stretto contatto con i team di finanza locali nei paesi e i team di servizi condivisi di finanza / fornitore di Business Process Outsourcing (BPO)

• Coordinare con gli altri dipartimenti e i team dei Servizi Condizionati di Finanza per garantire che tutte le transazioni finanziarie siano debitamente contabilizzate e riflesse nel registro generale

• Sostiene il termine chiuso, compresa la chiusura dei conti crediti/pagabili sommergibile e riconciliarsi con il registro generale; chiudere il registro generale, aprire nuovo periodo finanziario, chiudere Asset Accounting (AA)

• Sostegno alla preparazione delle voci della rivista, alla riconciliazione del bilancio e all'analisi della varianza

• Contribuire al miglioramento continuo del processo RTR, sfruttando la tecnologia e le migliori pratiche; mantenere politiche, procedure e modelli

• Assicurarsi che i controlli interni finanziari siano in vigore e seguiti per i processi svolti da questo ruolo

• Fare tutte le attività di chiusura dell'Anno tecnico come l'equilibrio portare avanti, le creazioni della gamma di numeri, chiusura di AA

• Sostenere il processo di riconciliazione intercompany in Coprocess e Tagetik (fisso varianze)

È necessario avere successo:

• Laurea in finanza, contabilità, amministrazione aziendale o campo relativo

• Minimo 2-3 anni di esperienza in Contabilità con una forte attenzione al registro generale e alla rendicontazione finanziaria

• CPA, ACCA, CMA o certificazione equivalente

• Forte capacità analitiche, di problem solving e di gestione

• Ottima attenzione ai dettagli e all'impegno per l'accuratezza e l'integrità nel reporting finanziario

• Capacità comprovata di gestire più priorità in un ambiente a scadenza

• Forte capacità di comunicazione per fornire informazioni chiave alla leadership senior

• Proficiente nei sistemi ERP (rilevante all'unità aziendale; SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365 o iScala) e software di contabilità

• Forte MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint) competenze

• Esperienza con Tagetik, Coprocess e Qlik Sense è un plus

• Competenza in inglese e francese

Cosa ti offriamo

• Un contratto permanente.

• Uno stipendio competitivo e la partecipazione al sistema di remunerazione variabile basato su obiettivi personali e finanziari.

• Biglietti del ristorante.

• Fai parte di un team esperto e internazionale.

• Una buona atmosfera ambiente di lavoro.

• Godetevi ottimi servizi di ufficio e una posizione perfetta a Madrid Nuevos Ministerios, rendendo la vostra esperienza di lavoro sia confortevole e conveniente.

• Altri benefici.

Sulzer ist ein führendes Ingenieurunternehmen mit einem stolzen Erbe an Innovationen. Schließen Sie sich unserem globalen Team an, um Ihr Fachwissen zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine prosperierende und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen.

Über die Rolle

Wir suchen nach einem RTR-Buchhalter, der sich unserem Accounting-Team in Spanien anschließt, um unseren Record to Report (RTR) -Bereich auf die nächste Ebene zu bringen. Als Buchhalter arbeiten Sie mit mehreren Ländern zusammen und engagieren sich in einer Vielzahl von Bereichen, darunter Buchhaltung, Reporting, Analytics, Country Finance Heads, Global Process Owners (GPOs) und externe Parteien wie Wirtschaftsprüfer und Steuerbehörden. Wichtigste Zuständigkeiten:

• Als Mitglied des RTR-Teams im CoE unterstützen Sie Ad-hoc-Themen und Buchhaltungsfragen

• Unterstützung bei Finanzbuchungsaktivitäten, Gewährleistung der Genauigkeit und Einhaltung der International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) und der Sulzer-Vorschriften

• Verwalten Sie das Clearing, einschließlich Abstimmungen und Anpassungen, um genaue Finanzunterlagen zu führen

• Nutzen Sie fortgeschrittenes Wissen über ERP-Systeme, um Buchhaltungsprozesse zu optimieren

• Unterstützen Sie den Global Process Owner (GPO) bei Systemimplementierungen

• Pflegen und aktualisieren Sie den Kontenplan und die Hierarchien, um sicherzustellen, dass er die aktuelle Geschäftsstruktur und die Berichtspflichten widerspiegelt

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit lokalen Finanzteams in Ländern und Finance Shared Services Teams / Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) Provider

• Unterstützt das Periodenende, einschließlich des Schließens des Debitoren- / Zahlungspflichtigen-Unterbuchs und des Abgleichs mit dem Hauptbuch; enges Hauptbuch, neue Finanzperiode eröffnen, schließen Asset Accounting (AA)

• Beitrag zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung des RTR-Prozesses, Nutzung von Technologie und Best Practices; Aufrechterhaltung von Richtlinien, Verfahren und Vorlagen

• Gewährleistung der internen Finanzkontrollen für die von dieser Rolle durchgeführten Prozesse

• Führen Sie alle technischen Aktivitäten zum Jahresende durch, z. B. Bilanzvortrag, Erstellung von Zahlenbereichen, Abschluss von AA

• Unterstützung des Intercompany-Abgleichsprozesses in Coprocess und Tagetik (Fix-Varianzen)

• Mindestens 2-3 Jahre Erfahrung im Rechnungswesen mit einem starken Fokus auf General Ledger und Finanzberichterstattung

• CPA, ACCA, CMA oder eine gleichwertige Zertifizierung bevorzugt

• Starke analytische, Problemlösungs- und Managementfähigkeiten

• Ausgezeichnete Liebe zum Detail und Verpflichtung zu Genauigkeit und Integrität in der Finanzberichterstattung

• Bewährte Fähigkeit, mehrere Prioritäten in einer terminabhängigen Umgebung zu verwalten

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable.

Sur le rôle

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un comptable RTR pour rejoindre notre équipe de comptabilité en Espagne pour nous aider à porter notre secteur Record to Report (RTR) au niveau suivant. En tant que comptable, vous collaborerez avec de nombreux pays et vous engagerez avec divers intervenants dans divers domaines, notamment la comptabilité, les rapports, l'analyse, les chefs des finances par pays, les propriétaires de processus mondiaux (OPG) et les parties externes telles que les vérificateurs et les autorités fiscales. Responsabilités clés :

• Servir en tant que membre de l'équipe RTR au sein du Conseil de l'Europe, fournir un appui sur des sujets spéciaux et des questions comptables

• Appui aux activités de réservation financière, en veillant à l'exactitude et au respect des normes internationales d'information financière (IFRS) et des règlements Sulzer

• Gérer la compensation, y compris les rapprochements et les ajustements, pour tenir des dossiers financiers exacts

• Utiliser les connaissances avancées des systèmes PGI pour rationaliser les processus comptables

• Soutenir le propriétaire du processus mondial (GPO) avec les implémentations du système

• Maintenir et mettre à jour le plan comptable et les hiérarchies, en veillant à ce qu'il reflète la structure opérationnelle actuelle et les exigences en matière de rapports.

• Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes des finances locales dans les pays et les équipes des services partagés des finances / fournisseur d'externalisation des processus d'affaires

• Coordonner avec les autres ministères et les équipes des Services partagés des finances pour s'assurer que toutes les opérations financières sont dûment comptabilisées et reflétées dans le grand livre

• Appuie la clôture de l'exercice, y compris la clôture des comptes débiteurs/sous-registres à payer et le rapprochement avec le grand livre général;

• Appui à la préparation des entrées de journaux, rapprochements des bilans et analyse des écarts

• Contribuer à l'amélioration continue du processus de RTR, en tirant parti de la technologie et des pratiques exemplaires; maintenir les politiques, les procédures et les modèles

• S'assurer que des contrôles internes financiers sont en place et suivis pour les processus exécutés par ce rôle

• Faire toutes les activités techniques de clôture de fin d'année telles que le report de l'équilibre, les créations de gamme de nombres, la fermeture de l'AA

• Soutien au processus de rapprochement interentreprises dans Coprocess et Tagetik (variations fixes)

Vous devez réussir :

• Diplôme universitaire en finance, comptabilité, administration des affaires ou domaine connexe

• Minimum de 2 à 3 ans d'expérience en comptabilité, l'accent étant mis sur le grand livre et l'information financière

• CPA, ACCA, CMA ou certification équivalente préférée

• Fortes compétences en analyse, résolution de problèmes et gestion

• Excellente attention aux détails et à l'engagement en faveur de l'exactitude et de l'intégrité des rapports financiers

• Capacité éprouvée de gérer de multiples priorités dans un environnement axé sur les échéances

• Capacités de communication solides pour fournir des renseignements clés aux cadres supérieurs

• Compétence en systèmes ERP (pertinents pour votre unité d'affaires; SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365 ou iScala) et logiciel de comptabilité

• Fortes compétences de MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint)

• Expérience avec Tagetik, Coprocess et Qlik Sense est un plus

• Compétence en anglais et en français

Ce que nous vous offrons

• Un contrat permanent.

• Un salaire compétitif ainsi que la participation au système de rémunération variable fondé sur des objectifs personnels et financiers.

• Billets de restaurant.

• Faites partie d'une équipe internationale expérimentée.

• Un bon environnement de travail.

• Profitez d'excellentes installations de bureau et d'un emplacement parfait à Madrid Nuevos Ministerios, rendant votre expérience de travail à la fois confortable et pratique.

• Autres avantages sociaux.

Les candidats internationaux sont invités à postuler. Pas de visa ou w

The Sales Manager is responsible for managing a team of sales representatives, setting sales goals, and ensuring the team meets performance targets. This role supports the execution of sales strategies and provides coaching and development to team members.

Train and mentor sales representatives.
Develop and implement sales plans and strategies.
Handle key customer accounts and resolve escalations.

Report sales performance to senior leadership.

Strong leadership and coaching skills.
Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities.
Proficiency in CRM systems and reporting tools.
