jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Are you an experienced Project Manager looking to join a global engineering leader where you'll play a critical role in delivering complex projects across some of the world's most important industries? At Sulzer, we're specialists in fluid engineering, helping customers maximise the reliability, performance and efficiency of their operations. With annual sales exceeding CHF 3.6 billion, approximately 13,000 employees worldwide and a strong global reputation for innovation and excellence, Sulzer offers the opportunity to build a rewarding career within a business that keeps critical industries moving.

Based at our Birmingham Service Centre, you'll work from one of the most advanced facilities of its kind in the UK. Opened in 2021 following a major investment, this 82,000 sq. ft purpose-built Centre of Excellence has been designed around lean manufacturing principles and is equipped with cutting-edge digital technologies, advanced machining capabilities and state-of-the-art additive manufacturing. Operating 24/7, the site delivers world-class maintenance, repair and overhaul solutions for pumps, motors, generators, compressors, turbines and other critical rotating equipment across all industries. If you're looking to make a real impact in a fast-paced environment where engineering expertise, innovation and customer focus come together, Sulzer offers the platform to take your career to the next level. What You'll Be Doing

• Managing multiple engineering and service projects simultaneously from initiation through to completion.

• Acting as the primary point of contact for customers throughout the project lifecycle.

• Coordinating cross-functional teams including engineering, production, procurement and operations.

• Developing and maintaining project schedules, budgets and resource plans.

• Monitoring project performance, identifying risks and implementing mitigation plans.

• Ensuring projects are delivered in compliance with safety, quality and contractual requirements.

• Managing project reporting and providing regular updates to internal and external stakeholders.

What You'll Bring

• Proven experience in a Project Manager role within engineering, manufacturing, industrial services or a related technical environment.

• Strong project planning and organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.

• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.

• Experience managing project budgets, schedules and commercial performance.

• Ability to work effectively within a fast-paced operational environment.

• Strong problem-solving and decision-making capabilities.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office and project management tools.

• Project Management qualification (APM, PRINCE2, PMP or equivalent) – desirable, not essential.

• Experience within rotating equipment, maintenance, repair and overhaul (MRO), manufacturing or industrial engineering sectors.

What we offer you

• A competitive basic salary

• Annual personal bonus scheme based on company and personal performance

• Private Medical Insurance

• 33 days annual leave.

• Defined pension contributions.

• Access to Medicash helping you cover everyday health costs like dental optical and physiotherapy plus a range of wellbeing perks.

• Confidential support via Employee Assistance Programmes.

• Access to discounts on shopping entertainment lifestyle plus opportunity to apply for Costco membership.

• Discounted personal car leasing for you your family and friends.

• Long Service Awards celebrating your commitment.

• Continuous learning opportunities through Sulzer Learning Pathways.

• As a Silver Award holder of the MoD Defence Employer Recognition Scheme, we welcome and support veterans, reservists and Cadet Adult

Informazioni sul ruolo

Sei un Project Manager esperto che cerca di unirsi a un leader di ingegneria globale in cui si svolgerà un ruolo fondamentale nella fornitura di progetti complessi in alcune delle industrie più importanti del mondo? A Sulzer, siamo specialisti in ingegneria dei fluidi, aiutando i clienti a massimizzare l'affidabilità, le prestazioni e l'efficienza delle loro operazioni. Con vendite annuali superiori a 3,6 miliardi di franchi, circa 13.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo e una forte reputazione globale per l'innovazione e l'eccellenza, Sulzer offre l'opportunità di costruire una carriera gratificante all'interno di un business che mantiene le industrie critiche in movimento.

Con sede presso il nostro Birmingham Service Centre, lavorerai da una delle strutture più avanzate del suo genere nel Regno Unito. Inaugurato nel 2021 a seguito di un importante investimento, questo Centro di Eccellenza costruito appositamente da 82,000 sq. ft è stato progettato intorno ai principi di produzione magra ed è dotato di tecnologie digitali all'avanguardia, capacità di lavorazione avanzate e produzione additiva all'avanguardia. Funzionamento 24/7, il sito offre soluzioni di manutenzione, riparazione e revisione di livello mondiale per pompe, motori, generatori, compressori, turbine e altre apparecchiature di rotazione critiche in tutti i settori. Se stai cercando di fare un impatto reale in un ambiente veloce dove competenze ingegneristiche, innovazione e focus del cliente si uniscono, Sulzer offre la piattaforma per portare la tua carriera al livello successivo. Cosa farai

• Gestione simultanea di più progetti di ingegneria e di servizio dall'avvio al completamento.

• Agire come punto di contatto principale per i clienti durante il ciclo di vita del progetto.

• Coordinamento di team interfunzionali tra cui ingegneria, produzione, approvvigionamento e operazioni.

• Sviluppare e mantenere programmi di progetto, budget e piani di risorse.

• Monitoraggio delle prestazioni del progetto, identificazione dei rischi e attuazione dei piani di mitigazione.

• Garantire la consegna dei progetti nel rispetto dei requisiti di sicurezza, qualità e contrattuali.

• Gestire i report dei progetti e fornire aggiornamenti regolari agli stakeholder interni ed esterni.

Cosa porterai

• Esperienza dimostrata in un ruolo di Project Manager all'interno di ingegneria, produzione, servizi industriali o un ambiente tecnico correlato.

• Forte pianificazione del progetto e competenze organizzative con la capacità di gestire più priorità.

• Eccellente capacità di gestione e comunicazione degli stakeholder.

• Esperienza di gestione budget, orari e prestazioni commerciali.

• Capacità di lavorare efficacemente in un ambiente operativo veloce.

• Forte problem solving e capacità decisionali.

• La competenza in Microsoft Office e strumenti di gestione del progetto.

• Titolo di Project Management (APM, PRINCE2, PMP o equivalente) – auspicabile, non essenziale.

• Esperienza all'interno di attrezzature rotanti, manutenzione, riparazione e revisione (MRO), industria manifatturiera o ingegneria industriale.

Cosa ti offriamo

• Uno stipendio base competitivo

• Schema di bonus personale annuale basato sull'azienda e sulle prestazioni personali

• Assicurazione medica privata

• 33 giorni di congedo annuale.

• Contributi pensionistici definiti.

• L'accesso a Medicash ti aiuta a coprire i costi di salute di tutti i giorni come odontoiatria e fisioterapia, oltre a una gamma di vantaggi per il benessere.

• Sostegno confidenziale tramite i programmi di assistenza ai dipendenti.

• Accesso agli sconti sullo stile di vita dello shopping più l'opportunità di richiedere l'iscrizione a Costco.

• Auto personale a noleggio per voi la vostra famiglia e gli amici.

• Long Service Awards che celebra il vostro impegno.

• Opportunità di apprendimento continua attraverso Sulzer Learning Pathways.

• Come titolare del premio d'argento del programma di riconoscimento dei datori di lavoro MoD Defence, accogliamo e sosteniamo veterani, reservisti e Cadet Adult

Ouvert en 2021 à la suite d'un investissement important, ce Centre d'excellence de 82 000 pieds carrés a été conçu autour de principes de fabrication maigre et est équipé de technologies numériques de pointe, de capacités d'usinage avancées et de fabrication additive de pointe. En service 24h/24 et 7j/7, le site propose des solutions d'entretien, de réparation et de révision de calibre mondial pour les pompes, moteurs, générateurs, compresseurs, turbines et autres équipements rotatifs essentiels dans toutes les industries. Si vous cherchez à faire un impact réel dans un environnement rapide où l'expertise en ingénierie, l'innovation et la concentration client se réunissent, Sulzer offre la plateforme pour amener votre carrière au niveau supérieur. • Gérer les rapports sur les projets et fournir régulièrement des mises à jour aux intervenants internes et externes.

• Expérience dans les secteurs de l'équipement rotatif, de la maintenance, de la réparation et de la révision (MRO), de la fabrication ou de l'ingénierie industrielle.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Sulzer is a global leader in fluid engineering and rotating equipment services, with a proud history dating back to 1834. Through our Rotating Equipment Services division, we deliver world-class maintenance, repair, and upgrade solutions for critical turbomachinery, including steam turbines, industrial gas turbines, aeroderivatives, and large compressors. Our Services team specializes in ensuring the reliability and longevity of rotating equipment and turbomachinery assets for customers in oil & gas, power generation, and industrial sectors.

As a Field Service Engineer, you will be at the forefront of delivering these solutions. Working on rotating equipment across diverse client sites worldwide, you’ll ensure critical assets operate at peak performance. Location: Flexible – Can be based anywhere in the UK
Travel: Domestic and international travel, both onshore and offshore

Key Responsibilities

• Install, remove, repair, commission, and maintain rotating equipment onshore and offshore.

• Dismantle, inspect, and report on equipment condition using standard field service documentation.

• Compile detailed inspection and commissioning reports, liaising with internal teams and clients.

• Reassemble and test equipment following engineering best practices and OEM standards.

• Ensure compliance with client and company safety procedures at all times.

• Provide professional client interaction to minimize downtime and maintain strong relationships.

What We’re Looking For

• We’re seeking a time-served mechanical engineer with proven practical experience in the maintenance and overhaul of rotating equipment,

• Flexibility and willingness to travel, both domestically and internationally, including offshore assignments.

• Ability to work independently and as part of a team in challenging environments.

• Excellent problem-solving skills, with a proactive approach to troubleshooting and delivering solutions under pressure.

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills to liaise effectively with clients and internal teams.

What we offer you

• A competitive basic salary

• Company-wide bonus scheme

• Paid overtime opportunities

• Access to Medicash helping you cover everyday health costs like dental optical and physiotherapy plus a range of wellbeing perks.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Based at our Birmingham Service Centre, you'll work from one of the most advanced facilities of its kind in the UK. Opened in 2021 following a major investment, this 82,000 sq. ft purpose-built Centre of Excellence has been designed around lean manufacturing principles and is equipped with cutting-edge digital technologies, advanced machining capabilities and state-of-the-art additive manufacturing.

Operating 24/7, the site delivers world-class maintenance, repair and overhaul solutions for pumps, motors, generators, compressors, turbines and other critical rotating equipment across a wide range of industries.

Due to continued growth, we're looking for a skilled Winder/Fitter to join our team. As a Winder/Fitter, you will play a key role in the repair, refurbishment, manufacture and assembly of electrical rotating equipment and components, ensuring all work is completed safely, efficiently and to the highest quality standards.

Key responsibilities include:

• Carrying out winding, fitting and assembly activities on a range of electrical equipment.

• Manufacturing and installing coils and windings to specification.

• Stripping, inspecting and rebuilding motors, generators and associated equipment.

• Reading and interpreting engineering drawings and technical documentation.

• Supporting electrical and mechanical testing activities.

• Identifying faults and assisting with repair solutions.

• Maintaining high levels of quality, housekeeping and safety within the workshop.

• Supporting continuous improvement initiatives and best practice across the business.
What We're Looking For

• Previous experience in an engineering, fitting, manufacturing or repair environment.

• Strong mechanical aptitude and practical problem-solving skills.

• Ability to interpret engineering drawings and technical instructions.

• Attention to detail with a commitment to delivering high-quality work.

• A positive attitude and willingness to work as part of a team.

• Wire winding experience would be a distinct advantage.

• Experience working on motors, generators or other rotating equipment.

• Coil manufacturing or rewind experience.

• Electrical testing knowledge and experience.

• Engineering apprenticeship or equivalent technical qualification.

What we offer you

• A competitive basic salary

• Company-wide bonus scheme

• Paid overtime opportunities

• Defined pension contributions.

• Access to Medicash helping you cover everyday health costs like dental optical and physiotherapy plus a range of wellbeing perks.

jobs.title: Inside Sales Support (Aftermarket)
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The Inside Sales (Aftermarket) Support will be responsible for supporting FRC Wastewater treatment systems after they have been commissioned for operation. You will be responsible for proactively reaching out to customers to ensure they have a stock of spare parts. You will assist customers with ordering spare parts and answering questions about performance or technical issues.
Essential Functions: (80%)

• Call customers with FRC equipment to assist them with ordering spare parts.

• Assemble detailed project specific spare parts list, provide to Project Manager.

• Respond to customer questions regarding spare parts and upgrades.

• Function as entry point for questions from customers and sales representatives regarding technical and performance questions for installations provided by FRC.

• Follow up to confirm customer questions have been answered.

• When required, forward questions to the right person within organization and ensure adherence to FRC's 24-hour response philosophy.

• Maintain positive relationships with customers, FRC representatives, consultants, engineers and managers through responsive, effective and honest communications.

• Proactive communication with customers about the need for and functionality of spare parts, (Discontinued items, Upgrades, etc.)

• Contact vendors for specific project/non-standard part quotes.

• Generate Spare parts quotes for customers.

• Calculate the mark-up of the spare parts, based on the margin schedule.

• Create and Process sales Orders on Purchase orders received for Spare Parts.

• Organize / Process customer's order shipment details.

Secondary Functions: (20%)

• Capture and maintain detailed notes related to customer contacts, conversations about spares, warranty issues, and upgrades.

• Prepare a monthly report providing a structured overview of all documented notes and communications concerning spares, warranty matters, and system upgrades.

• Coordinate with QA/Logistics manager and Project Manager(s) to resolve warranty complaints.

Qualifications:

• 2-year technical diploma or degree

• or

• Minimum of 2 years of work experience in a related industrial field (mechanical/manufacturing)

• Preferable experience with shipping

Key Skills, Knowledge and Competencies:

• Proficient computer skills: Microsoft Office, knowledge of an inventory / bookkeeping program, and online freight management (i.e., UPS, FedEx).

• A strong customer focus is essential, working with both internal and external customers.

• Fluent English skills verbally and written.

• Mechanical aptitude.

• Preferable basic mechanical and/or electrical knowledge.

• Highly self-motivated

• Good organizational and time management skills.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to listen and understand others.

• Team player with strong interpersonal skills with the ability to foster strong working relationships.

• Ability to work independently and follow through on work assignments with minimal direction.

• Detail oriented.

• Positive attitude towards change and growth

• Has cultural flexibility. Is capable to deal with the different corporate cultures and cultures of production plants of FRC's clients.

• Is allowed to legally work in the U.S.

Environmental, safety & health requirements:

• Complies with QESH policy

• Complies and participates with SBP (Safety Behavior Program)

• Performs its functions following and understanding the Job Safety Analysis (JSA), is aware of the workplace hazards

• Avoids and reports unsafe behaviors and unsafe conditions

• Uses and maintains personal protective equipment

• Reports accidents and near accidents

• Complies with environmental and safety rules, policies, work instructions, manuals, etc.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer è una società leader nel settore dell'ingegneria con un orgoglioso patrimonio di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile.

Sul ruolo

Il supporto vendite interne (aftermarket) sarà responsabile del supporto dei sistemi di trattamento delle acque reflue FRC dopo che sono stati messi in funzione. Sarai responsabile di contattare in modo proattivo i clienti per assicurarti che abbiano uno stock di pezzi di ricambio. Aiuterai i clienti a ordinare pezzi di ricambio e a rispondere a domande su prestazioni o problemi tecnici.
Funzioni essenziali: (80%)

• Chiamare i clienti con apparecchiature FRC per assisterli nell'ordinazione dei pezzi di ricambio.

• Assemblare un elenco dettagliato delle parti di ricambio specifiche del progetto, da fornire al Project Manager.

• Rispondere alle domande dei clienti riguardanti pezzi di ricambio e aggiornamenti.

• Fungere da punto di ingresso per le domande dei clienti e dei rappresentanti di vendita riguardanti questioni tecniche e prestazionali per gli impianti forniti da FRC.

• Follow-up per confermare che alle domande dei clienti sia stata data risposta.

• Quando richiesto, inoltrare le domande alla persona giusta all'interno dell'organizzazione e garantire il rispetto della filosofia di risposta 24 ore su 24 di FRC.

• Mantenere rapporti positivi con clienti, rappresentanti FRC, consulenti, ingegneri e manager attraverso comunicazioni reattive, efficaci e oneste.

• Comunicazione proattiva con i clienti sulla necessità e sulla funzionalità dei pezzi di ricambio (articoli fuori produzione, aggiornamenti, ecc.)

• Contattare i fornitori per preventivi di progetti specifici/parti non standard.

• Generare preventivi di pezzi di ricambio per i clienti.

• Calcolare il ricarico dei pezzi di ricambio, in base al programma dei margini.

• Creare ed elaborare ordini di vendita su ordini di acquisto ricevuti per pezzi di ricambio.

• Organizzare/elaborare i dettagli della spedizione dell'ordine del cliente.

Funzioni secondarie: (20%)

• Acquisire e conservare note dettagliate relative ai contatti dei clienti, alle conversazioni sui ricambi, ai problemi di garanzia e agli aggiornamenti.

• Preparare un rapporto mensile che fornisca una panoramica strutturata di tutte le note e le comunicazioni documentate relative a ricambi, questioni di garanzia e aggiornamenti del sistema.

• Coordinarsi con il responsabile QA/Logistica e con i Project Manager per risolvere i reclami di garanzia.

Qualifiche:

• Diploma o laurea tecnica di durata biennale

• o

• Minimo 2 anni di esperienza lavorativa in un settore industriale correlato (meccanico/manifatturiero)

• Preferibile esperienza con spedizioni

Abilità, conoscenze e competenze chiave:

• Competenze informatiche avanzate: Microsoft Office, conoscenza di un programma di inventario/contabilità e gestione del trasporto online (ad esempio UPS, FedEx).

• Una forte attenzione al cliente è essenziale, lavorando sia con clienti interni che esterni.

• Conoscenza fluente dell'inglese verbale e scritto.

• Attitudine meccanica.

• Preferibili conoscenze meccaniche e/o elettriche di base.

• Altamente motivato

• Buone capacità organizzative e di gestione del tempo.

• Eccellenti capacità di comunicazione scritta e verbale con capacità di ascoltare e comprendere gli altri.

• Giocatore di squadra con forti capacità interpersonali con la capacità di promuovere forti rapporti di lavoro.

• Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e di portare a termine gli incarichi di lavoro con una direzione minima.

• Orientato ai dettagli.

• Atteggiamento positivo verso il cambiamento e la crescita

• Ha flessibilità culturale. È in grado di confrontarsi con le diverse culture aziendali e delle culture degli stabilimenti produttivi dei clienti FRC.

• È autorizzato a lavorare legalmente negli Stati Uniti.

Requisiti ambientali, di sicurezza e di salute:

• Conforme alla politica QESH

• Rispetta e partecipa al SBP (Programma di comportamento di sicurezza)

• Svolge le proprie funzioni seguendo e comprendendo la Job Safety Analysis (JSA), è consapevole dei pericoli presenti sul luogo di lavoro

• Evita e segnala comportamenti e condizioni non sicuri

• Utilizza e mantiene i dispositivi di protezione individuale

• Segnala incidenti e quasi incidenti

• Rispetta le norme ambientali e di sicurezza, le politiche, le istruzioni di lavoro, i manuali, ecc.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Sulzer ist ein führendes Ingenieurunternehmen mit einer stolzen Tradition der Innovation. Werden Sie Teil unseres globalen Teams, um Ihr Fachwissen zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine wohlhabende und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen.

Über die Rolle

Der Inside Sales (Aftermarket) Support ist für die Betreuung der FRC-Abwasseraufbereitungssysteme nach deren Inbetriebnahme verantwortlich. Sie sind dafür verantwortlich, proaktiv auf die Kunden zuzugehen, um sicherzustellen, dass diese über einen Ersatzteilbestand verfügen. Sie unterstützen Kunden bei der Bestellung von Ersatzteilen und beantworten Fragen zur Leistung oder zu technischen Problemen.
Wesentliche Funktionen: (80 %)

• Rufen Sie Kunden mit FRC-Geräten an, um ihnen bei der Bestellung von Ersatzteilen behilflich zu sein.

• Erstellen Sie eine detaillierte projektspezifische Ersatzteilliste und stellen Sie sie dem Projektmanager zur Verfügung.

• Beantwortung von Kundenfragen zu Ersatzteilen und Upgrades.

• Funktion als Anlaufstelle für Fragen von Kunden und Vertriebsmitarbeitern zu technischen und Leistungsfragen für von FRC bereitgestellte Installationen.

• Nachfassen, um zu bestätigen, dass Kundenfragen beantwortet wurden.

• Leiten Sie Fragen bei Bedarf an die richtige Person innerhalb der Organisation weiter und stellen Sie sicher, dass die 24-Stunden-Antwortphilosophie von FRC eingehalten wird.

• Pflegen Sie positive Beziehungen zu Kunden, FRC-Vertretern, Beratern, Ingenieuren und Managern durch reaktionsschnelle, effektive und ehrliche Kommunikation.

• Proaktive Kommunikation mit Kunden über den Bedarf und die Funktionalität von Ersatzteilen (Auslaufartikel, Upgrades usw.)

• Kontaktieren Sie Anbieter für spezifische Projekt-/Nicht-Standard-Teileangebote.

• Generieren Sie Ersatzteilangebote für Kunden.

• Berechnen Sie den Aufschlag der Ersatzteile auf der Grundlage des Margenplans.

• Erstellen und Verarbeiten von Verkaufsaufträgen für eingegangene Bestellungen für Ersatzteile.

• Organisation/Verarbeitung der Versanddetails der Kundenbestellung.

Sekundäre Funktionen: (20 %)

• Erfassen und pflegen Sie detaillierte Notizen zu Kundenkontakten, Gesprächen über Ersatzteile, Garantieprobleme und Upgrades.

• Erstellen Sie einen monatlichen Bericht, der einen strukturierten Überblick über alle dokumentierten Notizen und Mitteilungen zu Ersatzteilen, Garantieangelegenheiten und System-Upgrades bietet.

• Koordinieren Sie die Lösung von Garantiebeschwerden mit dem QA-/Logistikmanager und den Projektmanagern.

Qualifikationen:

• 2-jähriges technisches Diplom oder Studium

• oder

• Mindestens 2 Jahre Berufserfahrung in einem verwandten Industriebereich (Maschinenbau/Fertigung)

• Vorzugsweise Erfahrung im Versand

Schlüsselqualifikationen, Kenntnisse und Kompetenzen:

• Gute Computerkenntnisse: Microsoft Office, Kenntnisse eines Inventar-/Buchhaltungsprogramms und Online-Frachtmanagement (z. B. UPS, FedEx).

• Eine starke Kundenorientierung ist bei der Zusammenarbeit mit internen und externen Kunden unerlässlich.

• Fließende Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

• Mechanische Begabung.

• Vorzugsweise grundlegende mechanische und/oder elektrische Kenntnisse.

• Hohe Eigenmotivation

• Gute Organisations- und Zeitmanagementfähigkeiten.

• Ausgezeichnete schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, anderen zuzuhören und sie zu verstehen.

• Teamplayer mit starken zwischenmenschlichen Fähigkeiten und der Fähigkeit, starke Arbeitsbeziehungen aufzubauen.

• Fähigkeit, unabhängig zu arbeiten und Arbeitsaufgaben mit minimaler Anleitung zu erledigen.

• Detailorientiert.

• Positive Einstellung gegenüber Veränderung und Wachstum

• Verfügt über kulturelle Flexibilität. Ist in der Lage, mit den unterschiedlichen Unternehmenskulturen und Produktionsstättenkulturen der FRC-Kunden umzugehen.

• Darf legal in den USA arbeiten.

• Erfüllt SBP (Safety Behavior Program) und nimmt daran teil.

• Führt seine Aufgaben unter Einhaltung und Verständnis der Arbeitssicherheitsanalyse (JSA) aus und ist sich der Gefahren am Arbeitsplatz bewusst

• Vermeidet und meldet unsichere Verhaltensweisen und unsichere Bedingungen

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Sulzer est une société d'ingénierie leader avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable.

À propos du rôle

Le support des ventes internes (après-vente) sera chargé de soutenir les systèmes de traitement des eaux usées FRC après leur mise en service. Vous serez responsable de contacter de manière proactive les clients pour vous assurer qu'ils disposent d'un stock de pièces de rechange. Vous aiderez les clients à commander des pièces de rechange et à répondre aux questions sur les performances ou les problèmes techniques.
Fonctions essentielles : (80%)

• Appeler les clients possédant un équipement FRC pour les aider à commander des pièces de rechange.

• Assembler une liste détaillée des pièces de rechange spécifiques au projet et la fournir au chef de projet.

• Répondre aux questions des clients concernant les pièces de rechange et les mises à niveau.

• Fonctionner comme point d'entrée pour les questions des clients et des représentants commerciaux concernant les questions techniques et de performances pour les installations fournies par FRC.

• Effectuer un suivi pour confirmer que les questions des clients ont reçu une réponse.

• Si nécessaire, transmettre les questions à la bonne personne au sein de l'organisation et garantir le respect de la philosophie de réponse 24 heures sur 24 de FRC.

• Entretenir des relations positives avec les clients, les représentants FRC, les consultants, les ingénieurs et les gestionnaires grâce à des communications réactives, efficaces et honnêtes.

• Communication proactive avec les clients sur le besoin et la fonctionnalité des pièces de rechange (articles abandonnés, mises à niveau, etc.)

• Contacter les fournisseurs pour des devis de projets spécifiques/pièces non standard.

• Générer des devis de pièces de rechange pour les clients.

• Calculer la majoration des pièces de rechange, en fonction du barème de marge.

• Créer et traiter les commandes de vente sur les bons de commande reçus pour les pièces de rechange.

• Organiser / Traiter les détails d'expédition des commandes du client.

Fonctions secondaires : (20%)

• Capturez et conservez des notes détaillées relatives aux contacts clients, aux conversations sur les pièces de rechange, aux problèmes de garantie et aux mises à niveau.

• Préparer un rapport mensuel fournissant un aperçu structuré de toutes les notes et communications documentées concernant les pièces de rechange, les questions de garantie et les mises à niveau du système.

• Coordonner avec le responsable de l'assurance qualité/logistique et le(s) chef(s) de projet pour résoudre les plaintes au titre de la garantie.

Qualités :

• Diplôme ou diplôme technique de 2 ans

• ou

• Minimum de 2 ans d'expérience de travail dans un domaine industriel connexe (mécanique/fabrication)

• Expérience préférable en matière d'expédition

Compétences, connaissances et compétences clés :

• Compétences informatiques maîtrisées : Microsoft Office, connaissance d'un programme d'inventaire/de tenue de livres et de gestion du fret en ligne (c'est-à-dire UPS, FedEx).

• Une forte orientation client est essentielle, en travaillant avec des clients internes et externes.

• Maîtrise de l'anglais verbalement et par écrit.

• Aptitude mécanique.

• Connaissances de base préférables en mécanique et/ou en électricité.

• Très motivé

• Bonnes compétences organisationnelles et de gestion du temps.

• Excellentes compétences en communication écrite et verbale avec la capacité d'écouter et de comprendre les autres.

• Esprit d'équipe doté de solides compétences interpersonnelles et de la capacité d'entretenir de solides relations de travail.

• Capacité à travailler de manière indépendante et à mener à bien ses tâches avec un minimum de directives.

• Souci du détail.

• Attitude positive envers le changement et la croissance

• A une flexibilité culturelle. Est capable de gérer les différentes cultures d'entreprise et les cultures des usines de production des clients de FRC.

• Est autorisé à travailler légalement aux États-Unis.

Exigences environnementales, de sécurité et de santé :

• Conforme à la politique QESH

• Se conforme et participe au SBP (Safety Behavior Program)

• Exerce ses fonctions en suivant et en comprenant l'analyse de la sécurité du travail (JSA), est conscient des dangers sur le lieu de travail.

• Évite et signale les comportements dangereux et les conditions dangereuses

• Utilise et entretient l'équipement de protection individuelle

• Signale les accidents et les quasi-accidents

• Se conforme aux règles, politiques, instructions de travail, manuels, etc. en matière d'environnement et de sécurité.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
Responsible for provision of technical support to customer, sales & operations in the form of detailed Engineering analysis and design, feasibility study and solutions offering to support growth of repairs, spares, upgrades and retrofits of Centrifugal Compressors and Expanders. Main tasks and responsibilities

• Act as a subject matter expert and manage engineering requests associated to tendering and project execution for Turbo-machinery Services in the region.

• Conduct site equipment inspection, root cause analysis and technical forums to support sales team to identify repairs, upgrades and retrofit opportunities

• Challenge traditional Sulzer thinking to ensure we remain ahead of the competition without taking excessive risk

• Review Technical specifications, provide comments/exceptions, input Technical know-how as required to ensure proposals are technically fit for purpose

• Identify and document areas of technical risk and level of design review associated with Projects at an early Tender stage

• Liaise with oversea Sulzer competence centers, specialist functions (e.g. Aero, welding, rotor-dynamic, C&I, etc) and key sub-contractors to clarify client requirements and ensure technical aspects have been adequately addressed

• Consolidate technical offer and associated technical documentation (e.g. data sheets, calculations, technical bid assessment questionnaires) as necessary to satisfy client's Tender requirements

• Provide an Engineering presence, when required, on customer visits, for assessment, bid clarification, client kick off meetings, project execution etc

• Lead and coordinate the different engineering resources associated to the project for the execution on-time and on budget

• Review ITP, inspection reports, and closing report to ensure upmost quality of the work and deliverables

• Develop guidelines, procedures and work instructions to support continuous improvement of quality of Compressor and Expander Services in Oceania

• Be part of the large Sulzer Services specialist and experts community and Support development of Turbine Services capabilities in the Asia region to support the business growth strategy

• All other duties as relevant to the post

Competencies and behaviour required (what strengths are needed)

• Customer service skills

• Communication skills

• Influencing and persuasion skills

• Time management skills

• Ability to act independently

• Attention to details

• Culture of Continuous improvement

• Flexibility and ability to adapt to different team, culture and environment

Qualifications/Experience Required

• Bachelor or Master in Mechanical Engineering

• 5 years minimum experience in service of Centrifugal Compressors and/or Expanders

• Experience in Oil &Gas, Fertilizers and Petrochemical industry

• Design and drafting skills

• General computer skills

• Analytical skills

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Sulzer’s Leeds facility is a global centre of excellence for advanced design and manufacturing, delivering OEM pump technology and engineered solutions for critical industries including energy, water, chemicals and infrastructure. Following significant recent investment, the site is rapidly evolving, strengthening capabilities in advanced machining, digital engineering, testing and innovation—and serves as an end-to-end hub where new pumps are brought to life from concept and design through to manufacture, testing, delivery and full lifecycle support..

We are now looking for a Factored Buyer to join our Supply Chain team and play a key role in ensuring the seamless procurement of externally manufactured components, assemblies and engineered products that support our customer commitments across the globe. What you'll be doing

• Managing the end-to-end procurement process for factored and engineered products.

• Raising and managing purchase orders in line with business requirements.

• Developing strong relationships with suppliers to ensure delivery, quality and cost expectations are achieved.

• Monitoring supplier performance and proactively resolving shortages, delays and supply chain risks.

• Negotiating pricing, lead times and commercial terms to deliver value to the business.

• Supporting supplier selection, qualification and development activities.

• Working closely with Production Planning to ensure material availability aligns with customer demand.

• Collaborating with Engineering teams on technical sourcing requirements and new product introductions.

• Supporting inventory optimisation and working capital improvement initiatives.

What we're looking for

• Previous experience in a Buyer, Factored Buyer, Procurement or Supply Chain role within manufacturing, engineering or an OEM environment.

• Proven ability to manage supplier relationships and negotiate effectively.

• Experience purchasing engineered components, fabricated products, castings, machined parts or technical equipment would be advantageous.

• Strong commercial awareness and analytical skills.

• Ability to prioritise workload and work effectively in a fast-paced environment.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

• Proficiency in ERP/MRP systems and Microsoft Office applications.

• CIPS qualification or working towards CIPS is desirable.

What we offer you

We’ve recently invested significantly in modernising our Leeds facility — creating a brighter, more efficient, and more advanced workspace designed to support high‑quality work and a great employee experience. Alongside our upgraded facilities, you’ll benefit from:

Core Benefits

• A competitive salary

• A company-wide bonus scheme

• Medicash Health Cash Plan (covering everyday healthcare expenses such as dental, optical and GP services)

• 33 days’ holiday

• Defined pension contribution

• Employee Assistance Programmes

• Discounts on shopping, entertainment & lifestyle

• Costco membership option

• Discounted personal car leasing for you, family & friends

• Long Service Awards

• Ongoing learning through Sulzer Learning Pathways

• Armed Forces Support – As a Silver Award holder of the MoD Defence Employer Recognition Scheme, we actively support veterans, reservists and Cadet Adult Volunteers. This includes policies that enable time for training, camps and deployment, alongside access to a growing internal military network.

Onsite Perks

• Free, secure parking with EV charging

• Multi-faith prayer room

• Newly modernised work areas

• Lively Sports & Social Club with events & prize draws

• 24/7 onsite gym

• Subsidised vending machines

• Subsidised Canteen offering hot and cold food

Working Pattern
This role is primarily site-base

The Heavy-Duty Gas Turbine FA will contribute to the management of site activities including planning, organizing, integrating and monitoring of resources such as labor, tools and technical assistants as required to complete the work scope according to contractual requirements. Will work within defined parameters to make decisions, apply concepts to issues of great complexity, and resolve issues through immediate action or short-term planning at customer power generating facilities. • Approva tutte le modifiche implementate.

• Conoscenza per la risoluzione dei problemi e la verifica della manutenzione ordinaria per un'ampia gamma di apparecchiature vintage

• Eseguire visite guidate durante l'installazione per garantire che gli appaltatori del cliente funzionino correttamente.

• Capacità e disponibilità a lavorare nei giorni festivi, nei fine settimana e negli straordinari come richiesto dagli incarichi sul campo

• Saranno necessari lunghi viaggi da e verso i progetti e vari incarichi sul campo

• Potrebbero essere assegnati altri compiti per contribuire a guidare in modo proattivo la nostra visione Sulzer e allinearci ai valori fondamentali della nostra organizzazione.

Competenze e comportamenti richiesti (quali punti di forza necessari?)

• Requisito: Min D3. Background ingegneristico: Meccanico.

• Possedere una conoscenza generale della manutenzione meccanica e generale delle turbine a gas per carichi pesanti. Familiarità con strumenti, utensili manuali e strumenti speciali.

• Familiarità con il disegno tecnico, i simboli e la legenda, il diagramma P&ID.

• Familiarità con il codice di sicurezza e la procedura per l'avvio e la messa in servizio

• Requisito comportamentale: orientamento al risultato, comunicazione per il risultato, lavoro di squadra, apprendimento attivo, consapevolezza aziendale, risoluzione dei problemi e pensiero analitico

Qualifiche/esperienza e conoscenze richieste

• Esperienza rilevante di almeno 15 anni di lavoro sull'interruzione di turbine a gas per carichi pesanti. Oppure proveniva dall'esperienza del cliente in una centrale elettrica

• Conoscenza della lingua inglese.

• Capacità di leggere e comprendere disegni e dati tecnici

• È preferibile aver lavorato in passato presso l'OEM

• Conoscenza approfondita del funzionamento e dei parametri di controllo delle turbine a gas.

• Forte competenza tecnica nella lettura e interpretazione dei diagrammi di flusso e degli strumenti elettrici/meccanici, del quadrante, dell'allineamento laser e delle apparecchiature per l'aumento termico

Cosa ti offriamo

Sulzer è un datore di lavoro che garantisce pari opportunità. Crediamo nella forza di una forza lavoro diversificata e ci impegniamo a offrire un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo.

Siamo orgogliosi di essere riconosciuti come Top Employer 2026 in Brasile, Canada, Cina, Finlandia, Germania, Irlanda, Messico, Svizzera, Sud Africa, Regno Unito e Stati Uniti.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Sulzer ist ein führendes Ingenieurunternehmen mit einer stolzen Tradition der Innovation. Werden Sie Teil unseres globalen Teams, um Ihr Fachwissen zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine wohlhabende und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen.

Über die Rolle

Der Schwerlast-Gasturbinen-FA wird zur Verwaltung der Standortaktivitäten beitragen, einschließlich der Planung, Organisation, Integration und Überwachung von Ressourcen wie Arbeitskräften, Werkzeugen und technischen Assistenten, soweit erforderlich, um den Arbeitsumfang gemäß den vertraglichen Anforderungen abzuschließen. Arbeitet innerhalb definierter Parameter, um Entscheidungen zu treffen, Konzepte auf sehr komplexe Probleme anzuwenden und Probleme durch sofortiges Handeln oder kurzfristige Planung in den Stromerzeugungsanlagen des Kunden zu lösen. Wird für die Installation und Wartung von Gasturbinen verantwortlich sein.
Hauptaufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten

• Verwaltung, Durchführung und Koordinierung des Managements der Standortaktivitäten für HD-Gasturbinen

• Führen Sie die Installation von Systemen und Geräten vor Ort sowie die laufende vorbeugende Wartung, Reparatur und Kalibrierung nach der Installation durch

• Reagieren Sie auf Anfragen nach Notfallreparaturen und -services für problematische Geräte

• Bereitstellung technischer Anweisungen und Unterstützung für Kundenvertreter in Bezug auf Installation, Betrieb, Kalibrierung, Reparatur und Wartung vor Ort beim Kunden

• Erledigen Sie administrative Aufgaben wie das Verfassen technischer Berichte, das Bestellen von Materialien, das Einholen von Angeboten, das Erstellen von Auftragsstatusberichten, Berichten an Kunden, Arbeitszeitnachweisen und Spesenabrechnungen, und zwar pünktlich und gründlich

• Signiert alle durchgeführten Änderungen.

• Kenntnisse zur Fehlerbehebung und zur Durchführung routinemäßiger Wartungsprüfungen für eine große Auswahl an Geräten aus dem Jahrgang

• Coachen, betreuen und schulen Sie andere Teammitglieder nach Bedarf, um Feldtechnik- und/oder Produktkenntnisse zu vermitteln und aufrechtzuerhalten.

• Erstellen Sie zeitnahe und genaue technische Berichte für Kundenunterlagen und als Referenz für zukünftige Ausfälle

• Stellen Sie sicher, dass alle für den Auftrag benötigten Teile an die Baustelle geliefert werden

• Führen Sie während der Installation Besichtigungen durch, um sicherzustellen, dass die Auftragnehmer des Kunden ordnungsgemäß arbeiten.

• Fähigkeit und Bereitschaft, Feiertage, Wochenenden und Überstunden zu leisten, wenn dies für die Einsätze vor Ort erforderlich ist

• Umfangreiche Reisen zu und von Projekten sowie verschiedene Einsätze vor Ort sind erforderlich

• Möglicherweise werden Ihnen andere Aufgaben zugewiesen, um unsere Sulzer-Vision proaktiv voranzutreiben und sie an den Grundwerten unserer Organisation auszurichten.

Erforderliche Kompetenzen und Verhaltensweisen (Welche Stärken werden benötigt?)

• Anforderung: Mindestens D3 technischer Hintergrund: Mechanik.

• Über allgemeine Kenntnisse der mechanischen und allgemeinen Wartung von Hochleistungsgasturbinen verfügen. Vertraut mit Werkzeugen, Handwerkzeugen und Spezialwerkzeugen.

• Vertraut mit technischen Zeichnungen, Symbolen und Legenden sowie P&ID-Diagrammen.

• Mit den Sicherheitsvorschriften und dem Verfahren zur Inbetriebnahme vertraut sein

• Verhaltensanforderung: Leistungsorientierung, Ergebniskommunikation, Teamarbeit, aktives Lernen, Geschäftsbewusstsein, Problemlösung und analytisches Denken

Qualifikationen/Erfahrung und Kenntnisse erforderlich

• Einschlägige Erfahrung von mindestens 15 Jahren in der Arbeit an der Störungsbeseitigung von Hochleistungsgasturbinen. Oder kam aus der Kraftwerkserfahrung eines Kunden

• Gute Englischkenntnisse.

• Fähigkeit, technische Zeichnungen und Daten zu lesen und zu verstehen

• Frühere Tätigkeiten im OEM-Bereich sind wünschenswert

• Solides Verständnis des Betriebs und der Steuerungsparameter von Gasturbinen.

• Starke technische Kompetenz im Lesen und Interpretieren von elektrischen/mechanischen Fluss- und Instrumentendiagrammen, Skalen- und Laserausrichtungs- und Wärmewachstumsgeräten

Was wir Ihnen bieten

Sulzer setzt sich als Arbeitgeber für Chancengleichheit ein. Wir glauben an die Stärke einer vielfältigen Belegschaft und setzen uns dafür ein, ein integratives Arbeitsumfeld zu bieten.

Wir sind stolz darauf, in Brasilien, Kanada, China, Finnland, Deutschland, Irland, Mexiko, der Schweiz, Südafrika, dem Vereinigten Königreich und den USA als Top-Arbeitgeber 2026 ausgezeichnet zu werden.

Sulzer est une société d'ingénierie leader avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable.

À propos du rôle

Le FA des turbines à gaz lourdes contribuera à la gestion des activités du site, y compris la planification, l'organisation, l'intégration et la surveillance des ressources telles que la main-d'œuvre, les outils et les assistants techniques, selon les besoins pour terminer la portée des travaux conformément aux exigences contractuelles. Travaillera selon des paramètres définis pour prendre des décisions, appliquer des concepts à des problèmes d'une grande complexité et résoudre les problèmes par une action immédiate ou une planification à court terme dans les installations de production d'électricité des clients. Sera responsable de l'installation et de l'entretien des turbines à gaz.
Principales tâches et responsabilités

• Gérer, réaliser, coordonner la gestion des activités du site HD Gas Turbine

• Effectuer l'installation sur site des systèmes et des équipements ainsi que la maintenance préventive, la réparation et l'étalonnage continus après l'installation.

• Répondre aux demandes de réparations et de services d'urgence sur les équipements problématiques

• Fournir des instructions techniques et une assistance aux représentants des clients concernant l'installation, le fonctionnement, l'étalonnage, la réparation et la maintenance sur les sites des clients.

• Effectuer des fonctions administratives telles que : rédiger des rapports techniques, commander du matériel, obtenir des devis, préparer des rapports sur l'état des travaux, des rapports aux clients, des feuilles de temps et des feuilles de dépenses en temps opportun et de manière approfondie.

• Approuve tous les changements mis en œuvre.

• Connaissances pour dépanner et effectuer un contrôle de maintenance de routine pour une large gamme d'équipements vintage

• Encadrer, encadrer et former les autres membres de l'équipe selon les besoins, pour transmettre et perpétuer les connaissances sur l'ingénierie de terrain et/ou les produits.

• Préparer des rapports techniques précis et en temps opportun pour les dossiers des clients et une référence pour les pannes futures.

• S'assurer que toutes les pièces nécessaires au travail sont expédiées sur le site

• Effectuer des visites guidées pendant l'installation pour s'assurer que les entrepreneurs du client travaillent correctement.

• Capacité et volonté de travailler les jours fériés, les week-ends et les heures supplémentaires, selon les exigences des missions sur le terrain.

• De nombreux déplacements vers et depuis les projets et diverses missions sur le terrain seront nécessaires.

• Peut se voir confier d'autres tâches pour aider à conduire de manière proactive notre vision Sulzer et à s'aligner sur les valeurs fondamentales de notre organisation.

Compétences et comportements requis (Quelles forces sont nécessaires ?)

• Exigence : Min D3 Formation en ingénierie : Mécanique.

• Posséder des connaissances générales en matière d'entretien mécanique et global des turbines à gaz à usage intensif. Familiarisé avec les outils, les outils à main et les outils spéciaux.

• Familier avec le dessin technique, les symboles et la légende, le diagramme P&ID.

• Familiarisé avec le code de sécurité et la procédure de démarrage et de mise en service

• Exigence comportementale : orientation vers la réussite, communication axée sur les résultats, travail d'équipe, apprentissage actif, conscience des affaires, résolution de problèmes et pensée analytique.

Qualifications/expérience et connaissances requises

• Expérience pertinente d'au moins 15 ans de travail sur des pannes de turbines à gaz lourdes. Ou provenait de l'expérience d'un client dans une centrale électrique

• Maîtrise de l'anglais.

• Capacité à lire et à comprendre des dessins et des données techniques

• Une expérience passée chez l'OEM est préférable

• Solide compréhension du fonctionnement et des paramètres de contrôle des turbines à gaz.

• Forte compétence technique dans la lecture et l'interprétation des flux électriques/mécaniques et des schémas d'instruments, de l'alignement des cadrans et des lasers et des équipements de croissance thermique.

Ce que nous vous proposons

Sulzer est un employeur garantissant l'égalité des chances. Nous croyons en la force d’une main-d’œuvre diversifiée et nous nous engageons à offrir un environnement de travail inclusif.

Nous sommes fiers d'être reconnus comme l'un des meilleurs employeurs 2026 au Brésil, au Canada, en Chine, en Finlande, en Allemagne, en Irlande, au Mexique, en Suisse, en Afrique du Sud, au Royaume-Uni et aux États-Unis.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The RTR Senior Accountant in the Center of Excellence (CoE) works in a RTR SWAT team assigned to multiple countries, supporting the Record to Report (RTR) teams for example with various ad hoc tasks, complex bookings, or the maintenance of the chart of accounts.
• Serve as a key member of the RTR SWAT team in the CoE , providing expert support on ad hoc topics and complex accounting issues

• Support with complicated financial booking activities, ensuring accuracy and compliance with International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) and Sulzer regulations

• Manage complex clearing, including reconciliations and adjustments, to maintain accurate financial records

• Utilize advanced knowledge of ERP systems to streamline accounting processes and improve efficiency

• Support the Global Process Owner (GPO) with the definition of RTR processes and system implementation

• Maintain and update the chart of accounts and hierarchies, ensuring it reflects the current business structure and reporting requirements

• Collaborate closely with local Finance Teams in countries and Finance Shared Services teams / Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) provider

• Coordinate with other departments and the Finance Shared Services teams to ensure all financial transactions are properly accounted for and reflected in the general ledger

• Support where required with the period end close, including closing the accounts receivable/payable subledger and reconcile with the general ledger; close general ledger, open new financial period, close Asset Accounting (AA)

• Support with the preparation of complex journal entries, balance sheet reconciliations and variance analysis

• Contribute to the continuous improvement of the RTR process, leveraging technology and best practices; maintain policies, procedures and templates

• Ensure financial internal controls are in place and followed for the processes performed by this role

• Do all technical Year End Closing activities such as balance carry forward, number range creations, close of AA

• Support Intercompany reconciliation process in Coprocess and Tagetik (fix variances)

Education and experience

• University degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration or related field

• Minimum of 3-4 years of experience in Accounting with a strong focus on general ledger and financial reporting

• CPA, ACCA, CMA or equivalent certification preferred

Critical success factors

• Strong analytical, problem-solving and management skills

• Excellent attention to detail and commitment to accuracy and integrity in financial reporting

• Proven ability to manage multiple priorities in a deadline-driven environment

• Strong communication skills for delivering key insights to senior leadership

Technical & language skills

• Proficient in ERP systems (relevant to your business unit; SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365 or iScala ) and accounting software

• Strong MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint) skills

• Experience with Tagetik, Coprocess and Qlik Sense is a plus

• Proficiency in English

What we offer you

• 12 days of vacation per year

• 50% vacation bonus

• Major medical expenses insurance for the employee

• 30 days Christmas bonus (aguinaldo)

• 8% savings fund

• Savings cooperative / savings bank

• Free cafeteria / free meals

• Seniority recognition every 5 years

• Pension plan

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

• Mantenere e aggiornare il grafico dei conti e delle gerarchie, assicurando che riflette la struttura aziendale attuale e i requisiti di reporting

• Collabora a stretto contatto con i team di finanza locali nei paesi e i team di servizi condivisi di finanza / fornitore di Business Process Outsourcing (BPO)

• Coordinare con gli altri dipartimenti e i team dei Servizi Condizionati di Finanza per garantire che tutte le transazioni finanziarie siano debitamente contabilizzate e riflesse nel registro generale

• Sostegno ove richiesto con il termine di chiusura, compresa la chiusura dei conti accreditati/pagabili sommergibile e riconciliarsi con il registro generale; chiudere il registro generale, aprire nuovo periodo finanziario, chiudere Asset Accounting (AA)

• Supporto con la preparazione di complesse voci di rivista, conciliazioni del bilancio e analisi della varianza

• Contribuire al miglioramento continuo del processo RTR, sfruttando la tecnologia e le migliori pratiche; mantenere politiche, procedure e modelli

• Assicurarsi che i controlli interni finanziari siano in vigore e seguiti per i processi svolti da questo ruolo

• Fare tutte le attività di chiusura dell'Anno tecnico come l'equilibrio portare avanti, le creazioni della gamma di numeri, chiusura di AA

• Sostenere il processo di riconciliazione intercompany in Coprocess e Tagetik (fisso varianze)

Istruzione ed esperienza

• Laurea in finanza, contabilità, amministrazione aziendale o campo relativo

• Minimo 3-4 anni di esperienza in Contabilità con una forte attenzione al registro generale e alla rendicontazione finanziaria

• CPA, ACCA, CMA o certificazione equivalente

Fattori di successo critici

• Forte capacità analitiche, di problem solving e di gestione

• Ottima attenzione ai dettagli e all'impegno per l'accuratezza e l'integrità nel reporting finanziario

• Capacità comprovata di gestire più priorità in un ambiente a scadenza

• Forte capacità di comunicazione per fornire informazioni chiave alla leadership senior

Capacità tecniche e linguistiche

• Proficiente nei sistemi ERP (rilevante al tuo business unit; SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365 o iScala) e software di contabilità

• Forte MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint) competenze

• Esperienza con Tagetik, Coprocess e Qlik Sense è un plus

• Proficienza in inglese

Cosa ti offriamo

• 12 giorni di vacanza all'anno

• 50% di bonus di vacanza

• Maggiore assicurazione delle spese mediche per il dipendente

• 30 giorni bonus di Natale (aguinaldo)

• Fondo di risparmio dell'8%

• Risparmio cooperativo / banca di risparmio

• caffetteria gratuita / pasti gratuiti

• Riconoscimento degli anziani ogni 5 anni

• Piano pensione

Sulzer è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità. Crediamo nella forza di una forza lavoro diversificata e ci impegniamo ad offrire un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo.

Siamo orgogliosi di essere riconosciuti come Top Employer 2026 in Brasile, Canada, Cina, Finlandia, Germania, Irlanda, Messico, Svizzera, Sud Africa, Regno Unito e Stati Uniti.

jobs.title: Industrial Machinery Project Manager
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

As an Industrial Machinery Project Manager, you will lead moderately complex projects from initiation through completion, ensuring the project will be delivered safely, on time, within scope, and within budget. You will serve as the primary point of contact for customers and stakeholders, while coordinating cross-functional teams to achieve high-quality outcomes and strong client satisfaction. Key Responsibilities

• Project Leadership
• Lead mid-sized projects, ensuring adherence to schedules, budgets, and quality standards.

• Serve as the primary point of contact for customers throughout project execution.

• Drive accountability across teams to meet project milestones and deliverables.

• Project Planning & Coordination
• Develop and manage detailed project plans, including timelines, budgets, and resource allocation.

• Lead estimating efforts, including takeoffs and input into the quoting system.

• Assign tasks and coordinate activities across internal teams, contractors, and vendors.

• Communication & Reporting
• Provide clear, consistent updates on project status, performance, and risks.

• Maintain accurate project documentation, including schedules, reports, and risk logs.

• Escalate issues that may impact cost, schedule, or quality.

• Safety & Compliance
• Ensure compliance with OSHA, NEC, and company safety standards.

• Conduct site audits and address safety concerns proactively.

• Support the integration of environmentally responsible and sustainable practices.

• Risk Management
• Identify potential project risks and develop mitigation strategies.

• Monitor project performance and implement corrective actions when needed.

• Team Collaboration
• Collaborate with customers, engineers, field teams, and contractors to resolve challenges.

• Promote teamwork and maintain alignment on project goals.

• Continuous Improvement
• Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, cost control, and project execution.

• Support the development and implementation of best practices.

• Additional Responsibilities
• Perform other duties as needed to support business objectives and project success.

• Pursuing ongoing learning and professional development opportunities

Qualifications & Competencies
Required:

• 2–4 years of experience in project management or project coordination

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office and project management software

• Ability to read and interpret electrical drawings and specifications.

• Knowledge of NEC standards, OSHA regulations, and environmental compliance

• Experience with estimating, quoting, and takeoff processes.
Preferred:

• Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Construction Management, Business Administration, Project Management, or related field

• Experience working with cross-functional teams.

• PMP, CAPM, or similar project management certification

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym re-imbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

About the role

Job Summary

Responsible for driving business development, product specialization, sales enablement, and strategic opportunity leadership to strengthen Sulzer’s position as the leading independent service provider for industrial steam turbines and process gas compressors. Serving as the regional focal point for Steam Turbines & Compressors (ST&C) across Sub-Saharan Africa (SSA), the role implements the global Product Line strategy by translating strategic objectives into actionable regional go-to-market plans.

The position ensures alignment with Sulzer’s overall business strategy while adapting initiatives to local market dynamics, supporting growth, customer engagement, and sustainable market leadership. Business Development Manager & Product Specialist – Steam Turbine & Compressor Services (SSA)

Location: Johannesburg, South Africa
Region: Sub-Saharan Africa (SSA)

Sulzer is a global leader in engineering and services, dedicated to delivering innovative and sustainable solutions for our customers. We are seeking an experienced and commercially driven Business Development Manager & Product Specialist – Steam Turbine & Compressor Services to lead the growth of our Steam Turbine & Compressor (ST&C) business across Sub-Saharan Africa.

Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile.

Informazioni sul ruolo

Sintesi del lavoro

Responsabile per lo sviluppo aziendale, la specializzazione del prodotto, l'attivazione delle vendite e la leadership strategica di opportunità per rafforzare la posizione di Sulzer come fornitore di servizi indipendente leader per turbine a vapore industriali e compressori di gas di processo. Servendo come punto focale regionale per Steam Turbines & Compressors (ST&C) attraverso l'Africa subsahariana (SSA), il ruolo implementa la strategia globale della linea di prodotto traducendo obiettivi strategici in piani di go-to-market regionali attuabili.

La posizione garantisce l’allineamento con la strategia aziendale globale di Sulzer, adattando al contempo le iniziative alle dinamiche del mercato locale, sostenendo la crescita, l’impegno dei clienti e la leadership di mercato sostenibile. Business Development Manager & Product Specialist – Servizi di turbine e compressori di vapore (SSA)

Ubicazione: Johannesburg, Sudafrica
Regione: Africa subsahariana (SSA)
Divisione: Servizi Sulzer

Sulzer è leader globale nell'ingegneria e nei servizi, dedicato alla fornitura di soluzioni innovative e sostenibili per i nostri clienti. Siamo alla ricerca di un Business Development Manager & Product Specialist esperto e commercialmente guidato – Steam Turbine & Compressor Services per condurre la crescita del nostro business Steam Turbine & Compressor (ST&C) in tutta l'Africa subsahariana.

Si tratta di un ruolo strategico regionale che combina lo sviluppo aziendale, la specializzazione dei prodotti, il rendimento delle vendite e la leadership di opportunità per rafforzare la posizione di Sulzer come fornitore di servizi indipendente leader per turbine a vapore industriali e compressori di gas di processo. In qualità di punto focale regionale per ST&C, tradurrai strategie di linea di prodotti globali in iniziative di crescita regionale incisive, costruendo relazioni con i clienti a lungo termine e espandendo la presenza di mercato di Sulzer in tutta l'Africa.

Cosa farai

• Promuovere una crescita redditizia del portafoglio di Turbine & Compressor Services di Sulzer in tutta l'Africa subsahariana.

• Sviluppare ed eseguire strategie regionali di go-to-market allineate agli obiettivi globali di ST&C.

• Identificare, qualificare e convertire opportunità in diversi settori industriali e basi multi-OEM installate.

• Supporto e abilitare i team di vendita attraverso competenze tecnico-commerciali e lo sviluppo delle opportunità.

• Condurre inseguimenti strategici e di alto valore e coordinare team interfunzionali per fornire soluzioni clienti vincenti.

• Costruire relazioni forti con clienti, proprietari di asset, operatori, EPC e partner commerciali in tutta la regione.

• Promuovere l'approccio "One Sulzer" di Sulzer sfruttando l'ingegneria globale, il centro assistenza, il servizio sul campo e le competenze tecniche.

• Monitorare le tendenze del mercato, l'attività dei concorrenti e le opportunità emergenti per sostenere la crescita sostenibile.

•
Cosa stiamo cercando

• Laurea in ingegneria meccanica o qualifica equivalente.

• Esperienza minima di 8 anni nell'industria dei servizi turbomacchine industriali.

• Esperienza dimostrata con turbine a vapore industriali e/o compressori a gas di processo.

• Forte acume tecnico e commerciale con la capacità di sviluppare e fornire soluzioni orientate al cliente.

• Provato record di traccia in sviluppo aziendale, gestione delle opportunità e leadership di vendita.

• L'esperienza che opera all'interno di organizzazioni di matrice e mercati emergenti sarà vantaggiosa.

• Eccellente coinvolgimento delle parti interessate, influenzando e capacità di costruzione di relazioni.

•
Richiesta di viaggio
Questo ruolo richiede viaggi regolari in tutta l'Africa subsahariana (circa il 40-60%) e la capacità di lavorare efficacemente in ambienti di mercato diversi ed emergenti.

Che successo sembra
Il candidato di successo contribuirà a:

• Crescita delle entrate e dell'ordine.

• Aumentata penetrazione di base installata e quota di mercato.

• Opportunità strategica vince e ser a lungo termine

Sur le rôle

Résumé de l'emploi

Responsable du développement des entreprises, de la spécialisation des produits, de l'habilitation des ventes et du leadership stratégique pour renforcer la position de SulzerS en tant que premier fournisseur de services indépendant pour les turbines à vapeur industrielles et les compresseurs de gaz de procédé. Fonctionnant comme point focal régional pour les turbines à vapeur et les compresseurs (ST&C) en Afrique subsaharienne (SSA), le rôle met en œuvre la stratégie mondiale de la chaîne de produits en transformant les objectifs stratégiques en plans régionaux de mise en marché réalisables.

La position assure l'alignement avec la stratégie commerciale globale de Sulzer, tout en adaptant les initiatives à la dynamique du marché local, en soutenant la croissance, l'engagement des clients et le leadership durable du marché. Gestionnaire de développement des affaires et spécialiste des produits – Services de turbine à vapeur et compresseur (SSA)

Lieu: Johannesburg, Afrique du Sud
Région: Afrique subsaharienne
Division : Services Sulzer

Sulzer est un leader mondial de l'ingénierie et des services, dédié à fournir des solutions innovantes et durables pour nos clients. Nous sommes à la recherche d'un responsable du développement commercial et spécialiste des produits – Turbine à vapeur et compresseur Services pour diriger la croissance de notre entreprise de turbine à vapeur et compresseur (ST&C) dans toute l'Afrique subsaharienne.

Il s'agit d'un rôle stratégique régional combinant le développement des entreprises, la spécialisation des produits, la capacité de vente et le leadership d'opportunité pour renforcer la position de Sulzer en tant que premier fournisseur de services indépendant pour les turbines à vapeur industrielles et les compresseurs de gaz de procédé. En tant que point focal régional pour la ST&C, vous transformerez les stratégies globales de gamme de produits en initiatives de croissance régionale impactées tout en établissant des relations client à long terme et en élargissant la présence de Sulzer sur le marché en Afrique.

Ce que vous ferez

• Conduire une croissance rentable du portefeuille Turbine & Compresseur Services de Sulzer dans toute l'Afrique subsaharienne.

• Élaborer et exécuter des stratégies régionales de mise en marché conformes aux objectifs mondiaux en matière de ST&C.

• Identifier, qualifier et convertir les possibilités dans divers secteurs industriels et bases installées à plusieurs OEM.

• Soutenir et permettre aux équipes de vente par l'expertise technique et commerciale et le développement des opportunités.

• Diriger des activités stratégiques de grande valeur et coordonner des équipes interfonctionnelles pour offrir des solutions gagnantes aux clients.

• Établir des relations solides avec les clients, les propriétaires d'actifs, les exploitants, les EPC et les partenaires commerciaux de toute la région.

• Promouvoir l'approche « One Sulzer » de Sulzer en tirant parti de l'ingénierie mondiale, du centre de services, du service sur le terrain et de l'expertise technique.

• Surveiller les tendances du marché, l'activité des concurrents et les nouvelles possibilités de soutenir une croissance durable.

•
Ce que nous cherchons

• Baccalauréat en génie mécanique ou diplôme équivalent.

• Minimum de 8 ans d'expérience dans l'industrie des services de turbomachines.

• Expérience démontrée avec les turbines à vapeur industrielles et/ou les compresseurs de gaz de procédé.

• Forte adéquation technique et commerciale avec la capacité de développer et de fournir des solutions axées sur le client.

• Expérience éprouvée en développement commercial, gestion des opportunités et leadership commercial.

• L'expérience des organisations matricielles et des marchés émergents sera avantageuse.

• Excellent engagement des intervenants, influence et compétences en matière d'établissement de relations.

•
Frais de voyage
Ce rôle exige des déplacements réguliers dans toute l'Afrique subsaharienne (environ 40 à 60 %) et la capacité de travailler efficacement dans des environnements de marché divers et émergents.

À quoi ressemble le succès
La candidate reçue contribuera à :

• Croissance des recettes et des commandes.

• Augmentation de la pénétration de la base installée et de la part de marché.

• Les opportunités stratégiques et le service à long terme

jobs.title: Assembly Fitter
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

At Sulzer Leeds, we don't just manufacture pumps. We engineer some of the world's most advanced pumping solutions for critical applications across energy, water, infrastructure, industrial processing and emerging technologies.

Our Leeds facility is a global centre of excellence for the design, engineering and manufacture of highly specialised pumps and pumping systems. From bespoke, large-scale engineered solutions to complex rotodynamic technologies, our teams tackle some of the most demanding technical challenges in the industry.

As we continue to invest in our people, technology and capabilities, we are looking for talented individuals who want to make a real impact and build a rewarding career within a world-class engineering environment. Key Duties

• Assemble, build and fit complex centrifugal pump assemblies and associated equipment in line with engineering drawings, specifications and quality standards.

• Carry out mechanical fitting activities including bearing installation, shaft assembly, impeller fitting, seal installation and final pump build.

• Interpret engineering drawings, assembly instructions and technical documentation to ensure accurate assembly of components.

• Use precision measuring equipment to verify dimensions, tolerances and alignment

What We're Looking For

• Time-served Mechanical Fitter, Mechanical Assembly Technician, or equivalent mechanical engineering apprenticeship.

• Experience assembling rotating equipment such as pumps, compressors, gearboxes, turbines or similar precision-engineered machinery.

• Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and technical specifications.

• Skilled in the use of hand tools, mechanical assembly equipment and precision measuring instruments.

• Strong understanding of mechanical tolerances, fits, alignments and assembly techniques.

• Experience working within a manufacturing, engineering or heavy industrial environment.

• A proactive approach to problem-solving with excellent attention to detail.

What we offer you

We’ve recently invested significantly in modernising our Leeds facility — creating a brighter, more efficient, and more advanced workspace designed to support high‑quality work and a great employee experience. Alongside our upgraded facilities, you’ll benefit from:

Core Benefits

• A competitive salary

• A company-wide bonus scheme

• Paid overtime opportunities

• Medicash Health Cash Plan (covering everyday healthcare expenses such as dental, optical and GP services)

• 33 days’ holiday

• Defined pension contribution

• Employee Assistance Programmes

• Discounts on shopping, entertainment & lifestyle

• Costco membership option

• Discounted personal car leasing for you, family & friends

• Long Service Awards

• Ongoing learning through Sulzer Learning Pathways

• Armed Forces Support – As a Silver Award holder of the MoD Defence Employer Recognition Scheme, we actively support veterans, reservists and Cadet Adult Volunteers. This includes policies that enable time for training, camps and deployment, alongside access to a growing internal military network.

Onsite Perks

• Free, secure parking with EV charging

• Multi-faith prayer room

• Newly modernised work areas

• Lively Sports & Social Club with events & prize draws

• 24/7 onsite gym

• Subsidised vending machines

• Subsidised Canteen offering hot and cold food

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

About the role

At Sulzer Leeds, we don't just manufacture pumps. We engineer some of the world's most advanced pumping solutions for critical applications across energy, water, infrastructure, industrial processing and emerging technologies.

Our Leeds facility is a global centre of excellence for the design, engineering and manufacture of highly specialised pumps and pumping systems. From bespoke, large-scale engineered solutions to complex rotodynamic technologies, our teams tackle some of the most demanding technical challenges in the industry.

As we continue to invest in our people, technology and capabilities, we are looking for talented individuals who want to make a real impact and build a rewarding career within a world-class engineering environment. Key Duties

• Assemble, build and fit complex centrifugal pump assemblies and associated equipment in line with engineering drawings, specifications and quality standards.

• Interpret engineering drawings, assembly instructions and technical documentation to ensure accurate assembly of components.

• Use precision measuring equipment to verify dimensions, tolerances and alignment

What We're Looking For

• Time-served Mechanical Fitter, Mechanical Assembly Technician, or equivalent mechanical engineering apprenticeship.

• Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and technical specifications.

• Skilled in the use of hand tools, mechanical assembly equipment and precision measuring instruments.

• Strong understanding of mechanical tolerances, fits, alignments and assembly techniques.

• Experience working within a manufacturing, engineering or heavy industrial environment.

• A proactive approach to problem-solving with excellent attention to detail.
