jobs.title: MRP Controller
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

At Sulzer, we are driving exciting transformation projects across our manufacturing operations. As part of our SAP implementation journey, we are looking for a motivated MRP Controller to join our Burgos site and support the development of our planning capabilities.
This is an excellent opportunity for a planning professional who wants to build expertise in production planning, ERP systems, and manufacturing operations while contributing to a key business transformation project.
Key Responsibilities

• Run the MRP system on a daily basis, ensuring that planned production orders and requisitions are aligned with the Master Production Plan.

• Perform capacity analysis by regularly assessing workload versus the plant’s installed capacity, identifying bottlenecks and recommending additional shifts or resource reallocation through the system when needed.

• Monitor production plan compliance by tracking actual manufacturing progress against the scheduled plan, analyzing deviations such as scrap, mechanical failures, absenteeism or delays, and promptly rescheduling the system to keep it updated.

• Update and manage key performance indicators (KPIs).

To succeed in this role, you will need

• Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related field.

• 1-3 years of experience in production planning, materials planning, supply chain, manufacturing operations, or similar environments.

• Experience working with ERP systems.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to manage priorities in a dynamic manufacturing environment.

• Strong communication and collaboration skills.

• Good knowledge of Microsoft Excel.

• Fluent Spanish and a good level of English.

What we offer you

• A permanent contract.

• A competitive salary as well as participation in the variable remuneration system based on personal and financial objectives.

• Meal vouchers.

• Access to a voluntary flexible compensation scheme allowing employees to optimize their salary package (e.g. health insurance, transport, childcare)

• Be part of an experienced and international team.

• A good vibe working environment.

• The opportunity to grow your career within a solid and well-established international company.

• Be part of a dynamic organization undergoing continuous transformation and improvement.

Über die Rolle

Bei Sulzer treiben wir spannende Transformationsprojekte in unseren Fertigungsbetrieben voran. Im Rahmen unserer SAP-Implementierung suchen wir einen motivierten MRP-Controller, der unserem Standort in Burgos beitritt und die Entwicklung unserer Planungsfähigkeiten unterstützt.
Dies ist eine hervorragende Gelegenheit für einen Planungsprofi, der Fachwissen in den Bereichen Produktionsplanung, ERP-Systeme und Fertigungsbetriebe aufbauen und gleichzeitig zu einem wichtigen Geschäftstransformationsprojekt beitragen möchte.
Hauptzuständigkeiten

• Führen Sie das MRP-System täglich aus und stellen Sie sicher, dass geplante Produktionsaufträge und -anforderungen mit dem Master-Produktionsplan übereinstimmen.

• Führen Sie eine Kapazitätsanalyse durch regelmäßige Bewertung der Arbeitsbelastung im Vergleich zur installierten Kapazität der Anlage durch, identifizieren Sie Engpässe und empfehlen Sie bei Bedarf zusätzliche Schichten oder Ressourcenumschichtungen durch das System.

• Überwachen Sie die Einhaltung des Produktionsplans, indem Sie den tatsächlichen Fertigungsfortschritt mit dem geplanten Plan verfolgen, Abweichungen wie Ausschuss, mechanische Ausfälle, Fehlzeiten oder Verzögerungen analysieren und das System umgehend neu planen, um es auf dem neuesten Stand zu halten.

• Aktualisieren und Verwalten von Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).

Um in dieser Rolle erfolgreich zu sein, müssen Sie

• Bachelor-Abschluss in Industrial Engineering, Maschinenbau, Supply Chain Management, Manufacturing Engineering oder einem verwandten Bereich.

• 1-3 Jahre Erfahrung in der Produktionsplanung, Materialplanung, Lieferkette, Fertigung oder ähnlichen Umgebungen.

• Erfahrung im Umgang mit ERP-Systemen.

• Starke analytische und problemlösende Fähigkeiten.

• Starke Kommunikation und Zusammenarbeit Fähigkeiten.

Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable.

Sur le rôle

Chez Sulzer, nous menons des projets de transformation passionnants dans nos activités de fabrication. Dans le cadre de notre parcours de mise en œuvre SAP, nous recherchons un contrôleur MRP motivé pour rejoindre notre site Burgos et soutenir le développement de nos capacités de planification.
C'est une excellente occasion pour un professionnel de la planification qui veut acquérir une expertise dans la planification de la production, les systèmes ERP et les opérations de fabrication tout en contribuant à un projet clé de transformation opérationnelle.
Principales responsabilités

• Exécuter quotidiennement le système MRP, en veillant à ce que les commandes et les demandes de production prévues soient conformes au plan directeur de production.

• Effectuer une analyse de la capacité en évaluant régulièrement la charge de travail par rapport à la capacité installée de l'usine, en identifiant les goulets d'étranglement et en recommandant des changements supplémentaires ou une réaffectation des ressources par l'intermédiaire du système, au besoin.

• Surveiller la conformité du plan de production en suivant les progrès réels de la fabrication par rapport au plan prévu, en analysant les écarts tels que la ferraille, les défaillances mécaniques, l'absentéisme ou les retards, et en rééchelonnant rapidement le système pour le tenir à jour.

• Mettre à jour et gérer les indicateurs de rendement clés (ICP).

Pour réussir dans ce rôle, vous aurez besoin

• Baccalauréat en génie industriel, génie mécanique, gestion de la chaîne d'approvisionnement, génie manufacturier ou un domaine connexe.

• 1-3 ans d'expérience dans la planification de la production, la planification des matériaux, la chaîne d'approvisionnement, les opérations de fabrication ou des environnements semblables.

• Expérience de travail avec les systèmes ERP.

• Forte capacité d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes.

• Capacité de gérer les priorités dans un environnement manufacturier dynamique.

• Fortes compétences en communication et en collaboration.

• Bonne connaissance de Microsoft Excel.

• L'espagnol et un bon niveau d'anglais.

Ce que nous vous offrons

• Un salaire compétitif ainsi que la participation au système de rémunération variable fondé sur des objectifs personnels et financiers.

• Des bons de repas.

• Accès à un système volontaire de rémunération flexible permettant aux salariés d'optimiser leur salaire (par exemple assurance maladie, transport, garde d'enfants)

• Faites partie d'une équipe expérimentée et internationale.

• Un bon environnement de travail.

• L'occasion de développer votre carrière au sein d'une entreprise internationale solide et bien établie.

• Faites partie d'une organisation dynamique en constante transformation et amélioration.

Are you passionate about engineering and looking for an exciting opportunity to grow your career? We have a vacancy at our Wexford Service Centre for a Service Engineer to join our dedicated team. This role involves servicing and installing industrial, municipal, and commercial wastewater and stormwater pumping equipment. Key Responsibilities:

• Planned Inspections & Maintenance : Conduct effective planned inspections, fault finding, and maintenance of pumping equipment at customer sites.

• Ownership & Initiative : Take an active role and ownership of your responsibilities.

• Technical Expertise : Demonstrate strong skills in the service and repair of wastewater equipment.

• Computer Skills : Proficiency in computer skills for reporting and communication.

• Interpersonal Skills : Strong interpersonal and customer service skills.

• Team Player : Ability to work alone or as part of a team, under pressure and to deadlines.

• Attention to Detail : Excellent attention to detail in all aspects of the role

• An interesting and rewarding position with opportunities for career progression.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Description Summary
Machinist is responsible for machining and refurbishing turbine and rotating‑equipment components using conventional machine tools. This role requires hands‑on experience with manual lathes, HBM, VTL, 4‑jaw chuck setups, precision measuring tools, and the ability to consistently hold tight tolerances on critical turbine parts. Key Responsibilities

• Set up and operate manual lathes, mills, horizontal boring mills (HBM), vertical turret lathes (VTL), and related machining equipment.

• Perform advanced 4‑jaw chuck setups, indicating, and alignment of irregular, heavy, and split components.

• Machine turbine components including IGVs, diaphragms, rings, shafts, sleeves, and split casings.

• Achieve and verify tight machining tolerances (typically ±0.001" or as specified by drawings and procedures).

• Conduct dimensional inspections using micrometers, dial indicators, calipers, bore gauges, and other precision instruments.

• Read and interpret blueprints, repair drawings, travelers, and work instructions.

• Select correct tooling, speeds, feeds, and machining methods for each job.

• Safely handle large and heavy components using overhead cranes, lifts, and rigging
equipment.

Required Qualifications

• Ability to work a 12‑day, 10‑hour minimum schedule with 12‑day, 12‑hour schedules during outage seasons .

• 3–5+ years of experience operating manual lathes, mills, and conventional machining equipment.

• Strong proficiency with 4‑jaw chuck setups and precision indicating.

• Skilled in the use of precision measuring instruments (micrometers, indicators, bore gauges, etc.).

• Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, blueprints, and repair procedures.

• Must supply basic personal hand tools.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in turbine repair, power generation, or heavy‑industrial machining.

• Knowledge of machining tolerances, fits, and GD&T.

• Experience operating overhead cranes and/or forklifts.

• Ability to machine large, heavy, and split turbine components.

Competencies

• Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.

• Ability to work independently as well as in a team environment.

• Effective communication and problem‑solving skills.

• Strong commitment to safety and proper machining practices.

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym re-imbursement

• New onsite cafeteria, all meals subsidized (La Porte Service Center)

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Informazioni sul ruolo

Descrizione del lavoro
Machinist è responsabile per la lavorazione e la ristrutturazione della turbina e dei componenti di equipaggiamento rotante utilizzando macchine utensili convenzionali. Questo ruolo richiede un'esperienza pratica con torni manuali, HBM, VTL, configurazioni di mandrino a 4 tempi, strumenti di misura di precisione e la capacità di tenere costantemente strette tolleranze sulle parti critiche della turbina. Principali responsabilità

• Impostare e utilizzare torni manuali, mulini, frese orizzontali (HBM), torni a torretta verticale (VTL), e relative attrezzature di lavorazione.

• Eseguire le impostazioni avanzate del mandrino 4-jaw, indicando e allineamento dei componenti irregolari, pesanti e divisi.

• Componenti della turbina della macchina tra cui IGV, diaframmi, anelli, alberi, maniche e involucri separati.

• Ottenere e verificare tolleranze di lavorazione strette (tipicamente ±0.001" o come specificato da disegni e procedure).

• Condurre ispezioni dimensionali utilizzando micrometri, indicatori di linea, pinze, bore e altri strumenti di precisione.

• Leggere e interpretare i progetti, riparare disegni, viaggiatori e istruzioni di lavoro.

• Selezionare strumenti corretti, velocità, feed e metodi di lavorazione per ogni lavoro.

• Maneggiare in modo sicuro componenti grandi e pesanti utilizzando gru, ascensori e rigging
attrezzature.

Qualificazioni richieste

• Possibilità di lavorare un programma minimo di 12 ore, di 10 ore con orari di 12 ore, 12 ore durante le stagioni in uscita.

• 3-5 anni di esperienza di tornio manuale operativo, mulini e attrezzature di lavorazione convenzionali.

• Forte competenza con configurazioni di mandrino 4-jaw e indicazione di precisione.

• Abilitato nell'uso di strumenti di misura di precisione (micrometri, indicatori, manometri, ecc.).

• Capacità di leggere e interpretare disegni tecnici, progetti e procedure di riparazione.

• Deve fornire strumenti di base della mano personale.

Qualificazioni predestinate

• Esperienza nella riparazione delle turbine, nella produzione di energia o nella lavorazione industriale pesante.

• Conoscenza delle tolleranze di lavorazione, si adatta e GD&T.

• Sperimenta le gru e/o i carrelli elevatori.

• Capacità di lavorare componenti a turbina grandi, pesanti e divisi.

Competenze

• Forte attenzione al dettaglio e all'impegno per la qualità.

• Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e in un ambiente di squadra.

• Efficace capacità di comunicazione e problem solving.

• Forte impegno per la sicurezza e le pratiche di lavorazione adeguate.

• 401k piano con una partita del 6%

* Minimum 3 ans d'expérience en tant que Technicien Service ou de maintenance d'équipements industriels, idéalement dans le secteur des pompes ou des machines tournantes.
* Solides compétences en mécanique, hydraulique, et idéalement en électricité/automatisme.
* Capacité à lire et interpréter des schémas techniques et des plans.

jobs.title: Industrial Painter
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The Painter is responsible for working with production to prepare finished pumps for the customer. Responsibilities

• Manage material movement through the department which aligns with the most immediate needs of internal customers to meet On-Time-Delivery (OTD) performance metrics.

• Operate overhead and manual floor lifting equipment to maneuver, load, and unload items onto and off of the paint line that exceed 50lbs.

• Utilize pre-coating agents, mix and match colors and textures according to specifications, and fill or level materials as required.

• Follow compound specifications for mixing of paints and painting techniques.

• Apply paint and any additional finishes according to sales order and work instructions.

• Read and interpret drawings, technical specifications and material data sheets.

• Maintain accurate and complete records as required.

• Perform quality inspections as described in quality plans and work instructions.

• Follow quality procedures according to ISO 9001.

• Commitment to following all work instructions, policies, and posted signs or instructions regarding safety, including but not limited to, proper use of required PPE at all times.

Requirements

• High school diploma or equivalent

• 1+ years of industrial or automotive painting experience

• Ability to wear a respirator

• Ability to read, write, and communicate in English

• Reliable transportation

• Ability to pass 7-year criminal history background check

• Ability to pass a drug screen

Physical Requirements:

• Must be able to lift 50 lbs (excess of 50 lbs, use of slings, hoist or cranes required)

• Must be able to stand for extended periods of time (up to 12hrs)

• Must be able to don required PPE for all operations included in the scope of this job including painting (some protective equipment may present problems for persons with claustrophobia or asthma)

What we offer you

• Competitive Paid Time Off (3 weeks to start)

• 12 Company Paid Holidays per year

• Annual Bonus Program

• Full Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits

• Company Paid Short Term and Long Term Disability, Company Paid Life Insurance

• Company Paid Retirement Security Contributions following 1 year of employment

• Tuition Reimbursement/Educational Assistance

• Quarterly Gym Reimbursement

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Project Engineer is responsible for supporting technical project planning, execution, and monitoring. The role involves working independently with general supervision and contributing to project success through technical and analytical support.
This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. SUMMARY:
The project engineering position verifies that components and assemblies meet all applicable design requirements, engineering standards, customer specifications, and applicable ASME codes and standards. This role performs calculations, technical evaluations, and detailed drawing reviews to confirm compliance with engineering standards, design documentation, and ASME Codes. The engineer contributes to ensuring that the parts, materials, and assemblies selected satisfy the functional and regulatory requirements of the nuclear application.
ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

• Verifies that replacement parts, new equipment, retrofit pumps, and refurbished pumps are designed & constructed in accordance with customer design specifications, applicable codes & standards, and Sulzer-internal Engineering standards.

• Generates, reviews, and maintains the design Bill of Materials and Drawings while adhering to Engineering Specifications, detailed documentation of design requirements, and ASME standards.

• Perform technical evaluations and justifications to resolve non-conformance reports, supplier deviations, and design changes.

• Perform design, material, and seismic reconciliations and/or reports for nuclear-safety-related components and ASME Code Components.

• Reviews and verifies cross-sectional and general arrangement drawings.

• Reviews component drawings to ensure adherence to Engineering Standards, design requirements, ASME Code requirements, and GD&T standards.

• Review and maintenance of special processes to ensure adherence to Engineering Standards and design requirements.
SECONDARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Adheres to company and department policies, procedures, and standards

• Supports, cooperates with, and participates in company-wide LEAN and Environmental Safety & Health (ESH) Management System which includes following all safety, health and environmental policies and procedures. Supports and cooperates in company-wide Quality Management effort.

• Performs other duties as assigned.
SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES: None
QUALIFICATIONS:

• Requires a minimum of three (3), in mechanical engineering of rotating equipment design experience preferred but not required.

• Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent Engineering degree.

• Basic understanding of engineering principles, calculations, and design software.

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word) and CAD tools.

• FE Certification is desirable but not mandatory.

• Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to balance multiple tasks

• Eagerness to learn and ability to work in a team environment.

• Must be a U.S. Citizen, U.S. National, or Lawful Permanent Resident

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym reimbursement

• Recensioni e verifica i disegni di disposizione trasversali e generali.

QUALIFICA:

• Richiede un minimo di tre (3), in ingegneria meccanica dell'esperienza di progettazione di attrezzature rotanti preferita ma non richiesto.

• Laurea in ingegneria meccanica o equivalente grado di ingegneria.

• La comprensione di base dei principi di ingegneria, calcoli e software di progettazione.

• Forte capacità analitiche, di problem solving e di comunicazione.

• La competenza in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word) e strumenti CAD.

• La certificazione FE è desiderabile ma non obbligatoria.

• Forte capacità organizzative e di gestione del tempo, con la capacità di bilanciare più compiti

• La voglia di imparare e la capacità di lavorare in un ambiente di squadra.

jobs.title: PM Team Leader
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
Responsible for the successful execution, governance, commercial performance, and delivery of multiple projects within the organization.
The role provides leadership to Project Coordinators, Engineers and Project Managers, ensuring projects are delivered safely, on schedule, within budget, and in accordance with contractual obligations and customer expectations.
The incumbent acts as the primary escalation point for project-related matters, drives project readiness for Steering Committee reviews, manages commercial risks including Liquidated Damages (LDs), claims, and change orders, and ensures effective project close-out and lessons learned implementation.

Key Responsibilities

Team Management

• Lead, coach, and supervise a team of Project Engineers and Project Managers.

• Establish project execution strategies, priorities, and performance targets.

• Allocate resources and balance workloads across the project portfolio.

• Conduct performance reviews, development planning, and succession planning for project personnel.

• Serve as the first level of escalation for project-related issues.

• Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, safety, and continuous improvement.

Project Delivery Management

• Oversee the execution of multiple EPC, Energy, Infrastructure, or Industrial projects.

• Ensure projects are delivered within approved schedule, budget, quality, and HSE requirements.

• Monitor project KPIs, progress, risks, and resource utilization.

• Conduct weekly project reviews and monthly portfolio reviews.

• Ensure project plans, schedules, recovery plans, and execution strategies remain current and achievable.

• Drive proactive identification and mitigation of project risks.

Commercial & Contract Management

• Lead the management of contractual obligations and commercial exposures.

• Review and address Liquidated Damages (LDs) risks and develop mitigation strategies.

• Manage contract change orders, variation requests, extension of time (EOT) claims, and commercial negotiations.

• Support dispute avoidance and resolution activities.

• Ensure contractual compliance with customers, partners, and suppliers.

• Participate in commercial negotiations with clients and subcontractors when required.

• Coordinate with Legal and Finance departments regarding contractual matters.

Project Governance & Steering Committee Readiness

• Establish governance processes across all projects.

• Ensure project readiness for Steering Committee and Executive Management reviews.

• Validate project dashboards, forecasts, risk registers, commercial updates, and mitigation plans before presentation.

• Present project performance, risks, opportunities, and corrective actions to senior management.

• Ensure management decisions are effectively implemented and tracked.

Project Close-Out & Lessons Learned

• Lead formal project close-out activities.

• Ensure completion of punch lists, final documentation, and handover requirements.

• Oversee final account settlements and commercial closure.

• Capture and institutionalize lessons learned and best practices.

Stakeholder Management

• Act as the senior interface between customers and internal stakeholders.

• Maintain strong relationships with clients, consultants, suppliers, and subcontractors.

• Coordinate activities among Engineering, Procurement, Production, Planning, QA/QC, HSE, and Finance.

• Ensure customer concerns are addressed promptly and professionally.

• Drive customer satisfaction and repeat business opportunities.

Operational Excellence

• Drive implementation of project management standards and best practices.

• Monitor project KPIs and portfolio metrics.

• Ensure compliance with company procedures and requirements.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile.

Informazioni sul ruolo

Sintesi del lavoro
Responsabile per l'esecuzione di successo, la governance, le prestazioni commerciali e la consegna di più progetti all'interno dell'organizzazione.
Il ruolo fornisce la leadership ai Coordinatori del Progetto, agli Ingegneri e ai Project Manager, garantendo che i progetti vengano consegnati in modo sicuro, puntuale, entro il budget e in conformità agli obblighi contrattuali e alle aspettative dei clienti.
L'incumbent agisce come punto di escalation primario per le questioni relative al progetto, guida la prontezza del progetto per le recensioni del comitato direttivo, gestisce i rischi commerciali tra cui i danni liquidati (LD), i reclami e gli ordini di cambiamento, e assicura un'efficace chiusura del progetto e le lezioni apprese implementazione.

Principali responsabilità

Gestione del team

• Guida, coach e supervisiona un team di ingegneri e manager di progetti.

• Stabilire strategie di esecuzione del progetto, priorità e obiettivi di performance.

• Allocare le risorse e i carichi di lavoro di bilancio attraverso il portafoglio di progetto.

• Condurre le recensioni delle prestazioni, la pianificazione dello sviluppo e la pianificazione di successione per il personale di progetto.

• Servire come primo livello di escalation per i problemi legati al progetto.

• Promuovere una cultura di responsabilità, collaborazione, sicurezza e miglioramento continuo.

Gestione della consegna del progetto

• Superare l'esecuzione di più progetti EPC, Energia, Infrastrutture o Industriali.

• Assicurare che i progetti vengano consegnati entro i requisiti di pianificazione, budget, qualità e HSE approvati.

• Monitorare i KPI, i progressi, i rischi e l'utilizzo delle risorse.

• Condurre le recensioni settimanali del progetto e le recensioni mensili del portafoglio.

• Assicurare piani di progetto, programmi, piani di recupero e strategie di esecuzione rimangono attuali e realizzabili.

• Guidare l'identificazione proattiva e la mitigazione dei rischi di progetto.

Gestione commerciale e dei contratti

• Condurre la gestione degli obblighi contrattuali e delle esposizioni commerciali.

• Review and address Liquidated Damages (LDs) rischi e sviluppare strategie di mitigazione.

• Gestire gli ordini di cambio del contratto, le richieste di variazione, l'estensione dei reclami del tempo (EOT) e i negoziati commerciali.

• Sostenere le attività di evitamento e risoluzione delle controversie.

• Assicurare la conformità contrattuale con clienti, partner e fornitori.

• Partecipare a trattative commerciali con clienti e subappaltatori quando necessario.

• Coordinamento con i dipartimenti Legali e Finanza in materia contrattuale.

Governance del progetto e Comitato direttivo

• Stabilire processi di governance in tutti i progetti.

• Assicurare la disponibilità del progetto per le recensioni del comitato direttivo e della direzione esecutiva.

• Convalida dashboard di progetto, previsioni, registri di rischio, aggiornamenti commerciali e piani di mitigazione prima della presentazione.

• Prestazioni, rischi, opportunità e azioni correttive per la gestione senior.

• Assicurarsi che le decisioni di gestione siano effettivamente implementate e tracciate.

Progetto Close-Out e lezioni

• Guidare attività di chiusura del progetto formale.

• Assicurare il completamento di elenchi di pugni, documentazione finale e requisiti di consegna.

• Controllare gli insediamenti dei conti finali e la chiusura commerciale.

• Catturare e istituzionalizzare le lezioni apprese e le migliori pratiche.

Gestione Stakeholder

• Agire come interfaccia senior tra i clienti e gli stakeholder interni.

• Mantenere forti relazioni con clienti, consulenti, fornitori e subappaltatori.

• Coordinare le attività tra Ingegneria, Procurement, Produzione, Pianificazione, QA/QC, HSE e Finanza.

• Assicurarsi che le preoccupazioni dei clienti siano affrontate prontamente e professionalmente.

• Guidare la soddisfazione del cliente e ripetere le opportunità di business.

Eccellenza operativa

• Guidare l'implementazione di standard di gestione del progetto e le migliori pratiche.

• Monitorare i parametri del progetto KPI e del portafoglio.

• Assicurare il rispetto delle procedure e dei requisiti aziendali.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Sulzer ist ein führendes Ingenieurunternehmen mit einem stolzen Erbe an Innovationen. Schließen Sie sich unserem globalen Team an, um Ihr Fachwissen zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine wohlhabende und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen.

Über die Rolle

Stellenbeschreibung
Verantwortlich für die erfolgreiche Durchführung, Governance, kommerzielle Leistung und Lieferung mehrerer Projekte innerhalb der Organisation.
Die Rolle bietet Projektkoordinatoren, Ingenieuren und Projektmanagern die Führung und stellt sicher, dass Projekte sicher, termingerecht, im Rahmen des Budgets und in Übereinstimmung mit vertraglichen Verpflichtungen und Kundenerwartungen geliefert werden.
Der Amtsinhaber fungiert als primärer Eskalationspunkt für projektbezogene Angelegenheiten, treibt die Projektbereitschaft für Überprüfungen des Lenkungsausschusses voran, steuert kommerzielle Risiken wie Liquidated Damages (LDs), Claims und Change Orders und sorgt für eine effektive Projektglattstellung und die Umsetzung von Lessons Learned.

Wichtigste Zuständigkeiten

Teammanagement

• Führen, coachen und betreuen Sie ein Team von Projektingenieuren und Projektmanagern.

• Legen Sie Projektdurchführungsstrategien, Prioritäten und Leistungsziele fest.

• Allokieren Sie Ressourcen und balancieren Sie Workloads im gesamten Projektportfolio.

• Durchführung von Leistungsüberprüfungen, Entwicklungsplanung und Nachfolgeplanung für das Projektpersonal.

• Dienen als erste Eskalationsebene für projektbezogene Themen.

• Förderung einer Kultur der Rechenschaftspflicht, Zusammenarbeit, Sicherheit und kontinuierlicher Verbesserung.

Projektbereitstellungsmanagement

• Beaufsichtigen Sie die Ausführung mehrerer EPC-, Energie-, Infrastruktur- oder Industrieprojekte.

• Stellen Sie sicher, dass Projekte innerhalb der genehmigten Zeitplan-, Budget-, Qualitäts- und HSE-Anforderungen geliefert werden.

• Überwachen Sie Projekt-KPIs, Fortschritt, Risiken und Ressourcenauslastung.

• Führen Sie wöchentliche Projektüberprüfungen und monatliche Portfolioüberprüfungen durch.

• Stellen Sie sicher, dass Projektpläne, Zeitpläne, Wiederherstellungspläne und Ausführungsstrategien aktuell und erreichbar bleiben.

• Proaktive Identifizierung und Minderung von Projektrisiken.

Commercial & Contract Management

• Führen Sie das Management von vertraglichen Verpflichtungen und kommerziellen Risikopositionen.

• Überprüfung und Bewältigung von Liquidated Damages (LDs) Risiken und Entwicklung von Minderungsstrategien.

• Verwalten Sie Vertragsänderungsaufträge, Variationsanforderungen, Verlängerungsansprüche (EOT) und kommerzielle Verhandlungen.

• Unterstützung von Aktivitäten zur Vermeidung und Beilegung von Streitigkeiten.

• Gewährleistung der vertraglichen Einhaltung von Kunden, Partnern und Lieferanten.

• Nehmen Sie bei Bedarf an kommerziellen Verhandlungen mit Kunden und Subunternehmern teil.

• Koordination mit Rechts- und Finanzabteilungen in vertraglichen Angelegenheiten.

Projekt Governance & Steering Committee Ready

• Etablieren Sie Governance-Prozesse in allen Projekten.

• Gewährleistung der Projektbereitschaft für Überprüfungen des Lenkungsausschusses und der Geschäftsleitung.

• Validieren Sie Projekt-Dashboards, Prognosen, Risikoregister, kommerzielle Updates und Minderungspläne vor der Präsentation.

• Präsentieren Sie Projektleistung, Risiken, Chancen und Korrekturmaßnahmen für die Geschäftsleitung.

• Stellen Sie sicher, dass Managemententscheidungen effektiv umgesetzt und verfolgt werden.

Projekt Close-Out & Lessons Learned

• Führen Sie formelle Projekt-Close-Out-Aktivitäten.

• Stellen Sie sicher, dass Sie die Stempellisten, die endgültige Dokumentation und die Übergabeanforderungen ausfüllen.

• Überwachung der endgültigen Abrechnungen und der kommerziellen Schließung.

• Erfassung und Institutionalisierung von Lessons Learned und Best Practices.

Stakeholder-Management

• Handeln Sie als Senior-Schnittstelle zwischen Kunden und internen Stakeholdern.

• Pflegen Sie starke Beziehungen zu Kunden, Beratern, Lieferanten und Subunternehmern.

• Koordinieren Sie die Aktivitäten zwischen Engineering, Beschaffung, Produktion, Planung, QA / QC, HSE und Finanzen.

• Sorgen Sie dafür, dass Kundenanliegen umgehend und professionell angesprochen werden.

• Steigern Sie die Kundenzufriedenheit und wiederholen Sie Geschäftsmöglichkeiten.

Operative Exzellenz

• Förderung der Umsetzung von Projektmanagement-Standards und Best Practices.

• Überwachen Sie Projekt-KPIs und Portfolio-Metriken.

• Gewährleistung der Einhaltung der Verfahren und Anforderungen des Unternehmens.

• P
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Sulzer est une société d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable.

Sur le rôle

Résumé de l'emploi
Responsable de l'exécution réussie, de la gouvernance, du rendement commercial et de la réalisation de plusieurs projets au sein de l'organisation.
Ce rôle assure le leadership des coordonnateurs de projets, des ingénieurs et des gestionnaires de projets, s'assurant que les projets sont exécutés en toute sécurité, dans les délais prévus, dans les limites du budget et conformément aux obligations contractuelles et aux attentes des clients.
Le titulaire joue le rôle de principal point d'escalade pour les questions liées aux projets, stimule l'état de préparation des projets aux examens du Comité directeur, gère les risques commerciaux, y compris les dommages liquidés, les réclamations et les ordres de modification, et veille à ce que les projets soient terminés efficacement et à ce que les enseignements tirés soient mis en œuvre.

Principales responsabilités

Gestion d'équipe

• Diriger, coacher et superviser une équipe d'ingénieurs de projet et de gestionnaires de projet.

• Établir des stratégies d'exécution des projets, des priorités et des objectifs de rendement.

• Attribuer les ressources et équilibrer la charge de travail dans l'ensemble du portefeuille de projets.

• Procéder à des examens du rendement, à la planification du perfectionnement et à la planification de la relève du personnel du projet.

• Servir de premier niveau d'escalade pour les questions liées aux projets.

• Favoriser une culture de responsabilisation, de collaboration, de sécurité et d'amélioration continue.

Gestion de l'exécution des projets

• Superviser l'exécution de plusieurs projets EPC, Énergie, Infrastructure ou Industriel.

• Veiller à ce que les projets soient exécutés dans les limites du calendrier, du budget, de la qualité et des exigences en matière de SST.

• Surveiller les ICR, les progrès, les risques et l'utilisation des ressources.

• Effectuer des examens hebdomadaires des projets et des examens mensuels du portefeuille.

• Veiller à ce que les plans, les calendriers, les plans de rétablissement et les stratégies d'exécution demeurent à jour et réalisables.

• Favoriser l'identification proactive et l'atténuation des risques du projet.

Gestion commerciale et contractuelle

• Diriger la gestion des obligations contractuelles et des expositions commerciales.

• Examiner et traiter les risques liés aux dommages liquidés et élaborer des stratégies d'atténuation.

• Gérer les ordres de modification de contrat, les demandes de modification, les demandes de prorogation de délai et les négociations commerciales.

• Appuyer les activités d'évitement et de règlement des différends.

• Assurer la conformité contractuelle avec les clients, les partenaires et les fournisseurs.

• Participer aux négociations commerciales avec les clients et les sous-traitants au besoin.

• Coordonner avec les services juridiques et financiers les questions contractuelles.

Gouvernance du projet et préparation du comité directeur

• Établir des processus de gouvernance pour tous les projets.

• Veiller à ce que le projet soit prêt pour les examens du Comité directeur et de la haute direction.

• Valider les tableaux de bord, les prévisions, les registres des risques, les mises à jour commerciales et les plans d'atténuation avant la présentation.

• Présenter le rendement du projet, les risques, les possibilités et les mesures correctives à la haute direction.

• Veiller à ce que les décisions de gestion soient mises en oeuvre et suivies efficacement.

Clôture du projet et leçons retenues

• Diriger les activités officielles de clôture du projet.

• Veiller à ce que les listes de perforations, la documentation finale et les exigences de transfert soient remplies.

• Surveiller les règlements définitifs des comptes et la clôture commerciale.

• Saisir et institutionnaliser les enseignements tirés et les pratiques exemplaires.

Gestion des parties prenantes

• Agir comme interface principale entre les clients et les intervenants internes.

• Maintenir des relations solides avec les clients, les consultants, les fournisseurs et les sous-traitants.

• Coordonner les activités entre le génie, l'approvisionnement, la production, la planification, l'AQ/CQ, le HSE et les finances.

• Veiller à ce que les préoccupations des clients soient traitées rapidement et professionnellement.

• Conduire la satisfaction des clients et de répéter les opportunités d'affaires.

Excellence opérationnelle

• Favoriser la mise en œuvre des normes de gestion de projet et des meilleures pratiques.

• Surveiller les ICR du projet et les paramètres du portefeuille.

• Assurer le respect des procédures et des exigences de l'entreprise.

• P

About the role

Job Summary

Use specialized machinery for industrial welding and oversee machines that perform the same job. Maintain and repair all machinery. Assess welded surfaces, structures and components to identify errors. Follow and enforce strict safety regulations such as wearing heat-resistant gloves, protective masks, and safety shoes. • Be able capable of reading all prints issued to welding department

• Accurately follow welding instructions to provide quality welds within the appropriate approved methods

• Ability to use and operate overhead cranes, torches, grinders and forklifts

• Work closely and communicate clearly with the other departments, Weld personnel, Supervisor and Lead Man

• Maintain LEAN objectives within the department

• Proactively engage and support company initiatives designed to promote a culture of safe working, environmental protection and continual improvement.

• Knowledge and understand of turbo machinery repair.

• Must have the required tools to perform their expected tasks within 6 months of hire.

• Must be able to use precision measuring instruments.

• Must be able to work overtime when necessary.

• 12 Paid Holidays

• 15 Paid Time Off (PTO) Days

• Medical, dental, vision, life & disability

• 401K with 6% company match

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Project Engineer is responsible for supporting technical project planning, execution, and monitoring. The role involves working independently with general supervision and contributing to project success through technical and analytical support.
This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. About Us

At Sulzer, you are empowered to deliver superior results. As a pioneer in industry, we have a proud heritage of innovation and continue to evolve for the future. Join our story and create your own impact by developing your expertise and building solutions that help make our lives safer, smarter and more sustainable.
Sulzer is a global leader in fluid engineering. We specialize in pumping, agitation, mixing, separation and purification technologies for fluids of all types. Our customers benefit from our commitment to innovation, performance and quality and from our responsive network of 180 world-class manufacturing facilities and service centres across the globe. Sulzer has been headquartered in Winterthur, Switzerland, since 1834.
Join our APAC team within the Flow division in Australia as a Project Engineer.

What will you be doing?

As a Project Engineer, your responsibilities day to day will include:

• Manage and coordinate customer projects from order intake through to delivery, ensuring scope, quality, budget, and schedule requirements are achieved.

• Provide technical engineering support, including equipment configuration (SAP), data sheets design review against customer specification, and preparation of project documentation and reporting

• Act as the primary interface between customers, sales, engineering, manufacturing, and suppliers to ensure successful project execution.

• supporting the sales team to achieve divisional growth and financial objectives.

• Promote and maintain Sulzer's commitment to safety, quality, and continuous improvement across all project activities.

What you will bring to Sulzer

To be a successful Project Engineer, you will ideally have:

• A Bachelor of Mechanical Engineering or equivalent.

• Demonstrated experience with technical report writing / technical documentation

• Exposure and experience to SAP, D365 ERP, Project Control software such as ACONEX, etc

• Project execution responsibility (scheduling, cost control, documentation and invoicing timely reporting.)

• Strong communication skills.

• Ability to engage and work with others.

• Experience in taking responsibility for order delivery and maintaining stakeholder relationships

What we offer you

• Annual bonus scheme.

• Employee Assistance Program.

• On-site car parking.

• Work for a global organisation that values innovation, excellence and a commitment to the most important part of our business - our people and our customers.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Il Project Engineer è responsabile del supporto alla pianificazione, esecuzione e monitoraggio dei progetti tecnici. Il ruolo consiste nel lavorare in modo indipendente con la supervisione generale e contribuire al successo del progetto attraverso il supporto tecnico e analitico.

A Sulzer, siete autorizzati a fornire risultati superiori. Come pioniere nell'industria, abbiamo un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione e continuiamo a evolversi per il futuro. Unisciti alla nostra storia e crea il tuo impatto sviluppando le tue competenze e soluzioni costruttive che aiutano a rendere le nostre vite più sicure, intelligenti e sostenibili.
Sulzer è un leader globale nell'ingegneria dei fluidi. Siamo specializzati nella pompaggio, agitazione, miscelazione, separazione e tecnologie di purificazione per fluidi di tutti i tipi. I nostri clienti beneficiano del nostro impegno per l'innovazione, le prestazioni e la qualità e della nostra rete reattiva di 180 impianti di produzione e centri di assistenza di livello mondiale in tutto il mondo. Unisciti al nostro team APAC all'interno della divisione Flow in Australia come Project Engineer.

Cosa farai?

Come Ingegnere di Progetto, le vostre responsabilità giorno per giorno includono:

• Gestire e coordinare i progetti dei clienti dall'assunzione dell'ordine alla consegna, assicurando il raggiungimento dei requisiti di portata, qualità, budget e pianificazione.

• Fornire il supporto tecnico dell'ingegneria, compresa la configurazione delle attrezzature (SAP), la revisione della progettazione dei fogli di dati contro le specifiche del cliente, e la preparazione della documentazione del progetto e la segnalazione

• Agire come interfaccia primaria tra clienti, vendite, ingegneria, produzione e fornitori per garantire l'esecuzione di progetto di successo.

• sostenere il team di vendita per raggiungere la crescita divisionale e gli obiettivi finanziari.

• Promuovere e mantenere l'impegno di Sulzer per la sicurezza, la qualità e il miglioramento continuo in tutte le attività del progetto.

Cosa porterai a Sulzer

Per essere un ingegnere di progetto di successo, si avrà idealmente:

• Una laurea in ingegneria meccanica o equivalente.

• Esperienza dimostrata con la scrittura di report tecnici / documentazione tecnica

• Esposizione ed esperienza a SAP, D365 ERP, software di Project Control come ACONEX, ecc

• Responsabilità di esecuzione del progetto (programmazione, controllo dei costi, documentazione e fatturazione report tempestivo.)

• Forte capacità di comunicazione.

• Capacità di impegnarsi e lavorare con gli altri.

• Esperienza nell'assunzione di responsabilità per la consegna degli ordini e il mantenimento delle relazioni con gli stakeholder

Cosa ti offriamo

• Programma di bonus annuale.

• Programma di assistenza ai dipendenti.

• Parcheggio in loco.

• Lavoro per un'organizzazione globale che valorizza l'innovazione, l'eccellenza e l'impegno per la parte più importante del nostro business - la nostra gente e i nostri clienti.

Siamo orgogliosi di essere riconosciuti come Top Employer 2026 in Brasile, Canada, Cina, Finlandia, Germania, Irlanda, Messico, Svizzera, Sud Africa, Regno Unito e Stati Uniti.

Sulzer ist ein führendes Ingenieurunternehmen mit einem stolzen Erbe an Innovationen. Schließen Sie sich unserem globalen Team an, um Ihr Fachwissen zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine prosperierende und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen.

Über die Rolle

Stellenbeschreibung
Der Projektingenieur ist für die Unterstützung der technischen Projektplanung, -durchführung und -überwachung verantwortlich. Die Rolle besteht darin, unabhängig mit der allgemeinen Aufsicht zu arbeiten und durch technische und analytische Unterstützung zum Projekterfolg beizutragen.
Dieses Jobprofil richtet sich an erfahrene Fachkräfte, die praktische Kenntnisse eines Jobbereichs anwenden und unabhängig mit allgemeiner Aufsicht arbeiten. Über uns

Bei Sulzer sind Sie in der Lage, überlegene Ergebnisse zu liefern. Als Pionier in der Industrie haben wir ein stolzes Erbe der Innovation und entwickeln uns weiter für die Zukunft. Schließen Sie sich unserer Geschichte an und schaffen Sie Ihre eigene Wirkung, indem Sie Ihr Fachwissen entwickeln und Lösungen entwickeln, die dazu beitragen, unser Leben sicherer, intelligenter und nachhaltiger zu gestalten.
Sulzer ist ein weltweit führender Anbieter von Fluid Engineering. Wir sind spezialisiert auf Pumpen, Rühren, Mischen, Trennen und Reinigungstechnologien für Flüssigkeiten aller Art. Unsere Kunden profitieren von unserem Engagement für Innovation, Leistung und Qualität sowie von unserem reaktionsschnellen Netzwerk von 180 erstklassigen Produktionsstätten und Servicezentren auf der ganzen Welt. Sulzer hat seinen Hauptsitz seit 1834 in Winterthur, Schweiz.
Treten Sie unserem APAC-Team innerhalb der Flow-Division in Australien als Projektingenieur bei.

Was werden Sie tun?

Als Projektingenieur werden Ihre Aufgaben Tag für Tag umfassen:

• Verwalten und koordinieren Sie Kundenprojekte von der Auftragseingabe bis zur Lieferung, um sicherzustellen, dass Umfang, Qualität, Budget und Zeitplananforderungen erreicht werden.

• Bereitstellung technischer Unterstützung, einschließlich Ausrüstungskonfiguration (SAP), Überprüfung des Entwurfs von Datenblättern anhand der Kundenspezifikation und Vorbereitung der Projektdokumentation und -berichterstattung

• Handeln Sie als primäre Schnittstelle zwischen Kunden, Vertrieb, Engineering, Fertigung und Lieferanten, um eine erfolgreiche Projektdurchführung zu gewährleisten.

• Unterstützung des Verkaufsteams bei der Erreichung von Wachstums- und Finanzzielen.

• Förderung und Aufrechterhaltung des Engagements von Sulzer für Sicherheit, Qualität und kontinuierliche Verbesserung bei allen Projektaktivitäten.

Was Sie nach Sulzer bringen werden

Um ein erfolgreicher Projektingenieur zu sein, haben Sie idealerweise:

• Ein Bachelor of Mechanical Engineering oder gleichwertig.

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung mit technischem Berichtsschreiben / technischer Dokumentation

• Exposition und Erfahrung mit SAP, D365 ERP, Projektsteuerungssoftware wie ACONEX usw.

• Projektausführungsverantwortung (Planung, Kostenkontrolle, Dokumentation und zeitnahe Rechnungsstellung).

• Starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten.

• Fähigkeit, sich zu engagieren und mit anderen zu arbeiten.

• Erfahrung in der Übernahme von Verantwortung für die Auftragslieferung und Pflege von Stakeholder-Beziehungen

Was wir Ihnen bieten

• Jährliche Bonusregelung.

• Mitarbeiterhilfeprogramm.

• Parkplatz vor Ort.

• Arbeiten Sie für eine globale Organisation, die Innovation, Exzellenz und das Engagement für den wichtigsten Teil unseres Geschäfts - unsere Mitarbeiter und unsere Kunden - schätzt.

Sulzer ist ein Arbeitgeber für Chancengleichheit. Wir glauben an die Stärke einer vielfältigen Belegschaft und engagieren uns für ein integratives Arbeitsumfeld.

Wir sind stolz darauf, als Top Employer 2026 in Brasilien, Kanada, China, Finnland, Deutschland, Irland, Mexiko, der Schweiz, Südafrika, Großbritannien und den USA anerkannt zu werden.

L'ingénieur de projet est responsable de la planification, de l'exécution et du suivi des projets techniques. Le rôle consiste à travailler de manière indépendante avec une supervision générale et à contribuer au succès du projet grâce à un soutien technique et analytique.

En tant qu'ingénieur de projet, vos responsabilités quotidiennes comprendront :

• soutenir l'équipe de vente afin d'atteindre la croissance divisionnaire et les objectifs financiers.

• Promouvoir et maintenir l'engagement de Sulzer envers la sécurité, la qualité et l'amélioration continue de toutes les activités du projet.

• Baccalauréat en génie mécanique ou équivalent.

• Expérience démontrée en matière de rédaction de rapports techniques / documentation technique

• Exposition et expérience à SAP, D365 ERP, logiciel de contrôle de projet comme ACONEX, etc

• Responsabilité en matière d'exécution du projet (échéancier, contrôle des coûts, documentation et facturation en temps voulu).

• Fortes compétences en communication.

• Capacité de s'engager et de travailler avec les autres.

• Expérience dans la prise de responsabilité de l'exécution des commandes et le maintien des relations avec les parties prenantes

Ce que nous vous offrons

The Sales Engineering Specialist supports the sales process by providing technical expertise and helping customers understand how products meet their needs. This role bridges the gap between engineering and sales, ensuring technical accuracy and customer satisfaction.
This job profile is intended for professionals who apply advanced knowledge of a job area. Required to manage projects / processes independently with limited supervision. Typically coaches and reviews the work of lower level professionals. We are looking for a Sales Engineer - Western Area End User to join our Flow Division team in Australia .

Your main tasks and responsibilities:

• Planning, support and follow-up of sales activities in line with the sales strategy and defined processes.

• Identify new markets and business opportunities.

• Preparation of technical and commercial proposals in co-operation with the Tendering Team.

• Negotiating tender and contract terms with key accounts, to meet both client and company needs.

• Establishing new, and maintaining existing, long-term relationships with customers.

• Develop and maintain strong relationships with customers and suppliers in order to reduce commercial risk and to maximize future business opportunities.

• Maintain and monitor up to date knowledge of competitor products and activities.

• Meeting regular sales targets

• Providing pre-sales technical assistance and product education

• Solving client challenges

• Providing training and producing support material for the sales team

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• Tertiary Qualification - Mechanical Engineering

• Technical Sales experience and strong product knowledge with pumps and associated equipment

• Solid ability to build and maintain client relationships

• A hunger for achieving sales targets

• The ability to work in a team environment

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
Sulzer Turbo Services is seeking a skilled Machine Tool Technician to support maintenance, repair, and operation of precision machining equipment used in the repair and servicing of turbomachinery components. This role is responsible for ensuring machine tools operate safely, efficiently, and within required tolerances to support high-quality manufacturing and repair operations. Key Responsibilities

• Perform maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of machine tools including manual lathes, surface grinders, milling machines, CNC equipment, and horizontal and vertical machining centers.

• Diagnose mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, and pneumatic issues.

• Perform machine alignments, calibrations, and precision adjustments.

• Install, test, and commission new or rebuilt equipment.

• Maintain preventive maintenance schedules for shop equipment.

• Read and interpret mechanical drawings, blueprints, and technical manuals.

• Support production teams to minimize downtime.

• Ensure compliance with safety policies and OSHA standards.

• Maintain accurate maintenance records and documentation.

• Assist with equipment upgrades and continuous improvement initiatives.

• Observe Company Safety Policy and Procedures; follow and support all STS Safety Policies and ISO Procedures.

• Complete and properly document all tasks assigned by the Maintenance Supervisor.

• Report any mechanical issues identified during inspections to the Maintenance Supervisor.

• Work closely and maintain clear communication with other departments, mechanical personnel, Leadman, and Supervisors.

• Complete all company-required training programs.
Required Qualifications

• High School Diploma or GED required.

• Technical or vocational training in machining, industrial maintenance, or related field preferred.

• 7–10 years’ experience maintaining machine tools or industrial equipment.

• Strong knowledge of machining operations and precision measurement tools.

• Experience with CNC troubleshooting preferred.

• Ability to read schematics and technical drawings.

• Strong mechanical aptitude and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to work independently and within a team environment.
Preferred Skills

• Experience in turbomachinery, rotating equipment, or heavy industrial repair.

• Familiarity with vibration analysis or alignment practices.

• PLC troubleshooting experience is a plus.

• Forklift or overhead crane experience preferred.
Physical Requirements

• Ability to lift up to 50 lbs.

• Standing, bending, and working in an industrial shop environment.

• Ability to work around rotating machinery and heavy equipment.
Work Environment

• Industrial repair and machine shop setting.

• Exposure to noise, moving equipment, oils, and machining materials.

• PPE required at all times.

What we offer you

• 12 Paid Holidays

• 15 Paid Time Off (PTO) Days

• Medical, dental, vision, life & disability

• 401K with 6% company match

• Employee Assistance Program

• Employee Wellness Program

• New onsite cafeteria, all meals subsidized (La Porte Service Center)

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Sul ruolo

Riepilogo del lavoro
Sulzer Turbo Services è alla ricerca di un tecnico specializzato in macchine utensili per supportare la manutenzione, la riparazione e il funzionamento di apparecchiature di lavorazione di precisione utilizzate nella riparazione e assistenza di componenti di turbomacchine. Questo ruolo è responsabile di garantire che le macchine utensili funzionino in modo sicuro, efficiente e entro le tolleranze richieste per supportare operazioni di produzione e riparazione di alta qualità. Responsabilità chiave

• Eseguire la manutenzione, la risoluzione dei problemi e la riparazione di macchine utensili tra cui torni manuali, rettificatrici di superficie, fresatrici, apparecchiature CNC e centri di lavoro orizzontali e verticali.

• Diagnosticare problemi meccanici, elettrici, idraulici e pneumatici.

• Eseguire allineamenti, calibrazioni e regolazioni di precisione della macchina.

• Installare, testare e mettere in servizio apparecchiature nuove o ricostruite.

• Mantenere programmi di manutenzione preventiva per le attrezzature del negozio.

• Leggere e interpretare disegni meccanici, progetti e manuali tecnici.

• Supportare i team di produzione per ridurre al minimo i tempi di inattività.

• Garantire la conformità alle politiche di sicurezza e agli standard OSHA.

• Mantenere registri e documentazione accurati sulla manutenzione.

• Assistere con gli aggiornamenti delle apparecchiature e le iniziative di miglioramento continuo.

• Osservare le politiche e le procedure aziendali in materia di sicurezza; seguire e supportare tutte le politiche di sicurezza e le procedure ISO di STS.

• Completare e documentare adeguatamente tutti i compiti assegnati dal Supervisore della Manutenzione.

• Segnalare eventuali problemi meccanici identificati durante le ispezioni al Supervisore della Manutenzione.

• Lavorare a stretto contatto e mantenere una comunicazione chiara con gli altri reparti, il personale meccanico, il leader e i supervisori.

• Completare tutti i programmi di formazione richiesti dall'azienda.
Qualifiche richieste

• È richiesto il diploma di scuola superiore o il GED.

• È preferibile la formazione tecnica o professionale nella lavorazione meccanica, nella manutenzione industriale o in un settore correlato.

• 7-10 anni di esperienza nella manutenzione di macchine utensili o attrezzature industriali.

• Forte conoscenza delle operazioni di lavorazione e degli strumenti di misurazione di precisione.

• Preferibile esperienza nella risoluzione dei problemi CNC.

• Capacità di leggere schemi e disegni tecnici.

• Forte attitudine meccanica e capacità di problem solving.

• Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e all'interno di un ambiente di squadra.
Competenze preferite

• Esperienza in turbomacchine, apparecchiature rotanti o riparazioni industriali pesanti.

• Familiarità con l'analisi delle vibrazioni o le pratiche di allineamento.

• L'esperienza nella risoluzione dei problemi del PLC è un vantaggio.

• Preferibile esperienza con carrello elevatore o carroponte.
Requisiti fisici

• Capacità di sollevare fino a 50 libbre.

• Stare in piedi, piegarsi e lavorare in un ambiente di officina industriale.

• Capacità di lavorare attorno a macchinari rotanti e attrezzature pesanti.
Ambiente di lavoro

• Riparazioni industriali e allestimenti di officine meccaniche.

• Esposizione a rumore, apparecchiature in movimento, oli e materiali di lavorazione.

• DPI sempre obbligatori.

Cosa ti offriamo

• 12 ferie retribuite

• 15 giorni di ferie retribuite (PTO).

• Medicina, odontoiatria, vista, vita e disabilità

• 401K con una corrispondenza aziendale del 6%.

• Programma di assistenza ai dipendenti

• Programma di benessere dei dipendenti

• Nuova mensa interna, tutti i pasti sovvenzionati (Centro Servizi La Porte)

Sulzer è un datore di lavoro che garantisce pari opportunità. Crediamo nella forza di una forza lavoro diversificata e ci impegniamo a offrire un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo.

Siamo orgogliosi di essere riconosciuti come Top Employer 2026 in Brasile, Canada, Cina, Finlandia, Germania, Irlanda, Messico, Svizzera, Sud Africa, Regno Unito e Stati Uniti.

Über die Rolle

Jobzusammenfassung
Sulzer Turbo Services sucht einen qualifizierten Werkzeugmaschinentechniker zur Unterstützung bei Wartung, Reparatur und Betrieb von Präzisionsbearbeitungsgeräten, die bei der Reparatur und Wartung von Turbomaschinenkomponenten verwendet werden. Diese Rolle ist dafür verantwortlich, dass Werkzeugmaschinen sicher, effizient und innerhalb der erforderlichen Toleranzen arbeiten, um qualitativ hochwertige Fertigungs- und Reparaturvorgänge zu unterstützen. Hauptaufgaben

• Führen Sie Wartung, Fehlerbehebung und Reparatur von Werkzeugmaschinen durch, einschließlich Handdrehmaschinen, Flachschleifmaschinen, Fräsmaschinen, CNC-Geräten sowie horizontalen und vertikalen Bearbeitungszentren.

• Diagnostizieren Sie mechanische, elektrische, hydraulische und pneumatische Probleme.

• Führen Sie Maschinenausrichtungen, Kalibrierungen und Präzisionseinstellungen durch.

• Neue oder umgebaute Geräte installieren, testen und in Betrieb nehmen.

• Halten Sie vorbeugende Wartungspläne für die Werkstattausrüstung ein.

• Lesen und interpretieren Sie mechanische Zeichnungen, Blaupausen und technische Handbücher.

• Unterstützen Sie Produktionsteams, um Ausfallzeiten zu minimieren.

• Stellen Sie die Einhaltung von Sicherheitsrichtlinien und OSHA-Standards sicher.

• Führen Sie genaue Wartungsaufzeichnungen und -dokumentationen.

• Unterstützung bei Geräte-Upgrades und kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsinitiativen.

• Beachten Sie die Sicherheitsrichtlinien und -verfahren des Unternehmens. Befolgen und unterstützen Sie alle STS-Sicherheitsrichtlinien und ISO-Verfahren.

• Führen Sie alle vom Wartungsleiter zugewiesenen Aufgaben aus und dokumentieren Sie sie ordnungsgemäß.

• Melden Sie alle bei Inspektionen festgestellten mechanischen Probleme dem Wartungsleiter.

• Arbeiten Sie eng zusammen und pflegen Sie eine klare Kommunikation mit anderen Abteilungen, mechanischem Personal, Leadman und Vorgesetzten.

• Absolvieren Sie alle vom Unternehmen geforderten Schulungsprogramme.
Erforderliche Qualifikationen

• High-School-Diplom oder GED erforderlich.

• Wünschenswert ist eine technische oder berufliche Ausbildung in den Bereichen Zerspanung, industrielle Wartung oder einem verwandten Bereich.

• 7–10 Jahre Erfahrung in der Wartung von Werkzeugmaschinen oder Industrieanlagen.

• Umfangreiche Kenntnisse über Bearbeitungsvorgänge und Präzisionsmesswerkzeuge.

• Erfahrung mit CNC-Fehlerbehebung wünschenswert.

• Fähigkeit, Schaltpläne und technische Zeichnungen zu lesen.

• Ausgeprägte mechanische Begabung und Problemlösungsfähigkeiten.

• Fähigkeit, unabhängig und in einer Teamumgebung zu arbeiten.
Bevorzugte Fähigkeiten

• Erfahrung im Bereich Turbomaschinen, rotierende Anlagen oder Schwerindustriereparatur.

• Vertrautheit mit Vibrationsanalyse- oder Ausrichtungspraktiken.

• Erfahrung in der SPS-Fehlerbehebung ist von Vorteil.

• Erfahrung mit Gabelstaplern oder Laufkranen wünschenswert.
Körperliche Anforderungen

• Fähigkeit, bis zu 50 Pfund zu heben.

• Stehen, Bücken und Arbeiten in einer industriellen Werkstattumgebung.

• Fähigkeit, in der Nähe rotierender Maschinen und schwerer Geräte zu arbeiten.
Arbeitsumgebung

• Industriereparatur und Maschinenwerkstatteinrichtung.

• Belastung durch Lärm, bewegliche Geräte, Öle und Bearbeitungsmaterialien.

• Persönliche Schutzausrüstung ist jederzeit erforderlich.

Was wir Ihnen bieten

• 12 bezahlte Feiertage

• 15 bezahlte Freizeittage (PTO).

• Medizin, Zahnmedizin, Sehkraft, Leben und Behinderung

• 401K mit 6 % Unternehmensübereinstimmung

Résumé du poste
Sulzer Turbo Services recherche un technicien de machines-outils qualifié pour prendre en charge la maintenance, la réparation et l'exploitation des équipements d'usinage de précision utilisés dans la réparation et l'entretien des composants de turbomachines. • Effectuer l'entretien, le dépannage et la réparation des machines-outils, notamment les tours manuels, les meuleuses planes, les fraiseuses, les équipements CNC et les centres d'usinage horizontaux et verticaux.

• Solide connaissance des opérations d'usinage et des outils de mesure de précision.

• Expérience en dépannage CNC préférée.

• Capacité à lire des schémas et des dessins techniques.

• Fortes aptitudes en mécanique et compétences en résolution de problèmes.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sr. Project Manager is responsible for managing experienced professionals and implementing short-term strategies and policies. The role includes overseeing technical projects, ensuring quality standards, and influencing cross-functional stakeholders.
This job profile is intended for People Managers of 4+ experienced to senior expert-level employees. This job and its associated grade are specifically aligned with roles that have the following scope of responsibility: Large, Division / Extra Large organization.

Key Responsibilities
Lead and manage technical project teams.
Develop and monitor project plans, schedules, and budgets.
Conduct risk assessments and implement mitigation strategies.
Ensure quality standards and project deliverables are met.
Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders.
Skills & Qualifications
Typically a University degree (or equivalent work experience) and 9+ years of relevant work experienceare minimally required to be able to manage and coordinate one or more expert-level teams.
Required Skills:

Strong leadership and team management skills.
Proficiency in project management tools and techniques.
Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
Effective communication and problem-solving abilities.
Experience in technical project environments.

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Employee Assistance Program

• Gym reimbursement

Sur le rôle

Résumé de l'emploi
Le gestionnaire de projet principal est chargé de gérer les professionnels expérimentés et de mettre en oeuvre des stratégies et des politiques à court terme. Le rôle consiste à superviser les projets techniques, à assurer des normes de qualité et à influencer les intervenants interfonctionnels.
Ce profil d'emploi s'adresse aux gestionnaires de ressources humaines de plus de 4 employés expérimentés de niveau expert supérieur. Ce travail et la note qui y est associée sont particulièrement alignés sur les rôles qui ont la portée de responsabilité suivante : Grande, Division / Extra Grande organisation.

Principales responsabilités
Diriger et gérer les équipes de projets techniques.
Élaborer et surveiller les plans, les calendriers et les budgets des projets.
Effectuer des évaluations des risques et mettre en oeuvre des stratégies d'atténuation.
Veiller à ce que les normes de qualité et les produits livrables du projet soient respectés.
Coordonner avec les intervenants internes et externes.
Compétences et qualifications
En règle générale, un diplôme universitaire (ou une expérience de travail équivalente) et plus de 9 ans d'expérience de travail pertinente sont requis au minimum pour pouvoir gérer et coordonner une ou plusieurs équipes de niveau expert.
Compétences requises :

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Accounting Officer is responsible for supporting accounting operations including data entry, reconciliations, and assisting with financial reporting. This role ensures accuracy in financial records and supports compliance with accounting standards. This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyse problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. About the Role

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and contribute to delivering high-quality financial services that support a prosperous and more sustainable society.

Join our Finance team in Madrid as an Invoicing & Collection Clerk . In this role, you will be responsible for managing invoicing and accounts receivable activities, ensuring timely collections, maintaining accurate financial records, and supporting efficient accounting operations across the organization. You will work closely with internal stakeholders, external providers, and Sulzer entities worldwide to ensure smooth and effective financial processes

Your Main Tasks and Responsibilities

• Manage the accounts receivable process, ensuring timely and accurate customer invoicing.

• Monitor incoming payments and proactively follow up on overdue accounts.

• Perform collection activities and support the resolution of outstanding receivables.

• Reconcile customer accounts and investigate discrepancies or billing issues.

• Assist in the preparation of financial reports related to receivables and collections.

• Maintain and update customer and financial master data.

• Support intercompany invoice matching activities during month-end closing.

• Collaborate with internal departments to identify opportunities for process improvements and increased efficiency.

• Coordinate with the external service provider responsible for OTC and RTR activities.

• Build strong relationships with key stakeholders, including Group FP&A, Treasury, Tax & RE functions, and Sulzer subsidiaries.

To Succeed in This Role, You Will Need

• Degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.

• Ideally 3 years of experience in Accounts Receivable, invoicing, or collection management.

• Good understanding of accounting principles and financial processes.

• Experience working with SAP FI/CO as a user.

• Strong knowledge of Microsoft Excel, including formulas, functions, and pivot tables.

• Professional English communication skills (B2/C1 level). German would be a plus.

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

• Ability to work independently while maintaining a collaborative and team-oriented mindset.

• Customer-focused approach with strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

• Resilience, adaptability, and a proactive attitude toward change and continuous improvement.

What we offer you

• Permanent position within a globally recognised industrial technology leader.

• Competitive salary.

• Annual bonus scheme.

• Meal vouchers.

• Opportunity to work with cutting-edge Data & AI technologies.

• International exposure working with stakeholders across multiple business domains.

• Career growth opportunities within a global organisation.

• Modern offices located in Nuevos Ministerios, Madrid.

jobs.title: Quality Control Inspector (Goods In)
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Key
• Responsibilities

Perform inspection of incoming gas turbine components, materials, and assemblies to ensure compliance with engineering drawings, specifications, purchase orders, OEM requirements, and customer standards.
Conduct dimensional, visual, and documentation inspections using appropriate measuring equipment and inspection techniques.
Review and verify material certificates, certificates of conformity, inspection reports, and supplier documentation to ensure compliance and traceability requirements are met.
Inspect turbine rotors, casings, shafts, blades, vanes, bearings, fasteners, and associated components for conformity prior to release into production.
Identify, document, and support the resolution of non-conforming materials through established quality management processes.
Maintain accurate inspection records and support internal, customer, and third-party quality audits.
Support the implementation and continuous improvement of QA/QC procedures, standards, and inspection practices.
Monitor and provide feedback on supplier quality performance and incoming product quality trends.
Liaise with the Inspection Supervisor, Engineering, Procurement, Project Engineers, and Production teams to resolve quality-related issues and minimise disruption to repair and overhaul activities.
Ensure all inspection activities are performed in accordance with Sulzer quality procedures, customer requirements, and applicable industry standards.

Required Skills:

Experience in a Quality Control, QA/QC, or Inspection role within an engineering or manufacturing environment.
Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, specifications, technical documentation, and manufacturing standards.
Experience using precision measuring equipment such as verniers, micrometres, bore gauges, height gauges.
Understanding of material certification, traceability, and quality documentation requirements.
Knowledge of dimensional inspection techniques and engineering tolerances.
Strong attention to detail and a methodical approach to inspection activities.
Good communication and documentation skills.
Familiarity with supplier quality management, non-conformance reporting, and root cause investigations.
Competent in Microsoft Office applications.

Desirable Skills

Experience inspecting gas turbine, steam turbine, compressor, pump, or other rotating equipment components.
Understanding of OEM quality requirements and repair documentation.
Knowledge of ISO 9001 quality management systems.
Experience using quality management systems.

What we offer you

Competitive base salary
Inclusion in a company-wide bonus program
Attractive overtime pay scheme
33 days of annual leave
Private medical insurance
On-site parking
Access to various discounts on everyday shopping, entertainment, and lifestyle
An Employee Assistance Programme offering confidential support services, including counselling and resources to help manage personal and work-related issues, enhancing overall well-being and productivity
Continuous learning and development opportunities through on-the-job training and Sulzer Learning Pathways, our dedicated online platform for professional growth

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.
