descriptionByLocale.fr:
Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable.

Sur le rôle

Le gestionnaire de l'impôt US Holding est chargé d'appuyer les activités de conformité, de déclaration et de planification fiscales. Ce rôle assure l'exactitude des déclarations fiscales et contribue à la stratégie fiscale de l'organisation.

Ce profil d'emploi est destiné aux professionnels spécialisés qui appliquent des connaissances avancées d'un domaine d'emploi. Requis pour gérer les projets/processus de manière indépendante avec une supervision limitée. En général, il entraîne et examine le travail des professionnels de niveau inférieur.
Responsable des questions fiscales des personnes morales désignées, y compris la conformité fiscale fédérale, étatique et internationale et la comptabilisation de l'impôt sur le revenu (dispositions fiscales). Responsable également de la documentation relative aux prix de transfert des personnes morales désignées. C'est un poste de gestionnaire de travail.

Principales responsabilités :

• Responsable de la gestion de l'ensemble des activités de déclaration fiscale des personnes morales désignées et de l'aide à la réduction des coûts fiscaux des opérations proposées en identifiant des méthodes favorables de déclaration des faits et en formulant les plans d'action nécessaires.

• Préparation et regroupement des déclarations et des comptes d'exercice du gouvernement fédéral, des États et de la communauté internationale des États-Unis, ainsi que des documents de travail et des études pour assurer la détermination et la déclaration appropriées de l'impôt sur le revenu des sociétés dans chaque province et territoire.

• Déterminer et contrôler les paiements estimatifs d'impôt sur le revenu pour maximiser la déclaration des actifs.

• Préparation des réponses aux demandes d'information des organismes fiscaux en temps opportun et de façon exacte; recherche et défense des positions prises sur les déclarations de la société; recommandation et préparation des protestations aux questions de vérification contestées afin de s'assurer que les cotisations fiscales supplémentaires sont réduites au minimum.

• Surveiller et analyser les lois, règlements et tribunaux fédéraux, étatiques et étrangers proposés et récemment adoptés par les États-Unis afin de s'assurer que des procédures adéquates sont en place pour réduire au minimum les impôts sur le revenu de l'entreprise et les déclarer avec exactitude.

• Aider à la planification fiscale en préparant des analyses des opérations passées et proposées dans le but de présenter des solutions de rechange ou une recommandation visant à réduire les dépenses fiscales.

• Encourager les gestionnaires et autres membres du personnel des personnes morales désignées à demander des conseils fiscaux au besoin.

• Coopération avec des personnes/organismes externes et internes, y compris les autorités fiscales extérieures - Finances et personnel de contrôle pour les personnes morales américaines et étrangères - Consultants fiscaux extérieurs

• Tâche de gestion : Gestion indirecte du personnel de l'entreprise liée en réponse aux demandes de renseignements fiscaux et conseils sur les conséquences fiscales des opérations.

Expérience/compétences :

• Nécessite un baccalauréat ou plus d'un collège ou d'une université (préférez un master en fiscalité)

• CPA actuel, préféré

• Expérience avec une disposition fiscale à la source et un logiciel d'impôt à la source, préféré

• Expérience professionnelle antérieure en comptabilité publique, préférée

• Au moins 7 ans d'expérience requise en matière d'impôt sur le revenu des sociétés et de conformité

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sr. Process Engineer is responsible for supporting the development and optimization of manufacturing processes. This role applies practical engineering knowledge to improve efficiency, quality, and safety in production environments.
This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. Job Description: Senior Industrial Engineer

Job Title: Senior Industrial Engineer

Location
Sulzer Production Facility (Global/Regional Site)

Reporting To
Global Head Operations Excellence
Purpose of the Job
The Senior Industrial Engineer is responsible for driving operational excellence, productivity improvements, factory optimization, and manufacturing system design across Sulzer operations. The role combines industrial engineering expertise, lean manufacturing principles, digital manufacturing tools, and factory design methodologies to improve safety, quality, delivery, cost, and sustainability performance.

The position supports both local manufacturing operations and global operations initiatives through value stream optimization, standard work development, capacity planning, line balancing, factory layout design, and deployment of the Sulzer Excellence System (SES). The engineer will lead data-driven improvement projects and support the development of future-state manufacturing systems utilizing digital twins, simulation, and advanced manufacturing technologies.

Main Tasks and Responsibilities

Industrial Engineering & Operational Excellence

• Lead productivity improvement and cost reduction initiatives across manufacturing operations.

• Conduct time studies, motion studies, and video-based manufacturing method analysis using tools such as AVIX.

• Develop and maintain standard work instructions and work combination sheets.

• Perform line balancing and workload optimization to improve flow and labor efficiency.

• Calculate labour standards and manufacturing performance metrics.

• Analyse bottlenecks and implement sustainable corrective actions.

• Support capacity planning and resource optimization activities.

• Conduct overall equipment effectiveness (OEE) analysis and improvement projects.

• Utilize industrial engineering methodologies to improve throughput, quality, and operational performance.
Lean Manufacturing & Sulzer Excellence System

• Drive implementation of Sulzer Excellence System (SES) principles.

• Facilitate Value Stream Mapping (VSM) and future-state design workshops.

• Lead Kaizen, continuous improvement, and waste elimination initiatives.

• Implement pull systems, supermarket concepts, and material flow improvements.

• Support visual management, workplace organization, and 5S deployment.

• Develop and monitor KPI dashboards for operational performance.

• Coach production teams on Lean methodologies and problem-solving techniques.
Factory Design & Digital Manufacturing

• Create and maintain factory layouts and manufacturing line designs.

• Design factory and production flows using Visual Components and AutoCAD.

• Generate digital twins of manufacturing areas and production systems.

• Model equipment, fixtures, tools, lifting devices, and visual management solutions.

• Define material flow concepts and ergonomic workstation designs.

• Support simulation and validation of manufacturing concepts through digital modelling.

• Arrange production areas considering safety, infrastructure, and operational constraints.

Manufacturing Process Improvement

• Lead process optimization projects from concept through implementation.

• Conduct process failure mode and effects analysis (PFMEA).

• Develop process flow diagrams and manufacturing process maps.

• Identify opportunitie

Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile.

Informazioni sul ruolo

Sintesi del lavoro
L'Ingegnere di Processo Sr. è responsabile del supporto allo sviluppo e all'ottimizzazione dei processi produttivi. Questo ruolo applica conoscenze ingegneristiche pratiche per migliorare l'efficienza, la qualità e la sicurezza negli ambienti di produzione.
Questo profilo di lavoro è destinato a professionisti esperti che applicano la conoscenza pratica di un'area di lavoro e lavorano indipendentemente con la supervisione generale. Descrizione del lavoro: Ingegnere industriale senior

Titolo del lavoro: Ingegnere industriale senior

Location
Facilità di produzione del Sulzer (Sito Globale/Regionale)

Relazione a
Eccellenza Global Head Operations
Scopo del lavoro
L'Ingegnere Industriale Senior è responsabile della guida di eccellenza operativa, miglioramenti della produttività, ottimizzazione della fabbrica e progettazione del sistema di produzione attraverso le operazioni di Sulzer. Il ruolo combina competenze di ingegneria industriale, principi di produzione magra, strumenti di produzione digitale e metodologie di progettazione di fabbrica per migliorare la sicurezza, la qualità, la consegna, i costi e le prestazioni di sostenibilità.

La posizione supporta sia le operazioni di produzione locali che le iniziative operative globali attraverso l'ottimizzazione del flusso di valore, lo sviluppo del lavoro standard, la pianificazione della capacità, il bilanciamento della linea, la progettazione del layout di fabbrica e l'implementazione del Sistema di Eccellenza di Sulzer (SES). L'ingegnere porterà progetti di miglioramento basati sui dati e supporterà lo sviluppo di sistemi di produzione a stato futuro utilizzando gemelli digitali, simulazioni e tecnologie di produzione avanzate.

Compiti e responsabilità principali

Ingegneria industriale e eccellenza operativa

• Condurre iniziative di miglioramento della produttività e riduzione dei costi nelle operazioni di produzione.

• Condurre studi di tempo, studi di movimento e analisi dei metodi di produzione basati su video utilizzando strumenti come AVIX.

• Sviluppare e mantenere istruzioni di lavoro standard e fogli di combinazione di lavoro.

• Eseguire l'ottimizzazione del bilanciamento della linea e del carico di lavoro per migliorare l'efficienza del flusso e del lavoro.

• Calcola gli standard del lavoro e le metriche delle prestazioni di produzione.

• Analizzare i colli di bottiglia e implementare azioni correttive sostenibili.

• Supporta la pianificazione delle capacità e le attività di ottimizzazione delle risorse.

• Condurre i progetti di analisi e miglioramento dell'efficienza complessiva delle attrezzature (OEE).

• Utilizzare metodologie di ingegneria industriale per migliorare la produttività, la qualità e le prestazioni operative.
Lean Manufacturing & Sulzer Excellence System

• L'implementazione di Sulzer Excellence System (SES) principi.

• Facilitate Value Stream Mapping (VSM) e workshop di progettazione futuro-stato.

• Piombo Kaizen, miglioramento continuo e iniziative di eliminazione dei rifiuti.

• Implementare sistemi di pull, concetti di supermercato e miglioramenti del flusso materiale.

• Supporta la gestione visiva, l'organizzazione del lavoro e la distribuzione 5S.

• Sviluppare e monitorare cruscotti KPI per prestazioni operative.

• Squadre di produzione di coach sulle metodologie di Lean e tecniche di problem solving.
Progettazione di fabbrica e produzione digitale

• Creare e mantenere layout di fabbrica e progetti di linea di produzione.

• Flussi di produzione e di fabbrica utilizzando Componenti Visivi e AutoCAD.

• Generare gemelli digitali di aree di produzione e sistemi di produzione.

• Apparecchiature di modello, apparecchi, strumenti, dispositivi di sollevamento e soluzioni di gestione visiva.

• Definire i concetti di flusso dei materiali e i progetti ergonomici delle workstation.

• Supporta la simulazione e la convalida dei concetti di produzione attraverso la modellazione digitale.

• Organizzare aree di produzione in considerazione di sicurezza, infrastrutture e vincoli operativi.

Miglioramento dei processi produttivi

• Progetti di ottimizzazione del processo di piombo dal concetto attraverso l'implementazione.

• Condurre modalità di guasto del processo e analisi degli effetti (PFMEA).

• Sviluppare diagrammi di flusso di processo e mappe di processo di produzione.

• Identificare l'opportunita'

Sulzer ist ein führendes Ingenieurunternehmen mit einem stolzen Erbe an Innovationen. Schließen Sie sich unserem globalen Team an, um Ihr Fachwissen zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine prosperierende und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen.

Über die Rolle

Stellenbeschreibung
Der Senior Process Engineer ist für die Unterstützung der Entwicklung und Optimierung von Fertigungsprozessen verantwortlich. Diese Rolle wendet praktisches Ingenieurwissen an, um Effizienz, Qualität und Sicherheit in Produktionsumgebungen zu verbessern.
Dieses Jobprofil richtet sich an erfahrene Fachkräfte, die praktische Kenntnisse eines Jobbereichs anwenden und unabhängig mit allgemeiner Aufsicht arbeiten. Stellenbeschreibung: Senior Industrial Engineer

Berufsbezeichnung: Senior Industrial Engineer

Standort
Sulzer Produktionsstätte (Global/Regional Site)

Berichterstattung
Global Head Operations Excellence
Zweck des Auftrags
Der Senior Industrial Engineer ist verantwortlich für die Förderung von operativer Exzellenz, Produktivitätsverbesserungen, Fabrikoptimierung und Fertigungssystemdesign im gesamten Sulzer-Betrieb. Die Rolle kombiniert Industrietechnik-Know-how, Lean-Fertigungsprinzipien, digitale Fertigungswerkzeuge und Fabrikdesign-Methoden, um Sicherheit, Qualität, Lieferung, Kosten und Nachhaltigkeitsleistung zu verbessern.

Die Position unterstützt sowohl lokale Fertigungsbetriebe als auch globale Betriebsinitiativen durch Wertstromoptimierung, Standardarbeitsentwicklung, Kapazitätsplanung, Linienausgleich, Fabriklayout-Design und den Einsatz des Sulzer Excellence Systems (SES). Der Ingenieur wird datengesteuerte Verbesserungsprojekte leiten und die Entwicklung zukünftiger Fertigungssysteme mit digitalen Zwillingen, Simulation und fortschrittlichen Fertigungstechnologien unterstützen.

Hauptaufgaben und Zuständigkeiten

Industrial Engineering & Operational Excellence

• Führen Sie Produktivitätsverbesserungs- und Kostensenkungsinitiativen in allen Fertigungsbetrieben.

• Führen Sie Zeitstudien, Bewegungsstudien und videobasierte Fertigungsmethodenanalyse mit Tools wie AVIX durch.

• Entwicklung und Pflege von Standardarbeitsanweisungen und Arbeitskombinationsblättern.

• Führen Sie Linienausgleich und Workload-Optimierung durch, um die Fluss- und Arbeitseffizienz zu verbessern.

• Berechnen Sie Arbeitsstandards und Produktionsleistungskennzahlen.

• Engpässe analysieren und nachhaltige Korrekturmaßnahmen umsetzen.

• Unterstützung der Kapazitätsplanung und Ressourcenoptimierung.

• Durchführung von Gesamtanlageneffektivitätsanalysen und -verbesserungsprojekten.

• Verwenden Sie industrielle Engineering-Methoden, um Durchsatz, Qualität und Betriebsleistung zu verbessern.
Lean Manufacturing & Sulzer Excellence System

• Umsetzung der Prinzipien des Sulzer Excellence Systems (SES).

• Erleichterung von Value Stream Mapping (VSM) und Future-State-Design-Workshops.

• Führen Sie Kaizen, kontinuierliche Verbesserung und Abfallbeseitigungsinitiativen.

• Implementieren Sie Pull-Systeme, Supermarktkonzepte und Materialflussverbesserungen.

• Unterstützen Sie visuelles Management, Arbeitsplatzorganisation und 5S-Bereitstellung.

• Entwicklung und Überwachung von KPI-Dashboards für die operative Leistung.

• Coach-Produktionsteams zu Lean-Methoden und Problemlösungstechniken.
Factory Design & Digital Manufacturing

• Erstellen und pflegen Sie Fabriklayouts und Fertigungsliniendesigns.

• Design Fabrik- und Produktionsflüsse mit Visual Components und AutoCAD.

• Generieren Sie digitale Zwillinge von Produktionsbereichen und Produktionssystemen.

• Modellausrüstung, Vorrichtungen, Werkzeuge, Hebevorrichtungen und visuelle Managementlösungen.

• Definieren Sie Materialflusskonzepte und ergonomische Arbeitsplatzdesigns.

• Unterstützung der Simulation und Validierung von Fertigungskonzepten durch digitale Modellierung.

• Ordnen Sie Produktionsbereiche unter Berücksichtigung von Sicherheit, Infrastruktur und betrieblichen Einschränkungen.

Verbesserung des Herstellungsprozesses

• Führen Sie Prozessoptimierungsprojekte vom Konzept bis zur Umsetzung.

• Durchführung einer Prozessfehler- und Effektanalyse (PFMEA).

• Entwicklung von Prozessflussdiagrammen und Fertigungsprozesskarten.

• Möglichkeit identifizieren
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable.

Sur le rôle

Résumé de l'emploi
Le Sr. Process Engineer est chargé de soutenir le développement et l'optimisation des processus de fabrication. Ce rôle applique les connaissances pratiques en ingénierie pour améliorer l'efficacité, la qualité et la sécurité dans les environnements de production.
Ce profil d'emploi est destiné aux professionnels expérimentés qui appliquent les connaissances pratiques d'un domaine d'emploi et travaillent indépendamment avec une supervision générale. Description du travail: Ingénieur industriel principal

Titre du travail: Ingénieur industriel principal

Lieu
Installation de production de sulzer (site mondial/régional)

Rapports
Excellence des opérations du chef mondial
Objet du travail
L'ingénieur industriel principal est responsable de l'excellence opérationnelle, de l'amélioration de la productivité, de l'optimisation des usines et de la conception des systèmes de fabrication dans l'ensemble des opérations de Sulzer. Ce rôle combine l'expertise en ingénierie industrielle, les principes de fabrication maigre, les outils de fabrication numériques et les méthodologies de conception d'usine pour améliorer la sécurité, la qualité, la livraison, le coût et la performance de durabilité.

Le poste appuie à la fois les opérations de fabrication locales et les initiatives d'opérations mondiales par l'optimisation des flux de valeur, le développement de travaux standard, la planification des capacités, l'équilibrage des lignes, la conception de la disposition des usines et le déploiement du Sulzer Excellence System (SES). L'ingénieur dirigera des projets d'amélioration axés sur les données et appuiera le développement de systèmes de fabrication à l'avenir utilisant des jumelles numériques, des simulations et des technologies de fabrication de pointe.

Principales tâches et responsabilités

Génie industriel et excellence opérationnelle

• Diriger les initiatives d'amélioration de la productivité et de réduction des coûts dans toutes les activités manufacturières.

• Effectuer des études de temps, des études de mouvement et des analyses de méthodes de fabrication vidéo à l'aide d'outils comme AVIX.

• Élaborer et maintenir des instructions de travail normalisées et des feuilles de combinaisons de travail.

• Effectuer l'équilibrage des lignes et l'optimisation de la charge de travail pour améliorer le débit et l'efficacité du travail.

• Calculer les normes du travail et les paramètres de rendement de la fabrication.

• Analyser les goulets d'étranglement et mettre en œuvre des mesures correctives durables.

• Appuyer les activités de planification des capacités et d'optimisation des ressources.

• Mener des projets d'analyse et d'amélioration de l'efficacité globale de l'équipement.

• Utiliser des méthodes d'ingénierie industrielle pour améliorer le débit, la qualité et la performance opérationnelle.
Lean Manufacturing & Sulzer Excellence System

• Diriger la mise en oeuvre des principes du Sulzer Excellence System (SES).

• Faciliter la cartographie du flux de valeur (VSM) et les ateliers de conception d'états futurs.

• Diriger les initiatives Kaizen, d'amélioration continue et d'élimination des déchets.

• Mettre en oeuvre des systèmes de traction, des concepts de supermarchés et des améliorations du débit des matériaux.

• Appuyer la gestion visuelle, l'organisation en milieu de travail et le déploiement de la 5S.

• Élaborer et surveiller des tableaux de bord KPI pour le rendement opérationnel.

• Coach équipes de production sur les méthodologies Lean et les techniques de résolution de problèmes.
Conception d'usine et fabrication numérique

• Créer et entretenir des plans d'usine et des conceptions de lignes de fabrication.

• Concevoir des flux d'usine et de production en utilisant Visual Components et AutoCAD.

• Générer des jumelles numériques de zones de fabrication et de systèmes de production.

• Équipement modèle, installations, outils, appareils de levage et solutions de gestion visuelle.

• Définir les concepts de flux de matériaux et les conceptions ergonomiques des postes de travail.

• Soutenir la simulation et la validation des concepts de fabrication par la modélisation numérique.

• Organiser les zones de production en tenant compte des contraintes liées à la sécurité, à l'infrastructure et à l'exploitation.

Amélioration des procédés de fabrication

• Diriger les projets d'optimisation des processus du concept à la mise en oeuvre.

• Procéder à l'analyse des modes et des effets de défaillance du processus (AEMFP).

• Élaborer des diagrammes de processus et des cartes des processus de fabrication.

• Identifier les possibilités

jobs.title: Inside Sales Associate
jobs.description:

The Inside Sales Representative is responsible for managing assigned house accounts and providing comprehensive sales and customer service support for industrial service projects. • Project related communications (status updates, milestone communications, etc) – Customer/ ASM/ Operations where required

• Support ASM in facilitating customer visits where required (including witness test runs, TDI review, etc)

• Support development of sales process SOP’s and document templates

• Salesforce and D365 admin tasks – inactive customer accounts, house account related contacts, etc

• Participate in weekly production/ WIP meetings – coordinate and communicate sales related actions as required

• Coordinate commercial tasks of customer motor storage – quotes, PO’s, customer documentation where required

• Coordination and support of new customer onboarding

Required Experience:

• Excellent verbal and written communications skills

• Strong listening and presentation skills

• Fluent in reading and speaking both English and Spanish

• Ability to multi-task, prioritize, and manage time effectively

• Required to work in the office including overtime as required

• Required to work flexible and to respond to client emergencies.

• Computer skills including email, internet, data entry and MS Excel

Preferred Experience:

• Experience working with Salesforce.com or similar CRM

jobs.title: Mechanical Design Engineer ( Project Manager )
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Sulzer Wexford is looking for a Mechanical Design Engineer ( Project Manager ) that is product development focussed, giving you responsibility from concept through to prototype, testing, and successful product introduction.

You’ll help lead the next generation of submersible pumps and agitators, supporting our mission to deliver high‑performance, high‑reliability solutions for water recycling and sustainable operations worldwide.
About Sulzer Wexford
With over 250+ employees on site, Sulzer Wexford is a key engineering and manufacturing hub within Sulzer’s global network. The team’s work underpins critical water recycling, sustainability, and energy‑efficiency solutions used around the world.

What you’ll be doing

• Lead end‑to‑end product development projects using best‑practice project management methods.

• Design and develop new products, primarily submersible pumps and agitators — translating requirements into high‑performance, high‑reliability solutions.

• Oversee the build, test, and validation of prototypes, including detailed reporting, interpretation, and analysis of results.

• Support smooth introduction of new products into manufacturing and global markets.

• Act as the point of contact, collaborating with customers, suppliers, and internal teams to ensure engineering, quality, and commercial alignment.

Who will succeed here?

• You will hold a formal qualification in Mechanical Engineering

• Someone able to translate requirements into practical, innovative product solutions

• A hands‑on problem solver with experience in testing, analysis, and validation

• A confident communicator comfortable working with diverse stakeholders

• Someone excited by the opportunity to influence the next generation of engineered products

What we offer you

• A competitive base salary

• Flex time with core hours of 09:30–14:30

• 26 days annual leave

• A defined pension contribution

• Free on‑site parking with reduced‑rate EV charging

• Subsidised on‑site canteen

• Maternity/paternity leave top‑up

• Access to Sulzer Learning Pathways for continuous professional development

• Genuine opportunities for international mobility and long‑term progression

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Senior Commercial Contracts Manager
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job purpose
Short and concise statement of the primary role / function of the position within its organizational unit. Basically, answering the question: "Why does this position exist?”
The Global Head of Commercial Operations is responsible for leading the commercial management of Sulzer’s global claims portfolio, driving strong commercial and customer outcomes across complex, high-value projects within the oil & gas, industrial, and energy sectors. This is a senior, strategic and operational role leading a team of commercial contract managers, ensuring robust contract interpretation, commercial positioning, and delivery of business objectives, whilst operating at the interface between customers, EPC partners, and internal stakeholders. Working closely with the Global Head of Legal Excellence, the role combines strategic customer relationship management with hands-on engagement in complex commercial matters, requiring strong international experience, sound judgement, and a collaborative leadership approach within dynamic, fast-paced environments.

Main selling points of the job (for recruiting)

• Global leadership role at the heart of commercial operations: Lead the commercial management of a complex, high-value global claims portfolio, directly influencing customer outcomes, contractual positions, and business performance.

• Strategic and operational customer ownership: Operate at the interface with international customers and EPC partners, combining strategic relationship management with hands-on commercial and contractual engagement.

• Build and lead a high-performing commercial team: Shape, lead, and develop a team of commercial contract managers, driving performance, capability, and alignment to the Claims Management strategy.

• Partner with senior leadership to deliver business goals: Work closely with the Global Head of Legal Excellence, playing a key role in executing strategy and translating business priorities into operational delivery.

• Dynamic, high-impact environment with real autonomy: Thrive in a fast-paced, evolving global function requiring agility, sound judgement, and a hands-on approach—ideal for someone who enjoys ownership, complexity, and making a tangible impact.

Main accountabilities and tasks (include KPIs and ESH requirements, if available)
What is the job holder doing/expected to do and how is it done? Essential, permanent key responsibilities, measured by specific KPIs, as applicable (e.g. financial, production KPIs, project milestones etc.)
This role carries direct accountability for delivering measurable Contribution and EBITDA improvement through disciplined, data-driven claims management.

Global Claims Portfolio Management
Lead and manage the full global claims portfolio, ensuring effective handling of complex, high-value and cross-border claims, delivering strong financial outcomes and reduction in claim exposure. Direct line management responsiblity for the global aftersales warranty team.
Commercial Strategy & Contractual Positioning
Define and drive commercial strategies and contractual positions, including negotiation approach, settlement decisions, and recovery opportunities from customers, EPCs, and suppliers.
Customer & EPC Relationship Management
Own senior customer and EPC relationships, acting as the primary commercial interface to resolve escalated claims while maintaining long-term customer trust and value.
Team Leadership & Performance Management
Lead, develop, and manage a global team of commercial contract managers, driving accountability, capability, and delivery against business objectives and KPIs.
Cross-Functional Alignment & Integration
Align Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Legal, Finance, and Operations to ensure timely and effective

About the role

We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Manager to build and oversee a Field Service team. The team will be responsible for the installation, maintenance, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment across multiple client sites. The ideal candidate will possess solid technical expertise and strong leadership abilities, managing a team of field technicians, optimizing service processes, and ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction. This position requires frequent site visits, coordination with engineering and operations teams, and the ability to address complex technical and operational challenges efficiently.
Key Responsibilities

• Oversee profit and loss (P&L) responsibilities for the EMS field service operations, including budget management, cost control, and financial reporting.

• Collaborate with engineering, project management, and sales teams to support client projects and technical proposals.

• Serve as the primary technical escalation point for complex field service issues

• Lead, mentor, and manage a team of field service technicians specializing in electrical and mechanical equipment.

• Analyze performance metrics, including first-time fix rates, system uptime, and response times, and implement process improvements.

• Conduct site audits, field inspections, and on-the-job training for technicians.

• Develop and manage operational budgets, review cost efficiency, and ensure profitability of service operations.

• Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related technical field preferred. Equivalent experience in field services may be considered.

• Strong technical knowledge of electrical systems, mechanical systems, PLCs, motor controls, power distribution, and industrial equipment.

• Proven experience in team leadership, performance management, and personnel development.

jobs.title: Manual Machinist
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

As a Manual Machinist you will be responsible for setting up and operating machine tools, including HBM, VBM, lathes, milling machines, ID/OD grinders, planers, and bore parts to manufacture and recondition component parts to customer, OEM and industry standards. You will interpret mechanical drawings, blueprints, and sketches and perform precision metal cutting, grinding, shaping and fitting. You will measure components, parts, and raw materials with precision measuring instruments, gauges, and tools. Key Responsibilities

• Performing layouts, setting up and operating conventional machine tools as required

• Reading and interpreting all drawings, including geometric dimensioning and tolerancing

• Designing setup methods where none exist

• Instructing other shop personnel on proper machining techniques

• Continually improving methods to deliver higher quality with improved costs

Qualifications / Requirements

• Completion of a machinist apprentice program or equivalent training

• Ability to hold close tolerances and conduct component inspections

• Ability to set up machine tools: ID / OD Grinders, Turret Lathe, Engine Lathe, Horizontal Boring Mill, Vertical Boring Mill, Radial Drill, Planer Mill

• Four years of experience in machine shop operations

• Willingness to work in a team environment

• Openness to working overtime as required

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

jobs.title: EMS Specialist
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced and driven EMS Supervisor to lead our workshop operations in Elandsfontein. Reporting to the EMS Service Centre Manager, you will be responsible for supervising a team of employees and contractors while ensuring safe, efficient, and high-quality repair, refurbishment, assembly, and testing of mechanical equipment, particularly gearboxes.

This is an excellent opportunity for a technically strong leader with a passion for operational excellence, safety, customer service, and continuous improvement.
Key Responsibilities

• Plan and manage workshop activities to ensure work is completed within agreed timelines.

• Supervise gearbox overhaul, refurbishment, repair, assembly, and testing activities in accordance with OEM specifications and engineering standards.

• Attend to breakdowns and repair requests.

• Promote and maintain a strong safety culture through behavioural safety initiatives and toolbox talks.

• Conduct root cause investigations and implement corrective actions.

• Ensure compliance with engineering drawings, repair procedures, quality standards, and customer requirements.

• Manage inventory of critical components, consumables, bearings, seals, and lubricants.

• Oversee maintenance, calibration, and certification of workshop equipment and measuring instruments.

• Liaise with customers, suppliers, OEMs, and internal stakeholders on technical matters and project execution.

• Drive reliability improvement initiatives, cost control, and operational efficiency.

Qualifications

• Qualified Millwright or Fitter & Turner .

• National Diploma or equivalent technical qualification.

• Valid driver's licence.

Experience

• 5 to 10 years' progressive supervisory experience in a mechanical workshop or engineering environment.

• Sound knowledge of electrical and mechanical equipment.

• Experience using Microsoft Office (Word and Excel) and SAP.

• Sound knowledge of the Occupational Health and Safety Act

Key Competencies

• Strong leadership and people management skills.

• Excellent communication and relationship-building abilities.

• Commercial awareness and cost-control mindset.

• Strong planning, organisational, and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to work independently and adapt to changing priorities.

• Attention to detail and commitment to quality.

• Strong influencing, negotiation, and customer service skills.

What We're Looking For

The ideal candidate will be a hands-on supervisor with strong technical expertise, a safety-first mindset, and the ability to lead teams effectively while delivering exceptional service to our customers. Stiamo cercando un esperto e guidato Supervisore dello SME per condurre le nostre operazioni di officina in Elandsfontein. Si tratta di un'ottima opportunità per un leader tecnicamente forte con la passione per l'eccellenza operativa, la sicurezza, il servizio clienti e il miglioramento continuo.
Principali responsabilità

• Pianificare e gestire le attività di workshop per garantire il lavoro è completato entro tempi concordati.

• Supervise attività di revisione, ristrutturazione, riparazione, montaggio e test in conformità con le specifiche OEM e gli standard di ingegneria.

• Partecipa a guasti e richieste di riparazione.

• Promuovere e mantenere una forte cultura della sicurezza attraverso iniziative di sicurezza comportamentali e colloqui con la cassetta degli strumenti.

• Condurre le indagini causa radice e implementare azioni correttive.

• Assicurare la conformità con disegni di ingegneria, procedure di riparazione, standard di qualità e requisiti del cliente.

• Gestisci l'inventario di componenti critici, materiali di consumo, cuscinetti, guarnizioni e lubrificanti.

• Superare la manutenzione, la calibrazione e la certificazione delle attrezzature e degli strumenti di misura del laboratorio.

• Liaise con clienti, fornitori, OEM e stakeholder interni su questioni tecniche e l'esecuzione del progetto.

• Guidare iniziative di miglioramento dell'affidabilità, controllo dei costi e efficienza operativa.

Qualifiche

• Millwright qualificato o Fitter & Turner .

• Diploma nazionale o qualifica tecnica equivalente.

• Patente di guida valida.

Esperienza

• Esperienza di supervisione progressiva da 5 a 10 anni in un laboratorio meccanico o in un ambiente di ingegneria.

• Conoscenza del suono delle apparecchiature elettriche e meccaniche.

• Esperienza utilizzando Microsoft Office (Word e Excel) e SAP.

• Conoscenza sonora della legge sulla salute e sulla sicurezza sul lavoro

Competenze chiave

• Forte leadership e competenze di gestione delle persone.

• Ottima capacità di comunicazione e di costruzione di relazioni.

• Consapevolezza commerciale e mentalità di controllo dei costi.

• Forte capacità di pianificazione, organizzazione e problem solving.

• Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e adattarsi alle mutevoli priorità.

• Attenzione ai dettagli e all'impegno per la qualità.

• Forte influenza, negoziazione e competenze di servizio al cliente.

Cosa stiamo cercando

Il candidato ideale sarà un supervisore pratico con una forte competenza tecnica, una mentalità di sicurezza-primo, e la capacità di guidare i team efficacemente, offrendo un servizio eccezionale ai nostri clienti. Si dovrebbe essere in grado di analizzare i disegni di ingegneria, la comprensione delle tolleranze di ingegneria, e la guida di miglioramento continuo all'interno del workshop

jobs.title: Despatch Freight Coordinator
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

At Sulzer Leeds, we design and build some of the world’s most advanced engineered pump packages — the kind that keep global infrastructure moving and can weigh anything up to 150 tonnes. As we continue to grow and bring key capabilities in‑house, we’re now looking for a Despatch Freight Coordinator to help us take full control of our import, export, and heavy‑lift logistics. If you thrive in complex, high‑value engineering environments and love the challenge of out‑of‑gauge and break bulk freight, this is your opportunity to play a pivotal role in how we move some of the biggest kit in the industry. Key Duties ​

• Coordinate global import and export shipments, ensuring compliance with customs regulations and trade laws.

• Manage OOG and break bulk shipments, working closely with specialist carriers, port operators, and freight forwarders.

• Prepare and verify shipping and customs documentation (CDS entries, bills of lading, CoO, packing lists).

• Plan and book UK and international transport, optimising routes, loads, and freight costs.

• Monitor shipment progress, maintain accurate records, and keep internal teams updated in real time.

Required Skills & Experience

• Experience in freight coordination, transport planning, or logistics—ideally within heavy engineering or project cargo.

• Knowledge of out-of-gauge, break bulk, or oversized cargo handling (road, sea, or multimodal).

• Strong understanding of customs procedures, Incoterms, and international trade compliance.

• Excellent organisation, communication, and problem‑solving skills.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast‑paced, project‑driven environment.

What we offer you

We’ve recently invested significantly in modernising our Leeds facility — creating a brighter, more efficient, and more advanced workspace designed to support high‑quality work and a great employee experience. Alongside our upgraded facilities, you’ll benefit from:

Core Benefits

• A competitive salary

• A company-wide bonus scheme

• Medicash Health Cash Plan (covering everyday healthcare expenses such as dental, optical and GP services)

• 33 days’ holiday

• Defined pension contribution

• Employee Assistance Programmes

• Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes opérationnelles pour fournir des solutions clients exceptionnelles.

• Surveiller les tendances du marché, l'activité des concurrents et les nouvelles possibilités.

• Succès prouvé dans les ventes B2B dans le secteur minier.

• Expérience de vente de solutions d'ingénierie, de maintenance, de fiabilité ou de service industriel.

• Connaissance de l'équipement rotatif, des pompes, des moteurs, des compresseurs ou des actifs connexes.

• Des compétences commerciales et de négociation solides.

• Un créateur naturel de relations avec la capacité d'influencer à tous les niveaux.

Fonds de prévoyance

jobs.title: Buyer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Buyer to join our team at Sulzer GT Aero Services Ltd. In this role, you will be responsible for procuring goods and services necessary for our operations, ensuring timely delivery, cost-effectiveness, and adherence to quality standards. Job Responsibilities:

• Identify and evaluate potential suppliers, negotiate contracts, and establish strong vendor relationships.

• Prepare and process purchase orders, ensuring accuracy and compliance with company policies and procedures.

• Monitor inventory levels and anticipate material needs to prevent stockouts and support production schedules.

• Collaborate with engineering, production, and quality assurance departments to understand material requirements and specifications.

• Resolve supplier issues, including quality discrepancies, late deliveries, and invoice discrepancies.

• Analyze market trends and supplier performance to identify opportunities for cost savings and process improvements.

• Maintain accurate purchasing records and generate reports as required.

• Ensure all procurement activities comply with relevant regulations and company ethical guidelines.

• Participate in cross-functional teams to support new product development and continuous improvement initiatives.

Job Qualifications:

• Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in a purchasing or procurement role, preferably within the aerospace, manufacturing, or industrial services sector.

• Proven negotiation skills and the ability to build and maintain effective supplier relationships.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

• Excellent communication (written and verbal) and interpersonal skills.

• Proficiency in using ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle) and Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook).

• Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment.

• Knowledge of purchasing best practices and supply chain management principles.

What we offer you

• A competitive salary

• A company-wide bonus scheme

• Medicash Health Cash Plan (covering everyday healthcare expenses such as dental, optical and GP services)

• 33 days’ holiday

• Defined pension contribution

• Employee Assistance Programmes

• Discounts on shopping, entertainment & lifestyle

• Costco membership option

• Discounted personal car leasing for you, family & friends

• Long Service Awards

• Ongoing learning through Sulzer Learning Pathways

• Armed Forces Support – As a Silver Award holder of the MoD Defence Employer Recognition Scheme, we actively support veterans, reservists and Cadet Adult Volunteers. This includes policies that enable time for training, camps and deployment, alongside access to a growing internal military network.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

• Un sistema di bonus a livello aziendale

• Medicash Health Cash Plan (coprire le spese sanitarie quotidiane come i servizi dentali, ottici e GP)

• 33 giorni di vacanza

• Contributo pensionistico

• Programmi di assistenza ai dipendenti

• Sconti su shopping, intrattenimento e stile di vita

• Opzione di abbonamento Costco

• Noleggio auto personali scontati per te, famiglia e amici

• Premi di servizio lungo

• Apprendimento in corso attraverso Sulzer Learning Pathways

• Supporto delle Forze Armate – Come titolare del Premio d'Argento del programma di riconoscimento dei datori di lavoro MoD Defence, sosteniamo attivamente veterani, reservisti e Volontari per adulti Cadet. jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

At Sulzer, innovation has been at the heart of everything we do for nearly 200 years. As a global leader in fluid engineering and rotating equipment services, we design, manufacture and maintain critical pumps, agitators, compressors, motors, generators and turbomachinery that keep essential industries moving. From water and wastewater treatment to energy, chemicals, power generation and industrial manufacturing, our technologies help customers improve efficiency, reliability and sustainability across their operations.

We are now creating a new role that will help shape the future of environmental compliance and energy performance across our UK & Ireland business. This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced Environmental professional to develop and drive a strategic environmental agenda across multiple manufacturing and service locations, ensuring compliance excellence while supporting Sulzer's sustainability ambitions. What You'll Do

• Manage and continuously improve Sulzer's ISO 14001 Environmental Management System across UK & Ireland sites.

• Ensure compliance with environmental legislation, permits and regulatory requirements.

• Help shape and deliver environmental and energy initiatives that support Sulzer's sustainability ambitions.

• Conduct audits, assessments and compliance reviews across multiple locations.

• Monitor environmental and energy performance, identifying opportunities for improvement.

• Support carbon reduction, waste minimisation and resource-efficiency projects.

• Investigate environmental incidents and drive corrective actions.

• Partner with site teams, operational leaders and external bodies to embed best practice.

• Keep the business informed of emerging environmental legislation and compliance requirements.

What We're Looking For

• Experience in environmental compliance within manufacturing, engineering or industrial environments.

• Strong knowledge of UK environmental legislation and management systems.

• Proven experience managing or supporting ISO 14001.

• ISEP membership (or working towards it).

• Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills.

• The confidence to challenge, influence and drive improvements across multiple sites.

• A proactive mindset and passion for sustainability.

What we offer you

Core Benefits

• A competitive basic salary

• Annual personal bonus scheme based on company and personal performance

• Private Medical Insurance

• 33 days annual leave.

• Defined pension contributions.

• Access to Medicash helping you cover everyday health costs like dental optical and physiotherapy plus a range of wellbeing perks.

• Confidential support via Employee Assistance Programmes.

• Access to discounts on shopping entertainment lifestyle plus opportunity to apply for Costco membership.

• Discounted personal car leasing for you your family and friends.

• Long Service Awards celebrating your commitment.

• Continuous learning opportunities through Sulzer Learning Pathways.

• As a Silver Award holder of the MoD Defence Employer Recognition Scheme, we welcome and support veterans, reservists and Cadet Adult Volunteers with policies for training, camps and deployment, plus a growing internal military network.

We’ve recently invested significantly in modernising our Leeds facility — creating a brighter, more efficient, and more advanced workspace designed to support high‑quality work and a great employee experience. Alongside our upgraded facilities, you’ll benefit from:

• Free, secure parking with EV charging

• Multi-faith prayer room

• Newly modernised work areas

• Lively Sports & Social Club with events & prize draws

• 24/7 onsite gym

• Subsidised vending machines

• Subsidised Canteen offering hot and cold food

• Unterstützung von Projekten zur CO2-Reduktion, Abfallminimierung und Ressourceneffizienz.

• Untersuchen Sie Umweltvorfälle und führen Sie Korrekturmaßnahmen durch.

• Zusammenarbeit mit Standortteams, Betriebsleitern und externen Stellen, um Best Practices einzubetten.

• Halten Sie das Unternehmen über neue Umweltgesetze und Compliance-Anforderungen auf dem Laufenden.

• Erfahrung in der Umweltkonformität in Fertigungs-, Ingenieur- oder Industrieumgebungen.

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Verwaltung oder Unterstützung von ISO 14001.

This role supervises professional-level staff and ensures adherence to quality standards and production or service schedules.

Lead the site Maintenance function in providing both a reactive and proactive, multi-skilled maintenance service on all operational equipment and facilities infrastructure. Responsible for planned schedule creation and overseeing the adherence and timely completion of work carried out. Increase the site operational effectiveness, improve on project delivery, mean time between failure and downtime reduction, and manage and implement improvement plans, driving Key Performance Indicators (KPI's) ensuring that Health, Safety and Environmental requirements are adhered to. Manage the team on technical best practice.
Main selling points of the job
Sulzer being a Multinational Company, manufacturing Centrifugal Pumps and having two manufacturing Units can offers wide range of learning opportunities in Electrical, Mechanical and Instrumentation field.

Main accountabilities and tasks
• 1. Effectively delegate any maintenance issues to be resolved on each shift and small projects to the right skills in the team, planning and managing effective works
• 2. Manage the team to ensure machine availability, reactively managing dysfunctional machinery with the Shift management
• 3. Ensure routine calibration and maintenance requirements of a variety of electro-mechanical, hydraulic and pneumatic systems are undertaken
4. Manage the process of the introduction of new machinery, plant and equipment from drawing up the specification, to managing suppliers through to full installation in collaboration with all relevant parties
5. Manage contractors on site to ensure they meet legal and company requirements
6. Ensure that Maintenance function operates in accordance with site health, safety and environmental policies and procedures to ensure the safety of staff and visitors

Le superviseur des opérations, de la fabrication et de la production est chargé de superviser les activités quotidiennes de production ou de centre de service, en veillant à ce que les processus se déroulent en douceur, efficacement et en toute sécurité. Principales responsabilités et tâches

5. Gérer les entrepreneurs sur place pour s'assurer qu'ils satisfont aux exigences légales et à celles de l'entreprise
6. Veiller à ce que la fonction d'entretien fonctionne conformément aux politiques et procédures relatives à la santé, à la sécurité et à l'environnement du site pour assurer la sécurité du personnel et des visiteurs

jobs.title: Service - Coordinator
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
Responsible for collecting outstanding receivables and maintaining accurate records of collection activities. The role involves interacting with customers, assessing account status, and supporting timely payments. The objective is to maintain cash flow, reduce DSO, resolve disputes, and coordinate with internal teams to address billing or service issues affecting payments.

Key Responsibilities

• Collection Efforts: Contact customers via phone and email to follow up on past-due invoices and secure payments.

• Account Reconciliation: Review accounts to ensure payments are applied correctly and resolve discrepancies.

• Negotiation: Develop payment plans with customers for outstanding debt.

• Reporting: Submit daily/weekly reports on aging accounts and high-risk customers to management.

• Process Improvement: Recommend adjustments to improve AR collection process.

• Documentation: Maintain meticulous records of collection activities and customer correspondence.

Qualifications / Requirements

• Bachelor: in Accounting, Finance, or Business Administration.

• Previous experience in credit and collections or accounts receivable.

• Strong written/verbal communication, negotiation, and customer service skills.

• Proficiency in accounting software (e.g., QuickBooks, SAP, Oracle) and MS Excel.

• Languages: Arabic & English.

What we offer you

• Excellent opportunities for development, along with a competitive salary and company bonus scheme.

• A great working environment.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Responsabile per la raccolta di crediti eccezionali e il mantenimento di registri accurati delle attività di raccolta. • Documentazione: Mantenere scrupolosi record di attività di raccolta e corrispondenza dei clienti.

Qualifiche / Requisiti

• Corso di laurea: in contabilità, finanza, o Business Administration.

• Esperienza precedente nel credito e nelle collezioni o nei conti.

• Forte comunicazione scritta/verbale, negoziazione e competenze di servizio al cliente.

In this role, you will play a key part in ensuring the smooth day-to-day operation of the organization by coordinating communication, preparing reports and presentation materials, supporting meetings, and maintaining accurate data in Salesforce. By enabling our commercial leaders to focus on strategic priorities, you will make a significant contribution to the efficiency and effectiveness of the ENA Services organization.

• Prepare, consolidate, and maintain reports, dashboards, and presentation materials.

• Collect, compile, and structure information from regional sales teams and Service Centers.

• Support collaboration between Sales, Service Centers, and other internal stakeholders.

Über die Rolle

Der Area Sales Manager (ASM) ist der primäre externe Vertreter von Sulzer bei unseren Kunden. Dem ASM wird ein geografisches oder produktspezifisches Vertriebsgebiet zugewiesen und ist finanziell für die Auftragseingangs- (OI), Bruttogewinnmarge (GPM) und Operating Net Cash-Flow (ONCF) der zugewiesenen Bereiche für das Unternehmen verantwortlich. Das ASM findet und entwickelt Vertriebsmöglichkeiten und engagiert sich mit Kunden bei dieser Abwicklung von Aufträgen und bis zu dem Abschluss von Projekten innerhalb Sulzers. Das ASM wird die von der RSM festgelegten Umsatzziele verfolgen und erfüllen oder übertreffen.

In dieser Funktion wird die ASM Sulzer bei unseren Kunden korrekt und proaktiv vertreten. ASMs engagieren sich für Kunden und werden voraussichtlich Vorbilder für das Unternehmen in unserer größeren Sulzer-Gemeinschaft sein. ASM wird eng mit anderen Sulzer Turbo-Teams zusammenarbeiten, um folgende Bereiche zu berücksichtigen: Inside Sales, Business Process, Operations, Engineering, Finance, QC, Safety und HR, um profitable Aufträge zu sichern, zu versenden und zu rechen. Als Vertriebsleiter wird die ASM auch die RES-Geschäfte (Pumps und EMS) von Sulzer verstehen, mit ihnen in Kontakt treten, fördern und vertreten, um eine vollständige Ergänzung der RES-Dienstleistungen in der Region zu bieten.

ASM-Verantwortlichkeiten

- Entwickeln, verkaufen und behalten Sie alle Geschäftsverantwortung für die zugewiesene Fläche / Produktlinie - Entwickeln und implementieren Sie Verkaufsstrategien im Einklang mit den Zielen von Sulzer - Planen, unterstützen und überwachen Sie die Vertriebsaktivitäten innerhalb der Fläche / Produktlinie - Entwickeln und liefern Sie technisch und kommerziell überlegene Vorschläge für den Kunden - Unterstützen Sie alle Geschäftsaktivitäten mit dem Kunden durch Abschluss und Rechnungsstellung - Entwickeln, pflegen und melden Sie genaue Umsatzprognosen - Überprüfen Sie RFPs, Verträge, POs und Bedingungen für alle Unternehmen

Möglichkeiten - Steuern Sie alle Geschäftskosten, als ob sie Ihre eigenen wären - Befähigen Sie sich mit und pflegen Salesforce: Chancen, Ausfälle Tracking und Marktbedingungen Ereignisse, Trip Call Reports und Wettbewerbs-Updates - Koordination, planen, teilnehmen und durchführen Werbe-Messeveranstaltungen - Nehmen Sie an vierteljährlichen Verkaufsanrufe oder Sitzungen mit dem Management-Team - Diese Position erfordert und erwartet häufige Reisen in die zugewiesene Fläche.

- Unterstützung von strategischen Initiativen von Sulzer in den Bereichen Sicherheit, Wirtschaft, Ethik und Qualität. - Präsentieren Sie eine positive, proaktive, professionelle Haltung und den Auftritt zu jeder Zeit.

ASM-Qualifikationen:

- Hohe persönliche Standards des Charakters. Muss einwandfreie moralische und ethische Verhalten. - Bachelor,s Abschluss in Engineering oder Business wird bevorzugt. Stattdessen wird der Kandidat mindestens 5 Jahre Branchenwissen und Erfahrung mit Turbomaschinen haben. - Frühere Erfahrung der proaktiv beeinflussen oder schließen Geschäft mit Kunden, Mitarbeiter und / oder kommerziellen Peers. - Kommerzielle und technische Kenntnisse und Fähigkeiten, um die externe Verkaufsposition zu erfüllen.

- Ausführliche Kenntnisse der Turbomaschinen und Sulzer, komplette Produktlinie - Muss in der Lage sein, technische und kommerzielle Dokumente zu verstehen, zu interpretieren und zu diskutieren. - Starke mündliche und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit, Mikrodetails und Makrosituationen zu lesen, zu schreiben und zu diskutieren, sowie die zwischenmenschlichen Fähigkeiten, um mit Personal aus unterschiedlichen Hintergründen auf allen Ebenen unserer Kundenorganisation zu interagieren. - Bereitschaft, häufig zu reisen und das Geschäft als Ergebnis zurück zu bringen.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Jr. Machinery Mechanic is responsible for assisting in the maintenance and repair of industrial machinery under close supervision. This entry-level role supports senior mechanics in diagnosing issues, performing basic repairs, and ensuring equipment is safe and operational.
This job profile is intended for entry-level support staff who follow specific instructions and procedures, with supervision provided for non-routine situations. Tasks can be carried out after basic training or demonstration.
This job and its associated grade are specifically aligned with roles that have the following scope of responsibility: Small, Medium, Large, Division / Extra Large organization.

Key Responsibilities
Assist in inspecting and maintaining machinery and mechanical systems.
Perform basic repairs and part replacements.
Support preventive maintenance routines.
Clean and organize tools and work areas.
Follow safety procedures and report hazards.
Document maintenance activities.
Learn and apply mechanical troubleshooting techniques.
Skills & Qualifications
May require basic vocational training (or equivalent work experience) and the ability to carry out assigned tasks after initial instruction or demonstration.

Basic mechanical aptitude.
Willingness to learn and follow instructions.
Good teamwork and communication skills.
Attention to detail and safety awareness.
Ability to use basic hand tools.

What we offer you

• 12 Paid Holidays

• 15 Paid Time Off (PTO) Days

• Medical, dental, vision, life & disability

• 401K with 6% company match

• Employee Assistance Program

• Employee Wellness Program

• New onsite cafeteria, all meals subsidized (La Porte Service Center)

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Motor Control Design Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Position Summary:

This position operates within the Order Related Engineering (ORE) department and is responsible for designing Sales Order specific motor control electrical schematics and entering the associated bill of material (BOM) into the ERP system. This position closely works with Project Engineer to support the submittal package and provide electrical expertise to the customers. Upon approval of the submittal package, this position is accountable for generating part numbers in the ERP system and releasing the finalized package to production. Furthermore, this position provides electrical engineering expertise to Tendering and Operations by reviewing project specifications and offering recommendations Principal Duties and Responsibilities:

• Review project scope and specifications. Collaborate with Mechanical Engineer to organize hand-off meetings as necessary to ensure alignment and clarity.

• Design motor control electrical schematics to support production sales orders by reading and understanding specifications, quotes, purchase orders, or company scope worksheets.

• Enter parts and create assemblies of the motor control designs in the ERP system for procurement and production electrical assembly.

• Support Project Engineer with motor control design documentation required for sales order submittal packages.

• Check sales order specific electrical schematics (Drawings and BOM) created by other team members in ORE.

• Provides electrical review of specifications for Tendering, as assigned by ORE Manager.

• Provides electrical review and support to other departments, as assigned by ORE Manager

• Provide electrical support to field service technicians during installation and acceptance of products.

• Perform additional duties and participate in special projects as assigned.

Education & Experience:

Required:
Associate’s degree in electrical design with 5+ years of experience in motor control design.

Desired:
Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering with 2+ years of experience in motor control design.

Skills:
Required:

• CAD Experience in electrical schematic design

• ERP System Experience

• Ability to use technology and analysis tools (Excel, Outlook, web, databases).

Desired: AutoCAD Electrical and Vault
Knowledge of NEC Code

Decision Authority:

Accountability: Position is accountable for ensuring the accuracy and OTD of submittal package, fabrication drawings and Visual BOM updates. It is also accountable to maintain compliance with company standards and its safety policies

Responsibility: This position is responsible for making decisions related to electrical design, drawing creation, BOM verification and co-ordination between different departments. Also responsible for collaborating with Project Engineer during submittal approval process and support Operations.

Delegation: May delegate tasks such as Drawing checks and BOM verification to other team members within the ORE department, under the guidance of ORE Manager.

Approval Process: This position is responsible for approving electrical components and drawings before release to production. Collaborate with Project Engineer in the customer approval process for Submittal packages.

Consensus: Required to participate in consensus decision-making during cross-functional meetings such as Tendering and Operations to ensure alignment.

Automated Decisions: Utilizes Visual system and design tools such as AutoCAD Electrical and Vault to support decision-making related to component selection, BOM creation, and workflow updates.

Measured by: (Key Performance Managements):

Quality:

• On-time Delivery (OTD) of Submittal Package

• Accuracy of submittal package.

• Accuracy of electrical schematics.

• Accuracy of bill of

jobs.title: Manufacturing Engineer - Electronics & Digital Products
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

At Sulzer, we're looking for a talented Manufacturing Engineer to join our Wexford team and play a critical role in shaping the future of our electronic and digital product manufacturing.

This is an exciting opportunity to become the Subject Matter Expert for electronic and digital products, working at the heart of innovation, production excellence, and continuous improvement. About Sulzer Wexford

Sulzer Wexford is a global centre of excellence for the design and manufacture of advanced pump control, monitoring, and digital solutions that help customers improve efficiency, reliability, and sustainability across water, wastewater, industrial, and commercial applications. Our products combine engineering expertise with smart technology to deliver world-class solutions used around the globe.

The Opportunity

As a key member of our Manufacturing Engineering team, you'll support both daily manufacturing operations and long-term strategic initiatives. You'll work closely with colleagues across Production, Product Development, Procurement, Quality, and Supply Chain, while also collaborating with suppliers and global teams to optimise manufacturing processes throughout the product lifecycle.

From supporting exciting new product launches to driving continuous improvement projects, you'll have a direct impact on how we manufacture and deliver innovative electronic products to customers worldwide.

What You'll Be Doing

• Act as the manufacturing engineering lead for electronic and digital products, supporting production performance, quality, and continuous improvement across the value stream.

• Support the introduction of new products into manufacturing, ensuring efficient, cost-effective production while providing design-for-manufacture feedback to Product Development teams.

• Carry out testing, validation, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis of electronic products, embedded systems, and pump control equipment.

• Collaborate with suppliers and internal stakeholders to resolve technical issues, manage component lifecycles, and drive product and process improvements.

• Maintain and enhance production test systems, including LabVIEW applications, firmware updates, functional testing procedures, and operator training.

• Create and maintain technical documentation, ensure compliance with quality and manufacturing standards, and support strategic projects that improve safety, quality, delivery, and cost performance.

What We're Looking For

Essential Qualifications & Experience

• Experience in the production or manufacture of electronic and digital products.

• Strong understanding of electronic schematics and PCB layouts.

• Experience testing and debugging embedded systems.

• Knowledge of electronic test equipment and testing methodologies.

• Familiarity with manufacturing standards such as IPC, ISO, RoHS and REACH.

• Experience applying Root Cause Corrective Action (RCCA) techniques.

• Proven ability to promote and support continuous improvement initiatives.

Desirable Skills

• Experience with NI LabVIEW test software.

• Knowledge of PCB CAD tools such as Altium.

• Electronic component lifecycle management experience.

• Familiarity with SAP ERP systems.

• Experience supporting New Product Introduction (NPI) programmes.

• Knowledge of Lean manufacturing tools and methodologies.

• Understanding of EMC and product safety standards.

• Experience with DraftSight, SolidWorks or NX.

What we offer you

• A competitive base salary

• Flex time with core hours of 09:30–14:30

• 26 days annual leave

• A defined pension contribution

• Free on‑site parking with reduced‑rate EV charging

• Subsidised on‑site canteen

• Maternity/paternity leave top‑up

• Access to Sulzer Learning Pathways for continuo

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile.

Informazioni sul ruolo

A Sulzer, stiamo cercando un talentuoso ingegnere manifatturiero per unirsi al nostro team di Wexford e svolgere un ruolo fondamentale nella definizione del futuro della nostra produzione di prodotti elettronici e digitali.

Si tratta di un'emozionante opportunità per diventare il Oggetto Matter Expert per prodotti elettronici e digitali, lavorando al cuore dell'innovazione, dell'eccellenza produttiva e del miglioramento continuo. Informazioni su Sulzer Wexford

Sulzer Wexford è un centro di eccellenza globale per la progettazione e la produzione di soluzioni avanzate per il controllo delle pompe, il monitoraggio e il digitale che aiutano i clienti a migliorare l'efficienza, l'affidabilità e la sostenibilità in applicazioni acqua, acque reflue, industriali e commerciali. I nostri prodotti combinano competenze ingegneristiche con tecnologia intelligente per fornire soluzioni di livello mondiale utilizzate in tutto il mondo.

L'opportunità

Come membro chiave del nostro team di Ingegneria manifatturiera, supporterai sia le operazioni di produzione giornaliere che le iniziative strategiche a lungo termine. Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con colleghi di produzione, sviluppo del prodotto, approvvigionamento, qualità e supply chain, collaborando anche con fornitori e team globali per ottimizzare i processi produttivi in tutto il ciclo di vita del prodotto.

Dal supporto di nuovi entusiasmanti lanci di prodotto alla guida di progetti di miglioramento continuo, avrete un impatto diretto su come produciamo e forniamo prodotti elettronici innovativi ai clienti in tutto il mondo.

Cosa farai

• Agire come l'ingegneria manifatturiera piombo per prodotti elettronici e digitali, sostenendo le prestazioni di produzione, la qualità e il miglioramento continuo attraverso il flusso di valore.

• Sostenere l'introduzione di nuovi prodotti nella produzione, assicurando una produzione efficiente e conveniente, fornendo un feedback di progettazione per la produzione ai team di sviluppo del prodotto.

• Eseguire la prova, la validazione, la risoluzione dei problemi e l'analisi della causa principale di prodotti elettronici, sistemi incorporati e apparecchiature di controllo della pompa.

About the role

At Sulzer, we're looking for a talented Manufacturing Engineer to join our Wexford team and play a critical role in shaping the future of our electronic and digital product manufacturing.

This is an exciting opportunity to become the Subject Matter Expert for electronic and digital products, working at the heart of innovation, production excellence, and continuous improvement. About Sulzer Wexford

Sulzer Wexford is a global centre of excellence for the design and manufacture of advanced pump control, monitoring, and digital solutions that help customers improve efficiency, reliability, and sustainability across water, wastewater, industrial, and commercial applications. Our products combine engineering expertise with smart technology to deliver world-class solutions used around the globe.

The Opportunity

As a key member of our Manufacturing Engineering team, you'll support both daily manufacturing operations and long-term strategic initiatives. You'll work closely with colleagues across Production, Product Development, Procurement, Quality, and Supply Chain, while also collaborating with suppliers and global teams to optimise manufacturing processes throughout the product lifecycle.

From supporting exciting new product launches to driving continuous improvement projects, you'll have a direct impact on how we manufacture and deliver innovative electronic products to customers worldwide.

What You'll Be Doing

• Act as the manufacturing engineering lead for electronic and digital products, supporting production performance, quality, and continuous improvement across the value stream.

• Support the introduction of new products into manufacturing, ensuring efficient, cost-effective production while providing design-for-manufacture feedback to Product Development teams.

• Carry out testing, validation, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis of electronic products, embedded systems, and pump control equipment.

• Collaborate with suppliers and internal stakeholders to resolve technical issues, manage component lifecycles, and drive product and process improvements.

• Maintain and enhance production test systems, including LabVIEW applications, firmware updates, functional testing procedures, and operator training.

• Create and maintain technical documentation, ensure compliance with quality and manufacturing standards, and support strategic projects that improve safety, quality, delivery, and cost performance.

What We're Looking For

Essential Qualifications & Experience

• Experience in the production or manufacture of electronic and digital products.

• Strong understanding of electronic schematics and PCB layouts.

• Experience testing and debugging embedded systems.

• Knowledge of electronic test equipment and testing methodologies.

• Familiarity with manufacturing standards such as IPC, ISO, RoHS and REACH.

• Experience applying Root Cause Corrective Action (RCCA) techniques.

• Proven ability to promote and support continuous improvement initiatives.

Desirable Skills

• Experience with NI LabVIEW test software.

• Knowledge of PCB CAD tools such as Altium.

• Electronic component lifecycle management experience.

• Familiarity with SAP ERP systems.

• Experience supporting New Product Introduction (NPI) programmes.

• Knowledge of Lean manufacturing tools and methodologies.

jobs.title: Field Service Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Är du en lösningsorienterad person som trivs med tekniska utmaningar och vill bidra till en mer hållbar framtid?

Hos oss får du en varierande och utvecklande roll inom vattenrening, där du arbetar ute hos våra kunder tillsammans med kunniga och engagerade kollegor. Du kommer att möta nya utmaningar varje dag, lösa tekniska problem och bidra till att skapa långsiktiga och hållbara lösningar som gör skillnad för både kunder och miljö. På Nordic Water Products AB ligger fokuset på vattenrening och arbetet som servicetekniker utförs ute på plats hos våra kunder där Nordic Waters produkter finns representerade, både på kommunala renings- och vattenverk samt hos olika processindustrier.

I ditt uppdrag som servicetekniker ingår planerat förebyggande underhåll på våra egna produkter samt att hantera oplanerade reparationer. Montage, installationer och felsökning ingår också i dina arbetsuppgifter. En fullt utrustad servicebil ger dig goda förutsättningar att ta dig an de problem du ställs inför. Som servicetekniker är du vårt ansikte utåt och en del av Nordic Waters varumärke.
Som ny i tjänsten får du följa ett introduktionsprogram. Efter introduktion kommer du att arbeta tillsammans med en eller flera av dina arbetskamrater. Arbetet erbjuder ett ständigt lärande och du kommer regelbundet få möjlighet att utmanas och utvecklas i din roll. Du är ute på plats hos kunderna under veckorna.

Dina kompetenser
För att vara aktuell för tjänsten krävs:
• God erfarenhet och stort intresse av tekniskt och mekaniskt arbete
• Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska i tal och skrift, då engelska är vårat koncernspråk
• B-körkort
• Datavana
