jobs.title: Pump Service Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Sulzer is looking for a skilled Pump Service Engineer to join our Birmingham Service Centre, supporting the overhaul, repair and testing of critical pumping equipment for customers across the water, energy, industrial and infrastructure sectors.

This is primarily a workshop-based role, working within our state-of-the-art facility alongside experienced engineers and technicians. However, flexibility is essential, as you'll also support customers on-site with inspections, fault finding, maintenance and emergency breakdown activities when required. What You'll Be Doing

• Dismantling, inspecting, repairing and overhauling a wide range of centrifugal pumps (high and low pressure), blowers, vacuum pumps, submersible pumps and self-priming pumps, as well as other rotating equipment.

• Diagnosing faults and recommending effective repair and refurbishment solutions.

• Repairing and servicing associated mechanical equipment including valves, gearboxes, fans and compressors.

• Conducting performance testing, alignment checks and quality inspections to ensure equipment meets operational standards.

• Producing accurate service reports, inspection findings and technical documentation.

• Supporting site activities including maintenance, installation, commissioning and breakdown response.

• Working safely and professionally at customer locations across the UK when required.

What We're Looking For

• Experience servicing, repairing or overhauling pumps and rotating equipment

• Strong mechanical engineering and fault-finding skills

• Ability to interpret engineering drawings and technical documentation

• A flexible approach, with willingness to undertake site work and travel when required

• Commitment to quality, safety and customer service

Why Join Sulzer?

Based at our Birmingham Service Centre, you'll work from one of the most advanced facilities of its kind in the UK. Opened in 2021 following significant investment, our 82,000 sq ft Centre of Excellence has been designed around lean manufacturing principles and equipped with advanced machining technologies, digital inspection systems and state-of-the-art additive manufacturing capabilities.
Operating 24/7, the facility delivers world-class maintenance, repair and overhaul solutions for pumps, motors, generators, compressors, turbines and other critical rotating equipment, supporting some of the UK's most important industries.

Hours of work:

• This is primarily a workshop-based role, with the occasional work on-site.

• Monday - Thursday : 07:00 - 15:45

• Friday : 07:00 - 14:30

What we offer you

• A competitive basic salary

• Company-wide bonus scheme

• Paid overtime opportunities

• 33 days annual leave.

• Defined pension contributions.

• Access to Medicash helping you cover everyday health costs like dental optical and physiotherapy plus a range of wellbeing perks.

• Confidential support via Employee Assistance Programmes.

• Access to discounts on shopping entertainment lifestyle plus opportunity to apply for Costco membership.

• Discounted personal car leasing for you your family and friends.

• Long Service Awards celebrating your commitment.

• Continuous learning opportunities through Sulzer Learning Pathways.

• As a Sulzer Award holder of the MoD Defence Employer Recognition Scheme, we welcome and support veterans, reservists and Cadet Adult Volunteers with policies for training, camps and deployment, plus a growing internal military network.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the

The Production Worker / Technician is responsible for assembling, testing, and inspecting products to ensure they meet quality and safety standards. This role supports the manufacturing process by identifying defects, maintaining equipment, and following production protocols.

At Sulzer, you are empowered to deliver superior results. As an industry pioneer, we have a proud heritage of innovation and continue to evolve for the future. Join our story and create your own impact by developing your expertise and building solutions that help make our lives safer, smarter and more sustainable.

Join our Services team within Rotating Equipment Services division as a Journey-person Machinist to help us take Sulzer Rotating Equipment Services (Canada) Ltd., to the next level. Main tasks and responsibilities:

• Operates manual horizontal boring mills daily to perform line boring on split-case pump housings and other rotating equipment.

• Sets up and operates manual machine tools under limited supervision.

• Machine within tight tolerances to meet engineering/customer/contract specifications and applies knowledge of qualities of metals and alloys being machined.

• Plans sequence of own work operations and methods of set-up including methods of mounting, levelling, aligning, holding and fastening work. Interprets blueprints, charges, tables, handbook formulas, sketches and written and verbal orders.

• Lays out work according to requirements. Selects and grinds own cutting tools.

• Performs any bench work necessary to finish and fit parts to required specifications.

• Must be able to plan and organize own work activities

• Must have excellent understanding of customer focused, service-based business.

• Must have strong people skills and ability to work in a team environment.

• Must be capable of understanding and applying procedural based work processes.

• Must have good communication skills with strong organizational ability and detail orientation.

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• Working knowledge and ability to effectively set-up all or most of the following machines: Engine Lathe, Milling Machine, Radial Drill, Horizontal Boring Mill, Vertical Boring Mill

• CNC machine tool experience preferred

• Working knowledge of tool geometry and application

• Working knowledge of effects of feeds and speeds on alloy materials

• Ability to work overtime as required

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Production Planner is responsible for scheduling and coordinating production activities to ensure timely delivery of products. This role works closely with procurement, manufacturing, and logistics to align production plans with demand forecasts and resource availability.
This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. Immediate Opening: Deputy Manager ( ASM II)- Planning (Pumps & Rotating Equipment) -
We are looking for an experienced and results-driven Deputy Manager ( ASM II) - Planning to lead Production Planning, Demand Forecasting, Material Planning, Inventory Management, and Customer Delivery Planning for our Pump Manufacturing business. The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in SAP PP, production scheduling, MRP, inventory control, and cross-functional coordination to ensure achievement of sales plans and customer delivery commitments.
Key Responsibilities

Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP)

• Lead monthly S&OP process and align demand with manufacturing capacity.

• Create and own Annual, Quarterly, Monthly, and Weekly Sales & Production Plans.

• Drive demand forecasting and forecast accuracy improvements.

• Convert sales forecasts into executable manufacturing plans.

• Work closely with Sales and Project Management teams to ensure fulfillment of customer commitments.

Production & Assembly Planning

• Develop and manage Master Production Schedule (MPS).

• Ensure achievement of production plans and customer delivery commitments.

• Drive schedule adherence across machining, assembly, testing, and dispatch functions.

• Monitor capacity utilization and identify bottlenecks.
Pump Assembly Kit Management

• Lead daily and weekly reviews between Stores and Assembly teams.

• Ensure complete kit readiness before assembly starts.

• Drive closure of shortages affecting assembly schedules.

• Monitor critical material availability to support uninterrupted production.
Procurement & Material Planning

• Conduct regular planning reviews with Procurement teams.

• Align purchase schedules with sales forecasts and assembly requirements.

• Drive timely availability of long lead and critical materials.

• Proactively manage supply chain risks and escalations.
Project Planning & Customer Deliveries

• Lead project kick-off meetings for new customer orders.

• Define and monitor key milestones from Engineering Release through Invoicing.

• Work closely with Project Managers to ensure customer commitments are achieved.

• Support customer reviews by providing reliable execution and delivery forecasts.
Cross Functional Leadership

• Lead Tier-2 Operations Meetings and drive action closure.

• Coordinate with Sales, Project Management, Engineering, Procurement, Stores, Manufacturing, Quality, Logistics, and Finance teams.

• Drive organization-wide alignment towards achievement of business sales plans.
Inventory & MRP Management

• Own inventory planning and inventory control activities.

• Execute and monitor Daily MRP Runs in SAP.

• Review and close MRP exception messages on a daily basis.

• Ensure planning master data accuracy within SAP.

• Responsible for Packing Slip Creation in SAP to support dispatch and delivery activities.

• Drive material availability while optimizing inventory levels and working capital.

• Monitor Raw Material, WIP, and Finished Goods inventory performance.

Desired Skills & Competencies

• Expertise in Production Planning & Control (PPC)

• Strong experience in Pump Manufacturing / Engineered-to-Order (ETO) Environment

• Advanced Demand Forecasting & Capacity Planning

• Excellent knowledge of SAP PP Module (Mandatory)

• Working knowledge of S

Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile.

Informazioni sul ruolo

Sintesi del lavoro
Il programmatore di produzione è responsabile della pianificazione e del coordinamento delle attività di produzione per garantire la consegna tempestiva dei prodotti. Questo ruolo funziona a stretto contatto con l'approvvigionamento, la produzione e la logistica per allineare i piani di produzione con le previsioni della domanda e la disponibilità delle risorse.
Questo profilo di lavoro è destinato a professionisti esperti che applicano la conoscenza pratica di un'area di lavoro e lavorano indipendentemente con la supervisione generale. Apertura immediata: Direttore aggiunto (ASM II)- Pianificazione (Pumps & Rotating Equipment) -
Siamo alla ricerca di un vice manager esperto e guidato dai risultati (ASM II) - Pianificazione di condurre la pianificazione della produzione, la previsione della domanda, la pianificazione dei materiali, la gestione dell'inventario e la pianificazione della consegna del cliente per il nostro business di produzione della pompa. Il candidato ideale dovrebbe possedere una forte esperienza in SAP PP, programmazione di produzione, MRP, controllo dell'inventario e coordinamento interfunzionale per garantire il raggiungimento dei piani di vendita e impegni di consegna del cliente.
Principali responsabilità

Pianificazione delle vendite e delle operazioni (S&OP)

• Piombo mensile processo S&OP e allineare la domanda con capacità di produzione.

• Creare e possedere Piani di produzione e vendita annuali, trimestrali, mensili e settimanali.

• Previsione della domanda di guida e miglioramenti di precisione di previsione.

• Convertire le previsioni di vendita in piani di produzione eseguibili.

• Lavorare a stretto contatto con i team di Sales e Project Management per garantire l'adempimento degli impegni dei clienti.

Pianificazione della produzione e dell'assemblaggio

• Sviluppare e gestire Master Production Schedule (MPS).

• Assicurare il raggiungimento di piani di produzione e impegni di consegna del cliente.

• Aderenza programma di trasmissione attraverso funzioni di lavorazione, assemblaggio, test e spedizione.

• Monitorare l'utilizzo della capacità e identificare i colli di bottiglia.
Gestione del kit di assemblaggio pompa

• Guidare le recensioni giornaliere e settimanali tra i team Store e Assembly.

• Assicurare la disponibilità completa del kit prima dell'inizio del montaggio.

• Chiudere l'azionamento della carenza che colpisce i programmi di assemblaggio.

• Monitorare la disponibilità dei materiali critici per supportare la produzione ininterrotta.
Procurement & Material Planning

• Condurre regolari recensioni di pianificazione con i team di Procurement.

• Allineare i programmi di acquisto con le previsioni di vendita e i requisiti di assemblaggio.

• Guidare la disponibilità tempestiva di lungo piombo e materiali critici.

• Gestione attiva dei rischi e delle escalation della supply chain.
Pianificazione del progetto e consegne dei clienti

• Lead project kick-off meeting per nuovi ordini dei clienti.

• Definire e monitorare le pietre miliari chiave da Engineering Release attraverso Invoicing.

• Lavorare a stretto contatto con Project Manager per garantire gli impegni dei clienti.

• Supporta le recensioni dei clienti fornendo previsioni di esecuzione e consegna affidabili.
Leadership funzionale trasversale

• Lead Tier-2 Operazioni Riunioni e chiusura dell'azione di azionamento.

• Coordinate con le squadre Vendite, Project Management, Engineering, Procurement, Stores, Manufacturing, Quality, Logistics e Finance.

• Guida l'allineamento dell'organizzazione verso il raggiungimento dei piani di vendita di affari.
Gestione dell'inventario e MRP

• Pianificazione dell'inventario e attività di controllo dell'inventario.

• Eseguire e monitorare Daily MRP Runs in SAP.

• Rivedere e chiudere messaggi di eccezione MRP su base giornaliera.

• Assicurare la precisione dei dati master di pianificazione all'interno di SAP.

• Responsabile per l'imballaggio Slip Creation in SAP per sostenere le attività di spedizione e consegna.

• Guidare la disponibilità dei materiali ottimizzando i livelli di inventario e il capitale di lavoro.

• Monitorare le prestazioni dell'inventario di materie prime, WIP e oggetti finiti.

Competenze e competenze desiderate

• Competenza nella pianificazione e controllo della produzione (PPC)

• Forte esperienza nella produzione di pompe / Engineered-to-Order (ETO) Ambiente

• Previsione avanzata della domanda e pianificazione delle capacità

• Ottima conoscenza del modulo SAP PP (Mandatori)

• Conoscenze di lavoro di S

Dieses Jobprofil richtet sich an erfahrene Fachkräfte, die praktische Kenntnisse eines Jobbereichs anwenden und unabhängig mit allgemeiner Aufsicht arbeiten. Sofortige Eröffnung: Deputy Manager (ASM II) - Planung (Pumps & Rotating Equipment) -
Wir suchen einen erfahrenen und ergebnisorientierten stellvertretenden Manager (ASM II) - Planen, Produktionsplanung, Bedarfsprognose, Materialplanung, Lagerverwaltung und Kundenlieferplanung für unser Pumpenproduktionsgeschäft zu leiten. Der ideale Kandidat sollte über eine starke Expertise in SAP PP, Produktionsplanung, MRP, Bestandskontrolle und funktionsübergreifender Koordination verfügen, um die Erfüllung von Verkaufsplänen und Kundenlieferverpflichtungen sicherzustellen.
Wichtigste Zuständigkeiten

Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP)

• Erstellen und eigene jährliche, vierteljährliche, monatliche und wöchentliche Verkaufs- und Produktionspläne.

• Steigerung der Nachfrageprognose und Verbesserung der Vorhersagegenauigkeit.

• Konvertieren Sie Verkaufsprognosen in ausführbare Fertigungspläne.

• Arbeiten Sie eng mit Vertriebs- und Projektmanagementteams zusammen, um die Erfüllung der Kundenverpflichtungen sicherzustellen.

Produktions- und Montageplanung

• Entwicklung und Verwaltung von Master Production Schedule (MPS).

• Gewährleistung der Erfüllung der Produktionspläne und der Lieferverpflichtungen der Kunden.

• Fahrplaneinhaltung über Bearbeitungs-, Montage-, Test- und Versandfunktionen hinweg.

• Überwachung der Kapazitätsauslastung und Ermittlung von Engpässen.
Pump Assembly Kit Management

• Führen Sie tägliche und wöchentliche Bewertungen zwischen Stores und Assembly-Teams durch.

• Stellen Sie die vollständige Einsatzbereitschaft sicher, bevor die Montage beginnt.

• Schließung von Engpässen, die sich auf Montagepläne auswirken.

• Überwachen Sie die Verfügbarkeit kritischer Materialien, um eine ununterbrochene Produktion zu unterstützen.

• Führen Sie regelmäßige Planungsüberprüfungen mit Beschaffungsteams durch.

• Richten Sie die Einkaufspläne an Verkaufsprognosen und Montageanforderungen aus.

• Fahren Sie rechtzeitig Verfügbarkeit von langen Blei und kritische Materialien.

• Proaktives Management von Lieferkettenrisiken und Eskalationen.
Projektplanung & Kundenlieferungen

• Leiten Sie Projekt-Kick-off-Meetings für neue Kundenaufträge.

• Definieren und überwachen Sie wichtige Meilensteine aus dem Engineering Release durch die Rechnungsstellung.

• Arbeiten Sie eng mit Projektmanagern zusammen, um sicherzustellen, dass die Kundenverpflichtungen erfüllt werden.

• Unterstützen Sie Kundenbewertungen durch zuverlässige Ausführungs- und Lieferprognosen.
Funktionale Führung

• Führen Sie Tier-2-Operationsmeetings und treiben Sie den Abschluss von Aktionen voran.

• Koordinieren Sie sich mit den Teams Sales, Project Management, Engineering, Procurement, Stores, Manufacturing, Quality, Logistics und Finance.

• Leiten Sie die unternehmensweite Ausrichtung auf die Erreichung von Geschäftsverkaufsplänen voran.
Inventar & MRP Management

• Eigene Bestandsplanung und Bestandskontrolle.

• Führen und überwachen Sie Daily MRP Runs in SAP.

• Überprüfen und schließen Sie MRP-Ausnahmemeldungen täglich.

• Sicherstellen der Planung der Stammdatengenauigkeit innerhalb von SAP.

• Verantwortlich für Packing Slip Creation in SAP zur Unterstützung von Versand- und Lieferaktivitäten.

• Steigern Sie die Materialverfügbarkeit und optimieren Sie die Lagerbestände und das Betriebskapital.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Sulzer est une société d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable.

Sur le rôle

Résumé de l'emploi
Le planificateur de production est chargé de planifier et de coordonner les activités de production pour assurer la livraison en temps opportun des produits. Ce rôle est étroitement lié aux achats, à la fabrication et à la logistique afin d'harmoniser les plans de production avec les prévisions de la demande et la disponibilité des ressources.
Ce profil d'emploi est destiné aux professionnels expérimentés qui appliquent des connaissances pratiques d'un domaine d'emploi et travaillent de manière indépendante avec une supervision générale. Ouverture immédiate : Directeur adjoint (ASM II) - Planification (pompes et matériel rotatif) -
Nous sommes à la recherche d'un directeur adjoint expérimenté et axé sur les résultats (ASM II) - Planification de diriger la planification de la production, la prévision de la demande, la planification des matériaux, la gestion des stocks et la planification de la livraison des clients pour notre entreprise de fabrication de pompes. Le candidat idéal devrait posséder une solide expertise en PP SAP, planification de la production, PGR, contrôle des stocks et coordination interfonctionnelle pour assurer la réalisation des plans de vente et des engagements de livraison des clients.
Principales responsabilités

Planification des ventes et des opérations

• Diriger le processus mensuel de S et P et aligner la demande sur la capacité de fabrication.

• Créer et ses propres plans de ventes et de production annuels, trimestriels, mensuels et hebdomadaires.

• Favoriser la prévision de la demande et l'amélioration de la précision des prévisions.

• Convertir les prévisions de ventes en plans de fabrication exécutables.

• Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes de vente et de gestion de projet pour assurer le respect des engagements des clients.

Production et planification de montage

• Élaborer et gérer le calendrier directeur de production (SGP).

• Assurer la réalisation des plans de production et des engagements de livraison des clients.

• Conduire l'adhérence du calendrier à travers les fonctions d'usinage, de montage, d'essai et d'expédition.

• Surveiller l'utilisation des capacités et identifier les goulets d'étranglement.
Gestion du kit d'assemblage de pompe

• Dirigez les examens quotidiens et hebdomadaires entre les magasins et les équipes d'assemblage.

• Assurez-vous que la trousse est prête avant le début de l'assemblage.

• Mettre fin aux pénuries affectant les calendriers de montage.

• Surveiller la disponibilité des matériaux essentiels pour soutenir la production ininterrompue.
Planification des achats et du matériel

• Effectuer régulièrement des examens de planification avec les équipes d'approvisionnement.

• Aligner les calendriers d'achat avec les prévisions de vente et les exigences de montage.

• Assurer la disponibilité en temps opportun de matériaux de plomb et de matériaux essentiels.

• Gérer proactivement les risques et les escalades de la chaîne d'approvisionnement.
Planification de projet et livraisons à la clientèle

• Diriger les réunions de lancement du projet pour les nouvelles commandes de clients.

• Définir et surveiller les étapes clés de la publication d'ingénierie par facturation.

• Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les gestionnaires de projet pour s'assurer que les engagements des clients sont atteints.

• Soutenez les évaluations des clients en fournissant des prévisions d'exécution et de livraison fiables.
Leadership transfonctionnel

• Diriger les réunions opérationnelles de niveau 2 et conduire la clôture des activités.

• Coordonner avec les équipes ventes, gestion de projet, ingénierie, approvisionnement, magasins, fabrication, qualité, logistique et finances.

• Conduire l'alignement à l'échelle de l'organisation vers la réalisation des plans de vente des entreprises.
Gestion des stocks et des MRP

• Activités de planification et de contrôle des stocks.

• Exécuter et surveiller Daily MRP Exécute dans SAP.

• Examiner et fermer quotidiennement les messages d'exception au PRM.

• Assurer l'exactitude des données de gestion de la planification dans SAP.

• Responsable de l'emballage Slip Creation dans SAP pour soutenir les activités d'expédition et de livraison.

• Conduire la disponibilité des matériaux tout en optimisant les niveaux d'inventaire et le fonds de roulement.

• Surveiller le rendement des stocks de matières premières, de WIP et de marchandises finies.

Compétences et compétences recherchées

• Expertise en planification et contrôle de la production (PPC)

• Forte expérience dans la fabrication de pompes / environnement d'ingénierie à commande (ETO)

• Prévisions de la demande avancée et planification des capacités

• Excellente connaissance du module SAP PP (obligatoire)

• Connaissances pratiques de S

jobs.title: Assembly Technician
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Assembler is responsible for putting together component parts or products according to blueprints or schematics. This role ensures that assembled items meet quality standards and supports the production line by maintaining efficiency and accuracy.
This job profile is intended for support staff that follows established procedures and works under close supervision. Smaller/easier decisions are made autonomously. Key Responsibilities
Assemble parts and components using hand tools and equipment.
Follow technical instructions and blueprints.
Inspect assembled products for defects.
Maintain a clean and organized work area.
Report issues to supervisors.
Support inventory and materials tracking.
Follow safety and quality procedures.
Skills & Qualifications
May require basic vocational training (or equivalent work experience) and up to 2 years of relevant experience to carry out the role.

Manual dexterity and attention to detail.
Ability to read and interpret technical documents.
Basic mechanical and tool-handling skills.
Teamwork and communication abilities.
Willingness to follow procedures and meet production targets.

What we offer you

• Competitive Paid Time Off (3 weeks to start)

• 1 2 Company Paid Holidays per year

• Annual Bonus Program

• Full Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits

• Company Paid Short Term and Long Term Disability, Company Paid Life Insurance

• 6% 401K or Roth Company Match with Immediate Vesting

• Company Paid Retirement Security Contributions following 1 year of employment

• Tuition Reimbursement/Educational Assistance

• Quarterly Gym Reimbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Informazioni sul ruolo

Sintesi del lavoro
L'Assembler è responsabile di mettere insieme parti o prodotti dei componenti in base a progetti o schemi. Questo ruolo assicura che gli oggetti assemblati soddisfino gli standard di qualità e supportano la linea di produzione mantenendo efficienza e precisione.
Questo profilo di lavoro è destinato al personale di supporto che segue procedure e lavori consolidati sotto stretta supervisione. Le decisioni più piccole e più semplici sono prese in autonomia. Principali responsabilità
Assemblare parti e componenti utilizzando utensili manuali e attrezzature.
Seguire le istruzioni tecniche e i progetti.
Ispezionare prodotti assemblati per difetti.
Mantenere una zona di lavoro pulita e organizzata.
Rapporto numerico ai supervisori.
Supporto inventario e monitoraggio dei materiali.
Seguire procedure di sicurezza e qualità.
Competenze & Qualifiche
Può richiedere la formazione professionale di base (o l'esperienza lavorativa equivalente) e fino a 2 anni di esperienza rilevante per svolgere il ruolo.

Destrezza manuale e attenzione ai dettagli.
Capacità di leggere e interpretare documenti tecnici.
Competenze meccaniche e utensili di base.
Capacità di lavoro di squadra e di comunicazione.
Volontà di seguire le procedure e soddisfare gli obiettivi di produzione.

Cosa ti offriamo

• Competitive Paid Time Off (3 settimane per iniziare)

• 1 2 Vacanze a pagamento per anno

• Programma bonus annuale

• Vantaggi medici, dentali e di visione completi

• Società pagata a breve termine e disabilità a lungo termine, Azienda pagato vita assicurazione

• 6% 401K o Roth Company Match con gilet immediato

• Contributi di sicurezza a carico della società a seguito di 1 anno di occupazione

• Rimborso/Assistenza educativa

• Rimborso trimestrale

Sulzer è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità. Crediamo nella forza di una forza lavoro diversificata e ci impegniamo ad offrire un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo.

Siamo orgogliosi di essere riconosciuti come Top Employer 2026 in Brasile, Canada, Cina, Finlandia, Germania, Irlanda, Messico, Svizzera, Sud Africa, Regno Unito e Stati Uniti.

jobs.title: Service Operations Leader AME

titleByLocale.it: Leader delle operazioni di servizio AME

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The Head, Service Operations Americas is responsible for leading all service execution activities across the Americas region, including service estimation, project management, field execution, superintendents, third-party labor management, inventory coordination, customer execution support, and operational performance management.
• Lead all service project management activities across the Americas region and ensure projects are delivered safely, on-time, and profitably.

• Lead field execution activities including turnarounds, revamps, repairs, inspections, installations, and service projects.

• Lead service estimation activities supporting aftermarket and turnaround opportunities.

• Support sales organizations during opportunity qualification, customer meetings, and proposal development.

• Lead planning and deployment of internal and external service resources.

• Manage relationships with subcontractors, labor providers, specialty contractors, and field service partners.

• Oversee service-related inventory, tooling, equipment, logistics, and mobilization readiness.

• Develop and manage regional service operations KPIs and management cadence reviews.

• Drive improvements in execution speed, productivity, customer responsiveness, and operational effectiveness.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Manage superintendent leadership and establish consistent field execution standards across the region.

QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Business, Operations Management, or related discipline preferred.

• 10+ years of progressive experience in industrial field services, turnaround operations, maintenance services, project execution, or construction management.

• Minimum 5 years of leadership experience managing project execution and field service organizations.

• Experience leading multi-country or regional service operations organizations preferred.

• Strong knowledge of project management, turnaround execution, cost control, operational planning, customer management, and safety leadership.

•

TRAVEL: Up to 40%

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym reimbursement

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The Head, Applications & Proposal Technology (APT) Americas is responsible for leading the Americas Applications, Process Engineering, Proposal Generation, Estimation Support, Value Engineering and Technical Support functions. The role leads development of technical solutions and proposals for new products, replacement-in-kind opportunities, turnaround replacement components, revamps, upgrades, debottlenecking projects and other MTCS opportunities while ensuring proposals are delivered on time, in full, and with high technical quality. ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The IT Lead Expert is responsible for leading complex IT initiatives and providing expert-level guidance in the design, implementation, and optimization of IT systems and infrastructure. This role ensures alignment of IT solutions with business objectives and drives innovation across the organization. This job profile is intended for recognized subject matter experts in a job area. Required to manage large projects or processes with limited oversight from manager. Coaches, reviews and delegates work to lower level professionals. We are looking for an experienced IT Project Manager SAP S/4HANA to join our Business Transformation Program and play a key role in one of Sulzer's most strategic global initiatives.
In this position, you will help shape and drive the design, implementation, and rollout of Sulzer's global SAP S/4HANA template. Working closely with program leadership, business stakeholders, and implementation partners, you will provide expert guidance, governance, and quality assurance to ensure successful project delivery and long-term business value.
This is an exciting opportunity for a seasoned SAP transformation professional who enjoys operating at a strategic level while influencing solution design, governance, and delivery across a complex international environment.

What you will do:

• Lead quality assurance activities across all phases of the SAP S/4HANA transformation program.

• Establish and manage quality gates, review frameworks, and deliverable acceptance criteria.

• Review solution designs and technical deliverables to ensure alignment with business requirements and SAP best practices.

• Promote SAP Clean Core principles and support scalable, sustainable solution design.

• Conduct phase-gate and readiness reviews across program milestones.

• Assess project risks, dependencies, open issues, and mitigation plans.

• Provide expert advice and recommendations to program leadership and key stakeholders.

• Facilitate collaboration between business teams, IT functions, SAP specialists, and implementation partners.

• Review implementation partner deliverables, estimates, and design recommendations.

• Challenge solutions that introduce unnecessary complexity, risk, or long-term maintenance effort.

• Support future-state process design and operating model decisions.

• Contribute industry best practices from engineering, manufacturing, project-based, and service organizations.

• Drive continuous improvement by introducing lessons learned and proven practices from large transformation programs.

• Support knowledge transfer and capability development across the organization.

• Promote a collaborative One Sulzer culture focused on teamwork, customer value, and continuous improvement.

What you need to succeed:
Required:

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline.

• More than 15 years of experience in SAP consulting, solution architecture, transformation leadership, or program governance.

• Minimum 5 to 6 years of SAP S/4HANA implementation experience, including large-scale global transformation programs.

• Strong knowledge of SAP S/4HANA, SAP Activate methodology, global template design, integration, data migration, testing, cutover, and deployment.

• Experience supporting global template design, fit-to-standard workshops, solution governance, and design reviews.

• Deep understanding of manufacturing, engineering, project-based, Engineered-to-Order (ETO), Configured-to-Order (CTO), and service business environments.

• Experience working with senior business stakeholders and major ERP implementation partners.

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities.

• Excellent stakeholder man

• Sostenere le decisioni di progettazione e modello operativo del futuro-stato.

• Contribuire le migliori pratiche del settore da ingegneria, produzione, project-based e organizzazioni di servizi.

• Guidare il miglioramento continuo introducendo lezioni apprese e pratiche provate da grandi programmi di trasformazione.

• Supporto trasferimento di conoscenze e sviluppo di capacità in tutta l'organizzazione.

• Promuovere una cultura collaborativa One Sulzer focalizzata sul lavoro di squadra, sul valore del cliente e sul miglioramento continuo.

• Esperienza di implementazione SAP S/4HANA da 5 a 6 anni, compresi i programmi di trasformazione globale su larga scala.

• Forte conoscenza della metodologia SAP S/4HANA, SAP Activate, progettazione globale dei modelli, integrazione, migrazione dei dati, test, cutover e distribuzione.

• Esperienza che supporta la progettazione globale dei modelli, workshop fit-to-standard, governance delle soluzioni e recensioni di design.

• Comprensione profonda della produzione, dell'ingegneria, del progetto, dell'ingegneria, dell'ETO, del Configured-to-Order (CTO) e degli ambienti aziendali di servizio.

• Esperienza di lavoro con gli stakeholder aziendali senior e i principali partner di implementazione ERP.

• Forte capacità analitiche, problem solving e decision-making.

• Uomo di stakeholder eccellente

• Bieten Sie fachkundige Beratung und Empfehlungen für die Programmführung und die wichtigsten Stakeholder.

• Überprüfen Sie die Ergebnisse der Implementierungspartner, Schätzungen und Designempfehlungen.

• Herausfordern von Lösungen, die unnötige Komplexität, Risiken oder langfristigen Wartungsaufwand mit sich bringen.

• Unterstützen Sie zukünftige Prozessdesign- und Betriebsmodellentscheidungen.

• Tragen Sie Best Practices aus den Bereichen Engineering, Fertigung, projektbasierte und Serviceorganisationen bei.

• Steigern Sie kontinuierliche Verbesserungen durch die Einführung von Lektionen und bewährten Praktiken aus großen Transformationsprogrammen.

• Unterstützung des Wissenstransfers und der Entwicklung von Fähigkeiten im gesamten Unternehmen.

• Förderung einer kollaborativen One-Sulzer-Kultur, die sich auf Teamarbeit, Kundennutzen und kontinuierliche Verbesserung konzentriert.

Was Sie brauchen, um erfolgreich zu sein:
Vorgeschrieben:

• Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss in Informatik, Informationstechnologie oder einer verwandten Disziplin.

• Mehr als 15 Jahre Erfahrung in SAP-Beratung, Lösungsarchitektur, Transformation Leadership oder Programm Governance.

• Mindestens 5 bis 6 Jahre Erfahrung in der Implementierung von SAP S/4HANA, einschließlich groß angelegter globaler Transformationsprogramme.

• Umfangreiche Kenntnisse über SAP S/4HANA, SAP Activate-Methodik, globales Template-Design, Integration, Datenmigration, Testen, Cutover und Deployment.

• Erfahrung in der Unterstützung von globalem Template-Design, Fit-to-Standard-Workshops, Solution Governance und Design Reviews.

• Tiefes Verständnis für Fertigung, Engineering, projektbasierte, Engineered-to-Order (ETO), Configured-to-Order (CTO) und Service-Geschäftsumgebungen.

• Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit Senior Business Stakeholdern und wichtigen ERP-Implementierungspartnern.

• Starke analytische, Problemlösungs- und Entscheidungsfähigkeiten.

• Ausgezeichneter Stakeholder Mann

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. Your main tasks and responsibilities:

Portfolio & Project Management

• Lead and guide overall execution of multiple IT Projects, ensuring alignment with Sulzer’s strategic priorities.

• Monitor project progress, manage risks, and ensure timely delivery, budget adherence and manage interdependencies between projects.

• Maintain project documentation, status reports, and dashboards for leadership and stakeholders.

Governance & Methodology

• Apply and promote consistent project management methodologies, tools, and reporting standards.

• Ensure compliance with governance frameworks and contribute to process improvement initiatives.

Stakeholder Management

• Build strong relationships with business leaders and IT stakeholders to ensure project objectives meet business needs, leading the IT project Steering Committees.

• Act as a key point of contact for project-related communication and issue resolution.

• Proactively engage in business partnering, acting as a trusted advisor to business divisions and supporting the identification, prioritization, and management of IT demands to maximize value delivery.

Demand Management

• Lead the demand management process by capturing, evaluating, and prioritizing business requirements, ensuring alignment with Sulzer’s strategic objectives and resource availability.

• Facilitate transparent decision-making on project selection and resource allocation.

Vendor & Financial Management

• Support vendor selection, contract management, and performance tracking for project-related services.

• Assist in project budgeting, forecasting, and financial performance tracking.

Operational Excellence

• Drive efficiency in project delivery and resource allocation.

• Champion continuous improvement and simplification across project processes and tools.

Sulzer Core Ambition Program

• Actively contribute to the SulzerCore Ambition Program by ensuring that all project and portfolio activities support the organizations goals and strategic ambitions.

Team Collaboration & Development

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams and contribute to a culture of accountability and excellence.

• Mentor junior project managers or team members as needed.

• Drive efficiency across IT operations, including resource allocation, vendor management, and performance tracking.

• Champion continuous improvement and simplification across the IT landscape, including consolidation of tools and platforms.

OneSulzer Culture

• Promote and embody the OneSulzer mindset by fostering collaboration with an “Entrepreneurial spirit and teamwork”, challenging the status quo, and supporting a unified, “Customer focus” culture across all divisions and teams.

Desired Experience & Qualifications

• 9+ years of professional experience in IT and business/industry environments

• At least 5 years of experience in team management and leadership roles

• Strong experience with project methods and methodologies

• Solid knowledge of operating models (Ops Models)

• Proven experience in financial management within IT or project-driven environments

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field

• Project management certifications such as PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent practical experience

• Fluent in English

• Strong leadership and communication skills

• Proven ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously

• Experience in stakeholder engagement and change management

• Analytical mindset with strong attention to detail

• Ability to work effective

• Efficienza dell'azionamento attraverso le operazioni IT, tra cui allocazione delle risorse, gestione dei fornitori e monitoraggio delle prestazioni.

• Campione continuo miglioramento e semplificazione attraverso il paesaggio IT, compreso il consolidamento di strumenti e piattaforme.

• Almeno 5 anni di esperienza nella gestione del team e ruoli di leadership

• Forte esperienza con metodi e metodologie di progetto

• Conoscenza solida dei modelli operativi (Ops Models)

• Esperienza dimostrata nella gestione finanziaria in ambienti IT o project-driven

• Corso di laurea in Informatica, Informatica, o un campo relativo

• Certificazioni di gestione del progetto come PMP, PRINCE2, o equivalente esperienza pratica

• Fluente in inglese

• Forte capacità di leadership e comunicazione

• Prova capacità di gestire più progetti e priorità contemporaneamente

• Esperienza nell'impegno e nella gestione dei cambiamenti degli stakeholder

• Mindset analitico con forte attenzione al dettaglio

At Sulzer, we are innovators with a rich engineering heritage and a future ‑ focused mindset. To strengthen our Services business across Europe & Africa (EUA), we are looking for a senior engineering leader to drive innovation, technical excellence, and commercial impact across Steam Turbines and Compressors (STC) .

As a key member of the STC Team , you will develop and lead the engineering innovation and technical strategy for Compressors . You will strengthen engineering capabilities across the region, introduce best ‑ practice technical processes, and support service growth through high ‑ quality repair, retrofit, and reverse ‑ engineering solutions.

• Flexibility and adaptability in a dynamic service ‑ driven environment.

• Strong organisational skills with attention to detail and quality standards.

jobs.title: Regional Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Join Sulzer’s Business Intelligence & Analytics team and play a key role in accelerating our data transformation across the Services Division. This position sits at the crossroads of business intelligence, analytics, and technology, providing an exciting opportunity to influence how data is leveraged to support strategic and operational decisions across the region.
We are looking for a proactive and business-oriented data professional who enjoys turning complex data into actionable insights. The ideal candidate combines strong analytical capabilities with a builder mindset, constantly seeking smarter, faster, and more effective ways of working through technology and innovation.
In this highly visible role, you will partner with stakeholders across Sales, Operations, Finance, and Supply Chain, helping teams unlock the full value of data while promoting a culture of data-driven decision making. What you will do:

• Gather and translate business requirements into clear, decision-enabling dashboards and analyses.

• Develop, enhance, and maintain business intelligence dashboards, ensuring consistency, usability, and high-quality user experiences.

• Manage analytics and dashboard development projects from scope definition through delivery and continuous improvement.

• Build a strong understanding of data sources, structures, and flows across CRM, ERP, and cloud platforms.

• Ensure dashboards are intuitive, actionable, and accessible to business users with minimal training.

• Maintain documentation for dashboards, data models, and related processes.

• Participate in ERP, CRM, and BI governance activities and serve as a regional point of reference for business users.

• Identify data quality issues and collaborate with stakeholders to implement sustainable improvement solutions.

• Analyze trends across regions, product lines, and business areas to uncover actionable insights and opportunities.

• Support stakeholders with ad hoc analyses and deep-dive investigations to address complex business questions.

• Partner with regional and sub-regional management teams to understand business priorities and enable informed decision-making.

• Guide and support regional users in adopting and effectively utilizing BI tools and dashboards.

• Design and deliver training sessions that increase data literacy and user adoption.

• Support leadership teams with compelling, data-driven narratives and recommendations.

• Identify opportunities to automate, simplify, and improve existing reporting and analytics processes through emerging technologies and tools.

What you need to succeed:
Required:

• 3 to 6 years of experience in a data analytics, business intelligence, or related role.

• Proven experience developing dashboards that support real business decision-making.

• Advanced Excel and Power Pivot skills, including complex data models, pivot tables, and data analysis techniques.

• Hands-on experience with a major BI platform such as Qlik Sense, Power BI, Tableau, or similar.

• Strong understanding of data structures, data modelling, and working with multiple data sources.

• Experience partnering with business functions such as Sales, Operations, Finance, or Supply Chain.

• Experience collaborating with both business stakeholders and technical or IT teams.

• Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities.

• Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts to diverse audiences.

• Excellent written and spoken English.

Preferred:

• Experience in an industrial, manufacturing, B2B environment, or consultancy.

• Exposure to CRM systems such as Salesforce.

• Experience working with ERP systems such as SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365, or similar.

• Familiarity with cloud

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile.

Informazioni sul ruolo

Unisciti al team Business Intelligence & Analytics di Sulzer e gioca un ruolo chiave nell'accelerare la nostra trasformazione dei dati in tutta la Divisione Servizi. Questa posizione si trova all'incrocio tra business intelligence, analisi e tecnologia, fornendo un'emozionante opportunità di influenzare come i dati sono sfruttati per supportare le decisioni strategiche e operative in tutta la regione.
Siamo alla ricerca di un professionista di dati proattivo e orientato al business che gode di trasformare i dati complessi in insight attuabili. Il candidato ideale combina forti capacità analitiche con una mentalità di costruttore, costantemente alla ricerca di modi più intelligenti, più veloci e più efficaci di lavorare attraverso la tecnologia e l'innovazione.
In questo ruolo altamente visibile, si partnerrà con le parti interessate attraverso Vendite, Operazioni, Finanza e Supply Chain, aiutando i team a sbloccare il pieno valore dei dati, promuovendo una cultura del processo decisionale basato sui dati. Cosa farai:

• Raccogliere e tradurre i requisiti aziendali in cruscotti e analisi chiare e decisionali.

• Sviluppare, migliorare e mantenere dashboard di business intelligence, garantendo coerenza, usabilità e esperienze utente di alta qualità.

• Gestisci progetti di sviluppo di analisi e dashboard dalla definizione di scopo attraverso la consegna e il miglioramento continuo.

• Costruire una forte comprensione delle fonti di dati, delle strutture e dei flussi attraverso piattaforme CRM, ERP e cloud.

• Assicurarsi che i cruscotti siano intuitivi, utilizzabili e accessibili agli utenti aziendali con una formazione minima.

• Mantenere la documentazione per dashboard, modelli di dati e processi correlati.

• Partecipa alle attività di ERP, CRM e BI governance e funge da punto di riferimento regionale per gli utenti aziendali.

• Identificare i problemi di qualità dei dati e collaborare con gli stakeholder per implementare soluzioni di miglioramento sostenibile.

• Analizzare le tendenze in tutte le regioni, linee di prodotto e aree di business per scoprire intuizioni e opportunità attuabili.

• Sostenere gli stakeholder con analisi ad hoc e indagini approfondite per affrontare questioni aziendali complesse.

• Partner con i team di gestione regionale e subregionale per comprendere le priorità aziendali e consentire il processo decisionale informato.

• Guidare e sostenere gli utenti regionali nell'adottare ed efficacemente utilizzando strumenti e dashboard BI.

• Progettare e fornire sessioni di formazione che aumentano l'alfabetizzazione dei dati e l'adozione degli utenti.

• Sostenere i team di leadership con narrazioni e raccomandazioni convincenti e guidati dai dati.

• Identificare le opportunità per automatizzare, semplificare e migliorare i processi di reporting e analisi esistenti attraverso tecnologie e strumenti emergenti.

Quello che dovete avere successo:
Richiesto:

• Da 3 a 6 anni di esperienza in un'analisi dei dati, intelligenza aziendale o ruolo correlato.

• Esperienza comprovata nello sviluppo di dashboard che supportano il processo decisionale aziendale reale.

• Competenze avanzate di Excel e Power Pivot, inclusi modelli di dati complessi, tabelle pivot e tecniche di analisi dei dati.

• Esperienza pratica con una grande piattaforma BI come Qlik Sense, Power BI, Tableau o simili.

• Forte comprensione delle strutture dei dati, della modellazione dei dati e del lavoro con più fonti di dati.

• Esperienza di collaborazione con funzioni aziendali come vendite, operazioni, finanza, o Supply Chain.

• Esperienza di collaborazione sia con gli stakeholder aziendali che con i team tecnici o IT.

• Eccellente capacità analitiche e di problem solving.

• Forte capacità di comunicazione e presentazione, con la capacità di spiegare concetti complessi a diversi pubblico.

• Ottimo scritto e parlato inglese.

Preferito:

• Esperienza in un ambiente industriale, manifatturiero, B2B o consulenza.

• Esposizione a sistemi CRM come Salesforce.

• Esperienza di lavoro con sistemi ERP come SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365, o simili.

• Familiarità con il cloud

descriptionByLocale.de:

Treten Sie dem Business Intelligence & Analytics-Team von Sulzer bei und spielen Sie eine wichtige Rolle bei der Beschleunigung unserer Datentransformation in der gesamten Serviceabteilung. Diese Position steht an der Kreuzung von Business Intelligence, Analytics und Technologie und bietet eine aufregende Gelegenheit, Einfluss darauf zu nehmen, wie Daten genutzt werden, um strategische und operative Entscheidungen in der Region zu unterstützen.
Wir suchen einen proaktiven und geschäftsorientierten Datenprofi, der es genießt, komplexe Daten in umsetzbare Erkenntnisse umzuwandeln. Der ideale Kandidat kombiniert starke analytische Fähigkeiten mit einer Builder-Mentalität und sucht ständig nach intelligenteren, schnelleren und effektiveren Wegen, durch Technologie und Innovation zu arbeiten.
In dieser sehr sichtbaren Rolle arbeiten Sie mit Stakeholdern aus den Bereichen Vertrieb, Betrieb, Finanzen und Lieferkette zusammen und unterstützen Teams dabei, den vollen Wert der Daten zu nutzen und gleichzeitig eine Kultur der datengesteuerten Entscheidungsfindung zu fördern. Was Sie tun werden:

• Sammeln und übersetzen Sie Geschäftsanforderungen in klare, entscheidungsfähige Dashboards und Analysen.

• Unterstützen Sie Führungsteams mit überzeugenden, datengesteuerten Erzählungen und Empfehlungen.

• Identifizieren Sie Möglichkeiten zur Automatisierung, Vereinfachung und Verbesserung bestehender Berichts- und Analyseprozesse durch neue Technologien und Tools.

Was Sie brauchen, um erfolgreich zu sein:
Vorgeschrieben:

• 3 bis 6 Jahre Erfahrung in einer Data Analytics, Business Intelligence oder verwandten Rolle.

• Bewährte Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Dashboards, die echte Geschäftsentscheidungen unterstützen.

• Erweiterte Excel- und Power-Pivot-Fähigkeiten, einschließlich komplexer Datenmodelle, Pivot-Tabellen und Datenanalysetechniken.

• Praktische Erfahrung mit einer großen BI-Plattform wie Qlik Sense, Power BI, Tableau oder ähnlichem.

• Ein fundiertes Verständnis der Datenstrukturen, der Datenmodellierung und der Arbeit mit mehreren Datenquellen.

• Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit Geschäftsfunktionen wie Sales, Operations, Finance oder Supply Chain.

• Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit geschäftlichen Stakeholdern und technischen oder IT-Teams.

• Hervorragende analytische und Problemlösungsfähigkeiten.

• Starke Kommunikations- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, komplexe Konzepte einem unterschiedlichen Publikum zu erklären.

• Hervorragend geschriebenes und gesprochenes Englisch.

Bevorzugt:

• Erfahrung in einer Industrie-, Fertigungs-, B2B-Umgebung oder Beratung.

• Exposition gegenüber CRM-Systemen wie Salesforce.

• Erfahrung mit ERP-Systemen wie SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365 oder ähnlichem.

• Vertrautheit mit der Cloud
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable.

Rejoignez l'équipe d'intelligence d'affaires et d'analyse de Sulzer et jouez un rôle clé dans l'accélération de notre transformation des données à travers la Division des services. Ce poste se trouve à la croisée des chemins de l'intelligence d'affaires, de l'analyse et de la technologie, offrant une occasion passionnante d'influencer la façon dont les données sont utilisées pour appuyer les décisions stratégiques et opérationnelles dans toute la région.
Nous sommes à la recherche d'un professionnel des données proactif et orienté vers l'entreprise qui aime transformer des données complexes en informations pratiques. Le candidat idéal combine de solides capacités d'analyse avec un état d'esprit de constructeur, cherchant constamment des moyens plus intelligents, plus rapides et plus efficaces de travailler à travers la technologie et l'innovation.
Dans ce rôle très visible, vous travaillerez en partenariat avec des intervenants des secteurs des ventes, des opérations, des finances et de la chaîne d'approvisionnement, aidant les équipes à débloquer toute la valeur des données tout en favorisant une culture de prise de décision axée sur les données. Ce que vous devez réussir:

• Expérience éprouvée de l'élaboration de tableaux de bord qui appuient la prise de décisions commerciales réelles.

• Compétences avancées Excel et Power Pivot, y compris des modèles de données complexes, des tables de pivot et des techniques d'analyse de données.

• Expérience pratique avec une grande plateforme BI comme Qlik Sense, Power BI, Tableau, ou similaire.

• Une bonne compréhension des structures de données, de la modélisation des données et de la collaboration avec de multiples sources de données.

• Expérience de partenariat avec des fonctions commerciales comme les ventes, les opérations, les finances ou la chaîne d'approvisionnement.

• Expérience de collaboration avec les intervenants commerciaux et les équipes techniques ou informatiques.

• Excellentes capacités d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Business Excellence / Development Sr. Expert is responsible for driving strategic planning and operational improvement initiatives across the organization. This role applies deep subject matter expertise to identify growth opportunities, optimize business processes, and align operations with corporate goals. The position plays a key role in managing large-scale projects and mentoring junior professionals.
This job profile is intended for recognized subject matter experts in a job area. Required to manage large projects or processes with limited oversight from manager. Coaches, reviews and delegates work to lower level professionals. ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

• Lead the Americas Business Development & Sales Operations organization, including business intelligence, CRM governance, sales process management, installed-base development, forecasting, and commercial analytics.

• Drive regional business development initiatives focused on new account acquisition, white-space opportunities, emerging applications, geographic expansion, and strategic growth markets.

• Develop and maintain a comprehensive understanding of Sulzer and OEM-X installed base opportunities across the Americas.

• Establish systems and processes to track customer turnarounds (STOs), revamps, expansions, debottlenecking projects and maintenance cycles.

• Own CRM governance, opportunity management discipline, data quality standards, and forecasting processes.

• Coordinate pipeline reviews, forecasting processes, backlog analysis, and commercial performance reporting.

• Develop commercial dashboards, KPIs, and business intelligence tools to support decision making.

• Support deployment of market-based pricing initiatives and commercial governance processes.

• Partner with Sales, APT and Service Operations teams to identify and prioritize growth opportunities.

• Conduct market analysis, competitor assessments, and strategic business evaluations.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Lead, coach and develop business development, commercial analytics, and sales operations personnel.

QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Marketing, Economics, or related discipline.

• MBA preferred.

• 10+ years of experience in business development, sales operations, commercial excellence, strategic marketing, or sales leadership.

• Experience within refining, petrochemical, chemical processing, LNG, gas processing, engineered equipment, or related industries.

• Strong understanding of CRM systems, forecasting, business analytics, pipeline management, and commercial governance.

• Excellent communication, leadership, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

What we offer you

• PTO and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401K plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym reimbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Über die Rolle

Aufgrund des anhaltenden Wachstums suchen wir einen kaufmännischen Projektmanager, der komplexe internationale Projekte von der Auftragsvergabe bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss leitet.

Wir suchen eine Person, die starke Projektausführungsfähigkeiten mit kommerziellem Bewusstsein und Kundenorientierung kombiniert.

Sie werden mehrere internationale Projekte mit Gasturbinen, rotierenden Geräten und zugehörigen Dienstleistungen verwalten, um sicherzustellen, dass Projekte sicher, pünktlich, innerhalb des Budgets und mit gesunden Gewinnmargen geliefert werden.

In enger Zusammenarbeit mit Sales, Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain und Kunden sind Sie während des gesamten Projektlebenszyklus im Mittelpunkt der Zusammenarbeit und stellen sicher, dass die Erwartungen der Kunden übertroffen werden.

• Eigentümer des Projekts Rentabilität, finanzielle Leistung und vertragliche Verpflichtungen

• Bereitstellung regelmäßiger Projektaktualisierungen und Finanzprognosen für Stakeholder

• Unterstützung des Geschäftswachstums durch einen proaktiven und kundenorientierten Ansatz

Was wir suchen

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung als Projektmanager in Gasturbinen, Rotationsanlagen, Stromerzeugung, Energie oder verwandten Industriedienstleistungen

• Starker kommerzieller Scharfsinn mit einer Erfolgsbilanz bei der Bereitstellung profitabler Projekte

• Verständnis von Überholung, Wartung, Reparatur oder Außendienstumgebungen rotierender Geräte

• Fähigkeit, Kundenbeziehungen zu verwalten und selbstbewusst mit leitenden Stakeholdern in Kontakt zu treten

• Starke Verhandlungs- und Einflussfähigkeiten

• Hervorragende Kommunikations- und Führungsfähigkeiten

• Ergebnisorientierte Denkweise mit der Fähigkeit, kommerzielle Möglichkeiten jenseits des ursprünglichen Projektumfangs zu identifizieren

• Projektmanagement-Qualifikation wünschenswert, aber nicht notwendig

• Jährliches persönliches Bonussystem basierend auf Unternehmens- und persönlicher Leistung

Sur le rôle

Chez Sulzer GT Aero, nous sommes spécialistes de l'entretien, de la réparation, de la révision et de l'extension de la durée de vie des turbines à gaz aérodérivées et des équipements rotatifs associés. En soutenant les clients dans les secteurs de l'énergie, de l'industrie et de la marine, nous aidons à maintenir des actifs essentiels fonctionnant de façon sûre, efficace et fiable dans le monde entier.

En raison de la croissance continue, nous recherchons un gestionnaire de projet d'esprit commercial pour diriger des projets internationaux complexes, depuis l'attribution du contrat jusqu'à la réussite.

Nous sommes à la recherche d'une personne qui combine de solides compétences en exécution de projets avec une sensibilisation commerciale et une orientation client.

Vous gérerez plusieurs projets internationaux impliquant des turbines à gaz, des équipements rotatifs et des services associés, en veillant à ce que les projets soient livrés en toute sécurité, à temps, dans les limites du budget et avec des marges bénéficiaires saines.

En étroite collaboration avec les ventes, les opérations, l'ingénierie, la chaîne d'approvisionnement et les clients, vous jouerez le rôle de point focal tout au long du cycle de vie du projet.

Ce que tu vas faire

• Diriger la réalisation de projets internationaux de services de turbine à gaz et d'équipement rotatif

• Bénéfice du projet, performance financière et obligations contractuelles

• Développer et maintenir de solides relations avec les clients

• Identifier les possibilités d'affaires, de mises à niveau et de services supplémentaires

• Assurer une collaboration efficace entre les équipes des ventes, du génie, des opérations, des achats et du Service mobile

• Suivi des progrès, calendriers, risques et ressources nécessaires

• Gestion des négociations commerciales, des modifications de portée et des ordonnances de modification

• Veiller à ce que les projets soient exécutés conformément aux attentes des clients, aux normes de qualité et aux exigences en matière de HSE

• Fournir régulièrement des mises à jour des projets et des prévisions financières aux parties prenantes

• Soutenir la croissance des entreprises par une approche proactive et axée sur le client

• Expérience éprouvée en tant que gestionnaire de projet dans le secteur des turbines à gaz, des équipements rotatifs, de la production d'électricité, de l'énergie ou des services industriels connexes

• Forte acuité commerciale avec un passé de réalisation de projets rentables

• Compréhension des environnements de révision, d'entretien, de réparation ou de service sur le terrain

• Capacité de gérer les relations avec la clientèle et d'engager avec confiance des intervenants de haut niveau

• Forte négociation et influence des compétences

• Excellente capacité de communication et de leadership

• L'état d'esprit axé sur les résultats avec la capacité d'identifier des possibilités commerciales au-delà de la portée initiale du projet

• Qualité de gestion de projet souhaitable mais non essentielle

Ce que nous vous offrons

• Un salaire de base compétitif

• Régime annuel de bonus personnels basé sur la performance de l'entreprise et personnelle

• Assurance médicale privée

• 33 jours de congé annuel.

• Cotisations définies.

• Accès à Medicash vous aidant à couvrir les frais de santé quotidiens comme l'optique dentaire et la physiothérapie ainsi qu'une gamme de avantages bien-être.

• Soutien confidentiel via les programmes d'aide aux employés.

• Accès à des rabais sur le style de vie de divertissement d'achat et possibilité de demander l'adhésion à Costco.

• Location de voiture personnelle à rabais pour vous votre famille et vos amis.

• Long Service Awards célébrant votre engagement.

• Possibilités d'apprentissage continu par l'entremise de Sulzer Learning Pathways.

• En tant que récipiendaire du Prix d'argent du Programme de reconnaissance des employeurs de la Défense du Ministère de la Défense, nous accueillons et soutenons les anciens combattants, les réservistes et les cadets adultes bénévoles dans le cadre de politiques d'instruction, de camps et de déploiement, ainsi qu'un réseau militaire interne en pleine expansion.

jobs.title: Pump Mechanic
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The Pump Mechanic is responsible for repairing and maintenance of Sulzer Pumps’ and all other manufacturers’ pumping equipment while strictly adhering to customer, OEM and industry standard specifications. Follows department policy and procedures manual. Key Responsibilities

• Assembling all types of pump equipment to customer, OEM and industry standard specifications

• Disassembling equipment to gain access remove, clean and inspect components

• Inspecting & recording component measurements using instruments, tools and gages and providing inspection report

• Investigating and determining root cause failure

• Determining proper materials for repairs as per BOM

• Contouring impellers and pump casings to meet hydraulic requirements

• Setting and operating dynamic balancing equipment

• Performing final testing and inspections

Qualifications / Requirements

• Analytical and interpersonal skills

• Attention to detail

• Extensive knowledge of and ability to use hand tools, precision measuring and testing equipment and machine shop equipment

• Minimum five (5) years of pump repair experience

• Ability to work with limited supervision

• Ability to travel to and work at customer sites

• Ability to work overtime

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym reimbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Are you ready to take your career to the next level with a world-leading engineering company? At Sulzer, we operate through a network of advanced service centers in the UK sites and over 100 global service sites, offering cutting-edge solutions for parts, maintenance, and repairs related to pumps, turbines, compressors, motors, and generators. We service not only our own original equipment but also third-party rotating equipment, ensuring sustainability and cost-effectiveness throughout their life cycle. Our industry-leading product experts offer unparalleled technical support, and our capabilities range from local site services to large machine refurbishment and upgrade. We are committed to investing in and growing our market share in essential industries through key partnerships. e have an exciting challenge in the Midlands . This role will involve driving our growth in the area, covering the entire Midlands. You’ll be at the forefront of building new partnerships, opening doors, and getting Sulzer in front of prospective clients. It’s a pivotal role that requires both resilience and a strategic approach to establish Sulzer’s presence and grow our customer base in a region primed for expansion.

Your main tasks and responsibilities will include:

• Develop and maintain strong connections with both existing and potential clients. Understand their unique challenges and collaborate to create bespoke solutions that meet their needs.

• Carry out in-depth research within your region to uncover new sales leads, particularly for electric rotating machinery maintenance, including generators, motors, and transformers. Provide insightful market feedback to continuously enhance Sulzer's offerings.

• Offer support and guidance to customers, showcasing Sulzer's innovative products and services to address complex engineering problems.

• Pursue new business opportunities to drive revenue growth.

What You’ll Need to Succeed

• A proven track record in technical sales with a deep understanding of the sales process.

• Extensive knowledge of rotating machinery, including pumps, gearboxes compressors, motors, generators, transformers etc.

• Exceptional communication and presentation skills, capable of conveying technical information to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

What we offer you

• A competitive basic salary

• Annual personal bonus scheme based on company and personal performance

• The option of a car or allowance

• 33 days annual leave.

• Defined pension contributions.

• Access to Medicash helping you cover everyday health costs like dental optical and physiotherapy plus a range of wellbeing perks.

• Confidential support via Employee Assistance Programmes.

• Access to discounts on shopping entertainment lifestyle plus opportunity to apply for Costco membership.

• Discounted personal car leasing for you your family and friends.

• Long Service Awards celebrating your commitment.

• Continuous learning opportunities through Sulzer Learning Pathways.

• Were proud to support those whove served. Sulzer is a Bronze Award holder under the MoDs Defence Employer Recognition Scheme meaning we actively welcome and support ex-military personnel and reservists in building successful careers with us.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Sind Sie bereit, Ihre Karriere mit einem weltweit führenden Ingenieurunternehmen auf die nächste Stufe zu bringen? Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable.

Sur le rôle

Êtes-vous prêt à passer au niveau supérieur avec une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan au monde? Chez Sulzer, nous opérons à travers un réseau de centres de service avancés au Royaume-Uni et plus de 100 sites de service mondiaux, offrant des solutions de pointe pour les pièces, l'entretien et les réparations liées aux pompes, turbines, compresseurs, moteurs et générateurs. Nous servons non seulement notre propre équipement d'origine, mais aussi des équipements rotatifs tiers, assurant la durabilité et la rentabilité tout au long de leur cycle de vie. Nos experts en produits de pointe offrent un soutien technique inégalé, et nos capacités vont des services locaux aux gros travaux de rénovation et de mise à niveau de machines. Nous sommes déterminés à investir et à accroître notre part de marché dans les industries essentielles par le biais de partenariats clés. e ont un défi passionnant dans les Midlands . Ce rôle consistera à stimuler notre croissance dans la région, couvrant tout le nord-ouest de l'Angleterre. Vous serez à l'avant-garde de la construction de nouveaux partenariats, de l'ouverture des portes et de l'obtention de Sulzer devant des clients potentiels. Il s'agit d'un rôle central qui exige à la fois une résilience et une approche stratégique pour établir la présence de Sulzer.

Vos principales tâches et responsabilités seront les suivantes :

• Développer et maintenir des liens solides avec les clients existants et potentiels. Comprendre leurs défis uniques et collaborer pour créer des solutions sur mesure qui répondent à leurs besoins.

• Effectuez des recherches approfondies dans votre région pour découvrir de nouvelles pistes de vente, notamment pour l'entretien des machines tournantes électriques, y compris les génératrices, les moteurs et les transformateurs. Fournir des commentaires éclairés sur le marché pour améliorer continuellement les offres de Sulzer.

• Offrez soutien et conseils aux clients, mettant en valeur les produits et services innovants de Sulzer pour résoudre des problèmes d'ingénierie complexes.

• Poursuivre de nouvelles occasions d'affaires pour stimuler la croissance des revenus.

Ce dont vous aurez besoin pour réussir

• Une expérience éprouvée dans les ventes techniques avec une compréhension approfondie du processus de vente.

• Connaissance approfondie des machines tournantes, y compris les pompes, les boîtes de vitesses compresseurs, moteurs, générateurs, transformateurs, etc.

• Compétences exceptionnelles en communication et en présentation, capables de transmettre des informations techniques aux acteurs techniques et non techniques.

Ce que nous vous offrons

• Un salaire de base compétitif

• Régime annuel de bonus personnels basé sur la performance de l'entreprise et personnelle

• L'option d'une voiture ou une allocation

• 33 jours de congé annuel.

• Cotisations définies.

• Accès à Medicash vous aidant à couvrir les frais de santé quotidiens comme l'optique dentaire et la physiothérapie ainsi qu'une gamme de avantages bien-être.

• Soutien confidentiel via les programmes d'aide aux employés.

• Accès à des rabais sur le style de vie de divertissement d'achat et possibilité de demander l'adhésion à Costco.

• Location de voiture personnelle à rabais pour vous votre famille et vos amis.

• Long Service Awards célébrant votre engagement.

• Possibilités d'apprentissage continu par l'entremise de Sulzer Learning Pathways.

• Étaient fiers de soutenir ceux qui ont servi. Sulzer est titulaire d'un prix de bronze dans le cadre du Programme de reconnaissance des employeurs de la Défense du Ministère de la défense, ce qui signifie que nous accueillons et soutenons activement les anciens militaires et réservistes dans la construction de carrières réussies avec nous.

Sulzer est un employeur à chances égales. Nous croyons en la force d'un effectif diversifié et sommes déterminés à offrir un milieu de travail inclusif.

Nous sommes fiers d'être reconnus comme l'un des meilleurs employeurs 2026 au Brésil, au Canada, en Chine, en Finlande, en Allemagne, en Irlande, au Mexique, en Suisse, en Afrique du Sud, au Royaume-Uni et aux États-Unis.

jobs.description:

Tuotekehitysinsinöörinämme olet osana asiantuntevaa tiimiämme.
