jobs.title: Senior Field Service Technician
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The Senior Field Service Technician is responsible for installing, configuring, calibrating, and repairing technical products and systems at customer field locations. This role performs a variety of maintenance and technical support tasks and may provide onsite training to customer support personnel.
This job profile is intended for experienced support-level staff that generally works autonomously and only requires closer supervision in non-routine situations.
Job Title
Senior Field Service Technician

Area/Department
Services Division

Required Education
Higher Vocational Training in Mechatronics, Industrial Master Technician, a Mechanical Engineering degree (or any engineering discipline with a mechanical specialization), or an equivalent qualification, with solid knowledge and practical experience in rotating equipment, preferably centrifugal pumps, or alternatively steam turbines and centrifugal compressors.

Specific Knowledge

• Minimum of 2 years of professional experience in the supervision of commissioning activities and field service support for rotating equipment, in Italy, Spain, Portugal and worldwide. Alternatively, candidates should have at least 5 years of experience in the repair and maintenance of rotating equipment within workshop environments.

• Native Italian speaker, with excellent verbal communication skills.

• High level of spoken and written English (mandatory) and Spanish (valuable).

• Microsoft 365 package.

• High Knowledge of Occupational Risk Prevention.

Required Experience
With experience

Reporting Line
Services Field Service Manager

Direct Reports
0

Provide expert field service, technical support, and supervision for the installation, commissioning, inspection, maintenance, and repair of rotating equipment, with a primary focus on centrifugal pumps. The role ensures the reliable and efficient operation of customer assets by delivering high-quality technical services both at customer sites as well as at the company's Service Centers in Italy and Spain.
The successful candidate will act as a technical representative of the company, contributing to customer satisfaction, equipment reliability, and business growth through professional field service and engineering expertise.

Description of Specific Functions

• Perform the installation, commissioning, and start-up of new centrifugal pumps and related rotating equipment at customer sites across Italy, Spain, Portugal, and worldwide, ensuring compliance with Sulzer standards, customer specifications, and industry best practices.

jobs.title: Quality Control Coordinator
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

We are looking for a Quality Control Coordinator to join our team in Burgos, Spain. In this role, you will play a key part in ensuring that incoming materials, manufacturing processes, and finished products meet internal, customer, and regulatory quality requirements.
As a quality professional, you will coordinate quality control activities throughout the production cycle, working closely with suppliers, production teams, engineering, procurement, and project stakeholders. Your contribution will help maintain product conformity, strengthen quality performance, and support operational excellence.
This is an excellent opportunity for an autonomous and detail-oriented professional who enjoys working in a manufacturing environment and influencing quality standards across the organization. What you will do:

• Review and validate supplier quality documentation, material certificates, and inspection records.

• Coordinate incoming quality control activities and support supplier quality issue resolution.

• Define and maintain quality control standard operating procedures across production activities.

• Lead critical quality inspections and support in-process inspections.

• Monitor manufacturing quality performance and identify deviations from requirements.

• Ensure compliance with internal procedures, customer specifications, and applicable standards.

• Document inspection results and maintain accurate quality records.

• Collaborate with production, engineering, procurement, and project teams to ensure product conformity.

• Coordinate interactions with external inspectors when required.

What you need to succeed:

• Experience in manufacturing quality control environments.

• Strong knowledge of quality control practices and quality documentation processes.

• Experience reviewing material certificates and supplier quality documentation.

• Experience using ERP systems and quality management systems.

• Ability to interpret technical specifications, test certificates, and quality standards.

• Experience conducting incoming, in-process, and final inspections.

• Familiarity with welding, painting, dimensional inspections, and manufacturing processes.

• Strong organizational and documentation skills.

• Ability to work independently and manage priorities effectively.

• Fluent Spanish and professional English.

What we offer you

• A competitive salary as well as participation in the variable remuneration system based on personal and financial objectives.

• Meal vouchers.

• Access to a voluntary flexible compensation scheme allowing employees to optimize their salary package, such as health insurance, transport, or childcare.

• Be part of an experienced and international team.

• A good vibe working environment.

• The opportunity to grow your career within a solid and well-established international company.

• Be part of a dynamic organization undergoing continuous transformation and improvement.

• Office location: Burgos, Spain.

• Additional benefits may apply depending on the position and location.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Come professionista di qualità, coordina le attività di controllo della qualità in tutto il ciclo di produzione, lavorando a stretto contatto con fornitori, team di produzione, ingegneria, approvvigionamento e stakeholder di progetto. Il vostro contributo contribuirà a mantenere la conformità del prodotto, rafforzare le prestazioni di qualità e sostenere l'eccellenza operativa.
Questa è un'ottima opportunità per un professionista autonomo e orientato al dettaglio che gode di lavorare in un ambiente di produzione e di influenzare gli standard di qualità in tutta l'organizzazione. Cosa farai:

• Coordinare le attività di controllo della qualità in entrata e supportare la risoluzione dei problemi di qualità dei fornitori.

• Definire e mantenere le procedure operative standard di controllo della qualità nelle attività di produzione.

• Ispezioni di qualità critiche e supporto ispezioni in-process.

• Monitorare le prestazioni di qualità di produzione e identificare le deviazioni dai requisiti.

• Assicurare il rispetto delle procedure interne, specifiche del cliente e standard applicabili.

• I risultati dell'ispezione del documento e mantenere i record di qualità accurati.

• Collabora con team di produzione, ingegneria, approvvigionamento e progetto per garantire la conformità dei prodotti.

• Coordinare le interazioni con gli ispettori esterni quando necessario.

About the role

We are looking for a Quality Control Coordinator to join our team in Burgos, Spain. In this role, you will play a key part in ensuring that incoming materials, manufacturing processes, and finished products meet internal, customer, and regulatory quality requirements.
As a quality professional, you will coordinate quality control activities throughout the production cycle, working closely with suppliers, production teams, engineering, procurement, and project stakeholders. Your contribution will help maintain product conformity, strengthen quality performance, and support operational excellence.
This is an excellent opportunity for an autonomous and detail-oriented professional who enjoys working in a manufacturing environment and influencing quality standards across the organization. What you will do:

• Review and validate supplier quality documentation, material certificates, and inspection records.

• Coordinate incoming quality control activities and support supplier quality issue resolution.

• Define and maintain quality control standard operating procedures across production activities.

• Lead critical quality inspections and support in-process inspections.

• Monitor manufacturing quality performance and identify deviations from requirements.

• Ensure compliance with internal procedures, customer specifications, and applicable standards.

• Document inspection results and maintain accurate quality records.

• Collaborate with production, engineering, procurement, and project teams to ensure product conformity.

• Coordinate interactions with external inspectors when required.

• Experience in manufacturing quality control environments.

• Strong knowledge of quality control practices and quality documentation processes.

• Experience reviewing material certificates and supplier quality documentation.

• Experience using ERP systems and quality management systems.

• Ability to interpret technical specifications, test certificates, and quality standards.

• Experience conducting incoming, in-process, and final inspections.

• Familiarity with welding, painting, dimensional inspections, and manufacturing processes.

• Strong organizational and documentation skills.

• Ability to work independently and manage priorities effectively.

The Service Center Manager is responsible for supervising a team of technical professionals in delivering field service engineering support to customers. This role ensures the effective execution of service operations, resolves complex technical issues, and maintains high levels of customer satisfaction. The manager plays a key role in setting team goals, managing performance, and ensuring compliance with service standards.
This job profile is intended for People Managers of 4+ junior to experienced expert-level roles.Position Summary The Regional Service Manager will develop world-class water and wastewater pump service training with content focused on system troubleshooting and how to execute root cause analysis of systems. The target audience is Distributors and Representatives. jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

We are looking for an experienced Document Controller to join our Project Management team and support our growing project portfolio. This role plays a critical part in ensuring that technical and project documentation is accurately managed, controlled, and delivered throughout the lifecycle of complex pump manufacturing projects.
As a key member of the team, you will collaborate closely with engineering, procurement, manufacturing, quality, suppliers, and customers to ensure documentation is complete, compliant, approved, and available when needed. Your expertise will help maintain project quality, support contractual requirements, and contribute to successful project execution.
This is an exciting opportunity to join a specialized industrial environment during an important SAP transformation, offering exposure to international stakeholders and challenging cross-functional projects. What you will do:

• Manage project and engineering documentation throughout the full project lifecycle.

• Participate in project kick-off meetings and prepare Vendor Document Requirement Lists (VDRLs).

• Coordinate document submission, review, approval, and distribution activities.

• Maintain document registers, status reports, and document tracking systems.

• Control document revisions and ensure obsolete documentation is removed from circulation.

• Manage transmittals and document exchanges with customers, suppliers, and internal stakeholders.

• Maintain documentation within SharePoint, SAP, and other document management systems.

• Monitor documentation schedules and proactively follow up on outstanding deliverables.

• Support audits and final project documentation close-out activities.

• Prepare KPI reports and document control performance dashboards.

• Coordinate technical documentation across engineering, procurement, manufacturing, and quality functions.

• Ensure compliance with internal processes, contractual requirements, and document management standards.

What you need to succeed:
Required:

• Minimum 2 years of experience in document control within an industrial environment.

• Strong understanding of document management processes, document numbering, revision control, and document workflows.

• Experience working with SharePoint, SAP, EDMS platforms, or similar document management tools.

• Ability to coordinate multiple stakeholders and manage competing priorities effectively.

• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

• Good English communication skills, both written and spoken, for interactions with international customers and suppliers.

• Ability to work independently and manage deadlines proactively.

Preferred:

• Diploma or Engineering degree.

• Experience within manufacturing, engineering, EPC, oil and gas, pumps, rotating equipment, or related industrial sectors.

• Experience with Aconex, TeamBinder, ProArc, or similar document management systems.

• Exposure to SAP implementation projects.

• Experience managing technical documentation in project-based environments.

What we offer you

• A permanent contract.

• A competitive salary as well as participation in the variable remuneration system based on personal and financial objectives.

• Meal vouchers.

• Access to a voluntary flexible compensation scheme allowing employees to optimize their salary package, such as health insurance, transport, or childcare.

• Be part of an experienced and international team.

• A good vibe working environment.

• The opportunity to grow your career within a solid and well-established international company.

• Be part of a dynamic organization undergoing continuous transformation and improvement.

• Office location: Burgos, Spain.

• Additional benefits may apply depending on the position an

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Are you passionate about transforming data into business value? Do you enjoy working closely with senior stakeholders and influencing business decisions through analytics, insights, and emerging technologies?
At Sulzer, we're embarking on an exciting journey from traditional Business Intelligence towards Artificial Intelligence-powered solutions. We're looking for an experienced Inhouse Consultant BI & Analytics to join our Global IT BI & Analytics team in Madrid and help drive our data-driven transformation.
This is not a pure IT development role. We are looking for someone who can combine strong technical expertise with business consulting skills, building trusted relationships with senior leaders across the business while delivering innovative analytics solutions.
As part of our global BI & Analytics team, you will work closely with business stakeholders across Sulzer to understand challenges, identify opportunities, and deliver solutions that drive better decision-making.

Key responsibilities include:

• Partnering with business leaders to understand requirements and translate them into scalable analytics solutions

• Designing, developing and enhancing enterprise BI applications using Qlik Sense

• Delivering meaningful insights and dashboards that support strategic and operational decision-making

• Working with Snowflake and modern data platforms to create trusted, scalable data solutions

• Supporting Sulzer's "One Sulzer" harmonisation strategy through standardised reporting and analytics

• Driving self-service analytics and data literacy across the organisation

• Exploring and implementing emerging technologies including AI, Generative AI, Copilots and Agentic AI solutions

• Building intelligent applications and data products that connect to Sulzer's modern data platform

• Collaborating with Data Engineering teams to develop robust data models and scalable solutions

• Acting as a trusted advisor to both business and IT stakeholders globally

• Essential Skills & Experience

• Minimum 5 years' experience in a Business Intelligence, Analytics or Inhouse Consulting role

• Strong hands-on experience with Qlik Sense

• Advanced SQL skills

• Experience working with senior business stakeholders

• Strong business consulting and stakeholder management skills

• Experience gathering business requirements and translating them into technical solutions

• Excellent communication and presentation skills

• Highly Desirable

• Experience with Snowflake

• Knowledge of modern data warehousing concepts

• Experience with dbt

• Exposure to Power BI, Tableau or Looker

• Experience in AI, Generative AI, Copilots or emerging analytics technologies

• Experience working within an international or global organisation

The Opportunity

This is a unique opportunity for someone who enjoys operating at the intersection of business, data, analytics and AI. You'll play a key role in helping Sulzer evolve from traditional reporting and dashboards towards intelligent, AI-enabled business solutions that create measurable value across the organisation.
If you're excited by modern analytics, emerging AI technologies, and partnering with senior business leaders to drive transformation, we'd love to hear from you.

Chez Sulzer, nous nous engagons dans un voyage passionnant, de l'Intelligence commerciale traditionnelle à l'Intelligence artificielle. Nous sommes à la recherche d'un consultant interne BI & Analytics expérimenté pour rejoindre notre équipe Global IT BI & Analytics à Madrid et aider à piloter notre transformation axée sur les données.
Ce n'est pas un simple rôle de développement informatique. Nous sommes à la recherche de quelqu'un qui peut combiner une solide expertise technique avec des compétences de conseil en affaires, établir des relations de confiance avec des dirigeants supérieurs dans l'ensemble de l'entreprise tout en offrant des solutions analytiques innovantes.
Dans le cadre de notre équipe mondiale de BI & Analytics, vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les partenaires commerciaux de Sulzer pour comprendre les défis, identifier les opportunités et fournir des solutions qui conduisent à une meilleure prise de décision.

Les principales responsabilités sont les suivantes :

• Partenariat avec les chefs d'entreprise pour comprendre les exigences et les traduire en solutions analytiques évolutives

• Fournir des renseignements et des tableaux de bord utiles à la prise de décisions stratégiques et opérationnelles

• Travailler avec Snowflake et des plateformes de données modernes pour créer des solutions de données fiables et évolutives

• Soutenir la stratégie d'harmonisation « One Sulzer » de Sulzer par des rapports et des analyses normalisés

• Diriger l'analyse en libre-service et la connaissance des données dans l'ensemble de l'organisation

• Explorer et mettre en œuvre des technologies émergentes, y compris l'IA, l'IA Generative, les copilotes et les solutions d'IA Agentic

• Construire des applications intelligentes et des produits de données qui se connectent à la plate-forme de données moderne de Sulzer

• Collaborer avec les équipes de Data Engineering pour développer des modèles de données robustes et des solutions évolutives

• Agir en tant que conseiller de confiance auprès des intervenants du monde des affaires et des TI

• Compétences et expérience essentielles

• Au moins 5 ans d'expérience dans un rôle de Business Intelligence, Analytics ou Inhouse Consulting

• Forte expérience pratique avec Qlik Sense

• Compétences avancées SQL

• Expérience de travail avec les principaux intervenants commerciaux

• Renforcement des compétences en conseil aux entreprises et en gestion des intervenants

• Expérience de la collecte des exigences commerciales et de leur traduction en solutions techniques

• Excellentes compétences en communication et présentation

• Expérience dans l'IA, l'IA Generative, les copilotes ou les technologies d'analyse émergentes

• Expérience de travail au sein d'une organisation internationale ou mondiale

L'opportunité

C'est une occasion unique pour quelqu'un qui aime opérer à l'intersection des affaires, des données, de l'analyse et de l'IA. Vous jouerez un rôle clé en aidant Sulzer à évoluer de rapports traditionnels et tableaux de bord vers des solutions d'affaires intelligentes et adaptées à l'IA qui créent une valeur mesurable dans toute l'organisation.

jobs.title: Field Mechanic
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Under limited supervision, performs all necessary tasks in the repair and maintenance of Sulzer Pumps’ and all other manufacturers’ pumping equipment while strictly adhering to customer, OEM and industry standard specifications. Follows department policy and procedures manual. Key Responsibilities

• Assembling all types of pump equipment to customer, OEM and industry standard specifications

• Disassembling equipment to gain access remove, clean and inspect components

• Inspecting & recording component measurements using instruments, tools and gages and providing inspection report

• Investigating and determining root cause failure

• Determining proper materials for repairs as per BOM

• Contouring impellers and pump casings to meet hydraulic requirements

• Setting and operating dynamic balancing equipment

• Performing final testing and inspections

Qualifications/Requirements

• Analytical and interpersonal skills

• Attention to detail

• Extensive knowledge of and ability to use hand tools, precision measuring and testing equipment and machine shop equipment

• Minimum five (5) years of pump repair experience

• Ability to work with limited supervision

• Ability to travel to and work at customer sites

• Ability to work overtime

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holiday

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym re-imbursement

jobs.title: Master Scheduler
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Sulzer’s Leeds facility is a global centre of excellence for advanced design and manufacturing, delivering OEM pump technology and engineered solutions for critical industries including energy, water, chemicals and infrastructure. Following significant recent investment, the site is rapidly evolving, strengthening capabilities in advanced machining, digital engineering, testing and innovation—and serves as an end-to-end hub where new pumps are brought to life from concept and design through to manufacture, testing, delivery and full lifecycle support.. The Role

The Master Scheduler reports to the Planning & Scheduling Manager and is responsible for driving pre-production readiness across the Leeds site. You’ll own the master production schedule, coordinating materials, labour, subcontractors and capacity ahead of manufacturing to ensure everything is in place for efficient execution. Acting as the central link between engineering, procurement, project management and operations, you’ll ensure plans are realistic, aligned and deliverable, setting projects up for the successful delivery of complex, engineer-to-order pump packages.

Key Responsibilities

• Develop, maintain, and optimise the master production schedule across engineer-to-order pump packages

• Coordinate pre-production planning including materials, labour, subcontract services, and capacity

• Ensure alignment between demand, project timelines, and manufacturing capability

• Work closely with procurement to ensure material availability supports schedule requirements

• Identify and manage constraints, risks, and bottlenecks within the production plan

• Provide clear visibility of schedules, priorities, and delivery risks to stakeholders

• Monitor schedule adherence and drive continuous improvement in planning performance

• Support on-time, in-full delivery through effective cross-functional coordination

About You

• Proven experience in a master scheduling, production planning, or supply chain role within an engineering or manufacturing environment

• Strong understanding of MRP/ERP systems and scheduling best practices, with SAP experience preferred

• Experience working in a project-based or engineer-to-order environment is beneficial

• Ability to balance competing priorities and manage complex schedules

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

Sulzer ist ein führendes Ingenieurunternehmen mit einer stolzen Tradition der Innovation. Werden Sie Teil unseres globalen Teams, um Ihr Fachwissen zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine wohlhabende und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen.

Über die Rolle

Das Werk von Sulzer in Leeds ist ein globales Kompetenzzentrum für fortschrittliches Design und Fertigung und liefert OEM-Pumpentechnologie und technische Lösungen für kritische Industrien wie Energie, Wasser, Chemie und Infrastruktur. Nach erheblichen jüngsten Investitionen entwickelt sich der Standort rasant weiter und stärkt die Fähigkeiten in den Bereichen fortschrittliche Bearbeitung, digitales Engineering, Tests und Innovation – und dient als End-to-End-Drehscheibe, an der neue Pumpen vom Konzept und Design bis hin zur Herstellung, Prüfung, Lieferung und Unterstützung über den gesamten Lebenszyklus zum Leben erweckt werden. Die Rolle

Der Master Scheduler berichtet an den Planning & Scheduling Manager und ist dafür verantwortlich, die Vorproduktionsbereitschaft am gesamten Standort Leeds voranzutreiben. Sie sind für den Hauptproduktionsplan verantwortlich und koordinieren Materialien, Arbeitskräfte, Subunternehmer und Kapazitäten vor der Fertigung, um sicherzustellen, dass alles für eine effiziente Ausführung vorhanden ist. Als zentrales Bindeglied zwischen Technik, Beschaffung, Projektmanagement und Betrieb stellen Sie sicher, dass Pläne realistisch, abgestimmt und umsetzbar sind, und richten Projekte für die erfolgreiche Lieferung komplexer, vom Ingenieur auf Bestellung gefertigter Pumpenpakete ein.

Hauptaufgaben

• Entwickeln, pflegen und optimieren Sie den Master-Produktionsplan für kundenspezifische Pumpenpakete

• Koordinieren Sie die Vorproduktionsplanung einschließlich Materialien, Arbeitskräften, Subunternehmerleistungen und Kapazität

• Stellen Sie sicher, dass Nachfrage, Projektzeitpläne und Fertigungskapazitäten aufeinander abgestimmt sind

• Arbeiten Sie eng mit der Beschaffung zusammen, um sicherzustellen, dass die Materialverfügbarkeit den Zeitplananforderungen entspricht

• Identifizieren und verwalten Sie Einschränkungen, Risiken und Engpässe innerhalb des Produktionsplans

• Bieten Sie den Stakeholdern eine klare Sicht auf Zeitpläne, Prioritäten und Lieferrisiken

jobs.title: Goods in Controller
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

At Sulzer Birmingham Service Centre, we repair, refurbish and overhaul critical rotating equipment that keeps essential industries running. From pumps and motors to compressors, generators and turbines, our teams deliver world-class engineering solutions for customers across the UK and beyond.

Based at our 82,000 sq. ft Birmingham Centre of Excellence, you'll work from one of the most advanced service and repair facilities in the UK. Opened in 2021 following a major investment, the site combines cutting-edge digital technologies, advanced machining capabilities and additive manufacturing, operating 24/7 to support customers when reliability matters most.

We're looking for a highly organised and computer-savvy Goods In Controller to take ownership of all incoming deliveries, ensuring goods are received, inspected, recorded and stored accurately. You'll be the crucial link between suppliers, stores and production teams, helping ensure materials and components are available when needed and that inventory records remain accurate at all times. What You'll Be Doing

• Receiving and inspecting incoming goods, materials and equipment

• Checking deliveries against purchase orders and delivery notes

• Recording receipts accurately within Microsoft Dynamics 365

• Identifying and escalating shortages, damage or discrepancies

• Ensuring materials are correctly labelled, stored and available for production

• Maintaining accurate stock and inventory records

• Supporting stores, purchasing and workshop teams with day-to-day operational requirements

• Promoting high standards of housekeeping, quality and safety

What We're Looking For

• Experience in a Goods In, Stores, Warehouse or Logistics role, preferably within an engineering or manufacturing environment

• Strong attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy

• Confident using IT systems and technology

• Experience working with Microsoft Dynamics 365 ERP or similar systems would be highly advantageous

• Ability to work independently and prioritise workload effectively

• Strong communication and organisational skills

• Forklift licence desirable

Hours of work:
Monday - Thursday : 07:00 - 15:45
Friday : 07:00 - 14:30

What we offer you

• A competitive salary

• Paid overtime opportunities

• A company-wide bonus scheme

• Medicash Health Cash Plan (covering everyday healthcare expenses such as dental, optical and GP services)

• 33 days’ holiday

• Defined pension contribution

• Employee Assistance Programmes

• Discounts on shopping, entertainment & lifestyle

• Costco membership option

• Discounted personal car leasing for you, family & friends

• Long Service Awards

• Ongoing learning through Sulzer Learning Pathways

• Armed Forces Support – As a Silver Award holder of the MoD Defence Employer Recognition Scheme, we actively support veterans, reservists and Cadet Adult Volunteers. This includes policies that enable time for training, camps and deployment, alongside access to a growing internal military network.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Credit Manager
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

We are looking for a Credit Manager to join our Group Treasury team in Madrid. In this role, you will play a key part in managing and strengthening Sulzer's global credit risk framework while supporting strategic treasury initiatives across the organization.
This is an exciting opportunity for a finance professional who enjoys working in an international environment, leading cross-functional projects, and influencing decision-making at a global level. You will collaborate with senior stakeholders across the business to ensure effective credit risk management, support factoring activities, and contribute to treasury transformation initiatives. What you will do:

• Support the establishment and development of the HUB credit risk management team.

• Drive the creation of standardized and harmonized credit risk management processes across the organization.

• Manage global service contracts related to credit risk management, including relationships with external credit rating agencies and tender processes.

• Lead the assessment and design of credit risk management technologies supporting multiple ERP platforms.

• Collaborate with IT and business stakeholders to define and implement standard SAP credit risk management templates.

• Evaluate high-value credit limit requests and provide recommendations to Division CFOs and the Group CFO.

• Deliver training and guidance to internal stakeholders on credit risk assessment and banking policies.

• Support and further develop the company's global factoring processes.

• Manage the global bank account structure and maintain operational banking relationships.

• Coordinate access management for centrally controlled bank accounts.

• Participate in treasury projects and continuous improvement initiatives across the organization.

What you need to succeed:
Required:

• University degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.

• Minimum 5 years of experience in a similar role within an international organization, ideally in a regional or group treasury environment.

• Strong experience in credit risk management and third-party risk assessment.

• Proven success in managing complex cross-functional and international projects.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Set up and operate machine tools, including HBM, VBM, lathes, milling machines, ID/OD grinders, planers, and bore, without assistance, following department policy and procedures manual, to manufacture and recondition component parts to customer, OEM and industry standards. Interprets mechanical drawings, blueprints, and sketches and performs precision metal cutting, grinding, shaping and fitting. Measures components, parts, and raw materials with precision measuring instruments, gauges, and tools. Works under limited supervision.
• Performs layouts, sets up, and operates machines.

• Read and interpret procedures, work orders, and technical drawings to meet specifications.

• Apply knowledge of metals and alloys, including stainless and carbon steels.

• Improves set ups and methods for higher quality and improved cost.

• Operate overhead crane and forklifts safely as directed by Supervisor. Perform other duties as necessary.

• Maintain regular and reliable attendance.

• Maintains a safe, neat, and orderly workstation

• Assists in the disassembly, inspection, and re-assembly of pump equipment when required

• Communicate effectively to ensure smooth workflow transitions between team members.

• Support and assist coworkers, including training and collaboration.

• Supports, cooperates with, and participates in company-wide safety program which includes following all safety policies and procedures

• Supports and cooperates in Sulzer Nuclear Quality Program

• Performs other duties as assigned

• Works overtime as requested

• Operates forklifts, overhead cranes, man lifts, and scissor lifts

QUALIFICATION

• Completion of a machinist apprentice program or equivalent training.

• Minimum of five (5) years of experience in machining.

• Ability to hold close tolerances and conduct component inspection

• Ability to read and interpret technical drawings.

• Basic math skills.

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym re-imbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Sur le rôle

Le spécialiste de la planification de la production est chargé d'élaborer, de gérer et d'optimiser les calendriers de production afin d'assurer une utilisation efficace des ressources et la livraison en temps opportun des produits. Le rôle consiste à travailler de manière indépendante sur des tâches de planification complexes, à coordonner avec des équipes interfonctionnelles et à contribuer à l'amélioration des processus qui améliorent les performances de production.
Ce profil d'emploi est destiné aux professionnels spécialisés qui appliquent des connaissances avancées d'un domaine d'emploi. Requis pour gérer les projets/processus indépendamment avec une supervision limitée. En général, il entraîne et examine le travail des professionnels de niveau inférieur.
Ce travail et la note qui y est associée sont particulièrement alignés sur les rôles qui ont la portée de responsabilité suivante : Grande, Division / Extra Grande organisation.

Principales responsabilités
Élaborer et tenir à jour des calendriers de production détaillés conformes aux prévisions de la demande.
Coordonner avec les équipes de fabrication, de chaîne d'approvisionnement, d'approvisionnement et de logistique pour assurer la disponibilité des matériaux.
Analyser les contraintes, la capacité et les paramètres de performance pour optimiser le flux de production.
Identifier et résoudre les conflits de calendrier et les goulets d'étranglement.
Préparer des rapports de planification, des tableaux de bord et des analyses de rendement.
Appuyer la mise en oeuvre de nouveaux outils, systèmes et améliorations des processus de planification.
Encadrer les planificateurs juniors et contribuer au développement des meilleures pratiques.

Compétences et qualifications
Habituellement, un diplôme universitaire (ou une expérience de travail équivalente) et de 5 à 7 ans d'expérience pertinente sont requis au minimum.
Titres supplémentaires:
Connaissance approfondie des processus de planification, de planification et de fabrication de la production.
Connaissance des systèmes ERP/RPM et des outils de planification.
Fortes compétences d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes.
Capacité de gérer des données complexes et de travailler de façon indépendante.
Capacités de communication et de collaboration interfonctionnelles efficaces.

• Salaire selon l'expérience

• Assurance vie

• Fonds d ' épargne

• Prime de Noël de 30 jours

• Assurance pour frais médicaux majeurs

• Interaction avec l ' équipe internationale

• Options nationales et internationales de croissance de l'emploi

jobs.title: Field Services Project Manager
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Responsible for all aspects of Tower Field Service (TFS) project execution including the estimate, pre-job meetings and negotiations, insuring supervision have a clear scope of work, completing the project file and documentation, and invoicing the project. Responsible for maintaining or improving the project gross margin and for overall contract execution and success of all assigned TFS projects. Managers will manage many orders at once, both domestic and international, including the most complex projects we have which may range in value up to several million dollars. ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

• Responsible for project acceptance and for verification that the customer Purchase Order matches the quoted work scope, and that terms and conditions are negotiated to mutual satisfaction of the customer and Sulzer Chemtech.

• Acts as primary liaison between customer and Sulzer TFS. Manages overall project scheduling.

• Assesses the impact of change requests and revises the project schedule and price as appropriate. Determines the impact created by change requests and communicates information to the customer and all effected internal individuals.

• Responsible for daily communications and formal project reviews with the customer, internal management, informing them of milestones, problems, situations which increase the risk on a project, corrective actions, and results. Provides direction to the various functional areas within the organization on their individual contribution within the order’s scope of supply, schedule, and budget.

• Responsible for maximizing order gross margin through change orders/adders and ensuring that all opportunities are taken to achieve cost reductions for Sulzer TFS.

• Conducts gross margin reviews to explain deviations from planned gross margin, actual versus estimated cost information, change orders, problems, corrective actions, and results. Ensures order is closed in the computer in a timely manner, and that all appropriate invoicing is sent to customer.

QUALIFICATIONS:

• High School diploma or equivalent required.

• Seven years of project management experience in this similar engineered product manufacturing operation.

• Very strong customer service attitude and good negotiating skills are essential.

• Analytical and problem-solving skills, for developing and implementing solutions to problems with assigned projects is important.

• Strong interpersonal and communication skills as required in communicating with personnel in other departments, overseeing the results of their work activities, and accomplishing desired results through others.

• Demonstrated effective oral and written communication skills are critical, as required to meet with customers, relay project status or change information, and maintain a professional image that reflects positively on the organization.

• Strong computer skills, as required in working with word processing, database and spreadsheet applications. The ability to successfully use MS Project or other similar project management software is essential.

• Knowledge of contract management requirements including familiarity with terms and conditions of sale is important.

• Cost management and general business management knowledge to maximize efficient completion of assigned projects.

• Ability to read and correctly interpret engineering tower and internals drawings.

TRAVEL: This position requires occasional business travel. Larger projects may require Managers to be on site for the entire turnaround duration (which vary in length from one to several weeks), including working seven days a week and often over 12 hours a day. Some international travel may be required, and employees will be required to maintain a valid passport and obtain work visa

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile.

Informazioni sul ruolo

Responsabile di tutti gli aspetti dell'esecuzione del progetto Tower Field Service (TFS) tra cui la stima, le riunioni pre-lavoro e i negoziati, la supervisione assicurata ha una chiara portata di lavoro, completando il file di progetto e la documentazione, e fatturando il progetto. Responsabile per il mantenimento o il miglioramento del margine lordo del progetto e per l'esecuzione complessiva del contratto e il successo di tutti i progetti TFS assegnati. I gestori gestiranno contemporaneamente molti ordini, sia nazionali che internazionali, compresi i progetti più complessi che abbiamo, che possono variare in valore fino a diversi milioni di dollari. FUNZIONI ESSENTIALI:

• Responsabile per l'accettazione del progetto e per la verifica che l'ordine di acquisto del cliente corrisponda al campo di lavoro citato, e che termini e condizioni sono negoziati per la reciproca soddisfazione del cliente e Sulzer Chemtech.

• Agisce come collegamento primario tra cliente e Sulzer TFS. Gestisce la pianificazione generale del progetto.

• Assesse l'impatto delle richieste di cambiamento e rivede il programma e il prezzo del progetto come appropriato. Determina l'impatto generato dal cambiamento delle richieste e comunica informazioni al cliente e a tutti gli utenti effetti interni.

• Responsabile delle comunicazioni giornaliere e delle revisioni formali del progetto con il cliente, la gestione interna, informandoli di pietre miliari, problemi, situazioni che aumentano il rischio su un progetto, azioni correttive e risultati. Fornisce la direzione alle varie aree funzionali all'interno dell'organizzazione sul loro contributo individuale nell'ambito di fornitura, programma e budget dell'ordine.

• Responsabile per la massimizzazione del margine lordo dell'ordine attraverso gli ordini di cambiamento/adders e garantire che tutte le opportunità siano prese per ottenere riduzioni dei costi per Sulzer TFS.

• Conduce valutazioni lorde dei margini per spiegare deviazioni da margine lordo pianificato, informazioni reali contro i costi stimati, ordini di cambiamento, problemi, azioni correttive e risultati. Assicura l'ordine è chiuso nel computer in modo tempestivo, e che tutta la fatturazione appropriata viene inviata al cliente.

QUALIFICA:

• diploma di scuola superiore o equivalente richiesto.

• Sette anni di esperienza nella gestione dei progetti in questo simile processo di produzione di prodotti ingegnerizzati.

• Molto forte atteggiamento del servizio clienti e buone capacità di negoziazione sono essenziali.

• Analitica e problem solving competenze, per lo sviluppo e l'attuazione di soluzioni ai problemi con i progetti assegnati è importante.

• Forte capacità interpersonali e di comunicazione come richiesto nel comunicare con il personale in altri dipartimenti, supervisionando i risultati delle loro attività di lavoro, e ottenendo risultati desiderati attraverso gli altri.

• Le competenze di comunicazione orale e scritta efficaci dimostrate sono critiche, come richiesto per incontrare i clienti, relay stato del progetto o informazioni di cambiamento, e mantenere un'immagine professionale che riflette positivamente sull'organizzazione.

• Forte competenze informatiche, come richiesto nel lavoro con l'elaborazione delle parole, database e applicazioni foglio di calcolo. La capacità di utilizzare con successo MS Project o altri simili software di gestione del progetto è essenziale.

• La conoscenza dei requisiti di gestione dei contratti, compresa la familiarità con i termini e le condizioni di vendita è importante.

• Gestione dei costi e conoscenza generale della gestione aziendale per massimizzare il completamento efficiente dei progetti assegnati.

• Capacità di leggere e interpretare correttamente la torre di ingegneria e disegni interni.

TRAVEL: Questa posizione richiede occasionali viaggi d'affari. I progetti più grandi possono richiedere che i manager siano sul posto per tutta la durata del turnaround (che variano di lunghezza da una a più settimane), compreso il lavoro sette giorni alla settimana e spesso oltre 12 ore al giorno. Alcuni viaggi internazionali possono essere richiesti, e i dipendenti saranno tenuti a mantenere un passaporto valido e ottenere il visto di lavoro

descriptionByLocale.de:
Sulzer ist ein führendes Ingenieurunternehmen mit einem stolzen Erbe an Innovationen. Schließen Sie sich unserem globalen Team an, um Ihr Fachwissen zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine prosperierende und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen.

Über die Rolle

Verantwortlich für alle Aspekte der Ausführung des Tower Field Service (TFS)-Projekts, einschließlich der Schätzung, der Vorbesprechungen und Verhandlungen, der Sicherstellung der Aufsicht, haben einen klaren Arbeitsumfang, das Ausfüllen der Projektdatei und -dokumentation und die Rechnungsstellung des Projekts. Verantwortlich für die Aufrechterhaltung oder Verbesserung der Bruttomarge des Projekts sowie für die Ausführung und den Erfolg aller zugewiesenen TFS-Projekte. Manager werden viele Aufträge auf einmal verwalten, sowohl national als auch international, einschließlich der komplexesten Projekte, die wir haben, die bis zu mehreren Millionen Dollar wert sein können. WESENTLICHE FUNKTIONEN

• Verantwortlich für die Projektabnahme und die Überprüfung, dass der Kundenauftrag dem angegebenen Arbeitsumfang entspricht und dass die Bedingungen zur gegenseitigen Zufriedenheit des Kunden und von Sulzer Chemtech ausgehandelt werden.

• Funktioniert als primäre Verbindung zwischen dem Kunden und Sulzer TFS. Verwaltet die gesamte Projektplanung.

• Bewertet die Auswirkungen von Änderungswünschen und überarbeitet den Projektzeitplan und den Preis nach Bedarf. Bestimmt die Auswirkungen von Änderungswünschen und übermittelt dem Kunden und allen betroffenen internen Personen Informationen.

• Verantwortlich für die tägliche Kommunikation und formale Projektüberprüfungen mit dem Kunden, das interne Management, die Information über Meilensteine, Probleme, Situationen, die das Risiko für ein Projekt erhöhen, Korrekturmaßnahmen und Ergebnisse. Bietet den verschiedenen Funktionsbereichen innerhalb der Organisation eine Orientierung für ihren individuellen Beitrag innerhalb des Lieferumfangs, des Zeitplans und des Budgets des Auftrags.

• Verantwortlich für die Maximierung der Order-Bruttomarge durch Änderungsaufträge / Adder und dafür, dass alle Möglichkeiten genutzt werden, um Kostensenkungen für Sulzer TFS zu erzielen.

• Führt Brutto-Margin-Überprüfungen durch, um Abweichungen von geplanter Brutto-Margin, tatsächlichen versus geschätzten Kosteninformationen, Änderungsaufträgen, Problemen, Korrekturmaßnahmen und Ergebnissen zu erklären. Stellt sicher, dass die Bestellung rechtzeitig im Computer geschlossen wird und dass alle entsprechenden Rechnungen an den Kunden gesendet werden.

QUALIFIKATIONEN:

• High School Diplom oder gleichwertig erforderlich.

• Sieben Jahre Projektmanagement-Erfahrung in diesem ähnlichen technischen Produktherstellungsbetrieb.

• Sehr starke Kundenservice-Haltung und gutes Verhandlungsgeschick sind unerlässlich.

• Analytische und Problemlösung Fähigkeiten, für die Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Lösungen für Probleme mit zugewiesenen Projekten ist wichtig.

• Starke zwischenmenschliche und kommunikative Fähigkeiten, wie sie bei der Kommunikation mit Personal in anderen Abteilungen, der Überwachung der Ergebnisse ihrer Arbeitsaktivitäten und der Erreichung der gewünschten Ergebnisse durch andere erforderlich sind.

• Nachgewiesene effektive mündliche und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten sind von entscheidender Bedeutung, um Kunden zu treffen, den Projektstatus weiterzugeben oder Informationen zu ändern und ein professionelles Image zu pflegen, das sich positiv auf die Organisation auswirkt.

• Starke Computerkenntnisse, wie sie bei der Arbeit mit Textverarbeitungs-, Datenbank- und Tabellenkalkulationsanwendungen erforderlich sind. Die Fähigkeit, MS Project oder andere ähnliche Projektmanagement-Software erfolgreich zu nutzen, ist unerlässlich.

• Die Kenntnis der Vertragsmanagementanforderungen, einschließlich der Vertrautheit mit den Verkaufsbedingungen, ist wichtig.

• Kostenmanagement und allgemeines betriebswirtschaftliches Wissen zur Maximierung des effizienten Abschlusses zugewiesener Projekte.

• Fähigkeit, technische Turm- und Innenzeichnungen richtig zu lesen und zu interpretieren.

Reise: Diese Position erfordert gelegentliche Geschäftsreisen. Größere Projekte erfordern möglicherweise, dass Manager während der gesamten Bearbeitungsdauer (die von einer bis zu mehreren Wochen unterschiedlich lang ist) vor Ort sind, einschließlich sieben Tagen pro Woche und oft über 12 Stunden pro Tag. Einige internationale Reisen können erforderlich sein, und die Mitarbeiter müssen einen gültigen Reisepass beibehalten und ein Arbeitsvisum erhalten.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable.

Sur le rôle

Responsable de tous les aspects de l'exécution du projet du Service mobile de la tour, y compris l'estimation, les réunions préalables à l'emploi et les négociations, assurant la supervision ont une portée claire du travail, complétant le dossier et la documentation du projet, et facturer le projet. Responsable du maintien ou de l'amélioration de la marge brute du projet et de l'exécution globale des contrats et du succès de tous les projets de SFT assignés. Les gestionnaires géreront de nombreuses commandes à la fois nationales et internationales, y compris les projets les plus complexes dont nous disposons et dont la valeur peut atteindre plusieurs millions de dollars. FONCTIONS ESSENTIELLES:

• Responsable de l'acceptation du projet et de la vérification que le bon de commande du client correspond à la portée de travail citée, et que les conditions sont négociées à la satisfaction mutuelle du client et de Sulzer Chemtech.

• Fonctionne comme liaison principale entre le client et Sulzer TFS. Gérer le calendrier global du projet.

• Évaluer l'incidence des demandes de changement et réviser le calendrier et le prix du projet, selon le cas. Déterminer l'incidence créée par les demandes de changement et communiquer l'information au client et à toutes les personnes internes effectuées.

• Responsable des communications quotidiennes et des examens officiels des projets avec le client, la direction interne, les informant des étapes, des problèmes, des situations qui augmentent le risque d'un projet, des mesures correctives et des résultats. Fournit une orientation aux divers secteurs fonctionnels de l'organisation sur leur contribution individuelle dans le cadre de l'ordre de fourniture, du calendrier et du budget.

• Responsable de la maximisation de la marge brute des commandes par l'entremise des commandes ou des adders de changement et s'assurer que toutes les possibilités sont prises pour obtenir des réductions de coûts pour Sulzer TFS.

• Effectuer des examens de la marge brute pour expliquer les écarts par rapport à la marge brute prévue, les renseignements sur les coûts réels et les coûts estimatifs, les ordres de modification, les problèmes, les mesures correctives et les résultats. S'assure que la commande est fermée dans l'ordinateur en temps opportun, et que toute facturation appropriée est envoyée au client.

QUALIFICATIONS:

• Diplôme d'études secondaires ou équivalent requis.

• Sept ans d'expérience en gestion de projet dans cette opération similaire de fabrication de produits.

• Une attitude très forte du service à la clientèle et de bonnes compétences de négociation sont essentielles.

• Il est important d'acquérir des compétences en analyse et en résolution de problèmes pour élaborer et mettre en œuvre des solutions aux problèmes liés aux projets assignés.

• Fortes compétences en relations interpersonnelles et en communication, au besoin, pour communiquer avec le personnel d'autres ministères, surveiller les résultats de leurs activités de travail et obtenir les résultats souhaités par l'entremise d'autres ministères.

• Les compétences de communication orale et écrite éprouvées sont essentielles, au besoin, pour rencontrer les clients, transmettre l'état du projet ou modifier l'information, et maintenir une image professionnelle qui reflète positivement l'organisation.

• Fortes compétences en informatique, au besoin, dans le traitement de texte, la base de données et les applications de tableur. La capacité d'utiliser avec succès MS Project ou d'autres logiciels de gestion de projet similaires est essentielle.

• Il est important de connaître les exigences en matière de gestion des marchés, y compris la connaissance des modalités de vente.

• Gestion des coûts et connaissances générales en gestion des activités pour maximiser l'efficacité des projets assignés.

• Capacité de lire et d'interpréter correctement les dessins de tour d'ingénierie et d'intérieur.

VOYAGE: Ce poste nécessite des déplacements occasionnels en affaires. Les projets plus importants peuvent exiger que les gestionnaires soient sur place pendant toute la durée du processus (d'une à plusieurs semaines), y compris travailler sept jours par semaine et souvent plus de 12 heures par jour. Certains voyages internationaux peuvent être requis, et les employés devront conserver un passeport valide et obtenir un visa de travail

jobs.title: Manual Machinist
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary

Set up and operate machine tools, including HBM, VBM, lathes, milling machines, ID/OD grinders, planers, and bore, without assistance, following department policy and procedures manual, to manufacture and recondition component parts to customer, OEM and industry standards. Interprets mechanical drawings, blueprints, and sketches and performs precision metal cutting, grinding, shaping and fitting. Measures components, parts, and raw materials with precision measuring instruments, gauges, and tools. Works under limited supervision. Key Responsibilities

• Performing layouts, setting up and operating conventional machine tools as required

• Reading and interpreting all drawings, including geometric dimensioning and tolerancing

• Designing setup methods where none exist

• Instructing other shop personnel on proper machining techniques

• Continually improving methods to deliver higher quality with improved costs

Qualifications / Requirements

• Completion of a machinist apprentice program or equivalent training

• Ability to hold close tolerances and conduct component inspections

• Ability to set up machine tools: ID / OD Grinders, Turret Lathe, Engine Lathe, Horizontal Boring Mill, Vertical Boring Mill, Radial Drill, Planer Mill

• Four years of experience in machine shop operations

• Willingness to work in a team environment

• Openness to working overtime as required

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym re-imbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Set up and operate machine tools, including HBM, VBM, lathes, milling machines, ID/OD grinders, planers, and bore, without assistance, following department policy and procedures manual, to manufacture and recondition component parts to customer, OEM and industry standards. jobs.title: Area Sales Manager
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sr. Sales Engineer is responsible for providing technical expertise and support throughout the sales process, from initial customer engagement to post-sale implementation. This role involves analyzing customer requirements, preparing technical proposals, and delivering product demonstrations. The Sr. Sales Engineer ensures that solutions are technically sound and aligned with customer needs.
This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. Er du opptatt av en bærekraftig fremtid og levende fjorder? Vil du lære og utvikle deg hver eneste dag på jobb? Motiveres du av å ha en salgsjobb som bidrar til renere vann og et bedre miljø?

Vi ser etter vår ny Area Sales Manager for Nord-Norge, som har spesielt fokus på utvikling av markedet innen Aquakultur. Som oss, kjenner du at det er en ekstra verdi å kunne bidra til å ta vare på vår viktigste ressurs, vann - gjennom å selge løsninger på transport og rensing av vann . Du er engasjert, og samtidig teknisk dyktig. Du er en relasjonsbygger som man raskt får tillit til, og du stiller alltid opp for dine kunder.

Å selge gir deg mye energi og motivasjon, og du trives best i møte med andre mennesker. Du er god på å legge planer, elsker å besøke nye og eksisterende kunder. Digitale verktøy mestrer du godt, og du har et smittende engasjement når du presenterer eller holder foredrag.

Vi tror du har en teknisk utdannelse, og at du har jobbet praktisk tidligere i din karriere. Du styrer din reisevirksomhet selv – og synes det er bra å være på farten i typisk 100 til 150 dager pr år. Høres dette interessant ut? Da gleder vi oss til å høre fra deg.

Oppsummert håper vi at du er:

• En som har erfaring med B2B-salg og som blir motivert av lykkelig kunder

• Opptatt av å bygge tillit og være tilgjengelig for kundene

• Fleksibel og liker å styre hverdagen din selv

• Selvstendig og reiseglad

• Smart, engasjert og god på å løse problemer

• Strukturert og tydelig i kommunikasjonsformen – norsk er arbeidsspråket

• For Area Sales Manager i Nord-Norge håper vi at du er bosatt i Bodø, men omkringliggende områder er også ok

What we offer you

Hvem er vi tenker du? Og hva kan vi tilby akkurat deg?
Hos Sulzer tror vi på kontinuerlig læring og mulighetene det skaper for fremtiden din. Vi jobber i team for å komme frem til de beste løsningene for våre kunder, og du vil ha ingeniører og fageksperter i ryggen som hjelper deg der det trengs.

I Norge har Sulzer kontorer og verksteder i Asker, Bergen, Fredrikstad, Kristiansand og Trondheim, og har en Services Divisjon i Stavanger. Ditt område er under oppbygging, og du vil derfor ha «permanent» hjemmekontor når du ikke er på veien. Du vil allikeval ha tett tiknytning til resten av salgsmiljøet som er lokalisert over hele landet. Salgssjefen er lokalisert i Asker.

Vi har gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger. Du får firmabil, og det er ønskelig at du velger en miljøvennlig bil, på den måten bidrar du til å gjøre bedriften mer bærekraftig.

Denne stillingen er svært sentral for selskapet vårt, så er vi mest opptatt av å finne det riktige mennesket, som vil trives og ønsker å vokse sammen med oss. Nøyaktig hvor du bor, er ikke like viktig, men vi tror at Bodø er en bra lokasjon.

Søknadsfristen er ut søndag 1. november , men vi vurdererer alle søkere fortløpende!

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Sulzer ist ein führendes Ingenieurunternehmen mit einem stolzen Erbe an Innovationen. Schließen Sie sich unserem globalen Team an, um Ihr Fachwissen zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine prosperierende und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen.

Über die Rolle

Stellenbeschreibung
Der Sr. Sales Engineer ist verantwortlich für die Bereitstellung von technischem Know-how und Support während des gesamten Verkaufsprozesses, von der anfänglichen Kundenbindung bis zur Implementierung nach dem Verkauf. Diese Rolle beinhaltet die Analyse der Kundenanforderungen, die Vorbereitung technischer Vorschläge und die Bereitstellung von Produktdemonstrationen. Der Sr. Sales Engineer sorgt dafür, dass die Lösungen technisch fundiert und auf die Kundenbedürfnisse abgestimmt sind.
Dieses Jobprofil richtet sich an erfahrene Fachkräfte, die praktische Kenntnisse eines Jobbereichs anwenden und unabhängig mit allgemeiner Aufsicht arbeiten. Er du opptatt av en bærekraftig fremtid og levende fjorder? Vil du lære og utvikle deg hver eneste dag på jobb? Motiveres du av å ha en salgsjobb som bidrar til renere vann og et bedre miljø?

Vi ser etter vår ny Area Sales Manager für Nord-Norge, som har spesielt fokus på utvikling av marketet innen Aquakultur. Som oss, kjenner du at det er en ekstra verdi å kunne bidra til å ta vare på vår viktigste ressurs, vann - gjennom å selge løsninger på transport og rensing av vann . Du er engasjert, og samtidig teknisk dyktig. Du er en relasjonsbygger som man raskt får tillit til, og du stiller alltid opp for dine kunder.

Å selge gir deg mye energi og motivasjon, og du trives best i møte med andre mennesker. Du er god på å legge planer, elsker å besøke nye og eksisterende kunder. Digitale verktøy mestrer du godt, og du har et smittende engasjement når du presenterer eller holder foredrag.

Vi tror du har en teknisk utdannelse, og at du har jobbet praktisk tidligere i din karriere. Du styrer din reisevirksomhet selv – og synes det er bra å være på farten i typisk 100 til 150 dager pr år. Høres dette interessant ut? Da gleder vi oss til å høre fra deg.

Oppsummert håper vi at du er:

• En som har erfaring med B2B-salg og som blir motivert av lykkelig kunder

• Opptatt av å bygge tillit og være tilgjengelig für kundene

• Fleksibel og liker å styre hverdagen din selv

• Selvstendig og reiseglad

• Smart, engasjert og god på å løse problemer

• Strukturert og tydelig i kommunikasjonformen — norsk er arbeidsspråket

• Für Area Sales Manager i Nord-Norge håper vi at du er bosatt i Bodø, men omkringliggende områder er også ok

Was wir Ihnen bieten

Hvem er vi tenker du? Og hva kan vi tilby akkurat deg?
Hos Sulzer tror vi på kontinuerlig læring og mulighetene det skaper for fremtiden din. Vi jobber i team for å komme frem til de beste løsningene for våre kunder, og du vil ha ingeniører og fageksperter i ryggen som hjelper deg der det trengs.

I Norge har Sulzer kontorer og verksteder i Asker, Bergen, Fredrikstad, Kristiansand og Trondheim, og har en Services Divisjon i Stavanger. Ditt område er under oppbygging, og du vil derfor ha «permanent» hjemmekontor når du ikke er på veien. Du vil allikeval ha tett tiknytning til resten av salgsmiljøet som er lokalisert over hele landet. Salgssjefen er lokalisert i Asker.

Vi har gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger. Du får firmabil, og det er ønskelig at du velger en miljøvennlig bil, på den måten bidrar du til å gjøre bedriften mer bærekraftig.

Denne stillingen er svært sentral for selskapet vårt, så er vi mest opptatt av å finne det riktige mennesket, som vil trives og ønsker å vokse sammen med oss. Nøyaktig hvor du bor, er ikke like viktig, men vi tror at Bodø er en bra lokasjon.

Søknadsfristen er ut søndag 1. November , men vi vurdererer alle søkere fortløpende!

Sulzer ist ein Arbeitgeber für Chancengleichheit. Wir glauben an die Stärke einer vielfältigen Belegschaft und engagieren uns für ein integratives Arbeitsumfeld.

Wir sind stolz darauf, als Top Employer 2026 in Brasilien, Kanada, China, Finnland, Deutschland, Irland, Mexiko, der Schweiz, Südafrika, Großbritannien und den USA anerkannt zu werden.

jobs.title: Rental Sales Support (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Als unser neuer Rental Sales Support spielen Sie eine zentrale Rolle bei der Unterstützung des Mietgeschäfts. Sie sind verantwortlich für die Verwaltung von Mietaufträgen, die Pflege von Preisdaten sowie die Sicherstellung eines professionellen und kundenorientierten Services. Als wichtige Schnittstelle zwischen Vertrieb, Operations, Engineering und Kunden unterstützen Sie die Koordination von Mietanlagen über ihren gesamten Lebenszyklus hinweg – von der Angebotserstellung und Auftragsabwicklung bis hin zu Lieferung, Rücknahme und Fakturierung.

Die Position verbindet kaufmännische Unterstützung, Administration und Datenmanagement in einem dynamischen technischen Umfeld. Dabei tragen Sie dazu bei, die Auslastung des Mietanlagenbestands zu maximieren und eine hervorragende Kundenerfahrung sicherzustellen.

Sie werden Teil eines Teams von neun Kolleginnen und Kollegen in einem wachsenden Geschäftsbereich und profitieren von Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, die sich mit der Expansion des Teams ergeben. Ihre Hauptaufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten

• Verwaltung der administrativen Abwicklung von Mietaufträgen von der Auftragserfassung bis zur Vorbereitung der Rechnungsstellung, einschließlich Auftragsbearbeitung, Dokumentation, Kundenkoordination und Statusverfolgung.

• Pflege und Aktualisierung von Mietpreisstrukturen und kaufmännischen Daten unter Sicherstellung von Genauigkeit, Konsistenz und Einhaltung der Unternehmensrichtlinien.

• Verwaltung der Miet-Stammdaten, einschließlich Anlageninformationen, technischer Spezifikationen, Verfügbarkeiten, Mietpreise und Datenqualität über verschiedene Systeme hinweg.

• Unterstützung von Mietgeschäft und Vertrieb durch Reporting, KPI-Tracking, Vertriebsdokumentation, Prozessverbesserungen sowie die Koordination bereichsübergreifender Stakeholder.
Was Sie für diese Position mitbringen sollten

• Berufserfahrung in den Bereichen Vermietung, Vertriebsinnendienst, Kundenservice oder Vertriebsunterstützung, idealerweise in einem technischen, ingenieurwissenschaftlichen, industriellen oder mietbezogenen Umfeld.

• Fundierte Kenntnisse im Umgang mit ERP-Systemen und Unternehmenssoftware sowie Erfahrung in der Pflege von Kunden-, Auftrags-, Preis- und Stammdaten.

• Fließende Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sowie die Fähigkeit, effektiv mit Kunden und internen Stakeholdern zu kommunizieren.

• Ausgeprägte administrative und organisatorische Fähigkeiten mit hoher Genauigkeit und einem starken Augenmerk für Details.

• Sicherer Umgang mit Microsoft-Office-Anwendungen, insbesondere Excel, für Reporting, Datenanalysen und Dokumentation.

• Fähigkeit, mehrere Prioritäten gleichzeitig zu koordinieren, Fristen einzuhalten und effektiv mit den Teams aus Vertrieb, Operations, Engineering und Finanzen zusammenzuarbeiten.

What we offer you

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenen Führungskräften im kommerziellen Bereich

• Einblicke in internationale Geschäftsthemen, Reporting sowie Vertriebskennzahlen und ‑auswertungen

• Abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit mit einer Kombination aus administrativer Unterstützung, Business Support und Prozesskoordination

• Aktive Mitwirkung an der Effizienzsteigerung innerhalb der Sales-Organisation

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile.

Informazioni sul ruolo

Come il nostro nuovo supporto vendite di noleggio, si gioca un ruolo centrale nel sostenere il business di noleggio. Sei responsabile della gestione degli ordini di noleggio, del mantenimento dei dati sui prezzi e della garanzia di un servizio professionale e customer-centric. Supporto come interfaccia importante tra vendite, operazioni, ingegneria e clienti Coordinano le strutture di noleggio in tutto il loro ciclo di vita – dalla preparazione delle offerte e dall'elaborazione degli ordini alla consegna, al take-back e alla fatturazione.

La posizione combina supporto commerciale, amministrazione e gestione dei dati in un ambiente tecnico dinamico. In questo modo, si contribuirà a massimizzare l'utilizzo dei beni di noleggio e garantire un'eccellente esperienza del cliente.

Si diventerà parte di un team di nove colleghi in una zona di business in crescita e beneficiare di opportunità di sviluppo che si presentano come il team si espande. I vostri compiti principali e responsabilità

• Gestione della gestione amministrativa degli ordini di noleggio dall'ingresso dell'ordine alla preparazione della fattura, tra cui elaborazione dell'ordine, documentazione, coordinamento del cliente e monitoraggio dello stato.

• Mantenere e aggiornare le strutture dei prezzi di noleggio e i dati commerciali garantendo al contempo precisione, coerenza e conformità alle politiche aziendali.

• Gestione dei dati master di noleggio, comprese le informazioni sugli asset, le specifiche tecniche, la disponibilità, i prezzi di noleggio e la qualità dei dati in diversi sistemi.

• Supporto del business del noleggio e delle vendite attraverso la segnalazione, il monitoraggio KPI, la documentazione di vendita, i miglioramenti dei processi e il coordinamento delle parti interessate cross-divisionali.
Cosa dovresti portare per questa posizione

• Esperienza professionale in affitto, vendita, assistenza clienti o supporto vendita, idealmente in un ambiente tecnico, ingegneristico, industriale o di noleggio.

• Conoscenza approfondita nel trattare con sistemi ERP e software aziendale, nonché l'esperienza nel mantenere i dati di cliente, ordine, prezzo e master.

• competenze linguistiche tedesche fluide nelle parole e nella scrittura, nonché la capacità di comunicare efficacemente con i clienti e gli stakeholder interni.

• Forte competenze amministrative e organizzative con alta precisione e una forte attenzione ai dettagli.

• Gestione sicura delle applicazioni Microsoft Office, in particolare Excel, per la segnalazione, l'analisi dei dati e la documentazione.

• Capacità di coordinare più priorità allo stesso tempo, soddisfare le scadenze e lavorare efficacemente con i team di vendita, operazioni, ingegneria e finanza.

Cosa ti offriamo

• Una stretta collaborazione con i leader esperti nel settore commerciale

• Indagini su argomenti aziendali internazionali, reportistica e vendite figure chiave e valutazioni

• Attività varie con una combinazione di supporto amministrativo, supporto aziendale e coordinamento dei processi

• Partecipazione attiva all'aumento dell'efficienza all'interno dell'organizzazione di vendita

Sulzer è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità. Crediamo nella forza di una forza lavoro diversificata e ci impegniamo ad offrire un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo.

Siamo orgogliosi di essere riconosciuti come Top Employer 2026 in Brasile, Canada, Cina, Finlandia, Germania, Irlanda, Messico, Svizzera, Sud Africa, Regno Unito e Stati Uniti.

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

As our new Rental Sales Support, you play a central role in supporting the rental business. You are responsible for managing rental orders, maintaining pricing data and ensuring a professional and customer-centric service. Support as an important interface between sales, operations, engineering and customers They coordinate rental facilities throughout their entire life cycle – from the preparation of offers and order processing to delivery, take-back and invoicing.

The position combines commercial support, administration and data management in a dynamic technical environment. In doing so, you will help maximize the utilization of rental assets and ensure an excellent customer experience.

You will become part of a team of nine colleagues in a growing business area and benefit from development opportunities that arise as the team expands. Your main tasks and responsibilities

• Management of the administrative handling of rental orders from order entry to invoice preparation, including order processing, documentation, customer coordination and status tracking.

• Maintain and update rental price structures and commercial data while ensuring accuracy, consistency and compliance with company policies.

• Management of rental master data, including asset information, technical specifications, availability, rental prices and data quality across different systems.

• Support of rental business and sales through reporting, KPI tracking, sales documentation, process improvements and the coordination of cross-divisional stakeholders.
What you should bring for this position

• Professional experience in rental, sales, customer service or sales support, ideally in a technical, engineering, industrial or rental environment.

• In-depth knowledge in dealing with ERP systems and enterprise software as well as experience in maintaining customer, order, price and master data.

• Fluent German language skills in words and writing as well as the ability to communicate effectively with customers and internal stakeholders.

• Strong administrative and organizational skills with high accuracy and a strong focus on detail.

• Secure handling of Microsoft Office applications, especially Excel, for reporting, data analysis and documentation.

• Ability to coordinate multiple priorities at the same time, meet deadlines and work effectively with the sales, operations, engineering and finance teams.

What we offer you

• Close cooperation with experienced leaders in the commercial sector

• Insights into international business topics, reporting and sales key figures and evaluations

• Varied activities with a combination of administrative support, business support and process coordination

• Active participation in increasing efficiency within the sales organization

• Gestire e sviluppare un team di qualità e qualità dei fornitori ad alte prestazioni.

• Guida le prestazioni di qualità dei fornitori in una grande e diversificata catena di fornitura globale.

• Assicurare una pianificazione di qualità robusta attraverso i piani di ispezione e test (ITP).
