• Provata esperienza di leadership di assicurazione della qualità in un ambiente di produzione.

• Forte esperienza di gestione della qualità dei fornitori.

• Conoscenza dei processi di fabbricazione, lavorazione e montaggio.

• Sperimenta lo sviluppo e la gestione di Inspection & Test Plans (ITPs).

• Comprensione dei sistemi di gestione della qualità e delle metodologie di miglioramento continuo.

• Forte capacità di gestione e leadership degli stakeholder.

• Capacità di influenzare sia i team operativi che i fornitori esterni.

Desiderabile

• Conoscenza delle tecniche e dei requisiti di test non distruttivi (NDT).

• Esperienza di lavoro con grandi attrezzature ingegnerizzate, attrezzature rotanti, pompe, vasi di pressione o prodotti simili.

• Comprensione degli standard NORSOK.

• Esperienza che opera all'interno di industrie altamente regolamentate come energia, petrolio e gas, acqua, nucleare o rinnovabili.

Cosa ti offriamo

Vantaggi del nucleo

• Uno stipendio competitivo

• Schema di bonus personale annuale basato sull'azienda e sulle prestazioni personali

• Assicurazione medica privata

• Medicash Health Cash Plan (coprire le spese sanitarie quotidiane come i servizi dentali, ottici e GP)

• Noleggio auto personali scontati per te, famiglia e amici

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable.

Sur le rôle

Chez Sulzer, l'innovation et l'excellence sont au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons. Notre site Leeds est une installation avancée de conception et de fabrication de pompes et un centre d'excellence reconnu au sein de notre réseau mondial. De cette installation, nous concevons et fabriquons quelques-uns des paquets de pompes les plus importants et les plus complexes au monde, soutenant des projets d'infrastructures essentielles dans les secteurs de l'énergie, de l'eau, de l'industrie et des énergies renouvelables du monde entier.

En raison d'un transfert interne, nous cherchons un gestionnaire d'AQ expérimenté pour diriger et développer notre fonction d'assurance de la qualité à la fois dans les opérations de fabrication et dans une vaste chaîne d'approvisionnement mondiale. Le rôle

Diriger une équipe de 4 rapports directs et influencer un réseau plus large de qualité de plus de 15 + rapports indirects, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans le maintien de la confiance des clients, le soutien de l'excellence opérationnelle, et assurer le respect des exigences de qualité internes et externes.

Cette position offre une exposition importante à des produits d'ingénierie complexes, des attentes exigeantes des clients et une base de fournisseurs internationaux diversifiée.

Principales responsabilités

• Assurance de la qualité du plomb et fonctions de qualité du fournisseur pour l'usine de fabrication de Leeds.

• Élaborer et maintenir des stratégies, des politiques et des procédures de qualité conformes aux objectifs opérationnels.

• Gérer et développer une équipe haute performance Qualité et Qualité Fournisseur.

• Diriger les performances de qualité des fournisseurs sur une grande chaîne d'approvisionnement mondiale diversifiée.

• Assurer une planification robuste de la qualité grâce aux plans d'inspection et d'essai (PTI).

• Diriger les enquêtes sur les questions de qualité, mettre en oeuvre des mesures correctives et préventives efficaces.

• Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes d'exploitation, d'ingénierie, d'approvisionnement et de gestion de projet pour répondre aux besoins des clients.

• Superviser les activités de vérification, les examens de conformité et les initiatives d'amélioration continue.

• Veiller à l'application efficace des méthodes d'inspection et d'essai, y compris les exigences en matière de TDN, le cas échéant.

• Soutenir les inspections des clients, les tests de témoins et les évaluations de qualité.

Ce que nous cherchons

• Expérience éprouvée de leadership en assurance de la qualité dans un environnement manufacturier.

• Forte expérience de gestion de la qualité des fournisseurs.

• Connaissance des procédés de fabrication, d'usinage et d'assemblage.

• Expérience de l'élaboration et de la gestion des plans d'inspection et d'essai (PTI).

• Compréhension des systèmes de gestion de la qualité et des méthodes d'amélioration continue.

• Fortes compétences en gestion des intervenants et en leadership.

• Capacité d'influencer les équipes opérationnelles et les fournisseurs externes.

Désireux

• Connaissance des techniques et des exigences des essais non destructifs.

• Expérience de travail avec de gros équipements techniques, des équipements rotatifs, des pompes, des récipients sous pression ou des produits similaires.

• Compréhension des normes NORSOK.

• Expérience dans des industries hautement réglementées comme l'énergie, le pétrole et le gaz, l'eau, le nucléaire ou les énergies renouvelables.

Ce que nous vous offrons

Avantages de base

• Un salaire compétitif

• Régime annuel de bonus personnels basé sur la performance de l'entreprise et personnelle

• Assurance médicale privée

• Medicash Health Cash Plan (couverture des frais de soins de santé quotidiens tels que les services dentaires, optiques et GP)

• 33 jours

• Cotisations définies

• Programmes d'aide aux employés

• Réductions sur le shopping, le divertissement et le style de vie

• Option d'adhésion à Costco

• Location de voiture personnelle à rabais pour vous, famille et amis

• Prix Long Service

• Apprentissage continu par les voies d'apprentissage Sulzer

• Soutien des forces armées – En tant que récipiendaire du Prix d'argent du Programme de reconnaissance des employeurs de la Défense, nous appuyons activement les anciens combattants, les réservistes et les bénévoles adultes cadets. Il s'agit notamment de politiques qui permettent de disposer de temps pour l'entraînement, les camps et le déploiement, parallèlement à l'accès à un environnement interne en pleine expansion.

jobs.title: Head of Procurement
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

We’re looking for a Head of Procurement to join the Senior Leadership team for our Leeds facility. In this key role, you’ll drive strategic procurement initiatives, optimise supplier relationships, and ensure seamless delivery of large scale global projects, critical to our world-class pumping solutions.

Our Leeds facility plays a vital role within Sulzer’s global manufacturing network, delivering highly engineered, order-driven products for large-scale customer projects around the world. Operating in a complex engineer-to-order environment, this role is critical to ensuring the successful sourcing and delivery of materials and components that support major projects from initial order through to final execution.

Your main tasks and responsibilities:

• Develop and execute procurement strategies to ensure cost-effective and timely sourcing of components, raw materials, and factored items.

• Lead a team of buyers, driving operational excellence and supplier performance to meet customer requirements.

• Manage key supplier relationships, negotiate agreements, and implement KPIs for continuous improvement.

• Collaborate with internal teams, including operations, quality control, commercial, and production, to align procurement with business goals.

• Ensure compliance with Sulzer’s procurement policies and industry standards, maintaining a strong focus on quality, safety, and sustainability.

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• A CIPS/MCIPS qualification is preferred, but experience is more important – you must be able to demonstrate a strong background in procurement within an engineering or manufacturing environment.

• Strong background in procurement, supplier management, and contract negotiation with an understanding of the procurement challenges associated with large-scale, complex customer projects.

• Experience in castings and raw materials procurement.

• Leadership and team management skills, with a track record of driving performance.

• Commercial acumen, problem-solving ability, and a proactive approach to continuous improvement.

What we offer you

• Confidential support through our Employee Assistance Programmes

• Access to a wide range of discounts on everyday shopping, entertainment, and lifestyle

• Discounted personal car leasing available for you, your family, and friends

• Long Service Awards to celebrate employee longevity

• Continuous learning and development through Sulzer Learning Pathways

• Flexible working hours that allow you to balance your work and personal life

Our Leeds site has undergone a major redevelopment, creating a modern, state-of-the-art working environment designed to inspire collaboration and innovation. This is an exciting time to join us and experience the benefits of a refreshed, future-ready workplace.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Nous cherchons un chef de l'approvisionnement pour rejoindre l'équipe de leadership senior pour notre installation Leeds. Dans ce rôle clé, vous pilotez des initiatives d'approvisionnement stratégique, optimisez les relations avec les fournisseurs et assurez la livraison transparente de grands projets mondiaux, essentiels à nos solutions de pompage de calibre mondial.

Notre usine Leeds joue un rôle vital dans le réseau mondial de fabrication de Sulzer, fournissant des produits hautement conçus et axés sur la commande pour des projets clients à grande échelle dans le monde entier. Fonctionnant dans un environnement complexe d'ingénieur à commande, ce rôle est essentiel pour assurer la réussite de l'approvisionnement et de la livraison de matériaux et de composants qui soutiennent les grands projets, de l'ordre initial à l'exécution finale.

Vos principales tâches et responsabilités:

• Élaborer et exécuter des stratégies d'approvisionnement afin d'assurer l'approvisionnement rentable et en temps opportun des composantes, des matières premières et des éléments factorisés.

• Gérer les relations clés avec les fournisseurs, négocier des ententes et mettre en oeuvre des ICR pour améliorer continuellement.

• Collaborer avec les équipes internes, y compris les opérations, le contrôle de la qualité, le commerce et la production, pour aligner l'approvisionnement sur les objectifs opérationnels.

• Assurer le respect des politiques d'approvisionnement et des normes de l'industrie de Sulzer, en maintenant une forte priorité sur la qualité, la sécurité et la durabilité.

Pour réussir dans ce rôle, vous devrez :

• Une qualification CIPS/MCIPS est préférée, mais l'expérience est plus importante – vous devez être en mesure de démontrer une solide expérience dans l'approvisionnement dans un environnement d'ingénierie ou de fabrication.

• Forte expérience en matière d'approvisionnement, de gestion des fournisseurs et de négociation de contrats, avec une compréhension des défis en matière d'approvisionnement associés à des projets clients complexes à grande échelle.

• Expérience en matière de moulage et d'approvisionnement en matières premières.

• Compétences en leadership et en gestion d'équipe, avec un bilan de performance au volant.

• L'emphase commerciale, la capacité de résolution de problèmes et une approche proactive de l'amélioration continue.

Ce que nous vous offrons

• Soutien confidentiel grâce à nos programmes d'aide aux employés

• Accès à une large gamme de réductions sur les achats quotidiens, les divertissements et le style de vie

• Location de voiture personnelle à prix réduit disponible pour vous, votre famille et vos amis

• Prix Long Service pour célébrer la longévité des employés

• Apprentissage et perfectionnement continus par Sulzer Learning Pathways

• Heures de travail flexibles qui vous permettent d'équilibrer votre travail et votre vie personnelle

Notre site Leeds a subi un important réaménagement, créant un environnement de travail moderne et ultramoderne conçu pour inspirer la collaboration et l'innovation. C'est un moment passionnant pour nous rejoindre et profiter des avantages d'un milieu de travail rafraîchi et prêt à l'avenir.

Create and maintain production schedules based on demand forecasts.
Coordinate with supply chain and manufacturing teams.
Monitor production progress and adjust plans as needed.
Analyze capacity and resource constraints.

Report planning metrics and performance.

Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable.

Résumé de l'emploi
Servir de partenaire stratégique des opérations en matière de finances en stimulant le rendement financier par l'établissement des coûts des produits, la gouvernance des stocks, la gestion des coûts, les prévisions, les rapports et l'appui à la décision opérationnelle. • Agir en tant que partenaire financier de la direction des opérations.

• Fournir des rapports mensuels, des analyses des écarts et des commentaires sur le rendement des entreprises.

• Appuyer les processus de budgétisation, de prévision et de planification opérationnelle.

• Surveiller les ICR opérationnels et traduire les résultats opérationnels en incidences financières.

• Mener des initiatives d'amélioration continue et des processus de gouvernance financière.

• Analyser les coûts de fabrication et les dépenses d'exploitation et déterminer les possibilités d'amélioration.

• Surveiller la performance des centres de coûts et appuyer les initiatives de productivité.

• Maintenir les structures d'établissement des coûts des produits et appuyer les mises à jour des coûts standard.

• Analyser les écarts matériels, de travail et de frais généraux et recommander des mesures correctives.

• Soutenir la tarification, la rentabilité et l'analyse de la marge.

• Surveiller l'évaluation des stocks, l'exactitude et les ICR liés aux stocks.

• Compte du cycle de soutien, inventaire physique, analyse des réserves et initiatives de fonds de roulement.

• Élaborer et améliorer les outils de rapport, les tableaux de bord et les contrôles financiers.

• Surveiller les dépenses du CAPEX par rapport aux budgets approuvés et fournir une analyse des écarts et des rapports

• Assurer la viabilité et l'exactitude financière des initiatives d'épargne déclarées.

• Analyser la réception des commandes ouvertes, l'arriéré et le rendement des expéditions pour appuyer l'exactitude des prévisions et les rapports de fin de période.

• Surveiller les stocks, les créances et le rendement du fonds de roulement opérationnel. Établir des partenariats avec des dirigeants fonctionnels pour déterminer les possibilités d'amélioration des flux de trésorerie
Qualifications et compétences

• Baccalauréat en finance, comptabilité, affaires ou domaine connexe.

• 3 à 5 ans d'expérience dans le contrôle et/ou la comptabilité des coûts de fabrication

• Expérience des systèmes de PGI (favorisation du PAS, le cas échéant)

• Excel avancé

• Favoriser la responsabilisation en matière de rendement financier.

• Capacité à identifier les causes profondes et à prendre des mesures correctives.

• Prise de décision fondée sur les données.

• Fortes compétences en analyse, communication et partenariat d'affaires.

Ce que nous vous offrons

• Temps de repos payé concurrentiel (3 semaines pour commencer)

• 12 Société Jours fériés payés par an

• Avantages médicaux, dentaires et visuels complets

About the role

We are looking for a Tendering Engineer to join our Services team in Algete, Madrid. This role is a great opportunity for a technically minded and commercially aware professional who enjoys working in a dynamic international environment and making a direct impact on business performance.
As part of our aftermarket and service organization, you will play a key role in preparing and managing quotations for spare parts, duplicate pumps, maintenance solutions, and other service-related opportunities. Working closely with colleagues across South Europe, North Africa, and other Sulzer entities worldwide, you will help deliver accurate and competitive proposals that support our customers' operational needs.
This position offers a unique opportunity to contribute to the ongoing SAP Hana transformation, collaborate with international stakeholders, and help shape future business processes within a global engineering organization. What you will do:

• Prepare commercial and technical quotations for spare parts, duplicate pumps, and maintenance solutions.

• Analyze customer specifications and technical requirements to develop competitive proposals.

• Request and evaluate quotations from suppliers, manufacturers, and other Sulzer entities.

• Create, manage, and maintain quotations in SAP and other internal systems.

• Coordinate with Procurement, Sales, Operations, Engineering, and other key stakeholders.

• Review technical configurations and ensure quotation accuracy and completeness.

• Support sales teams and customers throughout the quotation and proposal process.

• Review and validate incoming orders before handover to the execution teams.

• Support forecasting activities and quotation-related reporting.

• Contribute to SAP Hana implementation and process improvement initiatives.

• Collaborate with colleagues across multiple countries and business units to deliver excellent customer service.

Required:

• Experience in tendering, proposal engineering, industrial quotations, technical sales, inside sales, or a similar technical-commercial role.

• Professional proficiency in English.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities and work with cross-functional stakeholders.

• Strong communication and collaboration skills.

POSITION: Mechanical Design Intern

SUMMARY:

The Product Development (PD) group is involved in the design, validation and documentation of new product design and upgrades to existing product ranges. The successful candidate will work on project support as assigned by Engineers in the PD group.

Position is full-time during the summer. Half time during the school year.

Training will be given to accomplish the following:

· Hands-on support of component testing and data collection.
· Drafting support using NX 3D/2D system.
· Engineering support work for projects as assigned.
· Release of drawings / documents through SAP & Teamcenter ERP systems.

· Supports, cooperates with, and participates in company-wide ESG & EHS Management systems, which includes following all safety, health and environmental policies and procedures. Supports and cooperates in company-wide Quality Management effort.
· Performs other duties as assigned

· Sound computer skills in Word and Excel.
· Experience with 2D and 3D CAD systems

This role applies practical knowledge of data analytics tools and techniques to extract insights, build reports, and support stakeholders across the organization.
This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.
We are looking for a Finance Solutions Developer to join our Finance & Analytics team, based at our Centre of Excellence in Pune, India. This is an opportunity to build the digital tools that power Finance process improvement across a global organisation - turning structured requirements into working applications that Finance teams rely on every day. If you are a resourceful builder with enough Finance understanding to validate your own output, who thrives on shipping practical solutions quickly, we want to hear from you.

About the rol e
Our Finance & Analytics team sits at the centre of Sulzer’s effort to standardise and improve Finance processes globally. We develop and roll out digital tools that support month-end close, cost controlling, and financial reporting across our legal entities - and we are growing our capability in Pune to meet an expanding project agenda.
As Finance Solutions Developer, your primary contribution is building and maintaining the applications and automations that our Finance processes depend on. You will take well-structured briefs from functional colleagues and turn them into working solutions on the Power Platform – and you will be expected to experiment with emerging tools, including AI-assisted development, to deliver faster and smarter. This is a hands-on building role in a team that values independence, curiosity, and a bias toward action.

Your key responsibilities

• Build and maintain Finance applications: Develop, configure, and maintain Power Apps, SharePoint List, and Power Automate–based solutions that support knowledge transfer and month-end closing process coordination across Sulzer’s legal entities

• Translate briefs into working solutions: Take structured requirements from functional colleagues and deliver tested, deployable applications - owning the build from brief through development, testing, and deployment

• Collaborate with the BI and functional teams: Work closely with the BI development team, Finance stakeholders, and the broader Finance & Analytics team across multiple time zones - ensuring your solutions integrate cleanly with the wider data and reporting environment

• Support continuous improvement: Maintain and improve existing tools based on user feedback, contribute to documentation, and help scale solutions across new entity rollouts

• Power Apps, SharePoint Lists, and Power Automate as a primary development stack – proven ability to build and maintain workflow applications, not just prototypes

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Data Analytics Lead Analyst is responsible for independently conducting advanced data analysis to support business decision-making and strategic initiatives. This role applies practical knowledge of data analytics tools and techniques to extract insights, build reports, and support stakeholders across the organization.
This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.
We are looking for a Finance Solutions Developer to join our Finance & Analytics team, based at our Centre of Excellence in Pune, India. This is an opportunity to build the digital tools that power Finance process improvement across a global organisation - turning structured requirements into working applications that Finance teams rely on every day. If you are a resourceful builder with enough Finance understanding to validate your own output, who thrives on shipping practical solutions quickly, we want to hear from you.

About the rol e
Our Finance & Analytics team sits at the centre of Sulzer’s effort to standardise and improve Finance processes globally. We develop and roll out digital tools that support month-end close, cost controlling, and financial reporting across our legal entities - and we are growing our capability in Pune to meet an expanding project agenda.
As Finance Solutions Developer, your primary contribution is building and maintaining the applications and automations that our Finance processes depend on. You will take well-structured briefs from functional colleagues and turn them into working solutions on the Power Platform – and you will be expected to experiment with emerging tools, including AI-assisted development, to deliver faster and smarter. This is a hands-on building role in a team that values independence, curiosity, and a bias toward action.

Your key responsibilities

• Build and maintain Finance applications: Develop, configure, and maintain Power Apps, SharePoint List, and Power Automate–based solutions that support knowledge transfer and month-end closing process coordination across Sulzer’s legal entities

• Translate briefs into working solutions: Take structured requirements from functional colleagues and deliver tested, deployable applications - owning the build from brief through development, testing, and deployment

• Experiment with emerging development approaches: Apply AI-assisted development and low-code/no-code tools to accelerate delivery - you are expected to try new approaches, iterate fast, and ship working solutions rather than wait for a pixel-perfect specification

• Collaborate with the BI and functional teams: Work closely with the BI development team, Finance stakeholders, and the broader Finance & Analytics team across multiple time zones - ensuring your solutions integrate cleanly with the wider data and reporting environment

• Support continuous improvement: Maintain and improve existing tools based on user feedback, contribute to documentation, and help scale solutions across new entity rollouts

What you’ll need to succeed

MUST HAVE - EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE

• 2–3 years’ experience in a Finance-adjacent data or development role - enough to understand cost centres, intercompany logic, trial balances, and month-end close without everything being explained

• Power Apps, SharePoint Lists, and Power Automate as a primary development stack – proven ability to build and maintain workflow applications, not just prototypes

• Comfort with AI-assisted development a

Über die Rolle

Sulzer ist ein führendes Ingenieurunternehmen mit einem stolzen Erbe an Innovationen. Schließen Sie sich unserem globalen Team an, um Ihr Fachwissen zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine prosperierende und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen.
Wir suchen einen Finance Solutions Developer, der sich unserem Finance & Analytics Team an unserem Centre of Excellence in Pune, Indien, anschließt. Dies ist eine Gelegenheit, die digitalen Tools zu entwickeln, die die Verbesserung von Finanzprozessen in einer globalen Organisation unterstützen und strukturierte Anforderungen in Arbeitsanwendungen verwandeln, auf die sich Finanzteams täglich verlassen. • 2–3 Jahre Erfahrung in einer finanznahen Daten- oder Entwicklungsrolle - genug, um Kostenstellen, Unternehmenslogik, Trial-Bilanz und Monatsabschluss zu verstehen, ohne dass alles erklärt wird

Sur le rôle

L'analyste principal de l'analyse des données est chargé de mener de façon indépendante une analyse avancée des données pour appuyer la prise de décisions et les initiatives stratégiques. Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Vos principales responsabilités

• Construisez et maintenez des applications de financement : Développez, configurez et maintenez des applications de puissance, une liste de points partagés et des solutions basées sur Power Automate qui soutiennent le transfert de connaissances et la coordination des processus de clôture en fin de mois entre les entités juridiques de Sulzer.

• Traduire des mémoires en solutions de travail: Prendre des exigences structurées de collègues fonctionnels et fournir des applications testées, déployables - posséder la construction de bref à la conception, test, et déploiement

• Expérimentez avec des approches de développement émergentes : appliquez des outils de développement assistés par l'IA et des outils à code bas/sans code pour accélérer la livraison - vous êtes censés essayer de nouvelles approches, itérer rapidement et expédier des solutions de travail plutôt que d'attendre une spécification parfaite pixel

• Collaborer avec l'équipe BI et les équipes fonctionnelles : Collaborer étroitement avec l'équipe de développement BI, les intervenants financiers et l'équipe Finance & Analytics dans de multiples fuseaux horaires.

• Soutenir l'amélioration continue : Maintenir et améliorer les outils existants en fonction de la rétroaction des utilisateurs, contribuer à la documentation et aider à l'échelle des solutions pour les déploiements de nouvelles entités

Ce dont vous avez besoin pour réussir

DOIVENT EDUCATION ET EXPÉRIENCE

• 2–3 ans d'expérience dans un rôle de données ou de développement lié aux finances - assez pour comprendre les centres de coûts, la logique interentreprises, les bilans d'essai et la clôture du mois sans que tout soit expliqué

• Power Apps, SharePoint Lists et Power Automate en tant que pile de développement primaire – capacité éprouvée de construire et de maintenir des applications de flux de travail, pas seulement des prototypes

• Confort avec le développement assisté par l'IA a

About the role

The Data Analytics Sr. Specialist is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining advanced reporting solutions that support strategic decision-making across the organization. This role leverages data analytics to uncover insights, optimize performance, and enhance business intelligence capabilities.

sustainable society.
We are looking for a Finance Transformation Consultant to join our Finance & Analytics team, based
at our Centre of Excellence in Pune, India. This is an opportunity to lead how Finance processes are
understood, redesigned, and standardised across a global organisation - working at the intersection of Finance expertise and structured problem-solving, in a team that genuinely welcomes new ideas. If you are a strong Finance professional who thrives on diagnosing process challenges, framing solutions, and driving real change, we want to hear from you.

Our Finance & Analytics team sits at the centre of Sulzer’s effort to standardise and improve
Finance processes globally. We develop and roll out digital tools that support month-end close, cost
controlling, and financial reporting across our legal entities - and we are growing our capability in

consulting capability: the ability to walk into a process, understand how it works, identify where it
breaks down, and define what a better solution looks like. You will frame requirements, align
stakeholders, and drive solutions to adoption - in a team that values independence, intellectual
curiosity, and a bias toward action.

• Drive Finance process diagnosis and improvement: Analyse existing Finance processes - particularly in month-end close, cost controlling, and management reporting - to identify gaps,inefficiencies, and opportunities for standardisation across Sulzer’s legal entities

• Frame and structure requirements: Translate Finance process problems into clear, well-structured briefs that technical colleagues, BI developers, and digital tools can act on - ensuring the Finance logic is sound before any tool is built

• Collaborate across functions and geographies: Work closely with Finance stakeholders, BI developers, IT, and the broader Finance & Analytics team across multiple time zones - managing your own workstream and communicating proactively to keep projects on track

• Contribute to the team’s transformation agenda: Bring forward ideas and proposals for how we can tackle problems more effectively - whether through process redesign, smarter use of data, or the application of emerging digital tools including AI
What you’ll need to succeed

MUST HAVE - EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE

• University degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field

• Minimum 5 years’ experience in a Finance role with direct exposure to process improvement - ideally in control

• Requisiti di struttura e struttura: Tradurre problemi di processo di finanza in chiari, ben strutturati slip che colleghi tecnici, sviluppatori BI e strumenti digitali possono agire su - assicurando che la logica di finanza è sana prima che qualsiasi strumento è costruito

• Avvio e adozione di un'unità: la consegna end-to-end dei miglioramenti di processo - dall'allineamento delle parti interessate attraverso la configurazione, il test e l'implementazione di Power Apps, SharePoint List e soluzioni basate su Power Automate che supportano il trasferimento delle conoscenze e il coordinamento dei processi di chiusura di fine mese, alla formazione degli utenti e al monitoraggio dell'adozione

• Collaborare tra funzioni e geografie: lavorare a stretto contatto con gli stakeholder Finance, gli sviluppatori BI, l'IT e il più ampio team Finance & Analytics in più fusi orari - gestire il proprio workstream e comunicare in modo proattivo per mantenere i progetti in pista

• Contribuire all’agenda di trasformazione del team: portare avanti idee e proposte per come possiamo affrontare i problemi in modo più efficace - sia attraverso la riprogettazione dei processi, l’uso più intelligente dei dati, sia l’applicazione di strumenti digitali emergenti, tra cui AI

jobs.description:

About the role

Sulzer Water Treatment Solutions is a place where entrepreneurial minds grow. We are seeking a Product Manager for continuous backwash granular media filtration DynaSand/SuperSand) to shape the growth ambitions in treatment, a talent who is ready to take ownership and make a real impact.

We are in search of a proactive, customer-focused Product Manager to bring our proven granular media filter technologies to new levels. In this role, you will own the product portfolio and plan its future. Working closely with global and regional teams, you will ensure solution-oriented offerings and full commercial readiness across sales, operations, and application support.  Your Main Tasks and Responsibilities

• Lead technology transfer and localize global solutions for regional market requirements.

• Define regional product strategy through market analysis, customer insights, and business planning.

• Drive commercial launches by coordinating cross-functional teams and go-to-market readiness.

• Enable sales success through training, pricing strategies, technical support, and sales tools.

• Act as the application expert, gathering customer feedback and translating insights into product improvements.

• A self-starter attitude with strong communication skills and a solid understanding of municipal , industrial water and wastewater treatment or similar technical solutions.

• Proven experience and expertise working with granular filtration products .

• Experience process engineering ,  project management, market-oriented business/product development and international work  within a water treatment sector.

• Ideally experience from Global Product Management, alternatively local product portfolio management, global/local business development, sales management or similar .

• Ability to work effectively in a matrix organization .

• Excellent written & verbal communication skills in English .

• Willingness to travel internationally .

jobs.title: Senior Accountant
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The senior accountant is responsible for supporting accounting operations including journal entries, reconciliations, and financial reporting. This role ensures compliance with accounting standards and supports audits and month-end close activities. This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. Key Responsibilities:
- Support with the period end close, including closing the accounts receivable/payable subledger and reconcile with the general ledger
- Oversee the month-end and year-end closing processes; support with the preparation of journal entries, balance sheet reconciliations and variance analysis
- Prepare accurate and timely financial statements, including income statements, balance sheets and cash flow statements
- Assist with coding of non-PO invoices
- Support the Finance Shared Services team with the fixed asset handling activities
- Closely collaborate with the Reporting & Analytics team to analyze financial data and provide insights into financial performance, identify trends and variances to support business decisions
- Coordinate with other departments and the Finance Shared Services teams to ensure all financial transactions are properly accounted for and reflected in the general ledger
- Participate in the budgeting and forecasting processes, providing input on financial considerations and projections; closely collaborate with the Country Finance Head
- Liaise with tax professionals to ensure accurate and timely tax reporting and compliance
- Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to assess the effectiveness of the Accounting processes and implement continuous improvement initiatives
- Contribute to the continuous improvement of the Finance process, leveraging technology and best practices; maintain policies, procedures and templates
- Provide accurate and timely financial reporting to senior management and stakeholders
- Ensure all financial reporting and processes comply with International Financial Reporting Standards and the Sulzer regulations
- Liaise with auditors and ensure the completion of audits with minimal adjustments
- Ensure financial internal controls are in place and followed for the processes performed by this role
- Support the Country Finance Head with managing the internal and external auditors requests and ensure that the Accounting team is providing the required information

Skills & Qualifications:
Typically a University degree (or equivalent work experience) and at least 3–4 years of relevant experience (or equivalent skills) are minimally required to carry out the role.
Knowledge of accounting principles and practices.
Experience with SAP, ERP system and Microsoft Excel. Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
Good organizational and communication skills.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

What we offer you

As per local requirements

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Il contabile senior è responsabile del supporto delle operazioni contabili, comprese le voci di giornale, le conciliazioni e la rendicontazione finanziaria. Questo ruolo garantisce il rispetto degli standard contabili e supporta audit e attività di fine mese. Responsabilità chiave:
- Sostegno alla chiusura del termine, compresa la chiusura dei conti sottotitoli crediti/pagabili e riconciliarsi con il registro generale
- Superare i processi di chiusura di fine mese e fine anno; supportare con la preparazione di voci di giornale, conciliazioni di bilancio e analisi di varianza
- Preparare un bilancio finanziario accurato e tempestivo, inclusi i rendimenti, i bilanci e i rendimenti dei flussi di cassa
- Assist con codifica di fatture non-PO
- Supporto del team Finance Shared Services con le attività di gestione degli asset fissi
- Collaborare con il team di Reporting & Analytics per analizzare i dati finanziari e fornire informazioni sulle prestazioni finanziarie, identificare le tendenze e le variazioni per supportare le decisioni aziendali
- Coordinare con gli altri dipartimenti e i team dei servizi finanziari condivisi per garantire che tutte le transazioni finanziarie siano debitamente contabilizzate e riflesse nel registro generale
- Partecipare ai processi di bilancio e di previsione, fornendo input su considerazioni finanziarie e proiezioni; collaborare strettamente con il Country Finance Head
- Liaise con i professionisti fiscali per garantire la segnalazione e la conformità delle imposte accurate e tempestive
- Monitorare gli indicatori chiave delle prestazioni (KPI) per valutare l'efficacia dei processi contabili e implementare iniziative di miglioramento continuo
- Contribuire al miglioramento continuo del processo Finance, sfruttando la tecnologia e le migliori pratiche; mantenere politiche, procedure e modelli
- Fornisci report finanziari accurati e tempestivi alla gestione senior e agli stakeholder
- Assicurarsi che tutte le relazioni finanziarie e i processi conformi agli standard internazionali di reporting finanziario e alle normative Sulzer
- Liaise with auditors e garantire il completamento degli audit con modifiche minime
- Assicurarsi che i controlli interni finanziari siano in vigore e seguiti per i processi svolti da questo ruolo
- Sostenere il Country Finance Head con la gestione delle richieste dei revisori interni ed esterni e garantire che il team di Accounting stia fornendo le informazioni necessarie

Competenze & Qualifiche:
Tipicamente una laurea (o un'esperienza lavorativa equivalente) e almeno 3-4 anni di esperienza rilevante (o competenze equivalenti) sono minimamente necessari per svolgere il ruolo.
Conoscenza dei principi contabili e delle pratiche.
Esperienza con SAP, sistema ERP e Microsoft Excel. Forte attenzione ai dettagli e alla precisione.
Buone capacità organizzative e di comunicazione.
Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e come parte di una squadra.

Come per i requisiti locali

Siamo orgogliosi di essere riconosciuti come Top Employer 2026 in Brasile, Canada, Cina, Finlandia, Germania, Irlanda, Messico, Svizzera, Sudafrica, Regno Unito e Stati Uniti.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The superintendent is the primary point of contact for customers in the field and oversees the installation of mass transfer equipment and any ASME code pressure vessel repairs. Project execution achieving expectations and aiming for continuous improvement in safety, quality, schedule and project budget are critical to the success of the entire organization. Successful employees in this role are involved in the entire project lifecycle from sales and estimating, through planning and execution, and completing with customer billing. ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

• Work safely or not at all. Forms and policies do no keep people safe. Field Leadership must be present in work areas and actively supervising in order to mitigate risk. Leaders protect their employees through the identification of existing and potential hazards, coaching, and collaborating to establish process controls and hazard elimination/reduction measures. Utilize JSAs and safety meetings to set and reinforce safety expectations with crews and individual employees

• Responsible for working with Project Management, Safety, Quality, Sales and Estimating to fully understand the scope, schedule, budget and other requirements as well as the resources allocated for assigned projects. Pre-job meetings, safety kick off meetings, and planning trips may be required

• Interface with client contacts including maintenance, safety, planners, schedulers and others as needed

• Ensures quality of work being performed by employees meets all customer and industry standards

• Manages project expense budgets and works with Project Management and support staff to propose and implement cost savings strategies.

• Creates workplans, sets productivity targets for subordinate leaders and crews and tracks progress to meet or exceed estimated project schedules

• Actively work to find solutions to customer issues pertaining to Sulzer’s defined scope, additional work within Sulzer’s capabilities, methods to execute work more safely, more efficiently or producing higher quality standards than originally specified. Document changes and approvals needed.

• Responsible for the accuracy and timeliness of all project related documentation including safety and quality forms, payroll timesheets, customer timesheets, expense reports, procurement requests, packing slips for deliveries, and field change orders including scope changes.

SECONDARY FUNCTIONS

• Assist in the coordination and logistics of necessary resources including employees, tools, equipment, consumables and PPE. Work with support functions to ensure the needed resources are acquired.

• Work closely with, and monitor/manager sub-contractors as necessary

• Contribute to the development of sales opportunities for equipment and service, bid reviews and project performance reviews as needed

• Development of field employees to improve capabilities of crews and Sulzer Tower Field Service

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES: Responsible for the overall supervision of assigned project personnel

QUALIFICATIONS:

• 7-10 years experience in tower field services related work

• 3-5 years in supervisory positions in related fields

• Ability to pass background checks, customer specific training, drug screens and other requirements for entry into refineries, petrochemical and industrial facilities

• Demonstrated knowledge of basic industrial/manufacturing engineering techniques, especially as required in the installation and retro-fit of equipment

• Analytical capability and resourcefulness as required in developing and implementing appropriate solutions to qualify or other installation-related problems

• Leadership and managerial capability, as required in leading and evaluating installation workers or sub-contractors at assign i

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Manager
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Talent Acquisition Manager | 8-12 Years Experience
• Lead end-to-end Talent Acquisition strategy and delivery for Shared Services organization of an Engineering Organization
• Manage and mentor a team of recruiters, driving recruitment performance, capability building, accountability, and delivery against hiring targets
• Establish recruitment governance, dashboard, SLAs, KPIs, and operating rhythms to ensure consistent and high-quality hiring outcomes
• Partner with business leaders and global stakeholders to develop workforce plans aligned to business growth, transformation, and expansion objectives
• Own headcount planning and hiring execution against approved HC budgets, ensuring workforce requirements are delivered within financial targets
• Demonstrate proven experience in rapid ramp-ups, Center expansion, transitions, and large-scale hiring programs across multiple business functions
• Develop proactive sourcing strategies and talent pipelines to support both immediate and future hiring requirements
• Drive campus recruitment programs including university partnerships, employer branding initiatives, internship programs, graduate hiring, management trainee programs, and pre-placement offers
• Build and maintain strong relationships with colleges, universities, and educational institutions to create a sustainable early talent pipeline
• Manage end-to-end campus hiring processes including demand planning, assessments, selection, offer management, and onboarding
• Own key recruitment metrics including time-to-fill, cost-per-hire, quality of hire, offer-to-join ratio, recruiter productivity, diversity hiring, and hiring manager satisfaction
• Monitor and control recruitment spend, agency utilization, vendor costs, and sourcing channel effectiveness to drive optimal cost-per-hire and recruitment ROI
• Lead recruitment process improvement initiatives, leveraging technology and data analytics to enhance hiring efficiency and candidate experience
• Manage relationships with external recruitment partners, search firms, RPOs, and staffing vendors to support business hiring demands
• Deliver recruitment dashboards and analytics to leadership, providing insights on hiring progress, budget adherence, ramp-up status, and market trends
• Ensure a seamless candidate experience from sourcing through onboarding, with a strong focus on offer acceptance, joining conversion, and new hire integration
• Drive employer branding, employee referral, social recruiting, and talent attraction initiatives to strengthen the organization's employer value proposition
Required Experience & Skills
• 8-12 years of Talent Acquisition experience within GBS, GCC, Shared Services, Captive Centers, or multinational organizations
• Minimum 2-4 years of experience leading and managing recruitment teams
• Proven track record of delivering high-volume hiring, rapid ramp-ups, and campus hiring programs
• Strong experience in headcount budgeting, workforce planning, and recruitment analytics
• Demonstrated success in optimizing cost-per-hire and driving recruitment operational excellence
• Experience managing global stakeholders and influencing senior business leaders across multiple geographies
• Strong leadership, stakeholder management, vendor management, and project management capabilities
• Proficiency with ATS and Workday
• MBA/PGDM in Human Resources

What we offer you

Company provided Insurance for employee & immediate family
Company provided transportation

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, Sou

Gestionnaire de l'acquisition de talents (en anglais) 8-12 ans d'expérience
• Diriger la stratégie d'acquisition de talents de bout en bout et la prestation pour les services partagés organisation d'une organisation de génie

jobs.description:

About the role

Job Summary
The Accounting Specialist is responsible for executing accounting tasks such as journal entries, reconciliations, and assisting with financial reporting. This role ensures accuracy and compliance in financial records and supports the finance team in daily operations. This job profile is intended for specialist professionals that apply advanced knowledge of a job area. Required to manage projects / processes independently with limited supervision. This job and its associated grade are specifically aligned with roles that have the following scope of responsibility: Small, Medium, Large organization. Key
• Responsibilities Perform general ledger accounting and reconciliations. Assist in month-end and year-end closing activities. Maintain accurate financial records and documentation. Support internal and external audit processes. Ensure compliance with accounting policies and procedures. Collaborate with other departments to resolve accounting issues. Skills &
• Qualifications Typically a University degree (or equivalent work experience) and at least 5–7 years of relevant experience (or equivalent skills) are minimally required to carry out the role. § Support with the period end close, including closing the accounts receivable/payable subledger and reconcile with the general ledger

§ Contribute to the continuous improvement of the Finance process, leveraging technology and best practices; maintain policies, procedures and templates
§ Provide accurate and timely financial reporting to senior management and stakeholders
§ Ensure all financial reporting and processes comply with International Financial Reporting Standards and the Sulzer regulations
§ Liaise with auditors and ensure the completion of audits with minimal adjustments

Subsidized cafeteria

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary

Set up and operate CNC /manual machine tools, including HBM, VBM, lathes, milling machines, ID/OD grinders, planers, and bore, without assistance, following department policy and procedures manual, to manufacture and recondition component parts to customer, OEM and industry standards. Interprets mechanical drawings, blueprints, and sketches and performs precision metal cutting, grinding, shaping and fitting. Measures components, parts, and raw materials with precision measuring instruments, gauges, and tools. Works under limited supervision.
• Performs layouts, sets up, and operates conventional / CNC machine tools as required

• Reads and interprets all drawings, including geometric dimensioning and tolerancing

• Designs setups and methods where none exist

• Instructs other shop personnel in proper machining techniques: set-ups, feeds and speeds for both carbide and high-speed steel cutting tools, methods and standard operating procedures

• Improve methods for higher quality and improved costs.

• Assist maintenance in diagnosis, repair, and preventative maintenance

• Operate jib cranes and forklifts as directed by Area Superintendent

• Adheres to company and department policies, procedures, and standards

• Supports, cooperates with, and participates in company-wide LEAN and EHS Management System which includes following all safety, health and environmental policies and procedures

• Performs other duties as assigned

Skills & Qualifications

• High School diploma or equivalent

• Completion of a CNC/ manual machinist apprentice program or equivalent training

• Ability to hold close tolerances and conduct component inspections

• Demonstrated ability to effectively set up all, or at least most, of the following machines: I.D./O.D. Grinder, Turret Lathe, Engine Lathe, Knee Mill, Radial Drill, Horizontal Boring Mill, Vertical Boring Mill, and Planer Mill

• Ability to perform with a minimum of direct supervision

• Working knowledge of tool geometry and application

• Working knowledge of effects of feeds and speeds

• 5 years of experience in machine shops on the above equipment

• Willingness to work in a team environment

• Ability to work overtime as required

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision,

• Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym reimbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The Sales Engineer is responsible for supporting the sales process by providing technical expertise, assisting with product demonstrations, and preparing proposals. This role works closely with senior engineers and sales teams to ensure customer requirements are met.
This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyze problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member

Responsible for identifying opportunities for Retrofit and upgrade projects and driving them through to timely delivery of order intake. Your main tasks and responsibilities:

• Acting as main point of contact and technical consultant to sales team or end user / customer for Retrofit enquiries and related activities for nominated region

• Support the Head of Retrofits with development of the overall regional strategy plan, sales plan and continuous improvement projects

• Developing the account/region plans for delivering growth of Retrofit opportunities in allocated sales territory using technical knowledge and customers market requirements as the drivers

• Responsible for driving initiatives within nominated sales territory to promote the identification of retrofit opportunities thru performing tasks such as technical Forums, health checks or asset reviews, customer visits, internal training sessions etc

• Support input to the Rolling Forecast (RFC) process for nominated sales territory in collaboration with regional sales and service managers / directors

• Ensure that effective client contact, relationship building, and management processes are in place to positively influence the client and create a pre-disposition to view Sulzer as the preferred source of supply and actively utilize the customer relationship management (CRM) system

• Maintain knowledge of market and industry trends, competitors, technologies, and leading customer strategies, especially in relation to the retrofit and re-rate business

• Produce and review proposals and support overall proposal process

• Ensure that handover meetings and documentation are effective and result in a smooth transition from pre to post order status

• Attendance at sales meetings and ensure that all relevant information from assigned area is available for the sales team

• Actively promote Retrofits though social media and other peer platforms – internally and externally

• Adheres to company and department policies, procedures, and standards

• Supports, cooperates with, and participates in company-wide EHS Management System which includes following all safety, health and environmental policies and procedures. Supports and cooperates in company-wide Quality Management effort.

• Performs other duties as necessary

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• Degree in Mechanical Engineering or related field.

• 4 Years of relevant experience within pump industry

• Relevant experience within related industry – Upstream, Refining, Petrochemical, Pipeline & Power.

• Experience of executing and building strategies

• Experience of technical / consultive selling

• Knowledge of pump design, application, and selection

• Knowledge of general pump upgrades

• Technical report and proposal writing skills

• Must have good organizational skills, attention to detail and ability to work independently

• Must have valid driver’s license and passport and be able to travel internationally

• Strong Communication and negotiating skills

• 25%-50% travel

What we offer you

• 12 Paid Holidays

• 15 Paid Time Off (PTO) Days

• Medical, dental, vision, life & disability

• 401K with 6% company match

• Employee Assistance Program

• Employee Wellness Program

Responsabile per l'individuazione delle opportunità per Retrofit e l'aggiornamento dei progetti e la guida attraverso la consegna tempestiva di immissione dell'ordine. I vostri compiti principali e responsabilità:

• Atto come punto principale di contatto e consulente tecnico per il team di vendita o utente finale / cliente per Retrofit richieste e attività correlate per regione nominata

• Sostenere il Capo dei Retrofit con lo sviluppo del piano globale di strategia regionale, del piano di vendita e dei progetti di miglioramento continuo

• Sviluppare i piani di conto/regione per la crescita delle opportunità di Retrofit nel territorio di vendita assegnato utilizzando conoscenze tecniche e requisiti di mercato dei clienti come i driver

• Responsabile delle iniziative di guida all'interno del territorio di vendita nominato per promuovere l'identificazione delle opportunità di retrofit per svolgere compiti quali forum tecnici, controlli sanitari o recensioni di asset, visite ai clienti, sessioni di formazione interna ecc

• Input di supporto al processo Rolling Forecast (RFC) per il territorio di vendita nominato in collaborazione con i responsabili regionali delle vendite e dei servizi / amministratori

• Assicurarsi che un efficace contatto cliente, la costruzione di relazioni e processi di gestione sono in atto per influenzare positivamente il cliente e creare una pre-disposizione per visualizzare Sulzer come fonte preferita di fornitura e utilizzare attivamente il sistema di gestione delle relazioni con il cliente (CRM)

• Mantenere la conoscenza delle tendenze del mercato e dell'industria, dei concorrenti, delle tecnologie e delle principali strategie dei clienti, soprattutto in relazione alla retrofit e alle attività di rivalutazione

• Proposte di produzione e di revisione del processo generale di proposta di sostegno

• Assicurarsi che le riunioni di consegna e la documentazione siano efficaci e si traducono in una transizione regolare da pre a post ordine

• Partecipazione alle riunioni di vendita e assicurarsi che tutte le informazioni pertinenti dall'area assegnata siano disponibili per il team di vendita

• Promuovere attivamente Retrofit anche se social media e altre piattaforme peer – internamente ed esternamente

• Aderisce a politiche, procedure e standard aziendali e dipartimentali

• Supporta, collabora e partecipa al sistema di gestione EHS a livello aziendale che include seguendo tutte le politiche e le procedure di sicurezza, salute e ambiente. Supporta e collabora nello sforzo aziendale di Gestione della Qualità.

• 4 anni di esperienza rilevante nell'industria della pompa

• Esperienza rilevante all'interno dell'industria correlata – a monte, raffinazione, petrolchimica, tubatura e potenza.

• Esperienza di esecuzione e strategie di costruzione

• Esperienza di vendita tecnica / consultiva

• Conoscenza della progettazione, applicazione e selezione della pompa

• Conoscenza degli aggiornamenti generali della pompa

• Deve avere buone capacità organizzative, attenzione ai dettagli e capacità di lavorare indipendentemente

• Deve avere patente valida e passaporto ed essere in grado di viaggiare a livello internazionale

• Forte capacità di comunicazione e di negoziazione

Sur le rôle

L'ingénieur commercial est chargé de soutenir le processus de vente en fournissant une expertise technique, en aidant à la démonstration de produits et en préparant des propositions. Ce rôle travaille en étroite collaboration avec les ingénieurs supérieurs et les équipes de vente pour s'assurer que les exigences des clients sont satisfaites.
Ce profil d'emploi est destiné aux professionnels en début de carrière qui appliquent de vastes connaissances théoriques et qui ont besoin de la capacité d'étudier et d'analyser les problèmes. Les solutions sont généralement discutées/vérifiées avec un membre plus âgé

Il s'agit de déterminer les possibilités de réaménagement et de modernisation des projets et de les mener à la livraison rapide des commandes. Vos principales tâches et responsabilités:

• En tant que point de contact principal et consultant technique auprès de l'équipe de vente ou de l'utilisateur final / client pour les demandes de Retrofit et les activités connexes pour la région désignée

• Appuyer le chef des projets de rénovation avec l'élaboration du plan stratégique régional global, du plan de vente et des projets d'amélioration continue

• Élaboration des plans de compte/région pour la croissance des possibilités de rénovation sur le territoire de vente attribué en utilisant les connaissances techniques et les exigences du marché des clients comme moteurs

• Responsable des initiatives à l'intérieur du territoire de vente désigné pour promouvoir l'identification des possibilités de modernisation grâce à l'exécution de tâches telles que les forums techniques, les contrôles de santé ou les évaluations d'actifs, les visites des clients, les sessions de formation interne, etc.

• Appuyer les contributions au processus de prévisions glissantes (FBC) pour le territoire de vente désigné en collaboration avec les gestionnaires régionaux des ventes et des services/directeurs

• S'assurer que des processus efficaces de communication avec le client, d'établissement des relations et de gestion sont en place pour influencer positivement le client et créer une prédisposition à considérer Sulzer comme la source d'approvisionnement préférée et utiliser activement le système de gestion de la relation client (CRM)

• Maintenir une connaissance des tendances du marché et de l'industrie, des concurrents, des technologies et des principales stratégies de la clientèle, en particulier en ce qui concerne la modernisation et la réévaluation des activités

• Produire et examiner des propositions et appuyer le processus global de proposition

• Veiller à ce que les réunions et la documentation soient efficaces et permettent une transition sans heurt de l ' état d ' avancement des travaux avant et après la publication de l ' ordre.

• Participation aux réunions de vente et veiller à ce que toute l'information pertinente provenant de la zone attribuée soit disponible pour l'équipe de vente

• Promouvoir activement les améliorations par le biais des médias sociaux et d'autres plateformes de pairs – à l'interne et à l'externe

• Adhérer aux politiques, procédures et normes de l'entreprise et du ministère

• Soutient, coopère avec et participe au système de gestion EHS à l'échelle de l'entreprise, qui comprend le suivi de toutes les politiques et procédures en matière de sécurité, de santé et d'environnement. Soutient et coopère aux efforts de gestion de la qualité à l'échelle de l'entreprise.

• Exécute d'autres fonctions au besoin

Pour réussir dans ce rôle, vous devrez :

• Diplôme en génie mécanique ou domaine connexe.

• 4 ans d'expérience dans l'industrie des pompes

• Expérience pertinente au sein de l'industrie connexe – En amont, affinage, pétrochimie, pipeline et électricité.

• Expérience des stratégies d'exécution et de construction

• Expérience de la vente technique / consultative

• Connaissance de la conception, de l'application et de la sélection des pompes

• Connaissance des mises à niveau générales de la pompe

• Compétences en rédaction de rapport technique et de proposition

• Doivent avoir de bonnes compétences organisationnelles, une attention aux détails et une capacité de travail indépendante

• Doit avoir un permis de conduire et un passeport valides et être en mesure de voyager à l'étranger

• Forte capacité de communication et de négociation

• Voyages de 25 à 50 %

• Support the Global Process Owner (GPO) with system implementations.

• Proficient in ERP systems (SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365 or iScala) and accounting software.

• Strong MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint) skills.

• Strong attention to detail and accuracy.

• Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

About the role

Job Summary
The Tendering Engineer is responsible for providing technical support to sales teams and conducting technical analysis of product configurations to determine customer-specific pricing.
This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyze problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. Job Description
This job and its associated grade are specifically aligned with roles that have the following scope of responsibility:

• Overall responsibility to ensure that initiated projects meet company requirements in terms of selection, pricing, terms and conditions and lead time. Ensure application of Sulzer tools and policies, procedures, codes of conduct and best practice guidelines

• Review inquiry documents/specifications and prepares quality quotations on time for Sulzer Pumps' products using current tendering tools & procedures independently or with guidance

• Analyzing customer requirements, particularly of complex applications and products for relevant market / application

• Independent development of suitable technical solutions with the involvement of specialist departments

• Consulting customers and the sales team on possible pump applications and in preparation of specifications, Configuration of pumps and accessories

• Enquiry and evaluation of subcontractor offers as well as corresponding expediting

• Co-operation with the plants in the Energy & Infrastructure Business Unit factory network

• Analysis and evaluation of commercial as well as technical risks of projects at the bidding stage, corresponding negotiations together with specialist departments as well as development of approaches to minimize risks in the event of an order

• Preparation and realization of presentations of technical offers

L'Ingegnere di Tendering è responsabile di fornire supporto tecnico ai team di vendita e di condurre analisi tecniche delle configurazioni dei prodotti per determinare i prezzi specifici del cliente.
Questo profilo di lavoro è destinato a professionisti precoci che applicano una vasta conoscenza teorica e richiedono la capacità di indagare e analizzare i problemi. Le soluzioni sono tipicamente discusse/verificati con un membro più anziano. Descrizione del lavoro

• Complessivamente la responsabilità di garantire che i progetti avviati soddisfino i requisiti aziendali in termini di selezione, prezzi, termini e condizioni e tempi di consegna. Assicurare l'applicazione di strumenti e politiche di Sulzer, procedure, codici di condotta e linee guida di best practice

• Richiesta di revisione documenti/specificazioni e prepara quotazioni di qualità in tempo per i prodotti di Sulzer Pumps utilizzando attuali strumenti di tendering e procedure indipendentemente o con guida

• Analizzando i requisiti dei clienti, in particolare applicazioni complesse e prodotti per il mercato / applicazione rilevante

• Sviluppo indipendente di soluzioni tecniche adeguate con il coinvolgimento di dipartimenti specializzati

• Consulenza clienti e team di vendita su possibili applicazioni di pompa e in preparazione di specifiche, configurazione di pompe e accessori

• Richiesta e valutazione delle offerte subappaltatori nonché corrispondente scadenza

• Cooperazione con gli impianti della rete di fabbrica Energy & Infrastructure Business Unit

• Analisi e valutazione dei rischi commerciali e tecnici dei progetti in fase di appalto, trattative corrispondenti con i dipartimenti specializzati e sviluppo di approcci per minimizzare i rischi in caso di ordine

• Preparazione e realizzazione di presentazioni di offerte tecniche

• Gestione indiretta e coordinamento con funzioni multidisciplinari nell'ambito della preparazione delle offerte

• Preparazione di offerte tecniche/commerciali di alta qualità in linea con i requisiti di mercato

• Citazione di revisione ricevuta e sfida come necessario interna e parti interessate esterne per garantire una proposta competitiva è presentato incontro Vendite / attesa di mercato

• Familiare con i rischi e i rischi all'interno delle attività e dei processi del ruolo e delle procedure, pratiche e misure in atto per mitigare i rischi.

• Principali negoziati tecnici con i subappaltatori

• Garantire una consegna completa e di successo al team di progetto

• Manutenzione regolare dei nostri sistemi di vendita e dei dati in esso contenuti

Sulzer ist ein führendes Ingenieurunternehmen mit einem stolzen Erbe an Innovationen. Schließen Sie sich unserem globalen Team an, um Ihr Fachwissen zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine wohlhabende und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen.

Über die Rolle

Stellenbeschreibung
Der Tendering Engineer ist verantwortlich für die technische Unterstützung der Vertriebsteams und die Durchführung der technischen Analyse der Produktkonfigurationen zur Bestimmung der kundenspezifischen Preise.
Dieses Stellenprofil richtet sich an Berufseinsteiger, die ein breites theoretisches Wissen anwenden und die Fähigkeit benötigen, Probleme zu untersuchen und zu analysieren. Lösungen werden in der Regel mit einem älteren Mitglied diskutiert / verifiziert. Stellenbeschreibung
Dieser Job und die damit verbundene Klasse sind speziell auf Rollen ausgerichtet, die folgenden Verantwortungsbereich haben:

• Gesamtverantwortung dafür, dass initiierte Projekte die Anforderungen des Unternehmens in Bezug auf Auswahl, Preisgestaltung, Bedingungen und Vorlaufzeit erfüllen. Gewährleistung der Anwendung von Sulzer-Tools und -Richtlinien, Verfahren, Verhaltenskodizes und Leitlinien für bewährte Verfahren

• Überprüfen Sie die Anfragedokumente / -spezifikationen und erstellen Sie rechtzeitig Qualitätsangebote für die Produkte von Sulzer Pumps unter Verwendung der aktuellen Ausschreibungstools und -verfahren unabhängig oder mit Anleitung

• Analyse von Kundenanforderungen, insbesondere von komplexen Anwendungen und Produkten für relevanten Markt / Anwendung

• Eigenständige Entwicklung geeigneter technischer Lösungen unter Einbeziehung von Fachabteilungen

• Beratung der Kunden und des Vertriebsteams zu möglichen Pumpenanwendungen und bei der Erstellung von Spezifikationen, Konfiguration von Pumpen und Zubehör

• Abfrage und Auswertung von Subunternehmerangeboten sowie entsprechende Beschleunigung

• Kooperation mit den Werken im Werksverbund Energy & Infrastructure Business Unit

• Analyse und Bewertung kaufmännischer sowie technischer Risiken von Projekten in der Ausschreibungsphase, entsprechende Verhandlungen gemeinsam mit Fachabteilungen sowie Entwicklung von Ansätzen zur Risikominimierung im Auftragsfall

• Erstellung und Realisierung von Präsentationen technischer Angebote

• Indirektes Management & Koordination mit multidisziplinären Funktionen im Rahmen der Angebotsvorbereitung

• Erstellung hochwertiger technischer/kommerzieller Angebote entsprechend den Marktanforderungen

• Rezensionsangebot erhalten und fordern Sie bei Bedarf interne sowie externe Stakeholder heraus, um sicherzustellen, dass ein Wettbewerbsvorschlag eingereicht wird, der die Umsatz- / Markterwartung erfüllt

• Vertraut mit den Risiken und Gefahren innerhalb der Aktivitäten und Prozesse der Rolle und Verfahren, Praktiken und Maßnahmen zur Minderung der Risiken.

• Teilnahme an Verkaufsverhandlungen, entsprechende Vorbereitung und Nachbereitung in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Vertrieb

• Führende technische Verhandlungen mit Subunternehmern

• Sicherstellung einer vollständigen und erfolgreichen Auftragsübergabe an das Projektteam

• Regelmäßige Wartung unserer Vertriebssysteme und der darin enthaltenen Daten

• Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes technisches Studium (ideal Maschinenbau, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder Verfahrenstechnik oder gleichwertig)

• Erfahrung in mindestens einer der folgenden Disziplinen: Pumpendesign, internationale Ausschreibung oder Verkauf, Projektmanagement oder gleichwertiges

• Idealerweise interkulturelle Kompetenzen

• Fundierte Kenntnisse von Pumpen oder rotierenden Geräten und Zubehör

Sulzer est une société d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable.

Sur le rôle

Résumé de l'emploi
L'ingénieur d'appel d'offres est chargé de fournir un soutien technique aux équipes de vente et d'effectuer une analyse technique des configurations de produits pour déterminer les prix propres à la clientèle.
Ce profil d'emploi est destiné aux professionnels en début de carrière qui appliquent de vastes connaissances théoriques et ont besoin de la capacité d'étudier et d'analyser les problèmes. Les solutions sont généralement discutées/vérifiées avec un membre plus âgé. Description de l'emploi
Ce travail et la note qui y est associée sont spécifiquement alignés sur les rôles qui ont la portée de responsabilité suivante :

• Responsabilité globale de s'assurer que les projets lancés répondent aux exigences de l'entreprise en termes de sélection, de prix, de modalités et de délais. Assurer l'application des outils et des politiques, des procédures, des codes de conduite et des lignes directrices sur les meilleures pratiques Sulzer

• Examiner les documents d'enquête/spécifications et préparer les devis de qualité à temps pour les produits de Sulzer Pumps en utilisant les outils et procédures d'appel d'offres actuels indépendamment ou avec des conseils

• Analyser les besoins des clients, notamment en ce qui concerne les applications et les produits complexes pour le marché / application pertinent

• Développement indépendant de solutions techniques appropriées avec la participation de départements spécialisés

• Consultation des clients et de l'équipe de vente sur les applications possibles des pompes et en préparation des spécifications, Configuration des pompes et accessoires

• Enquête et évaluation des offres de sous-traitants et accélération correspondante

• Coopération avec les installations du réseau industriel Energy & Infrastructure Business Unit

• Analyse et évaluation des risques commerciaux et techniques des projets au stade de l'appel d'offres, négociations correspondantes avec les départements spécialisés et élaboration d'approches pour minimiser les risques en cas de commande

• Préparation et réalisation de présentations d'offres techniques

• Gestion indirecte et coordination avec les fonctions multidisciplinaires dans le cadre de la préparation des soumissions

• Préparation d'offres techniques/commerciales de haute qualité conformes aux exigences du marché

• Examiner les soumissions reçues et contester au besoin les intervenants internes et externes afin de s'assurer qu'une proposition concurrentielle est soumise à l'attente des ventes et du marché

• Connaissance des risques et des dangers associés aux activités et aux processus liés au rôle, aux procédures, aux pratiques et aux mesures en place pour atténuer les risques.

• Participation aux négociations commerciales, préparation correspondante et suivi en coopération avec le service des ventes

• Assister à des réunions de clarification avec les clients au besoin et fournir tout le soutien nécessaire à Ventes pour s'assurer que la solution offerte répond aux exigences des spécifications/clients tout en soulignant notre avantage concurrentiel

• Principales négociations techniques avec les sous-traitants

• Assurer un transfert de commande complet et réussi à l'équipe du projet

• Maintenance régulière de nos systèmes de vente et des données qu'ils contiennent

Expérience professionnelle : >5 ans

Expertise (p. ex. professionnelle, technique) :

• Études techniques terminées avec succès (idéalement en génie mécanique, en génie industriel ou en génie des procédés ou égales)

• Mode de travail structuré, capacité à résoudre les problèmes complexes avec l'équipe de soumission

• Expérience dans au moins une des disciplines suivantes: conception de pompe, appel d'offres ou ventes internationaux, gestion de projet ou équivalent

• Compétences interculturelles idéales

• Connaissances sonores des pompes ou des équipements et accessoires rotatifs

Ce que nous vous offrons

22 jours de vacances + 9 jours Congés occasionnels + 8 jours Congés maladie + 13 jours Vacances festival
Régime de pension à cotisations définies
Assurance hospitalisation
Prix de longue durée
